photo_note: Photos are Wikimedia Commons thumbnails (hotlinked) with author and licence shown, or owner-supplied uploads in /assets/images with written permission. Never copy photos or data from other location databases; record only what a venue itself publishes, and keep source URLs.

locations.name: Amalienbad
locations.setting: Art Deco public indoor swimming pool built in the 1920s in Favoriten, with a 33.3 by 12.5 metre sports pool, a historic diving platform up to 10 metres, a children's pool and separate men's and women's sauna areas.
locations.facilities: Indoor sports pool, diving platform, children's pool, men's and women's sauna areas, showers and changing rooms
locations.suitability: Interior filming, permit applied for through the Vienna Film Commission's application tool

locations.name: Astoria Garage
locations.setting: A six-storey spiral-ramp tower garage in Vienna's Josefstadt district, built from 1935 with a glass-domed fuelling area, daylight-filled floors and an accessible roof.

locations.name: AVbaby Motion Pictures Studio
locations.setting: A film, photo and virtual production studio with a sound recording room and coworking space in Graz, described by its operator as the largest such facility in Styria.
locations.facilities: Film, photo and virtual production studio space with a sound recording studio, equipment rental and coworking space; exact stage dimensions are not published.
locations.logistics: Puchstrasse 41, 8020 Graz.

locations.name: Bergisel Ski Jump
locations.setting: Zaha Hadid's 2002 ski jump tower on Innsbruck's Bergisel hill, combining a competition in-run and judging tower with a public viewing platform and cafe over the city.
locations.facilities: Bergisel Sky restaurant/bar has 360-degree glazing and holds a maximum of 120 people. The SeminarRaum seats up to 80 people and has a 10 m2 whiteboard wall. The SeminarLounge holds groups of up to 16, about 40 people total with additional elements.

locations.name: Börsensäle, Vienna Stock Exchange
locations.setting: Three bookable 19th century ballrooms on the upper floor of the former Vienna Stock Exchange building, fitted with a passenger lift and a freight lift, not normally open to the public.
locations.facilities: Three ballrooms, passenger and freight lift, lighting control, kitchen access, office and conference rooms

locations.name: Bregenz Festival House
locations.setting: A lakeside festival hall on Lake Constance, home of the Bregenz Festival's floating stage and indoor auditorium, backed by mountain views.

locations.name: Brigittenauer Bad
locations.setting: A municipal indoor and outdoor swimming complex in Vienna's Brigittenau district, with plain functional architecture, large glazed halls and outdoor lawns for everyday, present-day scenes.
locations.facilities: Indoor multipurpose pool, teaching pool and heated pool with sauna area; outdoor non-swimmer pool, sunbathing lawns and water playground

locations.name: Brunnenmarkt
locations.setting: A 948 metre open-air street market with around 170 stalls in Vienna's Ottakring district, dating to 1786 and merged with the former Yppenmarkt in 2009, repaved as a level pedestrian zone since 2010.

locations.name: Burgtheater
locations.setting: Austria's national theatre on the Ringstrasse, a grand 19th-century building with ceremonial staircases, foyers and a horseshoe-shaped auditorium.

locations.name: Casino Wien
locations.setting: A casino across four floors of the Baroque Palais Esterhazy on Vienna's Kaerntner Strasse, with a ground-floor jackpot hall, roulette, blackjack and baccarat tables, a bar and a restaurant.

locations.name: Danube Tower
locations.setting: A 1964 observation and telecommunications tower above Vienna's Donaupark, with an express lift to platforms near 150 metres, a revolving restaurant at 170 metres and a cafe at 160 metres.

locations.name: Das Off Theater
locations.setting: A black-box theatre in Vienna's Neubau district with fixed, steeply raked seating, a stage 6 metres wide and up to 12 metres deep, plus a cloakroom and theatre bar.

locations.name: Depot (Kunst und Diskussion)
locations.setting: An art and discussion venue on Breite Gasse in Vienna's Neubau district, with a 36 square metre cafe and a 75 square metre function room seating around 100, plus a small outdoor terrace.

locations.name: Donaustaedter Bad
locations.setting: A municipal multi-purpose pool complex in Vienna's Donaustadt district in late-modern style, with indoor and outdoor swimming areas and a sauna facility.

locations.name: Dschungel Wien
locations.setting: A children's and youth theatre in Vienna's MuseumsQuartier with three stages, two studio spaces, a foyer box office and its own cafe.

locations.name: Ernst Fuchs Museum (Otto Wagner Villa)
locations.setting: A museum in Otto Wagner's 1888 Villa I in Vienna's Penzing district, combining the architect's original interiors with large-format paintings by Ernst Fuchs and a garden fountain pavilion.

locations.name: Erzberg
locations.setting: Open-pit iron ore mine near Eisenerz with terraced orange slopes over 700 metres high, a tourist park offering truck and cable tours through the workings, and host to the annual Erzbergrodeo enduro race.
locations.facilities: The Bohrerschmiede event space accommodates up to 100 people (own site).

locations.name: Filmcasino
locations.setting: An arthouse cinema in Vienna's Margareten district screening independent films in their original language, listed in the city film commission's location catalogue.

locations.name: Filmhaus Kino am Spittelberg
locations.setting: A cinema in Vienna's Spittelberg quarter with a 100-seat auditorium, a small bar, and both analogue and digital projection able to show ratios from 1.33:1 to 2.35:1.

locations.name: Floridsdorfer Markt
locations.setting: A neighbourhood market in Vienna's Floridsdorf district with permanent food stalls and a larger farmers market on Fridays and Saturdays.

locations.name: Flughafen Wien Aspern (Seestadt)
locations.setting: The site of Vienna's historic Aspern airfield, now redeveloped as the Seestadt district, retaining some early aviation-era structures amid new urban blocks.

locations.name: Foundation Gänsehäufel
locations.setting: Former tennis clubhouse on a wooded island in the Old Danube, now run as an independent art, production and event space with its own artist residency.
locations.facilities: 65 sqm interior, 50 sqm outdoor area, electricity and water connections, WC

locations.name: Frames Virtual Production Studio
locations.setting: A virtual production and film studio in Vienna's Liesing district with an 8 by 4 metre high-resolution LED volume, built for car commercials, music videos and driving shoots.

locations.name: Gasometer Vienna
locations.setting: Four former 19th-century gasholders in Vienna's Simmering district, rebuilt with glass domes into apartments, offices, a shopping mall, cinema and event hall around their original brick shells.
locations.facilities: Tower A commercial space available from 30 sqm, from EUR 16 per sqm net; concert hall capacity up to 4,200 visitors with more than 100 events a year; over 22,000 sqm of shopping area on site (own site).
locations.logistics: U3 subway station Gasometer on site; on-site parking garage with 1,100 spaces, first 1.5 hours free (own site).

locations.name: GrandurFilmStudio
locations.setting: A small 48 square metre photo and video studio with changeable backdrops in Carinthia, offering studio rental and equipment for local film and commercial production.
locations.price_note: Studio hire EUR 90 per hour Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00, EUR 110 per hour on weekday nights (18:00 to 08:00) and Saturdays, EUR 130 per hour on Sundays (own site)
locations.facilities: 48 m2 studio (8.0 x 6.0 m), 5.5 m ceiling, changeable white, black, grey and chroma-key blue backdrops, Kino Flo lighting adjustable 2900-5500K, 220V and 380V power connections, guest lounge and dressing area; the operator also offers access to a fairground with seven halls for larger productions.
locations.logistics: Klagenfurt am Worthersee, Carinthia.

locations.name: Halle E+G, MuseumsQuartier
locations.setting: Two multipurpose halls in the former imperial stables at Vienna's MuseumsQuartier, with a foyer, colonnaded entrance and backstage production offices, used for concerts, exhibitions and events.
locations.facilities: Ground-level access, backstage dressing rooms and production offices, freight and passenger lift, high-voltage power

locations.name: Hallstatt
locations.setting: Lakeside Alpine village of stacked wooden and stucco houses between the Hallstatter See and a steep mountainside, reachable by funicular to the salt mine above.

locations.name: Hangar-7
locations.setting: Curved glass and steel aviation hangar at Salzburg Airport housing the Flying Bulls historic aircraft collection, a restaurant and event spaces beneath its open-span dome roof.

locations.name: Heidi Horten Collection
locations.setting: A private art museum in a former archducal chancellery building of 1914 at Hanuschhof in Vienna's first district, with about 1,500 square metres of exhibition space and a Classical Modernism and Pop Art collection.

locations.name: Hotel Imperial Riding School Vienna, Autograph Collection
locations.setting: A hotel in the former Imperial Spanish Riding School building in Vienna's Landstrasse district, with guest rooms overlooking either a sculpture garden or the nearby Russian Orthodox church.

locations.name: Hotel Kaiserhof Wien
locations.setting: A 4-star hotel on a quiet side street in Vienna's Wieden district, opened in 1896, with turn-of-the-century interiors and room categories running from Classic to newly renovated Superior rooms.

locations.name: Hotel Sacher Vienna
locations.setting: Grand 1876 hotel opposite the State Opera, with red-panelled parlours, a chandeliered dining room and the original Sachertorte kitchen.
locations.facilities: The Marble Hall has a marble floor, marble-clad walls and chandeliers, and can be divided into two rooms with a mirrored wall. Capacity: cocktail 150, theatre 110, banquet 80, classroom 54, block table 50, U-table 50.

locations.name: Hotel Schani Wien Hauptbahnhof
locations.setting: Independent 135-room hotel opened in 2015 next to Vienna's main railway station, with a courtyard garden, rooftop space, co-working area and seminar rooms across six floors.
locations.facilities: Courtyard garden, rooftop space, co-working area, seminar and conference rooms, loading elevator, parking

locations.name: House 4, Semmelweis Clinic Vienna
locations.setting: A listed former supply wing of the closed Semmelweis maternity clinic in Vienna's Waehring district, now in interim cultural use with studios, event space, cellars and an untouched attic.

locations.name: HQ7 Studios
locations.setting: Two sound stages of 2,000 and 1,000 square metres with 12.5 metre ceilings at HQ7 Studios in Vienna-Simmering, built for international film and TV production including virtual production.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 2,000 m2, 12.5 m height, full grid 72 x 28 m; Stage 2: 1,000 m2, 12.5 m height, full grid 35 x 28 m. Both stages are soundproof, have stage doors of 4.15 x 5 m and concrete floors. Ancillary space: 2,000 m2 of offices and workshops plus 600 m2 of flex space for costume and wardrobe, fixed sets (pathology, hospital unit, surgery room), parking, 24/7 access, wifi and optical internet.
locations.logistics: 7. Haidequerstrasse 6, 1110 Vienna (Simmering).

locations.name: Interspot Film
locations.setting: Four studios from 140 to 500 square metres at Interspot Film in Vienna's Liesing district, with a large control room and full production crew available on request.
locations.facilities: Four studios with usable areas from 140 to 500 m2, a large control room, complete production staff on request, and additional equipment rental.
locations.suitability: The studios are used for live TV recordings with and without a studio audience; production, makeup and wardrobe rooms are attached to the studio complex.
locations.logistics: Walter-Jurmann-Gasse 4, 1230 Vienna.

locations.name: Justizpalast Wien
locations.setting: Vienna's historicist Palace of Justice, seat of the supreme and administrative courts, with a monumental stone facade and galleried central hall.

locations.name: Karl-Marx-Hof
locations.setting: A monumental 1920s municipal housing block from Vienna's Red Vienna period, stretching over a kilometre with arched gateways, courtyards and a reddish facade.

locations.name: Karmelitermarkt
locations.setting: Working food market in Leopoldstadt dating to 1910, with daily stalls and about 60 farmers' market stands on Fridays and Saturdays, offering both indoor and outdoor filming space.
locations.suitability: Interior and exterior filming (Innen- und Aussenbereich)

locations.name: Kirche am Steinhof (Klinik Penzing)
locations.setting: Otto Wagner's Art Nouveau hospital church of 1907 crowning a hillside campus of pavilion wards built for the former Lower Austrian asylum, now Vienna's Klinik Penzing.

locations.name: Kitzbühel
locations.setting: Alpine market town below the Hahnenkamm and Kitzbueheler Horn, with a pastel-fronted medieval centre and ski infrastructure running from the streets onto the pistes.

locations.name: Kongressbad
locations.setting: An open-air municipal pool in Vienna's Ottakring district, opened in 1928 during the Red Vienna era, with a heritage-protected entrance and red-and-white wooden facades.

locations.name: Krapfenwaldlbad
locations.setting: An open-air bath on Vienna's Kahlenberg hill in the Doebling district, with several pools, wide sunbathing lawns and a view over the city; the main building and 1920s Waldhaus keep their original look.

locations.name: Kunsthaus Graz
locations.setting: Biomorphic blue-panelled contemporary art museum of 2003 on the Mur riverbank, its bulging acrylic shell fitted with roof-top nozzle skylights beside Graz's baroque old town.
locations.facilities: Rentable spaces named on site are Space04 (meeting/presentation room) and Needle (elevated glass observation platform) (own site).

locations.name: Kunstlerhaus Wien
locations.setting: An 1868 exhibition and social hall at Vienna's Karlsplatz, built in the style of an Italian Renaissance villa for the country's largest artists' association, fully renovated with modern event technology.

locations.name: Kutschkermarkt
locations.setting: A neighbourhood market in Vienna's Waehring district with classic stalls for fresh produce, flowers, cheese, fish and meat alongside food stands.

locations.name: Laaerbergbad
locations.setting: An outdoor swimming pool from the late 1950s on a slope of the Laaer Berg in Vienna's Favoriten district, with a wave pool, a multi-purpose pool, diving facilities and mature trees.

locations.name: Leopold Museum
locations.setting: A museum of Austrian art from the late 19th century to 1945 in Vienna's MuseumsQuartier, housed in a white limestone-clad cube with about 5,400 square metres of exhibition space over five floors.

locations.name: mumok - Museum moderner Kunst
locations.setting: A museum of modern and contemporary art in Vienna's MuseumsQuartier, built as a dark anthracite basalt block with a curved roof and column-free exhibition floors of up to 700 square metres.

locations.name: Museum Arbeitswelt Steyr
locations.setting: Museum of industrial and labour history housed in a former weapons and bicycle factory hall in Steyr's Wehrgraben quarter, with original machine-hall interiors.
locations.price_note: Venue hire from EUR 190 for a half day (up to 6 hours, Seminar Room 2) up to EUR 1,460 for a full day (Large Hall), prices exclude 20% VAT, valid through 31 December 2026 (own site).
locations.facilities: Rooms: Large Hall 380 sqm, Small Hall 140 sqm, Seminar Room 1 80 sqm, Seminar Room 2 60 sqm, Gallery 270 sqm; evening surcharge after 20:00 of EUR 65 per hour; setup on the day before costs 30% of the room rate (own site).

locations.name: Naschmarkt
locations.setting: A 1.5-kilometre open-air market along the Wienzeile with produce stalls, delicatessens and restaurants, and a Saturday flea market at its western end.

locations.name: Natural History Museum of Vienna
locations.setting: A historicist museum on Vienna's Ringstrasse with 39 exhibition rooms holding the Venus of Willendorf, dinosaur skeletons and a large meteorite collection, alongside active research departments.

locations.name: Ottakringer Bad
locations.setting: A combined indoor and outdoor pool in Vienna's Ottakring district, with a diving pool, separate saunas, a steam room, a cold plunge pool and an outdoor adventure pool with slides.

locations.name: Palais Auersperg
locations.setting: A baroque city palace in Vienna's Josefstadt district with a grand ballroom, smaller salons and a garden, hired out for period and contemporary film, photo and commercial productions.

locations.name: Palais Kinsky
locations.setting: A baroque palace on the Freyung in Vienna's Innere Stadt district; five rooms on its second floor are rented out separately for filming, with a hall supervisor on site and a small goods lift.

locations.name: Palais Niederoesterreich
locations.setting: A former seat of the Lower Austrian Estates on Herrengasse in central Vienna, dating back to the 16th century, now an event venue with historic rooms such as the Landtagssaal and Rittersaal.

locations.name: Rochusmarkt
locations.setting: A compact, roughly 3,500 square metre neighbourhood market in Vienna's Landstrasse district, with market stalls and surrounding shops giving it an everyday urban market look.

locations.name: Salzburg Old Town
locations.setting: Baroque old town of church domes, squares and narrow lanes beneath the Hohensalzburg fortress on the Salzach river.

locations.name: Sanatorium Purkersdorf
locations.setting: An early modernist sanatorium building from 1905 on the edge of the Vienna Woods, with a clean white geometric facade, now used for events.

photo.author: derivative work: Alberto Fernandez Fernandez (talk) Sanatoriumpurkersdorf1.JPG: Roman Klementschitz, Wien

locations.name: Schönbrunn Palace
locations.setting: Baroque imperial summer palace with more than 1,400 rooms, formal gardens, the Gloriette hilltop folly and a historic zoo.
locations.price_note: Outdoor motion pictures or commercial projects from EUR 6,600 per day (incl. 20% VAT), minimum fee. Smaller outdoor documentaries and travel reports: EUR 333 per hour (incl. 13% VAT). Indoor filming beyond private use: EUR 333 per hour for smaller productions; large-scale indoor productions on request. Prices valid from 27 March 2026 (own site).
locations.suitability: Filming beyond private use requires prior written approval from the Schonbrunn Group, requested at least 3 weeks ahead. Indoor filming beyond private use is only allowed outside regular opening hours: battery-powered lighting only (max 12V per head, 100V total), flash photography is prohibited, and furniture may not be moved. Outdoor filming for private purposes needs no approval, but drones, barriers and climbing on structures are not allowed in the park (own site).

locations.name: Semmering Railway
locations.setting: The world's first standard-gauge mountain railway, opened in 1854, still an operating OBB main line with sixteen tunnels and stone viaducts climbing the Semmering pass.

locations.name: Simmeringer Bad
locations.setting: A multi-purpose municipal swimming facility in Vienna's Simmering district, with indoor and outdoor pools, a toddler pool, a slide tower and sunbathing lawns bordered by trees.

locations.name: Sölden
locations.setting: High Alpine ski resort village in the Ötztal valley with glacier roads climbing to 2,800 metres and a summit restaurant at 3,048 metres.

locations.name: Stadtkino im Kunstlerhaus
locations.setting: An arthouse cinema built in 1947 inside Vienna's Kunstlerhaus building on Akademiestrasse, with a decorated period interior, a foyer restaurant and its own festival programme.

locations.name: State Hall of the Austrian National Library
locations.setting: A Baroque hall built between 1723 and 1726 for Emperor Charles VI's court library, now the ceremonial state hall of the Austrian National Library on Josefsplatz.

locations.name: Steigenberger Hotel Herrenhof Vienna
locations.setting: A listed 1913 building on Herrengasse in central Vienna, originally built as a school, now a hotel with 196 rooms, a bar, event spaces and penthouse suites overlooking the rooftops.

locations.name: Tabakfabrik Linz
locations.setting: A converted 1935 Bauhaus-style tobacco factory in Linz, now a creative and start-up quarter with exhibition halls, event spaces and a rooftop terrace across the Danube from the old town.
locations.facilities: About 2,500 m2 of event space across multiple halls and outdoor areas, wheelchair accessible. Technical equipment can be customised and an on-site fire safety officer is mandatory; a preferred caterer is required only for the Hoersaal 0 hall.

locations.name: Technisches Museum Wien
locations.setting: Austria's largest museum of technology and industry, on Mariahilfer Strasse in Vienna's Penzing district, combining historic collection halls with exhibitions on current science and engineering.

locations.name: Theresienbad
locations.setting: A public indoor and outdoor swimming bath in Vienna's Meidling district, reopened in the 1960s and still showing some original mosaic decoration alongside a children's pool section.

locations.name: Thuryhof
locations.setting: 1920s municipal housing block in Alsergrund built over a former brickyard, with fortress-like courtyards, arcades and round-arched loggias, listed as a protected historic building.

locations.name: University of Vienna Main Building
locations.setting: Historicist university building of 1884 on the Ringstrasse, with an arcaded courtyard of scholars' monuments, a grand ceremonial hall and lecture theatres.

locations.name: Vienna City Hall (Rathaus)
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic seat of Vienna's city government from 1883, with a vaulted arcaded courtyard, ceremonial halls and a square in front used for open-air events and markets.
locations.suitability: The City of Vienna's Film Commission is the central point of contact for film shoots in Vienna and supports national and international productions. Separate permits apply for filming on bridges and on public traffic areas.

locations.name: Vienna Open Lab
locations.setting: A public molecular biology laboratory at the Vienna BioCenter that opens working lab space to visitors, drawing close to 14,000 visitors a year.

locations.name: Vienna State Opera
locations.setting: An 1869 opera house on the Ringstrasse with a gilded auditorium, grand staircase and backstage areas that host around 350 performances a season.

locations.name: Vienna Synchron Stage
locations.setting: A 540 square metre scoring stage with up to 12 metre ceilings on the former Rosenhugel studio site in Vienna, built for orchestral film and game score recording.
locations.facilities: Stage A: 540 m2, 10.5 to 12 m ceiling height, capacity for orchestras of up to 130 musicians, with a published noise floor of 16 dB(A); plus Stage B and two isolation booths.
locations.logistics: Speisinger Strasse 121, 1230 Vienna (Liesing), on the former Rosenhugel Filmstudios site.

locations.name: Viktor-Adler-Markt
locations.setting: A neighbourhood market between Favoritenstrasse and Senefeldergasse in Vienna's Favoriten district, founded in 1877 and expanded in 1910, with a farmers' market section on Leibnizgasse.

locations.name: Volksoper Wien
locations.setting: Vienna's second opera house, a late-19th-century theatre staging opera, operetta and musicals, with a traditional gilded auditorium and backstage areas.

locations.name: weXelerate
locations.setting: An office, event and innovation hub of about 9,000 square metres across four floors in Vienna's Leopoldstadt district, with more than 20 individual offices and an on-site garage.
locations.facilities: About 9,000 sqm across four floors, more than 20 offices, on-site garage

locations.name: Wiener Riesenrad (Prater)
locations.setting: A 1897 giant Ferris wheel and adjoining amusement park on the edge of the Prater, with vintage gondola cabins and a fairground of rides, food stalls and an events hall.

locations.name: Wiener Stadthalle
locations.setting: Vienna's largest multi-purpose arena, opened in 1958, with several halls used for concerts, sport and exhibitions under a distinctive folded roof.
locations.facilities: Halle D: up to 16,000 capacity (10,741 seated), interior space 4,968 m2, foyer 2,120 m2, interior height 15.4 m, stage up to 476 m2 (adjustable height 1.20 to 2.00 m, 750 kg/m2 load capacity), 35 chain hoists (1,000 kg each) and 650 linear metres of trusses, rigging points 17 to 20 m high, roof load capacity 100 t evenly distributed. Halle F: up to 2,000 capacity (including 8 wheelchair spaces, reducible to 750 seated), usable area 5,081 m2, main foyer 1,300 m2, stage 27.2 x 15.3 m, 264 dimmer circuits, line-array sound system, multiple dressing rooms.
locations.suitability: Halle F is listed by the venue as suitable for concerts, music shows, touring productions, children's events, dance, cabaret, circus, product presentations, fashion shows, films, lectures and conferences.
locations.logistics: Halle D backstage loading has 3.70 m clearance and takes 25-tonne trucks; the foyer loading area has 4.30 m clearance; three 3-tonne electric forklifts are available on site. Electrical supply reaches up to 2,450A across distribution points, including Powerlock connections up to 1,250A.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Extrawurst assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: wolke19 at Ares Tower
locations.setting: Event and conference venue on the 19th to 21st floors of the Ares Tower office high-rise in Donau City, with a 220 square metre Sky Hall and a rooftop Sky Lobby with terrace and bar.
locations.facilities: Two meeting rooms, Sky Hall (220 sqm), Sky Lobby with terrace and bar, freight and passenger lift, high-voltage power

locations.name: wolke21 at Saturn Tower
locations.setting: A penthouse event space atop the Saturn Tower in Vienna's Donau City, with a 160 square metre sky lobby, a 50 square metre bar, a large foyer and a 160 square metre terrace with a near 360 degree view.
locations.facilities: 160 sqm sky lobby, 50 sqm bar area, 160 sqm terrace

locations.name: Wörthersee
locations.setting: A 19-kilometre subalpine lake ringed by resort towns, promenades, lidos and wooded hills between Klagenfurt and Velden.

locations.name: WU Vienna Library and Learning Center
locations.setting: The library building of Vienna's business university campus, a deconstructivist design by Zaha Hadid with sweeping concrete forms and glass atria.

locations.name: Abattoir, Anderlecht
locations.setting: Historic livestock market and food-hall complex in Anderlecht, Brussels, with weekend markets, the FOODMET food hall and renovated buildings used for events.
locations.logistics: 350 parking spaces across two levels in the MANUFAKTURE building, including 24 EV charging stations; site accessible via Nijverheidskaai 168.

locations.name: Abbaye d'Orval
locations.setting: Cistercian abbey near Florenville in Luxembourg province, with medieval ruins beside a working monastery known for its Trappist beer and cheese.

locations.name: Abbaye de Maredsous
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic Benedictine abbey near Denée in Namur province, founded in 1872, with a working monastery, cheese and beer production and a visitor centre.

locations.name: Abdij van Herkenrode
locations.setting: A former Cistercian abbey site on the edge of Hasselt with a walled herb garden, monastic outbuildings and a restored gatehouse.

locations.name: AED Studios
locations.setting: A studio complex on a former factory site in Lint near Antwerp, with 16 sound stages from 45 to 3,000 sqm, a deep water tank, backstage wings, workshops and a helipad.
locations.known_for: Grace of Monaco, Kursk, Largo Winch: Le prix de l'argent, Familie
locations.facilities: 16 sound stages ranging from 45 sqm to 3,000 sqm, including one of Europe's largest water-tank stages (25m x 35m, 4m deep); 5 separate backstage areas with guestrooms, green rooms, hair/make-up rooms and production offices; warehouses, a carpentry workshop, gym, cinema and helipad on a 5.5 hectare site.
locations.logistics: Near Kontich-Lint railway station and the A12 motorway between Antwerp and Brussels, with on-site parking for around 1,000 vehicles.

locations.name: Alden Biesen Castle
locations.setting: Moated former headquarters of the Teutonic Order in Bilzen with formal gardens and a museum, now a conference and cultural centre that lists availability for film shoots.
locations.suitability: Website lists availability for film shooting alongside conferences and events.

locations.name: Ancienne Belgique (AB)
locations.setting: Concert hall on Boulevard Anspach in central Brussels with two stages, offering the venue for private hire and running its own in-house production and photography team.
locations.facilities: Six rentable spaces: AB Connect 126 sqm (20-60 guests), AB Salon 63 sqm (54-110 guests), AB Antenna 145 sqm (50-120 guests), AB Rooftop 84 sqm (50-80 guests), AB Club 170 sqm (100-280 guests), AB Main Hall 442 sqm (500-2000 guests standing). Basic furniture (tables, chairs, reception tables) is included; technical support available for lighting, sound, projection and stage setup; wheelchair accessible.
locations.suitability: Recording and livestreaming is possible in the Main Hall, AB Club and AB Salon using a fixed camera setup (separate technical specifications document available on request).
locations.logistics: About 10 minutes' walk from Brussels Central Station; accessible by public transport or car.

locations.name: Aquatopia
locations.setting: A municipal indoor swimming pool complex in Aalst with a sports basin, recreational pools and slides used by local clubs and schools.

locations.name: Ascenseur de Strépy-Thieu
locations.setting: Boat lift on the Canal du Centre in Hainaut, part of a UNESCO-listed historic waterway with older hydraulic lifts nearby, raising vessels between two canal levels.

locations.name: Autoworld
locations.setting: Vintage and classic car museum in the Cinquantenaire park's Belvedere hall in Brussels, hired out as an event space for more than a thousand guests.
locations.facilities: Event space for over 1,000 guests among the car collection, with escape-game and audio-guide experiences.

locations.name: Blegny-Mine
locations.setting: Former coal mine near Liège, one of four coal mines in Europe still offering underground visits through its original shaft and galleries.

locations.name: Bois du Cazier
locations.setting: Former coal mine at Marcinelle near Charleroi with preserved headframes and pithead buildings, site of the 1956 mining disaster, now housing industry and glass museums.

locations.name: Bozar
locations.setting: Centre for Fine Arts in central Brussels hosting concerts, exhibitions and film screenings across several halls, with a dedicated team for private and corporate venue hire.
locations.facilities: Seven hireable spaces: Henry Le Boeuf Hall, Hall M, Studio, Horta Hall, Terarken Hall, Suzanne Bertouille Rotunda and Royal Salon.

locations.name: Bruges Historic Centre
locations.setting: Intact medieval city centre of canals, cobbled streets, stepped-gable brick houses and the towering thirteenth-century Belfry.

locations.name: C-mine
locations.setting: Former Winterslag coalmine in Genk with preserved headframes and a compressor hall, now a creative cluster of more than 30 spaces that are rented out for events.
locations.facilities: Seven renovated former mine buildings around C-mine square with more than 30 rental spaces, indoor and outdoor, ranging from small to large; includes theatre halls, meeting rooms, and open spaces for catering and exhibitions.

locations.name: Centre Belge de la Bande Dessinée
locations.setting: Comic strip museum in a 1906 Art Nouveau former textile warehouse designed by Victor Horta in central Brussels, with galleries, a library and a brasserie.

locations.name: Château de Beloeil
locations.setting: 18th and 19th-century château of the Ligne family in Beloeil, Hainaut, with formal French gardens, a long ornamental lake and rooms open to the public.
locations.known_for: Les Jeux de société, Angélique, L'échange des princesses, La Guerre des trônes

locations.name: Château de Bouillon
locations.setting: Medieval fortress overlooking the town of Bouillon and the Semois river in Luxembourg province, one of Belgium's oldest surviving feudal castles.

locations.name: Château de Freÿr
locations.setting: Renaissance chateau on a bend of the Meuse near Hastière with terraced 18th-century gardens, whose barn and orangeries can be booked for events.
locations.suitability: Drones are prohibited on site.
locations.logistics: On-site parking for coach buses, cars and bikes; a boat jetty is available.

locations.name: Château de Jehay
locations.setting: Renaissance-era castle with a chequered stone facade in Amay, Liège province, moated and set in a landscaped domain managed by the Province of Liège.

locations.name: Château de Vêves
locations.setting: Medieval castle with rounded towers and pointed roofs in Celles, Namur province, restored in the 19th and 20th centuries and open for tours.

locations.name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
locations.setting: Seven-kilometre motor racing circuit through the Ardennes hills near Francorchamps, host of the Formula 1 Belgian Grand Prix, with the track and facilities available to hire for private and business events.
locations.facilities: Multiple hireable event spaces: Raidillon Loges (170 sqm, up to 160 people, with a 120 sqm private terrace); Endurance Loges (300 sqm, or two 150 sqm sections, up to 140 people); Formula 1 Loges (2x300 sqm / 2x600 sqm, 180 to 380 seats); Eau Rouge (700 sqm total: winter garden for 350, rotunda for 100, upper rooms for 150); meeting rooms for 5 to 180 people; a press conference room for 150. Wifi, screens, projectors, heating and air conditioning are available.

locations.name: Citadel of Namur
locations.setting: Hilltop fortress complex above Namur spanning two thousand years of military building, with underground passages, a park and rooms offered for professional and private hire.
locations.facilities: Four rentable spaces in the former Terra Nova barracks (Salle Blanche, Salle Don Juan, Salle Vauban, and a bar), each accommodating up to 120 people, plus a professional kitchen with cold rooms, freezer, hood, gas hobs, fryers, ovens, dishwasher and sinks. Furniture, screen, WiFi, cleaning (except kitchen and bar) and electricity/water/heating are included. Equipment rental: standing tables EUR 15 each, flipchart with paper EUR 30, sound equipment EUR 60, video projector EUR 75.
locations.logistics: EUR 200 deposit required per room; site visits by appointment Monday-Thursday, 9am-5pm.

locations.name: Coudenberg, Former Palace of Brussels
locations.setting: Underground archaeological site beneath Place Royale in Brussels, preserving the foundations and halls of the former Palace of Coudenberg, open to visitors and used for filming.
locations.suitability: Site publishes information on filming (tournage) alongside visitor tours

locations.name: Cristallerie du Val Saint Lambert
locations.setting: Crystal glassworks founded in 1826 on the site of a former abbey in Seraing, near Liège, still producing crystal, with a factory, shop and heritage buildings open to visitors.

locations.name: De Grote Post
locations.setting: A former central post office in Oostende converted into a cultural centre with a concert hall, library and cafe behind its restored mid-century facade.

locations.name: Doel
locations.setting: Polder village on the Scheldt earmarked for demolition since the 1990s to expand the port of Antwerp, now with around 200 empty houses, street art and a small remaining community.

locations.name: Domaine des Grottes de Han
locations.setting: Show caves carved by the Lesse river near Han-sur-Lesse in Namur province, combined with a wildlife park and adventure trail on the surrounding land.

locations.name: Euro Space Center
locations.setting: Space-themed visitor and education centre in Redu-Transinne, Luxembourg province, with astronaut training simulators, a planetarium and full-scale space hardware replicas.

locations.name: Flagey
locations.setting: 1938 Art Deco former national radio building on Place Sainte-Croix in Brussels, now a music and cinema centre with studios and halls available for venue hire.

locations.name: Galeries Royales Saint-Hubert
locations.setting: Glass-roofed shopping arcade from 1847 in central Brussels, with three linked galleries of boutiques, cafes, a cinema and a theatre.

locations.name: Grand Curtius
locations.setting: Museum of archaeology, decorative arts and weapons in Liège, housed in the restored 17th-century mansion of arms merchant Jean Curtius on the Meuse.

locations.name: Grand Hospice
locations.setting: A large nineteenth-century former almshouse in central Brussels with a neoclassical facade, an arcaded courtyard and long institutional corridors, now partly used for housing.
locations.facilities: Entrance hall, corridors, interior courtyard, garden, carriage entrance

locations.name: Grand-Hornu
locations.setting: Neoclassical former colliery and workers' town near Mons, built 1810 to 1830 around an oval courtyard, now a design and contemporary art centre with rooms available for hire.

locations.name: Gravensteen
locations.setting: Moated twelfth-century stone castle with towers, battlements and a gatehouse standing in the middle of Ghent.
locations.facilities: Knights' Hall (Ridderzaal) seats up to 99 people; the Suikerlade room is also bookable. Used for meetings, performances, lectures, presentations and receptions.
locations.suitability: Available for hire outside the castle's normal opening hours.

locations.name: Halles de Schaerbeek
locations.setting: Former covered market hall in Schaerbeek, Brussels, converted into a performing arts venue for dance and theatre, with its hall offered for hire.
locations.price_note: Great Hall EUR 10,000/day (EUR 5,000/day for community organisations); Small Hall EUR 2,000/day (EUR 1,000/day community); Cellar/former swimming pool EUR 1,000/day (EUR 500/day community) (own site).
locations.facilities: Three rentable spaces: Great Hall 1200 sqm (up to 2000 people standing, sit-down or buffet dining possible); Small Hall 215 sqm (400 standing / 120 seated, includes stage and bar); Cellar/former swimming pool 400 sqm including a 100 sqm room 6m deep (up to 300 people, foyer with bar).
locations.suitability: Venue hosts concerts, markets and conferences; explicitly does not accommodate private parties such as birthdays or weddings.

locations.name: Handelsbeurs Concert Hall
locations.setting: 19th-century former merchants' exchange on the Kouter in Ghent, now a concert hall with a brasserie, offering its hall for private hire.
locations.facilities: Concert hall with foyer, conference rooms, a mixing studio and dressing rooms (loges); modern theatre-technical infrastructure with climate control.

locations.name: Hof van Liere (University of Antwerp city campus)
locations.setting: A restored Renaissance courtyard building on the University of Antwerp's city campus, with arcaded galleries and a walled garden used for lectures and events.

locations.name: Hôpital Erasme / Campus Erasme
locations.setting: University hospital of the Université Libre de Bruxelles in Anderlecht, a large modernist 1970s hospital campus with wards, corridors and outdoor grounds.

locations.name: Janseniustoren
locations.setting: A squat medieval defence tower on the banks of the Dijle in central Leuven, standing among old mill buildings and narrow riverside streets.

locations.name: K-Tower
locations.setting: A slender, diagonally tilted residential and office tower beside the Leie river in Kortrijk, built in the early 2010s as a landmark of the city's redevelopment.

locations.name: Kanal-Centre Pompidou
locations.setting: Former 1930s Citroën garage on the Brussels canal, now a contemporary art museum with raw industrial halls, a large open floor and a rooftop terrace.

locations.name: Kortrijk Xpo
locations.setting: 40,000 square metre exhibition and conference campus in Kortrijk with six halls and a covered boulevard connecting them, rented out for trade shows, conferences and public events.
locations.facilities: Six halls, a Meeting Center with five rooms, catering, ticketing, parking and technical support.

locations.name: Kursaal Oostende
locations.setting: Seafront concert and congress hall in Ostend with a large auditorium and casino, offering dedicated business and corporate event spaces.
locations.facilities: Multiple event spaces: Lounge, Concert Hall, Entrance Hall, Foyer, Delvaux Hall, Main Studio and Studios; a new multifunctional hall is due to open from 2027, the renovated Lounge is currently available.

locations.name: KVS (Koninklijke Vlaamse Schouwburg)
locations.setting: Brussels' Flemish-language city theatre, combining a restored 19th-century theatre building with a modern extension, used for stage productions and events.

locations.name: La Bellone
locations.setting: 18th-century townhouse in central Brussels covered by a glass roof, now a house for the performing arts with an archive, exhibition space and courtyard.

locations.name: La Monnaie / De Munt
locations.setting: Belgium's national opera house in central Brussels, offering venue hire and audiovisual exploitation services alongside its main stage and the smaller Malibran room.

locations.name: Lites Studios
locations.setting: Modern studio complex near Brussels with five stages, including Europe's largest heated indoor water tank for underwater filming.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 1,250 m2 (13,500 sq ft); Stage 2: 1,700 m2 (18,300 sq ft); Water Stage: 1,450 m2 (15,600 sq ft) with a 24 x 21 m deep section, up to 10.8 m depth with the floor flooded, 7 million litres kept at 30 to 32 C, a tilting platform (up to 50 degrees) that can sink to 8 m, a moveable pool floor rated for 20 tonnes of set and a 14.3 m grid height; Stage 4: 470 m2 (5,000 sq ft); Stage 5 (daylight): 170 m2 (1,800 sq ft); Stage 6: 220 m2 (2,350 sq ft). Dressing rooms and an in-house camera rental department.
locations.suitability: Sound stages with high acoustic performance; the water stage is used for underwater and surface filming with a tilting, submersible platform and dual gantry cranes. The studio points to Belgium's 45 percent tax incentive.
locations.logistics: Fabrieksstraat 81, 1800 Vilvoorde (Brussels)

locations.name: Loppem Castle
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic castle built in the 1850s and 1860s near Bruges with original interiors and art collections, whose former stables now form a hall for hire.
locations.facilities: Former stables converted into an event hall for 250 to 300 seated guests or 450 standing, plus vaulted cellars for smaller groups.

locations.name: Lycee Emile Max
locations.setting: An Art Nouveau public secondary school in Schaerbeek with an ornate wrought-iron staircase and entrance hall behind an understated brick facade.
locations.facilities: Wrought-iron staircase, exterior facade

locations.name: MAS (Museum aan de Stroom)
locations.setting: Tower-shaped museum from 2011 in Antwerp's old harbour district, with a spiralling public route past galleries to a rooftop panorama over the city and river.

locations.name: Mundaneum
locations.setting: Archive centre and museum in Mons documenting Paul Otlet's early 20th-century project to catalogue the world's knowledge, recognised by UNESCO's Memory of the World register.

locations.name: NEP Belgium
locations.setting: Three broadcast sound stages on an industrial estate in Londerzeel between Antwerp and Brussels, ranging from a small green-key room to a large stage with a 60m cyclorama and adjustable lighting grid.
locations.facilities: Studio 1: 1,341 sqm inside the cyclorama (42.3m x 31.7m, 7.95m high), six independently adjustable grid frames each lifting 6,800kg, an 18m x 7m greenkey wall, a 60m seamless cyclorama and a 60m bluekey curtain, 600kVA power; Studio 2: 992 sqm (31.5m x 31.5m, 9.75m high), 99 lighting booms, 60m cyclorama, 1,000kVA power; Studio 3: 120 sqm (12.6m x 9.5m, 9.75m high), green and black curtains, adjoining gallery/production room, 1,000kVA power. All three studios connect to a shared warehouse for load-in.
locations.suitability: Each studio page describes the space as suited to TV, film, commercial and event use, with level-0 warehouse access for loading sets and equipment directly into the studios.
locations.logistics: On Nijverheidsstraat in Londerzeel, near the A12 motorway between Brussels and Antwerp; Studio 3's warehouse includes parking for two OB trucks.

locations.name: Option Media
locations.setting: A post-production house in Mechelen, between Antwerp and Brussels, that includes a 140 sqm green-key stage for compositing, virtual production and content shoots alongside its grading and sound suites.
locations.facilities: 2,400 sqm facility including a 140 sqm chroma-key (green screen) studio for shoots and virtual production, image and sound post-production suites, a private screening room with Dolby Atmos playback, and a co-working area; the site states some parts of the facility are open for rent.
locations.suitability: Site welcomes on-site client visits and states parts of the facility can be rented; free parking is available and the building is reached directly from the E19 motorway.
locations.logistics: On Zandvoortstraat in Mechelen-Noord, midway between Antwerp and Brussels, with direct access from the E19 motorway and free on-site parking.

locations.name: Paleis op de Meir
locations.setting: 1745 rococo mansion on Antwerp's main shopping street, once refurbished for Napoleon Bonaparte, now a heritage house offering rooms for dinners, receptions and meetings.

locations.name: Pixel Kinetics Alliance
locations.setting: A green-screen production stage with a motorised turntable and broadcast control room in Buggenhout, run by a virtual-production and LED-wall specialist that also operates a stage inside AED Studios in Lint.
locations.facilities: Green screen studio in Buggenhout with an infinite chroma-key cyclorama, a motorised rotating platform for talent or product turns, a programmable camera crane, calibrated even lighting for keying, and a broadcast control room supporting multi-camera recording and live switching.
locations.suitability: Site markets the studio for cinema, television, advertising and digital content production, and separately offers LED wall and media-server rental with on-site technical crews for live events.
locations.logistics: Belgian base at Kasteelstraat 223a, 9255 Buggenhout; the alliance also lists virtual production studios at AED Studios in Lint (Belgium), Gran Canaria and Madrid (Super 8, Moncloa) and Barcelona in Spain, and Clermont Studios in Wicklow, Ireland.

locations.name: Red Star Line Museum
locations.setting: Museum in the former Red Star Line shipping company warehouses on the Antwerp quays, telling the story of transatlantic emigration to America between 1873 and 1934.

locations.name: RV Studio
locations.setting: A black-box event and TV studio on the Mechelen-Noord industrial estate, just off the E19 between Brussels and Antwerp, built around one large hall with a seamless concrete floor.
locations.facilities: Main hall of 1,100 sqm (30m x 36m, 6.6m ceiling height) with a seamless paintable concrete floor and 174 rigging/anchor points, one circuit of black molton cyclorama, a 6m x 12m foyer with kitchen, a make-up room, wardrobe, shower and laundry room, and six flexible rooms usable as dressing rooms or production offices.
locations.suitability: Site lists use for television productions, corporate events, fashion shows, theatre rehearsals and cultural events; loading is via a 3.9m high by 4m wide gate and a 480kVA high-voltage supply is available.
locations.logistics: On the Mechelen-Noord industrial estate just off the E19 motorway, halfway between Brussels and Antwerp, with 50 private parking spaces and further parking available on request.

locations.name: Saint Peter's Abbey, Ghent
locations.setting: Former Benedictine abbey by Sint-Pietersplein in Ghent with a baroque church, historic cellars and a south-facing vineyard garden, whose rooms are hired for receptions and conferences.
locations.facilities: Historic cellar and loft rooms, courtyard and south-facing garden with vineyard, underground parking nearby.

locations.name: Sport Vlaanderen Gent (Wielercentrum)
locations.setting: An outdoor cycling centre in Ghent's Blaarmeersen sports park with a velodrome track, clubhouse and surrounding playing fields.

locations.name: Sport Vlaanderen Heusden-Zolder
locations.setting: A regional sports centre in Heusden-Zolder next to the Circuit Zolder racetrack, with an athletics track and multi-purpose sports halls.

locations.name: Sport Vlaanderen Hofstade
locations.setting: A public sports and recreation domain in Zemst with a swimming lake, athletics track and sports halls set among woodland.

locations.name: Sport Vlaanderen Waregem
locations.setting: A regional sports centre in Waregem with an athletics track, sports halls and outdoor pitches used for training and competitions.

locations.name: Sport Vlaanderen Willebroek
locations.setting: A national watersports centre on a canal in Willebroek with a straight regatta course, grandstands and boathouses used for rowing and canoe racing.

locations.name: Station Mechelen
locations.setting: A working railway station in central Mechelen with platforms, an overhead concourse and surrounding public squares, listed by Screen Flanders with filming requests handled by national rail operator NMBS.
locations.logistics: Filming requests are arranged directly with NMBS (national rail operator), not the station itself.

locations.name: Stoomcentrum Maldegem
locations.setting: Volunteer-run heritage railway based at Maldegem station, running historic steam and diesel trains through the Meetjesland countryside.
locations.suitability: Website explicitly offers photo and film location bookings alongside private charters and group visits.

locations.name: STUK, Leuven
locations.setting: Multidisciplinary arts centre on Naamsestraat in Leuven with theatre spaces, a cinema and studios, offering rooms and rehearsal spaces for rent.

locations.name: Théâtre de Liège
locations.setting: Contemporary performing arts theatre in Liège with a large auditorium and studio spaces, part of the city's cultural quarter near the Meuse.

locations.name: Tour & Taxis
locations.setting: Former customs and rail freight depot on the Brussels canal, with 19th-century brick, glass and iron warehouse halls now used as a large indoor event and exhibition venue.

locations.name: Tour a Plomb
locations.setting: A former lead-shot factory tower near Brussels' old abattoir district, now a community and sports centre that keeps its raw industrial brickwork and stairwells.
locations.facilities: Stairwells, exposed industrial interior

locations.name: Villa Empain
locations.setting: 1930s Art Deco mansion on Avenue Franklin Roosevelt in Brussels, home to the Boghossian Foundation, with salons, gardens and a bar that can be privatised for events.
locations.price_note: Filming from EUR 7,500; commercial shoots from EUR 5,000; wedding photography from EUR 1,500 (own site).
locations.suitability: Villa is offered for film shoots, promotional or commercial clips, and wedding photo shoots; filming is restricted to outside the venue's normal operating hours.

locations.name: Villers Abbey ruins
locations.setting: The roofless ruins of a Cistercian abbey near Villers-la-Ville, with vaulted cellars, a ruined church nave and monastic gardens open for shoots by arrangement.

locations.name: Alexandrovska University Hospital
locations.setting: Teaching hospital founded in 1879, a campus of late nineteenth century pavilions and later clinical blocks with long corridors, wards and lecture theatres.

locations.name: Ancient Stadium of Philippopolis
locations.setting: Excavated end of a Roman stadium set below the main pedestrian street, with marble tiers and vaulted entrances open to the square above.

locations.name: Balabanov House
locations.setting: Reconstructed merchant house in the old town, a symmetrical National Revival building with a large salon, carved ceilings and a terraced garden.

locations.name: Belogradchik Fortress
locations.setting: Fortress built into the sandstone towers above the town, with Ottoman era stone walls, gun emplacements and rock faces forming two of its sides.

locations.name: Belogradchik Rocks
locations.setting: Belt of red sandstone and conglomerate towers up to 200 metres high, spread over about 30 kilometres of hillside above the town.

locations.name: Boyana Church
locations.setting: Small three part medieval church at the foot of Vitosha, with 1259 wall paintings, a stone and brick exterior and a walled garden of old trees.

locations.name: Bozhentsi architectural reserve
locations.setting: Protected village of stone roofed timber houses on a wooded hillside, with unpaved lanes, orchards, workshops and no modern building.

locations.name: Burgas Airport
locations.setting: Airport between Burgas and the salt lakes, with a terminal of 2013, wide aprons, a fire station and flat open ground around the runway.

locations.name: Burgas Regional Historical Museum
locations.setting: Municipal museum working from four buildings in central Burgas, including an 1894 school with plain plastered halls and tall windows.

locations.name: Business Park Sofia
locations.setting: Office campus in Mladost with glazed low rise blocks, landscaped courtyards, underground parking, a conference centre and its own metro station.

locations.name: Central Balkan National Park
locations.setting: Long protected ridge of the Balkan range with beech forest, waterfalls, open pasture, karst gorges and mountain passes crossing it.

locations.name: Devetashka Cave
locations.setting: Very large river cave with a 35 metre entrance arch, seven collapse openings in the roof that light the main chamber, and a stream running through it.

locations.name: Devnya Cement works
locations.setting: Cement plant in the Devnya industrial valley with kilns, silos, conveyor galleries, quarry faces and rail connections to the port.

locations.name: Grand Hotel Varna
locations.setting: Large seaside hotel at St. Constantine and Helena with a modernist block, congress halls, a spa, pools and direct access to the beach.

locations.name: International Fair Plovdiv
locations.setting: Trade fair ground by the Maritsa with large exhibition halls, a congress centre, open display areas and wide service roads for heavy vehicles.

locations.name: Ivan Vazov National Theatre
locations.setting: Neoclassical theatre of 1907 facing the City Garden, with a portico and quadriga, a gilded auditorium of about 750 seats and foyers on two levels.

locations.name: Kaliopa House
locations.setting: Mid nineteenth century town house near the Danube quay, now a museum of urban life, with panelled rooms, period furniture and a small garden.

locations.name: Kapana creative district
locations.setting: Grid of narrow pedestrian streets behind the main street of Plovdiv, lined with small bars, cafes, galleries and craft shops in low old buildings.

locations.name: Kempinski Hotel Grand Arena Bansko
locations.setting: Alpine style resort hotel at the Bansko gondola station, with stone and timber interiors, a ballroom, spa and views to the Pirin peaks.

locations.name: Koprivshtitsa
locations.setting: Protected mountain town of about 380 listed houses in painted National Revival style, with cobbled streets, humpback bridges and a river through the centre.

locations.name: Maritsa Iztok 2 thermal power station
locations.setting: Large lignite fired power station with boiler houses, turbine halls, cooling towers, coal yards and conveyor bridges on an open plain.

locations.name: Mini Maritsa-Iztok open pit mines
locations.setting: Three working lignite open pits with cut terraces, bucket wheel excavators, long conveyor lines and spoil heaps, the largest mining landscape in the country.

locations.name: National Museum of History
locations.setting: State museum in the former government residence at Boyana, a 1970s modernist block with marble halls, wide staircases and a wooded park.

locations.name: National Museum of Military History
locations.setting: Military museum with indoor galleries and a large outdoor park of tanks, artillery, aircraft, missiles and radar vehicles on hard standing.

locations.name: National Opera and Ballet
locations.setting: Opera house completed in 1953, with a colonnaded stone front, a horseshoe auditorium seating about 1,100 and a deep stage with fly tower.

locations.name: National Palace of Culture (NDK)
locations.setting: Congress centre of 1981 with a hexagonal concrete and glass form, thirteen halls including a 3,000 seat auditorium, wide lobbies and a large forecourt.
locations.known_for: Sofia International Film Festival is held here

locations.name: Nesebar Old Town
locations.setting: Rocky peninsula joined by an isthmus, with medieval stone and timber churches, wooden houses on stone bases, narrow lanes and harbour walls.

locations.name: Nu Boyana Film Studios
locations.setting: Studio lot of about 30 hectares with ten sound stages, a water tank with an underwater stage and standing backlot sets for New York, London and a Roman city.
locations.known_for: 300: Rise of an Empire, The Expendables 3, London Has Fallen, Rambo: Last Blood
locations.facilities: Ten sound stages, water tank with underwater stage, motion capture stage, construction workshops, camera, lighting and grip rental, props, costumes and picture vehicles.
locations.logistics: In the Boyana district on the edge of Sofia, with the wooded slopes of Vitosha directly behind the backlot.

locations.name: Oslekov House
locations.setting: Painted merchant house of 1856 in Koprivshtitsa, with a columned porch, wall paintings, carved wooden ceilings and a walled yard.

locations.name: Plovdiv Central Railway Station
locations.setting: Through station south of the old town, with a low symmetrical station building, open platforms, canopies and a large adjoining goods yard.

locations.name: Plovdiv Old Town and Nebet Tepe
locations.setting: Cobbled hill quarter of overhanging National Revival houses, walled lanes, Roman remains and the ruined citadel of Nebet Tepe at the top.

locations.name: Plovdiv Regional Ethnographic Museum
locations.setting: Museum in the Kuyumdzhieva house of 1847 in the old town, a painted National Revival mansion with a curved gable, carved ceilings and a walled courtyard.

locations.name: Port of Varna
locations.setting: Black Sea cargo port on two terminals, with container and bulk quays, gantry cranes, warehouses, rail sidings and a ferry terminal.

locations.name: PrimeTime Studios
locations.setting: Television and film pavilion complex on the Sofia ring road, with separate control rooms for each studio, camera cranes and modular video walls.
locations.logistics: On the Sofia ring road at Tsarigradsko shose, about ten minutes from Sofia Airport (own site).

locations.name: Rila Monastery
locations.setting: Walled monastery in a forested valley, with striped arcaded ranges on four levels, a domed painted church and a fourteenth century stone tower.

locations.name: Rila National Park and the Seven Rila Lakes
locations.setting: High granite range with glacial lakes, cirques, alpine meadows and conifer forest, reached by mountain roads, huts and a chairlift.

locations.name: Roman Theatre of Philippopolis
locations.setting: Second century Roman theatre cut into the hillside of the old town, with marble seating for about 3,500, a two storey stage wall and views over the city.

locations.name: Rousse Regional Historical Museum
locations.setting: Museum in the former Battenberg palace by the Danube, with period rooms, a garden and a group of listed nineteenth century town houses in its care.

locations.name: Sofia Airport
locations.setting: International airport with two passenger terminals, check in halls, piers and stands, a general aviation apron and a single runway.

locations.name: Sofia Balkan Palace
locations.setting: Hotel inside the 1950s Largo ensemble in the centre of Sofia, with a stone colonnade, a marble lobby, ballrooms and meeting suites.

locations.name: Sofia Central Mineral Baths (Regional History Museum)
locations.setting: Former public bath house of 1913 in Vienna Secession style, now the city museum, with tiled halls, arcaded facades and a mineral water colonnade outside.
locations.price_note: Film shoot 180 BGN (about 92 EUR) for the first hour and 90 BGN per further half hour; advertising shoots 350 BGN for the first hour (own price list).
locations.suitability: The museum publishes separate hourly rates for feature film and advertising shoots in its services price list.

locations.name: Sofia Central Railway Station
locations.setting: Main station of 1974 with a concrete shell roof over a raised concourse, platforms below, tiled halls and a long approach of tracks and signal gantries.

locations.name: Sofia Court House
locations.setting: Neoclassical courts building of 1940 on Vitosha Boulevard, with a colonnaded front, a marble entrance hall, wide staircases and panelled court rooms.

locations.name: Sofia University St. Kliment Ohridski
locations.setting: Main university building of 1934 with a colonnaded front, a domed aula, marble stairs, long corridors and tiered lecture halls.

locations.name: SS. Cyril and Methodius National Library
locations.setting: National library of 1953 next to the university, with a neoclassical facade, a columned entrance hall and large reading rooms lined with shelving.

locations.name: St. Cyril and St. Methodius University of Veliko Tarnovo
locations.setting: University campus on a hillside above the Yantra, with concrete teaching blocks, lecture halls, libraries and terraces looking over the old town.

locations.name: St. Marina University Hospital
locations.setting: Large teaching hospital on the western edge of Varna, with modern clinical blocks, treatment rooms, corridors and an emergency entrance.

locations.name: Stomana Industry steelworks
locations.setting: Working steel plant with an electric arc furnace, rolling mills, tall production halls, gantry cranes and yards of stock served by rail sidings.

locations.name: Tsarevets Fortress
locations.setting: Medieval hill fortress above a bend of the Yantra, with rebuilt curtain walls, gate towers, a patriarchal church and steep approach paths.

locations.name: TZUM Sofia
locations.setting: Central department store of 1957 in the Largo, with a stone clad facade, a full height atrium, marble floors and galleried shopping levels.

locations.name: UFO Film Studios
locations.setting: Four stage studio east of Sofia with a curved LED volume and a large backlot carrying standing sets for an American suburb, a western town, a Viking village and an Arctic station.
locations.facilities: Stages of 1,680, 770, 510 and 480 square metres with 12 metre clear height, a 20 by 5 metre curved XR stage, green screen stage and over 56,000 square metres of backlot.
locations.logistics: In the village of Dolna Malina, about 22 kilometres from central Sofia (own site).

locations.name: Underground Mining Museum, Pernik
locations.setting: Museum set in the galleries of a former coal mine, with timbered tunnels, rails, cutting machines and winding gear left in place underground.

locations.name: Varna Airport
locations.setting: Coastal airport with a compact modern terminal, apron stands, a control tower and a preserved older terminal building on the same site.

locations.name: Varna Archaeological Museum
locations.setting: Museum in an 1898 neo-Renaissance girls school, with a symmetrical brick facade, high ceilinged galleries and an inner courtyard of stone finds.

locations.name: Varna Opera Theatre
locations.setting: Opera and drama house of 1932 on Independence Square, a neo-Baroque block with a decorated auditorium, boxes and a colonnaded entrance hall.

locations.name: Varna Railway Station
locations.setting: Terminus station beside the port canal, with a 1920s station building, a plain concourse, buffer stop platforms and quays a short walk away.

locations.name: Vasil Levski National Stadium
locations.setting: National stadium of 1953 inside Borisova Gradina park, with a colonnaded entrance, an athletics track, about 43,000 seats and floodlight masts.

locations.name: Vitosha Nature Park
locations.setting: Mountain park on the edge of Sofia rising to 2,290 metres, with boulder rivers, spruce forest, ski runs, a chairlift and a road to the plateau.

locations.name: Zheravna
locations.setting: Reserve village of about 200 wooden houses from the seventeenth to nineteenth centuries, with stone walls, cobbled lanes and beech forest around it.

locations.name: Abandoned Bus Station, Gračac
locations.setting: A disused bus terminal in the inland town of Gračac, next to the main road, listed by the Zadar Film Commission as a derelict-places location.

locations.name: Abandoned Military Airfield, Šepurine
locations.setting: A disused military runway with deteriorated hangars near the village of Šepurine by Nin, set between the sea and Velebit mountain, listed by the Zadar Film Commission.

locations.name: Academy of Music, University of Zagreb
locations.setting: The University of Zagreb's music academy building on Gundulićeva ulica in the city centre, listed by the Zagreb Film Office among schools and universities.

locations.name: Arena Centar, Zagreb
locations.setting: A large shopping centre in Novi Zagreb next to the Arena Zagreb hall, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as an architectural filming location.

locations.name: Arena Zagreb
locations.setting: Large modern indoor arena in Zagreb's Lanište district, built for the 2009 World Men's Handball Championship, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a sports hall filming location.

locations.name: Art Pavilion Zagreb
locations.setting: Steel-framed exhibition hall on Zagreb's Zrinjevac park, originally built for the 1896 Budapest exhibition and re-erected in the city, now an art gallery with a domed central hall.

locations.name: Botanical Garden of the University of Zagreb
locations.setting: University-run botanical garden next to Zagreb's main railway station, with greenhouses, ponds and around 5,000 plant species laid out as an English-style landscape park.

locations.name: Brijuni National Park
locations.setting: An archipelago of fourteen islands off Fažana, the former summer residence of Josip Broz Tito, with parkland, a safari zone, Roman and Byzantine ruins and a residence complex.

locations.name: Britanski Square Market
locations.setting: Small neighbourhood square and daily market in Zagreb's Britanski trg area, with market stalls and street-level cafes catalogued by the Zagreb Film Office as a shooting location.

locations.name: Bundek Park
locations.setting: Lakeside park in Novi Zagreb with two lakes, a bathing area, barbecue spots, playgrounds and a cycling and skating track around the water.
locations.facilities: 545,000 m2 park with 470,000 m2 of green area, 50,000 m2 of lakes, 10,000 m2 of paths, 10 free barbecue areas and a 1,650 metre cycling and skating track

locations.name: Church of St Mark, Zagreb
locations.setting: A medieval parish church on St Mark's Square in Zagreb's Upper Town, known for its tiled roof, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as an Old Town location.

locations.name: Church of St. Donatus
locations.setting: Circular ninth-century pre-Romanesque church built partly from recycled Roman stone on Zadar's ancient forum, now used as a concert venue for its acoustics.
locations.known_for: Through the Centuries (per Zadar Film Commission)

locations.name: Croatian National Theatre in Split
locations.setting: A neo-Renaissance national theatre building from 1893 in central Split, with a main stage, tiered auditorium and rehearsal rooms used for opera, drama and ballet.

locations.name: Croatian National Theatre in Zagreb
locations.setting: Neo-baroque opera and drama house on the Republic of Croatia Square in Zagreb, opened in 1895, with a gilded auditorium, foyer and working stage still in daily use.

locations.name: Croatian National Theatre Ivan pl. Zajc
locations.setting: Opera house opened in 1885 in central Rijeka with a gilded horseshoe auditorium, main stage and rehearsal rooms, still in daily use for opera, ballet and drama.

locations.name: Diocletian's Palace
locations.setting: Fourth-century Roman imperial palace whose walls, basement halls and peristyle form the living core of Split's old town, mixing ancient masonry with shops and homes.

locations.name: Dolac Market
locations.setting: Zagreb's main open-air produce market on a raised square above the central square, with rows of red umbrellas, fruit and vegetable stalls and an indoor hall, run by the city market company.

locations.name: Dom Sportova
locations.setting: Multi-hall indoor sports and events complex in Zagreb with three separate arenas, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a sports hall filming location.

locations.name: Domovinski Most (Homeland Bridge)
locations.setting: A cable-stayed road bridge over the Sava on Zagreb's eastern bypass, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a traffic-connection location.

locations.name: Dražen Petrović Basketball Hall
locations.setting: Indoor arena at Zagreb's Cibona sports complex with seating for around 5,400, home court of KK Cibona and a regular venue for concerts and other events.

photo.author: Andrea Cislaghi from Robbio Lomellina, Italia

locations.name: Dubrovnik Old Town
locations.setting: Walled seaside old town with intact medieval ramparts, baroque stone streets and fortresses rising straight from the Adriatic.
locations.known_for: Game of Thrones (King's Landing, from season 2), Star Wars: The Last Jedi (2017), Robin Hood (2018)

locations.name: Dvorac Podolje (Hamor Castle)
locations.setting: A small noble manor house in the Hamor part of Samobor, near Zagreb, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a castle-and-manor location.

locations.name: Esplanade Zagreb Hotel
locations.setting: Art Deco hotel opened in 1925 next to Zagreb's main station to serve Orient Express passengers, with a marble lobby, period ballroom and historic guest rooms.

locations.name: Franjo Tuđman Airport
locations.setting: Croatia's main international airport south of Zagreb, with a passenger terminal built in 2017, an aircraft apron, control tower and cargo facilities.

locations.name: Governor's Palace, Rijeka
locations.setting: A late 19th-century palace on Rijeka's waterfront built for the Hungarian-appointed governor, now housing the Maritime and History Museum of the Croatian Littoral.

locations.name: Grič Tunnel
locations.setting: Pedestrian tunnel cut through Zagreb's Grič hill in the 1940s, linking the Ilica and Mesnička areas of the Upper Town, with bare concrete walls and arched side chambers.

locations.name: Hendrix Bridge, Zagreb
locations.setting: A pedestrian and cycling bridge over the Sava in the Kajzerica district, catalogued by the Zagreb Film Office among the city's bridges.

locations.name: Hotel International Zagreb
locations.setting: Business hotel in Zagreb with 207 rooms, six multifunctional meeting rooms, a casino and a lobby bar with terrace, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a filming location.
locations.facilities: 207 rooms, restaurant, lobby bar with terrace, fitness room, casino, six meeting rooms

locations.name: Hotel Jadran, Zagreb
locations.setting: A bed-and-breakfast hotel on Vlaška ulica between Zagreb's Upper and Lower Town, with 49 rooms and a restaurant, listed by the Zagreb Film Office.

locations.name: Hotel Kvarner (Grand Hotel Kvarner)
locations.setting: The first purpose-built hotel on the eastern Adriatic coast, opened in 1884 on Opatija's seafront, with a Belle Epoque facade, period function rooms and a sea-facing terrace.

locations.name: Hotel Panorama Zagreb
locations.setting: Business hotel near Zagreb's fairground with conference rooms, a restaurant, lobby bar and fitness studio, used for corporate and hospitality scenes.
locations.facilities: 280 rooms and suites, 9 multifunctional meeting rooms, restaurant, lobby bar with terrace, fitness studio and sauna

locations.name: Jadran Film
locations.setting: Film studio founded in 1946 with stages and backlot grounds in Zagreb's Dubrava district, host to well over a hundred international co-productions.
locations.known_for: Winnetou series (1962-1968), The Tin Drum (1979), Sophie's Choice (1982)
locations.facilities: Nine stages totalling 8,000 m2; the largest are Studio 2 (1,200 m2, 47 x 23 m, over 10 m high) and Studio 4 (1,200 m2, 60 x 20 m, 8 m working height), with Studio 6-7 a divisible 950 m2 complex and Studio 9 a 440 m2 TV studio. A 1,000 m2 production hub with offices and its own transformer station, plus carpentry, paint, plaster and model workshops.
locations.suitability: Presented as a full-service production base with base camp infrastructure and dressing, makeup and wardrobe rooms around each stage; Studios 4 and 9 are on long-term lease to a television company and a 2,500 to 3,200 m2 Studio 10 is planned. Stage pages are marked under construction pending a summer 2026 relaunch.
locations.logistics: Ulica Rudolfa Kolaka 12, Zagreb; parking for production vehicles at Studio 2 and gated access with RF cards at the production hub.

locations.name: Jankomir Bridge
locations.setting: Road bridge carrying the Zagreb bypass over the Sava river on the city's western edge, a steel and concrete structure used for traffic and industrial-area shots.

locations.name: Kazalište Komedija
locations.setting: A musical theatre on Kaptol in Zagreb's old town, staging operettas, musicals and cabaret in a roughly 500-seat auditorium, operating since 1950.

locations.name: Kopački Rit Nature Park
locations.setting: A wetland nature park at the confluence of the Drava and Danube rivers, with flooded forest, reed beds, an observation tower and boat routes through the marshland.

locations.name: Krka National Park
locations.setting: Karst river canyon with a chain of travertine waterfalls, lakes and old watermills, plus the island monastery of Visovac reached only by boat.

locations.name: Lake Jarun
locations.setting: Recreational lake and park complex in western Zagreb built for the 1987 World Student Games, with rowing lanes, beaches, cafes and cycling paths around the water.

locations.name: Lauba
locations.setting: Former Zagreb textile and later arms factory converted into an open art house, with a large column-free exhibition hall, glass additions and a sculpture garden.
locations.facilities: 1,350 sq m of exhibition space; the venue states it can host groups of 20 to 2,000 guests, for dinners, concerts, conferences, weddings, workshops, film screenings and theatre performances.

locations.name: Medvednica Nature Park
locations.setting: The forested mountain range above Zagreb, with the ruined medieval Medvedgrad fortress, a former ore mine open to visitors, hiking trails and the Sljeme peak and ski area.

locations.name: Mimara Museum
locations.setting: Neo-Renaissance former school building on Roosevelt Square in Zagreb, now home to the Mimara Museum's collection of European paintings, sculpture and applied art.

locations.name: Museum of Ancient Glass, Zadar
locations.setting: A museum in central Zadar holding Roman-era glass, with a glassblowing workshop, souvenir shop and exhibition halls, listed by the Zadar Film Commission.

locations.name: Museum of Arts and Crafts, Zagreb
locations.setting: A decorative-arts museum on Trg Republike Hrvatske in central Zagreb, its historicist building and galleries listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a filming location.

locations.name: National and University Library in Zagreb
locations.setting: Croatia's national library, a large modernist building from 1995 with reading rooms, book stacks and a central atrium, serving as the country's main research library.

locations.name: Oktogon Passage
locations.setting: A covered shopping arcade with a vaulted glass roof linking Ilica and Trg Petra Preradovića in central Zagreb, catalogued by the Zagreb Film Office as an architectural location.

locations.name: Opatija
locations.setting: Belle-epoque resort town on the Kvarner riviera with a twelve-kilometre coastal promenade, villa gardens and grand hotels dating from the Austro-Hungarian era.

locations.name: Opatovina
locations.setting: Pedestrian street and square in Zagreb's Upper Town lined with restaurants and bars, listed by the Zagreb Film Office as a filming location for street scenes.

locations.name: Oštri Rat Lighthouse, Zadar
locations.setting: A working lighthouse with a spiral staircase and keeper's house on the Puntamika coast at Zadar, listed by the Zadar Film Commission.

locations.name: Pag Salt Pans
locations.setting: Working saltworks on Pag island with roots in Roman times, laid out as shallow evaporation basins and canals, with a visitor centre run by the salt company Solana Pag.
locations.known_for: Following the Salt (documentary, per Zadar Film Commission)

locations.name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
locations.setting: Chain of sixteen terraced turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls in a forested karst canyon.
locations.known_for: Treasure of the Silver Lake (1962), Karl May Winnetou westerns (1962-1968)

locations.name: Port of Rijeka
locations.setting: Working deep-sea cargo port on the Kvarner Gulf with container terminals, cranes, warehouses and the older Delta basin quaysides close to the city centre.

locations.name: Pula Arena
locations.setting: Roman stone amphitheatre in central Pula whose surviving outer wall and tiered seating host summer concerts, the Pula Film Festival and other large outdoor events.
locations.price_note: Filming or event use for up to 30 minutes while the site stays open to the public: EUR 5,000 plus VAT; longer use that closes the amphitheatre to visitors is priced separately, per a document not published on the page (own site).
locations.suitability: Site states that using the amphitheatre for filming or events requires consent from the City of Pula, in addition to approval from the Conservation Department in Pula and the Archaeological Museum of Istria, which manages the venue.
locations.logistics: Requests for use up to 30 minutes must be submitted at least 15 days in advance to the Archaeological Museum of Istria (uprava.ami@gmail.com); use of over 30 minutes that closes the site to the public depends on the city's official annual event calendar, so approval cannot be guaranteed until that programme is announced.

locations.name: Rikard Benčić Complex
locations.setting: Former sugar refinery and later Rikard Benčić machine factory in central Rijeka, restored as an industrial heritage complex now housing the Rijeka City Museum.

locations.name: SD Trešnjevka
locations.setting: Municipal sports hall in Zagreb's Trešnjevka district, listed by the Zagreb Film Office among the city's sports halls available for filming.

locations.name: Sheraton Zagreb Hotel
