locations.facilities: 1,350 sq m of listed halls plus 10,000 sq m open ground, 9.4 m hall height, drive in access, 40 parking spaces, 16 A and 32 A outlets
locations.suitability: Historic train runs on open track can be arranged for filming

locations.name: Bauhaus Dessau
locations.setting: 1926 Bauhaus school building by Walter Gropius in Dessau, a UNESCO World Heritage site with glass curtain walls, workshop wings, studio flats and an auditorium.

locations.name: Bauhaus-Universitat Weimar
locations.setting: The founding site of the Bauhaus school, with Henry van de Velde's Art Nouveau studio building and later modernist extensions still used as a working university.

locations.name: Bavaria Studios Cologne
locations.setting: Four sound stages from about 760 to 1,560 square metres at Bavaria Studios' Cologne-Bocklemund site, used for film and TV production in the region.
locations.logistics: Cologne-Bocklemund production site.

locations.name: Bavaria Studios Munich
locations.setting: Twelve sound stages from 150 to 3,150 square metres at the Bavaria Filmplatz in Grunwald near Munich, including the large Wolfgang Petersen hall, for film, TV and commercial shoots.
locations.facilities: Studio 1: 550 m2; Studio 2: 875 m2; Studio 3: 875 m2; Studio 4/5: 2,100 m2; Studio 6: 750 m2; Studio 7: 750 m2; Studio 8: 300 m2; Studio 9 (Wolfgang Petersen Halle): 2,400 m2, 58.0 x 44.5 x 15.0 m, lighting walkways at 12.8 m, 50 movable lighting hoists with a white-light base package and air conditioning, a VIP foyer with limousine drop-off, an audience foyer and an annex with 34 side rooms, 2 makeup rooms and 2 VIP lounges; Studio 11: 50 m2; Studio 12: 3,150 m2, 69.0 x 46.0 x 14.0 m, column-free, total power feed 2,340 kW of which 1,800 kW for filming light (571 W/m2), a 2,000 kVA transformer and 400 V CEE outlets, with 16 dressing rooms or offices, 3 VIP dressing rooms, 2 makeup rooms, 5 technical rooms, a catering room and a roof terrace; Studio 14: 1,050 m2. Studios 9 and 12 can be linked to the audience foyer and are used for TV productions with audiences of up to 1,500 people.
locations.logistics: Bavariafilmplatz 7, 82031 Grunwald, near Munich.

locations.name: Bayerisches Eisenbahnmuseum
locations.setting: A former steam locomotive depot at Nordlingen with a working roundhouse, turntable and yard of preserved steam and diesel engines.

locations.name: bayernhafen Nuremberg
locations.setting: Inland freight port and logistics centre on the Main Danube Canal covering 337 hectares, with harbour basins, gantry cranes, a container terminal and about 260 companies on site.

locations.name: Beelitz-Heilstätten
locations.setting: Sprawling former tuberculosis sanatorium and military hospital south of Berlin with dozens of derelict Wilhelmine-era pavilions, overgrown grounds and a former alpine slide building.

locations.name: Bergson Kunstkraftwerk
locations.setting: Former 1940 heating plant in Munich Aubing turned into a culture venue, with a 25 metre boiler hall in brick, glass and steel next to a concert hall, gallery, club and beer garden.

locations.name: Berlin-Hohenschönhausen Memorial
locations.setting: Former Stasi remand prison in Lichtenberg with preserved interrogation rooms, cells and a prisoner transport van, run as a memorial site open for research and filming about East Germany.

locations.name: Black Forest Studios
locations.setting: Film and photo studio complex at Kirchzarten near Freiburg, with stages, a cyclorama and production rooms at the edge of the Black Forest.

locations.name: Boardinghaus Weinberg Campus
locations.setting: Three late classicist villas grouped around a courtyard at the edge of Halle's Weinberg Campus technology park, now listed guest houses with one and two room serviced apartments.

locations.name: Boettcherstrasse
locations.setting: Short brick expressionist street of the 1920s between the Bremen market square and the Weser, with sculpted gables, courtyards, small museums and workshops.

locations.name: Brahms Kontor
locations.setting: Brick office building of 1903 at Johannes-Brahms-Platz in Hamburg, with a stepped tower, marble entrance hall, paternoster and long office corridors.

locations.name: Bremen Town Hall
locations.setting: Gothic and Weser Renaissance town hall on the Bremen market square, with a vaulted wine cellar, the upper hall, council rooms and a carved arcaded front.

locations.name: Breuninger Kaufhaus Erfurt
locations.setting: A department store built in the 1990s in Erfurt's historic city centre, designed to fit the scale of the surrounding 1,250 year old old town while offering large modern retail floors inside.

locations.name: Bundesbank-Bunker Cochem
locations.setting: Cold war currency bunker under two houses in Cochem-Cond, with a blast door, long tunnels, control rooms, dormitories and empty banknote vaults.

locations.name: Buropark Airfurt
locations.setting: An 11.3 hectare office and business park next to Erfurt airport, built in the 1990s with several built-up streets, a roundabout and cycle paths, home to logistics, IT and public-sector tenants.

locations.name: Cap San Diego
locations.setting: Seagoing general cargo ship of 1961 moored at the Ueberseebruecke in Hamburg, with bridge, engine room, holds, cabins and decks kept in working order.

locations.name: CCC Filmstudios Berlin-Haselhorst
locations.setting: Four sound stages from 350 to 1,200 square metres at the CCC Filmstudios in Berlin-Haselhorst, a studio site in continuous production use since the early 1950s.
locations.facilities: Filmatelier Artur Brauner 1,200 m2 (12.40 m ceiling), Filmatelier Romy Schneider 640 m2 (10.60 m), Filmatelier Curd Jurgens 600 m2 (7.60 m), Filmatelier Fritz Lang 350 m2 (6.00 m); soundproofed since 1979/80, modular stages that can be combined, a cyclorama, and LED lighting run on renewable power since 2022.
locations.suitability: Stages are available for rental to outside productions; viewings by appointment.
locations.logistics: Daumstrasse 49/51, 13599 Berlin (Haselhorst).

locations.name: Chilehaus
locations.setting: Brick expressionist office block of 1924 in the Hamburg Kontorhaus quarter, with a ship's prow corner, arcaded passages, terracotta stairwells and office floors.

locations.name: Congresshalle Saarbruecken
locations.setting: Post war congress hall by the Saar in Saarbruecken with a large auditorium, foyers, meeting rooms and a modernist glazed front onto the riverside park.

locations.name: Container Terminal Halle (Saale)
locations.setting: A working inland freight terminal on the Saale river in Halle, with rail and road links, a harbour basin, quayside, tracks, weighing and loading equipment across a large industrial site.

locations.name: Deichtorhallen Hamburg
locations.setting: Two former market halls of steel and glass near the Hamburg city centre, now exhibition halls with column free floors and high daylight, also hired for events.

locations.name: Denkort Bunker Valentin
locations.setting: Unfinished submarine bunker of 1945 at Bremen-Farge, a vast concrete shell with broken roof slabs, flooded bays and a memorial path through the interior.

locations.name: Deutsche Nationalbibliothek (Deutsche Buecherei)
locations.setting: The Leipzig home of Germany's national library, founded in 1912 and holding around 20 million items, in a purpose-built early 20th century building on Deutscher Platz.

locations.name: Deutsches Museum
locations.setting: Large science and technology museum on an island in the Isar in Munich, with historic machine halls, a planetarium and collections spanning mining to aerospace.

locations.name: documentaHalle
locations.setting: A 1992 exhibition hall beside Kassel's Fridericianum, built for the documenta art show and also used for conferences, trade fairs, concerts and film screenings.
locations.facilities: 1,400 sqm of column-free exhibition space plus around 700 sqm of office, storage and cafeteria space

locations.name: Donau-Einkaufszentrum
locations.setting: Large shopping centre in Regensburg with 140 shops, wide malls, planted light wells and fountains, an attached health centre and a spiral car park ramp.
locations.facilities: 82,000 sq m lettable area on a 102,000 sq m site, 3,600 free parking spaces, sections of car park can be closed off, outlets throughout

locations.name: Duesseldorf Airport
locations.setting: International airport with check in halls, piers, gates, an airside apron and a rail station under the terminal, offering the usual range of travel interiors.

locations.name: Duisburg Innenhafen
locations.setting: A former inland harbour of grain silos and warehouses redeveloped into offices, restaurants and waterside promenades, keeping its industrial brick shells.

locations.name: Egon-Eiermann-Bau Apolda
locations.setting: A modernist industrial building by architect Egon Eiermann on the edge of Apolda, originally built for fire-extinguisher production and now used as studios and creative workspace.

locations.name: Ehemaliger Handelshafen Magdeburg
locations.setting: A former trading harbour in Magdeburg dating from 1893, with red-brick silos and warehouses along a largely disused harbour basin and a lifting bridge over the entrance canal.

locations.name: Ehemaliges Kaufhaus Hermann Tietz Gera
locations.setting: A former department store in Gera dating to 1882, one of the first built by the Hermann Tietz chain, with the grand facade the company used to signal the scale of its business inside.

locations.name: Eisenbahnmuseum Bochum-Dahlhausen
locations.setting: A preserved steam-era railway depot with a roundhouse, turntable, workshops and sidings of historic locomotives and carriages.

locations.name: Elbphilharmonie
locations.setting: Concert hall on the Elbe in Hamburg's HafenCity, built above a former cocoa warehouse with a glass wave-shaped upper structure, a public plaza and two auditoriums.
locations.facilities: Grand Hall: standard capacity 2,091, reducible to about 1,555 in some configurations; stage about 260 m2, playable area about 18 x 15 m; 31 electrically operated height-adjustable platforms; organ; foyers with cloakrooms and bars on multiple floors. Recital Hall: 532 in standard configuration (14.5 x 6.3 m stage), 388 with a larger 14.5 x 11.8 m stage, 210 seated for banquets; base area 435 m2 (14.5 x 30 m) with seating removed; mobile auditorium and stage elements.
locations.logistics: Two loading zones with service lifts on the south side require advance arrangement; artists access via the Artists' Entrance on the south/port side. Visitor access to the concert area is only via the Elbphilharmonie Plaza, so every visitor needs a ticket.

locations.name: EmiLu Design Hotel
locations.setting: Design hotel in central Stuttgart with planted rooms, a roof terrace and a bar, listed in the Baden-Wuerttemberg location guide.

locations.name: Erlebnis-Zoo Hannover
locations.setting: Themed zoo in Hanover with built worlds standing in for a savannah, a jungle palace, a Canadian river and a fishing village, listed in the nordmedia guide.

photo.author: Joachim Meyer - User: (WT-shared) HaJo at  wts wikivoyage

locations.name: Erlebnisbergwerk Velsen
locations.setting: Former coal mine at Saarbruecken-Velsen kept as a visitor pit, with a shaft head, pit railway, machine rooms and worked underground roadways.

locations.name: Europa-Galerie Saarbruecken
locations.setting: Shopping centre in Saarbruecken built into the listed halls of the former Burbach ironworks administration, combining brick facades with modern malls.

locations.name: Eutin Castle
locations.setting: Four winged brick residence on a lake at Eutin with furnished state rooms, a chapel, a courtyard and a landscape park used for an open air opera festival.

locations.name: Excelsior Hotel Ernst
locations.setting: Grand hotel of 1863 opposite Cologne cathedral, with a marble lobby, panelled salons, a restaurant and banqueting rooms that are hired for events.
locations.suitability: Publishes meeting and banqueting hire for its salons and function rooms.

locations.name: Fairmont Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten
locations.setting: Hotel of 1897 on the Binnenalster in Hamburg with wood panelled salons, a tea lounge, private dining rooms and event floors that are hired out.
locations.suitability: Publishes meeting and event hire for its salons and function rooms.

locations.name: Ferropolis
locations.setting: Open-air museum on a peninsula in a former lignite mining lake near Gräfenhainichen, displaying five giant excavators and dredgers on a bare industrial ground used for festivals and events.
locations.facilities: Arena covers 14,000 m2 with a maximum of 25,000 visitors; seated configurations include 3,250 seated/6,500 standing, 4,820 standing steps, or up to 13,500 to 14,000 in the arena. Buildings include the Orangerie (560 m2), a mechanical workshop, an auxiliary workshop and admin areas (80 m2). On-site parking for 400 cars (7,000 more at the nearby federal highway), 10 bus spaces, 1,000 bike spaces and a heliport. Power supply: 782 kW for stage lighting and other uses, 248 kW for audio, with six distribution points around the arena. Water supply up to 13.32 m3/h, wastewater capacity 47.34 m3/h. Fixed sanitation for about 10,000 visitors, partly wheelchair accessible, plus a medical care room.

locations.name: Festung Ehrenbreitstein
locations.setting: Prussian hill fortress above the Rhine at Koblenz with casemates, ramparts, barrack blocks, a large parade court and views over the river junction.

locations.name: Fischauktionshalle
locations.setting: Former fish auction hall of 1896 on the Altona waterfront, a cast iron and glass hall with galleries and a view of the Elbe, now hired for events and markets.

locations.name: Flandernbunker
locations.setting: Wartime air raid bunker at the Kiel fjord kept as a memorial and cultural site, with bare concrete stairwells, narrow rooms on several floors and a roof terrace.

locations.name: Fleischerei Buechner Goerlitz
locations.setting: A butcher's shop in Goerlitz opened in 1911, with an original sales room of about 30 square metres lined in colourful period wall tiles depicting meat and sausage production.
locations.facilities: Sales room of about 30 sqm with original 1911 wall tiling

locations.name: Flughafen Berlin-Gatow
locations.setting: A former military airfield on the western edge of Berlin, now the Bundeswehr's air force museum, with a control tower, runway and hangars holding historic aircraft.

locations.name: Flughafen Dresden International
locations.setting: Dresden's airport, with a terminal built in 2001 in a glazed contemporary industrial style and Saxony's first underground S-Bahn station in its lower level.

locations.name: Flughafen Leipzig/Halle
locations.setting: An intercontinental airport between Leipzig and Halle, expanded around 2000 with a central terminal combining a railway station, multi storey car park and passenger check-in in one complex.

locations.name: Folkwang University of the Arts
locations.setting: Arts university in the former abbey buildings at Essen-Werden, with cloisters, rehearsal rooms, studios, lecture halls and a courtyard used for teaching.

locations.name: Frankfurt Bankenviertel
locations.setting: Frankfurt's financial district of glass office towers grouped around the old town and the river Main, the only high-rise skyline of its kind in Germany.

locations.name: Frankfurt-Hahn Airport
locations.setting: Former airbase in the Hunsrueck now used for cargo and charter flights, with a quiet terminal, long runway, aprons and hangars away from built up areas.

locations.name: Frauenkirche Dresden
locations.setting: A baroque domed church rebuilt after wartime destruction, on Dresden's Neumarkt square, with a large sandstone dome and an ornate galleried interior.

locations.name: Freilichtmuseum am Kiekeberg
locations.setting: Open air museum south of Hamburg with relocated farmhouses, barns, a village shop, gardens and field paths covering rural life from the 18th century onward.

locations.name: Friedrichsbad Baden-Baden
locations.setting: Nineteenth century Roman Irish bath house in Baden-Baden, with domed bathing halls, tiled steam rooms and a central pool under a coffered cupola.

locations.name: Fritz-Walter-Stadion
locations.setting: Football stadium on the Betzenberg hill above Kaiserslautern, a steep four sided bowl with tight stands, dressing rooms and a wooded approach.

locations.name: Frohnauer Hammer
locations.setting: A fully working historic hammer forge in the Frohnau district of Annaberg-Buchholz, part of the Ore Mountains mining heritage recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

locations.name: FTL Filmautobahn
locations.setting: A private closed motorway loop of 2,300 metres at an industrial park in Aldenhoven, built as a standing backlot for high-speed car chase and highway filming.
locations.facilities: Two 1,000 metre lanes separated by an 81 cm barrier, with turning loops at both ends for a 2,300 metre total closed circuit; entrance and exit ramps, shoulder lanes, emergency parking bays, a noise barrier and adjustable regional signage.
locations.suitability: Built for continuous high-speed driving shots, long dialogue scenes and staged oncoming traffic; used for the RTL series Alarm fur Cobra 11.
locations.logistics: Industriepark Emil Mayrisch, 52457 Aldenhoven.

locations.name: Fuenf Hoefe
locations.setting: Shopping and office quarter in central Munich by Herzog and de Meuron, with five courtyards and glazed arcades, hanging planting in the Salvator passage and a suspended steel sphere in the Viscardihof.
locations.facilities: 48,000 sq m in total with 17,000 sq m retail, 25,000 sq m offices and a 3,200 sq m art hall, no parking inside the building

locations.name: Fuggerei
locations.setting: Walled social housing settlement in Augsburg founded in 1521 and still in use, with 67 houses, 142 flats, its own church and lanes that read as a town within the town.
locations.facilities: Lorry access possible, six parking spaces on site, 16 A and 32 A power

locations.name: Funkhaus Berlin
locations.setting: A former East German state radio headquarters on the river Spree, with wood-panelled studios, offices and a large concert hall, run today as an event and production venue.

locations.name: Galopprennbahn Iffezheim
locations.setting: Horse racing course at Iffezheim near Baden-Baden, with grandstands, weighing room, paddock, restaurants and parkland around the track.

locations.name: Gasometer Oberhausen
locations.setting: 117-metre disused gas holder in Oberhausen converted into an exhibition hall, with a vast cylindrical interior used for large-scale installations.

locations.name: Gaswerk Augsburg
locations.setting: Coal gasworks of 1915 in Augsburg Oberhausen, kept almost complete across about 18 hectares, with gasholders, brick workshops and open yards.
locations.facilities: Site of about 18 hectares, power supply on request
locations.logistics: Condition described by the operator as in need of renovation

locations.name: Gedenkstaette Hoheneck
locations.setting: A listed former prison complex in Stollberg with a main tract and three wings; cells occupied the south and west wings over four floors, and the north wing held workshop production lines.

locations.name: Genossenschaft in der Heilstaette Harzgerode
locations.setting: The former Harzgerode sanatorium north of the town, a park-like ensemble of Neues Bauen buildings now run by a housing cooperative, with most structures in largely original condition.

locations.name: Georg-Gassmann-Stadion
locations.setting: Marburg's athletics stadium in the Ockershausen district, with a modern 400 metre synthetic running track and long jump, shot put and pole vault facilities.

locations.name: Glaeserne Manufaktur (Volkswagen)
locations.setting: Volkswagen's Transparent Factory in central Dresden, opened in 2001, where car assembly takes place behind glass walls visible to visitors alongside a showroom.

locations.name: Glasmanufaktur Harzkristall
locations.setting: One of Germany's few remaining working glassworks, at Derenburg in the Harz, where visitors can watch traditional glassblowing on the factory floor alongside a cafe and shop.

locations.name: Gloria Kino Kassel
locations.setting: A 1954 cinema at Kassel's Staendeplatz with 342 seats, green velvet upholstery, an original chandelier and its 1950s facade with black steel-letter signage still intact.

locations.name: Goethe-Universitaet Frankfurt am Main
locations.setting: One of Germany's largest universities, with more than 158 degree programmes spread across four campuses in Frankfurt, linked by the city's public transport network.

locations.name: Gondwana Das Praehistorium
locations.setting: Dark walk through museum on the former Reden colliery in Schiffweiler, with built prehistoric scenes indoors and the pit head buildings and slag heap outside.

locations.name: Görlitz Old Town
locations.setting: War-spared old town of around 4,000 listed buildings ranging from Gothic and Renaissance to Baroque and Wilhelminian styles.
locations.known_for: The Grand Budapest Hotel, Inglourious Basterds, The Reader

locations.name: Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg
locations.setting: A former hunting palace above Cologne converted into a hotel, with baroque state rooms, a park and a modern spa wing.
locations.facilities: Ballsaal: meeting up to 180, banquet 240, reception 300. Eventhalle: meeting up to 250, reception 300. Bel Etage: reception up to 200. Salon Medici & Goethe: meeting/reception up to 100, banquet 80. Salon Alberti: meeting/reception up to 60. Salon Zanetti: meeting/reception up to 40. Gewoelbekeller (vaulted cellar): banquet up to 30, reception up to 50. Smaller boardrooms (Business Lounge, Library, Salon Habsburg) seat up to 12 to 20.

locations.name: Gymnasium St. Augustin zu Grimma
locations.setting: A grammar school in Grimma founded in 1450, housed since the 19th century in the former Augustinian monastery buildings, with its current facade dating from a full 1891 rebuild.

locations.name: Halle-Neustadt (noerdliche Neustadt)
locations.setting: A large prefabricated socialist new town built from 1964 to house workers near the Buna and Leuna chemical plants, originally planned with generous greenery and public art between the blocks.

locations.name: Hamburg Airport
locations.setting: City airport with two terminals, check in rows, gates, baggage areas and an apron, plus a rail station beneath the plaza between the terminals.

locations.name: Hamburg Rathaus
locations.setting: Neo-Renaissance city hall of 1897 on the Rathausmarkt in Hamburg, with a 112-metre tower, an ornate facade and several hundred rooms including ceremonial halls.

locations.name: Hannover Congress Centrum
locations.setting: Congress complex in Hanover with a domed 1914 hall, modern conference rooms, foyers and a park setting, used for conferences, banquets and broadcasts.

locations.name: Hansaviertel Berlin
locations.setting: A postwar modernist housing estate built for the 1957 Interbau exhibition, with apartment towers and low-rise blocks by international architects set in parkland near the Tiergarten.

locations.name: Hauptbahnhof Frankfurt
locations.setting: Frankfurt's main station, Germany's second busiest long-distance rail hub, with a broad historicist concourse building where travellers from many routes cross paths.

locations.name: Hauptbahnhof Leipzig
locations.setting: Leipzig's main station, with a nearly 300 metre long concourse building and a six-vault steel platform hall, built with a strong symmetrical layout on both sides of the tracks.

locations.name: Hauptgebaeude FSU Jena
locations.setting: The main Art Nouveau building of Friedrich Schiller University Jena, opened in 1908 for the university's 350th anniversary, with an asymmetrical three to four storey facade.

locations.name: Havelstudios Berlin
locations.setting: Three sound stages from 95 to 600 square metres with cycloramas up to 11 metres high at Havelstudios on the river Havel in Berlin, with production offices and dressing rooms.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 600 m2, 11 m ceiling, U-shaped cyclorama (12+15+5 m wide, 8 m high); Stage 2: 215 m2, 6.5 m ceiling, 10 x 5.5 m cyclorama; Stage 3: 95 m2, 4.5 m ceiling. Control rooms, up to 3 makeup rooms, 7 wardrobes, offices and a cafeteria.
locations.logistics: Havelchaussee 161, 14055 Berlin.

locations.name: Heidelberg University
locations.setting: Germany's oldest university, with a baroque Old University building, a Great Hall and a historic student prison around Universitätsplatz in Heidelberg's old town.

locations.name: Heinz von Heiden Arena
locations.setting: Football stadium in the Maschsee park in Hanover, a bowl with a continuous roof, hospitality levels, dressing rooms and service corridors, also used for concerts.

locations.name: Hellerau
locations.setting: Early twentieth-century garden city on the edge of Dresden built around the Hellerau Festival Theatre, with modernist workshop housing and a rhythmic-gymnastics hall used for performance and film.
locations.facilities: On-site Lago-Bar for catering; qualified in-house technical staff manage events due to the stage setup and specialised equipment (own site).
locations.logistics: Reachable by tram line 8, highway accessible, large on-site parking lot (own site).

locations.name: Henrichshuette Hattingen
locations.setting: Preserved ironworks in the Ruhr valley with a blast furnace, casting house, forge and machine halls, kept as an industrial museum by the regional authority LWL.

locations.name: High Performance Computing Center Stuttgart
locations.setting: University supercomputing centre in Stuttgart Vaihingen, with machine halls of cabinets, cabling and cooling plant plus a visualisation laboratory.

locations.name: Hinterbergwerk
locations.setting: The largest rental studio in Wiesbaden, combining older building character with modern technical fit-out for photo and film production in the Rhine-Main area.
locations.facilities: Studio for photography, film and events with a 180 degree cyclorama rounded at top and bottom, 14 metres in diameter and 5 metres high, and a camera distance of 17 metres. Equipment includes a 9 x 7 m remote-controlled ceiling sail, a movable light wall, a topshot rig, a black curtain running all the way round, a green screen, ARRI, Dedo and Kino Flo lighting, a goods lift, a make-up room, a meeting room and a lighting store. Floor plan and equipment list are published as PDFs.

locations.name: Historische Stadthalle Wuppertal
locations.setting: Concert and congress building of 1900 on the Johannisberg in Wuppertal, with a galleried great hall, stucco salons, staircases and foyers in period decoration.

locations.name: Historisches Feuerwehrhaus Ketzerbach
locations.setting: A two storey fire station built in 1911 on Ketzerbach in Marburg's old town, still in use by a volunteer fire brigade unit and keeping vintage engines and equipment on site.

locations.name: Historisches Rathaus Marburg
locations.setting: The late-Gothic town hall of 1512 to 1527 on Marburg's Oberstadt market square, with a hexagonal stair tower, a historic council chamber for up to 120 people and two cells in its cellar.

locations.name: Hochschule der Medien Stuttgart
locations.setting: Media university on the Vaihingen campus in Stuttgart, with lecture rooms, a library, teaching studios and modern circulation space.

locations.name: Hohenzollern Castle
locations.setting: Nineteenth century hilltop castle above Hechingen on the Swabian Alb, with ramparts, courtyards, a chapel and furnished state rooms, reached by a spiral approach road.

locations.name: Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin
locations.setting: A rebuilt grand hotel beside the Brandenburg Gate, with a marble lobby, ballroom and period-style suites used for period and contemporary interiors.
locations.facilities: Two ballrooms and 16 function rooms. Ballroom 500 m2 (500 reception, 340 banquet, 300 classroom); Palais Room 450 m2 (400 reception, 300 banquet, 240 classroom); Event Location 1907, 330 m2 (200 reception, 120 banquet); Large Wintergarten 147 m2 (100 reception, 90 banquet); Academy Rooms 1-2, 120 m2 each (90 reception, 80 banquet, 60 classroom); Bundeszimmer 74 m2 (60 reception, 50 banquet, 42 classroom); smaller rooms range 40 to 84 m2. Most function rooms have natural daylight.

locations.name: Hotel Atlantic Hamburg
locations.setting: White grand hotel of 1909 on the Aussenalster with a columned lobby, staircase, ballroom and lake facing suites, listed by the Hamburg film commission.

locations.name: Hotel Bayerischer Hof
locations.setting: Grand hotel on Promenadeplatz in the Munich old town with 337 rooms, 74 suites, 40 banqueting and conference rooms, five restaurants, six bars, a rooftop spa, a theatre stage, a cinema and a night club.
locations.facilities: Underground car park at the hotel, unproblematic access, 16 A, 32 A and 64 A power

locations.name: Hotel Camp Reinsehlen
locations.setting: Hotel on a former military airfield in the Lueneburg Heath, low modern buildings with meeting rooms and a wide open heath plain around them.

locations.name: Hotel Maximilian's Augsburg
locations.setting: Long established 132 room hotel on Maximilianstrasse in central Augsburg, formerly the Drei Mohren, listed in the Bavarian film commission catalogue.
locations.facilities: Multi storey car park directly behind the building, 64 A power

locations.name: Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski Munich
locations.setting: Grand hotel on Maximilianstrasse open since 1858, with a listed facade, 300 rooms and suites, lobby, two restaurants, a new spa, a smokers' lounge and the Hemingway Bar.

locations.name: Hotelrestaurantschiff Mainod
locations.setting: A 1959-built, 55-metre former passenger ship permanently moored on the river Main at Frankfurt-Hoechst, now a restaurant ship with an Art Deco main deck and a floating terrace.

locations.name: Hugo Junkers Hangar
locations.setting: Aircraft hangar at Moenchengladbach airfield used as an event hall, with a clear span interior, apron access and a historic Ju 52 on site.
locations.suitability: Listed in the Film Commission NRW location catalogue; hall and apron are hired for events and shoots.

locations.name: Humboldt University of Berlin
locations.setting: Berlin's oldest university on Unter den Linden, with a neoclassical main building, historic lecture halls, a courtyard and library reading rooms in the government district.

locations.name: Hyparschale Magdeburg
locations.setting: A 1969 multi-purpose hall by engineer Ulrich Muther next to Magdeburg's Stadthalle, built from four self-supporting hyperbolic paraboloid concrete shells and reopened in 2024 after restoration.

locations.name: Institute of Forensic Medicine, Ulm University Hospital
locations.setting: Forensic medicine department of Ulm University Hospital on the Oberer Eselsberg campus, with laboratory and autopsy rooms offered for filming.

locations.name: Jahrhunderthalle Bochum
locations.setting: Former gas blowing hall of a Bochum steelworks, now an event venue with a riveted steel nave, brick side halls, overhead cranes and a park on the old works site.

photo.author: The original uploader was Stahlkocher at German Wikipedia.

locations.name: Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt
locations.setting: A domed former engineering hall in Frankfurt-Hoechst with an iron-and-glass roof, used for concerts, ballet, comedy shows, congresses and corporate events.

locations.name: Justizpalast Munich
locations.setting: A neo-baroque courthouse from 1897 housing Munich's higher regional court, with a domed atrium, marble stairways and panelled courtrooms.

locations.name: KaDeWe
locations.setting: One of continental Europe's largest department stores, with Art Deco and postwar interiors, a glass-domed food hall and escalator halls suited to retail and crowd scenes.

locations.name: Kammergericht Berlin
locations.setting: Berlin's highest court, a Wilhelmine-era courthouse with a domed entrance hall, marble staircases and panelled courtrooms.

locations.name: Kampnagel
locations.setting: Former crane factory in Hamburg's Winterhude district converted into a production house for theatre, dance and performance, with large industrial halls and a forecourt.
locations.facilities: During the 2026-2028 renovation, spaces available for hire are Hall k6, Foyer k6, 'Links vorbei', KX (80 seats) and 6a (80 seats); housed in a former factory building (own site).

locations.name: Kap Arkona
locations.setting: Northern tip of Rügen with two historic lighthouses, a former Cold War radar bunker and a reconstructed Slavic hillfort on chalk and boulder-clay cliffs above the Baltic.

locations.name: Kempinski Hotel Berchtesgaden
locations.setting: Modern hotel at 1,000 metres in the Berchtesgaden Alps, with 138 rooms and suites, two restaurants, a fireplace bar and a spa of 1,400 sq m.
locations.logistics: Good road access, winter tyres and sometimes snow chains needed in winter

locations.name: Kiel Hauptbahnhof
locations.setting: Terminus station in Kiel with a glazed train shed over dead end platforms, a concourse of 1899 and the harbour and ferry berths a short walk away.

locations.name: Kloster Eberbach
locations.setting: Former Cistercian monastery in the Rheingau with a Romanesque basilica, a vaulted dormitory, wine cellars and surrounding vineyards, now run as an events and wine estate.
locations.suitability: The monastery is described as offering interior and exterior filming, suitable for photo shoots, advertising, image videos and TV productions. Spaces named for use include the cloisters, lay refectory, monks' dormitory, baroque floor rooms, basilica, hospital cellar and treasury (own site).

locations.name: Kokerei Hansa
locations.setting: Former coking plant in Dortmund with intact coke oven batteries, coal towers, pump houses and machine halls preserved as an industrial heritage site.
locations.suitability: Casual visitor photography or filming needs no permit. Editorial photo and video work and drone flights require a free permit; commercial use requires a paid permit; wedding shoots are paid unless part of a rental event. Applicants should allow up to five working days for processing. Rules ban nudity, weapons or replicas, fire, pyrotechnics, artificial fog and glitter, and entry to cordoned-off areas; visitor safety and flow must be respected and private drone flights are not allowed. This applies across all Stiftung Industriedenkmalpflege sites (13 mines plus Kokerei Hansa, Koepchenwerk and Ahe-Hammer).

locations.name: Kongresshalle Reichsparteitagsgelaende
locations.setting: Unfinished Nazi congress hall of 1935 to 1940 modelled on the Colosseum, 39 metres high and 240 by 200 metres outside, in bare brick with granite facing, with long corridors and colonnades around an open inner circle.
locations.facilities: Very large spaces, storage areas, lift and sanitary facilities, extensive parking, normal and three phase power

locations.name: Königsstuhl (Rügen)
locations.setting: Chalk cliff on Rügen's Jasmund coast rising sharply above the Baltic, within a national park of beech forest, with a visitor centre built into the clifftop.

locations.name: Kraemerbruecke Erfurt
locations.setting: A medieval stone arch bridge of 1325 across the Gera river in Erfurt's old town, still lined with inhabited half-timbered shop buildings, one of the few such bridges left north of the Alps.

locations.name: Kraftzentrale Straubing
locations.setting: Listed 1952 power house of a former roof tile works in Straubing, with boiler and machine halls used for concerts and events since the plant closed in 1992.
locations.facilities: 275 sq m usable floor, about 50 car spaces in front, unrestricted lorry access, 64 A three phase supply

locations.name: Kriminalpanoptikum Aschersleben
locations.setting: A former remand prison in Aschersleben, a bare red brick Prussian utility building from the late 19th century with barred windows, now kept as a crime and prison history exhibit.

locations.name: Krystallpalast Variete Leipzig
locations.setting: A variety theatre in Leipzig reviving the name of a celebrated venue destroyed in 1943, rebuilt in the 1990s behind a preserved historic facade in the Magazingasse.

locations.name: Kultur Gut Hasselburg
locations.setting: Manor farm near the Baltic coast at Altenkrempe, with a thatched gatehouse barn used as a concert and event hall, stables, courtyards and open farmland.

locations.name: Kulturzentrum Schlachthof Wiesbaden
locations.setting: A collectively run cultural centre in a former Wiesbaden slaughterhouse, now Hesse's largest socio-cultural venue with close to 400 events and 300,000 visitors a year.

locations.name: Kunstlabor 2
locations.setting: Former municipal health building of 1963 on Dachauer Strasse in Munich, taken over as a temporary art centre over six floors with bare rooms, street art, floor to ceiling windows and 6.5 metre ceilings.
locations.facilities: About 10,000 sq m over six floors plus 6,800 sq m outside, 180 sq m event room, 400 sq m showroom, two courtyards of about 270 sq m

locations.name: Kunstquartier Bethanien
locations.setting: A former 19th-century deaconess hospital in Kreuzberg, converted into studios and exhibition halls, keeping its brick wards, corridors and courtyard.

locations.name: Kurhaus Wiesbaden
locations.setting: A neoclassical spa and casino building from 1907, with a colonnaded facade, a domed festival hall and formal grounds, still run as an event and casino venue.

locations.name: Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord
locations.setting: Disused early twentieth-century ironworks in Duisburg with blast furnaces, gasometers, bunkers and pipe bridges left standing in a public park, floodlit at night and open for climbing and diving.
locations.suitability: Private, non-commercial filming and photography (weddings, family photos, TFP, cosplay) generally needs no permit. Commercial filming, including for agencies, TV companies, professional photographers and commercial YouTube makers, always requires a paid permit, processed within up to 5 working days and charged at a daily rate. Drones are prohibited unless a special application is approved; nude photography, high-speed powder photography for commercial use, weapons, paintball, artificial fog and fireworks are restricted or need separate permits. A permit covers the parkland and public areas only; the event halls (Power Plant, Blower House Complex, Casthouse) are separately leased (own site).
locations.logistics: 1,600 free parking spaces directly across from the main entrance (own site).

locations.name: Lanxess Arena
locations.setting: Indoor arena in Cologne's Deutz district with a bowl seating around 20,000, used for concerts, ice hockey, basketball and television productions.
locations.facilities: Theatre seating configuration up to 5,300 seats; multiple restaurants (Backstage, Henkelmaennchen) and bar/catering areas on site (own site).
locations.logistics: Multiple car parks on site: P1, P3 (VIP), P4, P5 and KoelnArcaden (own site).

locations.name: Lava-Dome and Lava Cellars Mendig
locations.setting: Basalt quarrying cellars under Mendig, a cold cavern system of pillars and vaults once used by breweries, reached from a museum building at the surface.

locations.name: LEDcave Mannheim
locations.setting: Virtual production stage in Mannheim built around an LED volume with camera tracking, used for in camera visual effects work.

locations.name: Leichtathletikhalle Erfurt (Hartwig-Gauder-Halle)
locations.setting: An indoor athletics hall built in 1994 as part of the Erfurt-Sued sports centre, with a 200 metre indoor track and about 9,200 square metres of training and competition space.

locations.name: Liederhalle Stuttgart
locations.setting: Listed 1950s culture and congress centre in Stuttgart, with three main halls, mosaic clad facades, foyers and staircases in period modernist detail.

locations.name: Ludwig Maximilian University Main Building
locations.setting: Main building of Munich's LMU built from 1835 to 1840 by Friedrich von Gaertner, with lecture halls, the Grosse Aula and interiors mixing historicism, art nouveau and neoclassicism, facing Geschwister-Scholl-Platz.
locations.suitability: Film and photo work needs approval from Press and Communications, application to be sent well before the shooting date
locations.logistics: Parking must be applied for through the City of Munich film service office

locations.name: Ludwig Studio Berlin
locations.setting: A 930 square metre sound stage with an 11 metre ceiling in Berlin-Tempelhof, with truck-rated flooring, a pre-rigged truss grid and a terrace on the Teltow canal.
locations.facilities: 930 m2 stage (almost 1,000 m2 total floor area), 11 m ceiling height, sealed concrete floor rated for trucks, pre-installed green/black truss and curtain system, vehicle gate 3.80 x 4.00 m, CEE power connections up to 125A, makeup room, two VIP rooms, production office and a terrace on the Teltow canal.
locations.suitability: Used for commercials, music videos, TV series and feature films, per the operator.
locations.logistics: Berlin-Tempelhof, near the Gradestrasse exit of the A100.

locations.name: Luebeck Town Hall
locations.setting: Medieval brick town hall on the Luebeck market square with wind screen walls, an arcaded front, the audience hall and council chambers still in use.

locations.name: LWL-Industriemuseum Zeche Nachtigall
locations.setting: Early coal mine in the Ruhr valley at Witten with a brick engine house, a brickworks kiln and an accessible tunnel, presented as an LWL industrial museum.

locations.name: LWL-Museum Schiffshebewerk Henrichenburg
locations.setting: Boat lift of 1899 on the Dortmund-Ems Canal with towers, machine house, old canal basin and moored inland vessels, run as a museum site of the LWL.

locations.name: MAINSTUDIO.TV
locations.setting: A rental film and television studio in Dreieich near Frankfurt, used for image films, commercials, product videos, livestream productions and photo shoots.
locations.price_note: Studio hire EUR 465 net for a half day (up to 4 hours including set-up and strike) and EUR 795 net for a full day, both excluding VAT; a staffed town hall or live event day starts at EUR 3,850 net (own site).
locations.facilities: 225 m2 column-free studio floor of 15 x 15 m with a 3.80 m ceiling, a truss system, three-phase power connections and full blackout; 32 m2 of green screen (green screen 15 x 3 m), a separate 125 m2 control room, make-up room, lounge, coffee kitchen and air conditioning. Internet is 300 Mbit upload over fibre, with DSL, LTE on two networks and Starlink as fallbacks.
locations.logistics: In Dreieich, ten kilometres south of Frankfurt and 15 minutes from the airport; delivery up to 40-tonne trucks and 20 parking spaces at the studio.

locations.name: Max-Morlock-Stadion
locations.setting: Nuremberg stadium completed in 1928 in Bauhaus style, home of 1. FC Nuernberg, with a red 400 metre running track around the pitch and a three storey VIP and media building.

locations.name: Media City Atelier Leipzig
locations.setting: Five studios from about 50 to 1,500 square metres, including a greenscreen stage and a daylight glass hall, at Media City Atelier on a former slaughterhouse site in Leipzig.
locations.facilities: Studio 3 combines a 420 m2 event area with the 384 m2 standing Riverboat set at 8 m height, in a hall with a gross area of 1,575 m2, a floor rated 20 kN/m2 for trucks and forklifts, a cyclorama rail at 8 m running 156 m all round with lowering gear, a total power supply of 1,080 kW with 360 analogue 2.5 kW dimmers and 43 analogue 5.0 kW dimmers, and 550 kW of cooling. Studio 5 is 484 m2 at 4.75 m height with an 8.00 x 4.00 x 0.40 m stage, 80 kW of power, base lighting of 18 x 1 kW and a 3 x 4 m door with direct street access. The daylight studio in the inner courtyard is 576 m2 at 6 m height. Studios 1 and 2 are used for the ARD series In aller Freundschaft and Studio 4 is a green box studio.
locations.logistics: Altenburger Strasse 13, 04275 Leipzig.

locations.name: Memorium Nuremberg Trials
locations.setting: The Nuremberg Palace of Justice, still a working courthouse, whose historic Courtroom 600 hosted the postwar Nuremberg trials and is now also a memorial museum.
locations.suitability: Filming permits are handled by the museum; access to the working courthouse is limited by ongoing court use.

locations.name: Merkurdome
locations.setting: Former publishing house and office site with halls at Wolfratshausen south of Munich, kept as a standing set for police stations, newsrooms, cells, hospital rooms and operating theatres.
locations.facilities: 200 sq m of set or production rooms plus halls of 1,000 and 540 sq m up to 12 m high, power and water outside for catering, 16 A and 64 A
locations.suitability: Green rooms and dressing rooms available, parking and unit base space around the building

locations.name: Messe Stuttgart
locations.setting: Trade fair grounds beside Stuttgart airport, with large column free halls, a congress centre and a car park deck spanning the motorway.
locations.logistics: Directly at Stuttgart airport and the A8 motorway

locations.name: Metropolis Halle
locations.setting: A 3,034 square metre television studio hall with an 11 metre ceiling at Filmpark Babelsberg in Potsdam, dividable into two halls and used for TV production and corporate events.
locations.facilities: 3,034 m2 hall with 11 m clear height, divisible into Studio Ost (about 1,600 m2) and Studio West (about 1,400 m2) by a sound-insulating partition wall, plus a 956 m2 glazed foyer, three 120 m2 and three 50 m2 multipurpose rooms. Floor loading is 4 t/m2, there are two hall entrances with 4 m clear height, a grid of 105 ceiling points rated 450 to 950 kg each, WLAN, ISDN and CAT7 patch panels, a service corridor running all round, and catering areas with cooling and storage space. The hall is barrier-free and opened in 2008 as a television-capable multipurpose studio.
locations.suitability: Described by the venue as a television-suitable multi-function studio; TV production and filming are listed among its uses alongside corporate events, conferences and galas.
locations.logistics: At Filmpark Babelsberg in Potsdam, about 300 m from Medienstadt Babelsberg station and 45 minutes from central Berlin, with 900 on-site parking spaces.

locations.name: Metropolitan Backlot (Studio Babelsberg)
locations.setting: A more than 15,000 square metre outdoor street backlot next to Studio Babelsberg in Potsdam, with four street sets that can be redressed as different European or American cities.
locations.known_for: Babylon Berlin, Mute, A Hidden Life
locations.facilities: Over 15,000 m2 backlot (opened 2016, replacing an earlier 7,000 m2 set demolished in 2013) with four street configurations in different architectural styles and multiple courtyards, green and blue screen integration, and adjoining office, workshop and functional space.
locations.logistics: Adjoins the Studio Babelsberg site on August-Bebel-Strasse, Potsdam-Babelsberg.

locations.name: Meyer Werft
locations.setting: Cruise ship yard in Papenburg with covered building docks, steel workshops, a fitting out quay and the narrow Ems below, listed in the nordmedia location guide.

locations.name: MHP Arena Stuttgart
locations.setting: Football stadium in the Neckarpark at Stuttgart, home of VfB Stuttgart, with steep stands, hospitality levels and media areas.

locations.name: MMC Studios Cologne (Coloneum)
locations.setting: Twenty film and TV studios on a 157,000 square metre former airfield site at MMC's Coloneum in Cologne-Ossendorf, including a daylight studio and set-building workshops.
locations.facilities: MMC's own studio factsheet gives dimensions for 19 stages at the Coloneum, Am Coloneum 1, Cologne: Studio 30/31 2,565.00 m2 (scene area 2,117.92 m2) at 11.00 m to the roof truss, Studios 52 and 53 1,977.80 m2 each at 26.00 m, Studio 32 1,974.00 m2 at 11.00 m, Studio 36 1,581.40 m2 at 11.00 m, Studios 37 and 38 1,222.80 m2 each at 8.80 m, Studios 39, 40 and 41 about 1,000 m2 each at 8.80 m, Studio 50 938.50 m2 at 11.50 m, Studio 35 945.70 m2 at 9.00 m, and smaller stages down to 174.30 m2 at 6.00 m. The factsheet lists studio and scene area, roof truss, lighting grid and curtain track height per stage. The site covers 157,000 m2 on the former Butzweilerhof airfield.
locations.logistics: Am Coloneum, 50829 Cologne-Ossendorf (former Butzweilerhof airfield).

locations.name: Monte Kali
locations.setting: A large potash mining spoil heap over 500 metres high near Heringen in eastern Hesse, made up of more than 200 million tonnes of salt waste from the works below.

locations.name: Mueller'sches Volksbad
locations.setting: Art nouveau public baths opened in Munich in 1901 and kept in original condition, with two pools, a Roman Irish steam bath, tub and shower baths and a Finnish sauna.

locations.name: Muellverwertungsanlage Ingolstadt
locations.setting: Working waste to energy plant of 1977 with furnaces, tipping ramps, pipework, ventilation plant, cranes and chimneys, described by the film commission as a repeat filming location.
locations.facilities: About 16,000 sq m, lorry access, 16 A, 32 A and 64 A power

locations.name: Munich Airport
locations.setting: Airport opened in 1992 with two terminals and a satellite pier, 120 aircraft stands, five multi storey car parks and the covered MAC forum of 10,000 sq m used for shoots and events.
locations.suitability: Press office handles news filming, Terminal Services issues permits for commercial photo and film shoots
locations.logistics: About 28 km from central Munich, two S-Bahn stations, motorway A92, parking applied for through the airport company

locations.name: Museum Kalkwerk Lengefeld
locations.setting: A 19th and 20th century lime works near Lengefeld in the Ore Mountains, preserved as a technical monument with its kilns, a transport bridge system and quarrying equipment intact.

locations.name: Museum Park Rüdersdorf
locations.setting: Former limestone quarry and cement works east of Berlin preserved as an open-air museum, with quarry faces, kilns, a narrow-gauge railway and industrial machinery halls.
locations.facilities: Named event spaces at the former limestone quarry site are KulturDach, Bohlenbinderdach and Cafe Magazin (own site).

locations.name: Museum Reinhard Ernst
locations.setting: A museum of abstract art after 1945 in Wiesbaden, opened in 2024 in a building designed by Pritzker Prize winning architect Fumihiko Maki.

locations.name: Musikforum Katharinenkirche
locations.setting: A former monastery church in Stendal, dating back to a 1468 dedication, converted into an acoustically modern concert hall hosting about 50 concerts and events a year.

locations.name: MVG Museum
locations.setting: Listed former tram workshop hall of over 5,000 sq m in Munich Ramersdorf, holding 25 historic trams, buses and works vehicles from several periods plus a small cinema room.
locations.facilities: 40 parking spaces beside the hall, further spaces can be hired, power up to 130 kW

locations.name: Naval Memorial Laboe
locations.setting: A tall brick naval memorial tower overlooking the Kiel fjord, with a preserved World War Two submarine open to visitors alongside it.

locations.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century Romanesque revival castle rising from a wooded Alpine crag above the village of Hohenschwangau.
locations.known_for: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, The Great Escape, Ludwig (1973)

locations.name: nhow Frankfurt
locations.setting: A design hotel in Frankfurt's Gallus district with a gold-toned lobby, money-themed guest rooms, meeting rooms up to 200 square metres and a rooftop bar on its 47th floor.
locations.facilities: Meeting rooms up to 200 sqm, rooftop bar on the 47th floor

locations.name: Nivre Film & Studio
locations.setting: A 220 square metre film and greenscreen studio in a converted former milk-storage building in Weimar, with a production office, control room and dressing rooms.
locations.facilities: 220 m2 studio within a 330 m2 building, ground-level roller-door access, high ceiling, break room, costume/makeup area, production office and control room; usable as a traditional set studio or greenscreen studio.
locations.logistics: Georg-Haar-Strasse 5, 99427 Weimar.

locations.name: NOUVABRIK
locations.setting: The brick building of a former furniture factory in Dautphetal-Holzhausen, with exposed brickwork, industrial windows, timber floors and a curated interior kept for filming.
locations.facilities: Direct vehicle access, on-site parking, holiday apartment on the grounds

locations.name: Nürburgring
locations.setting: Motor racing circuit in the Eifel hills with the 20.8-kilometre Nordschleife loop and a separate shorter Grand Prix track, plus paddock, grandstands and a visitor centre.

locations.name: Oberlandesgericht Dresden (Staendehaus)
locations.setting: Dresden's higher regional court, housed in the former Staendehaus built 1901-06 by Paul Wallot, standing between the Bruehlsche Terrasse and the Schlossplatz in the old town.

locations.name: Oberlandesgericht Hamm
locations.setting: Higher regional court in Hamm with courtrooms, judges' corridors, a law library and formal entrance halls, listed as a location by the Film Commission NRW.

locations.name: Olympiapark München
locations.setting: 1972 Olympic park in Munich with a tent-roofed stadium, hall and swimming venue around an artificial hill and lake, still used for concerts and sporting events.
locations.facilities: The venue offers halls and spaces for 100 to 10,000 or more people, including the Olympiastadion (Olympic Stadium), Olympiahalle, Kleine Olympiahalle (Small Olympic Hall), a Business Area, the Coubertin/Club restaurant, and outdoor grounds under the park's tent roof.

locations.name: Osthafenbruecke
locations.setting: A road bridge linking Frankfurt's Ostend and Sachsenhausen districts across the river Main, with an open view over the city's skyline, managed by the city of Frankfurt.

photo.author: Total number of my uploaded files: 1116

locations.name: Outletcity Metzingen
locations.setting: Outlet shopping town at Metzingen, mixing converted textile factory buildings with new glass fronted stores, pedestrian streets and restaurants.

locations.name: Panometer Leipzig
locations.setting: Former gasometer in Leipzig converted into a 360-degree panorama exhibition space, with a cylindrical brick interior more than thirty metres high.

locations.name: Parkhaus Domplatz Erfurt
locations.setting: A multi storey car park cut into Erfurt's medieval old town next to the cathedral and Petersberg citadel, with a glazed exit leading straight onto the Domplatz.

locations.name: Pausa Quartier Moessingen
locations.setting: Former Pausa textile printing works in Moessingen, a listed factory quarter of production halls, archive and museum rooms, a gallery, library and cafe.

locations.name: Peenemünde
locations.setting: Former Wehrmacht rocket research site on Usedom where the V2 was developed, with a preserved power station now housing a museum on wartime and Cold War history.

locations.name: Penzing Studios
locations.setting: Six sound stages from about 290 to 5,540 square metres, including a 478 square metre LED volume, on a former airbase near Landsberg am Lech, with backlot space across the 270 hectare site.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 1,580 m2, 7.9-8.9 m; Stage 2: 291 m2 (20.32 x 14.32 m), 5.43 m, with a 478 m2 LED wall at 2.6 mm pixel pitch (Hyperbowl virtual production stage); Stage 3: 2,190 m2, 7 m; Stage 4: 5,543 m2 in three sections, 5 m; Stage 5: 5,472 m2, 16 m, with 1,500 m2 of offices and 1,300 m2 of storage/workshop; Stage 6: 5,472 m2, 16 m.
locations.logistics: Kauferinger Strasse 32/34, 86929 Penzing, on a 270 hectare former airbase about 60 km west of Munich.

locations.name: phaeno Wolfsburg
locations.setting: Science centre by Zaha Hadid in Wolfsburg, a concrete body raised on cones with a cavernous open space beneath and a column free exhibition floor above.

locations.name: Platzl Hotel Munich
locations.setting: Family run four star hotel next to the Hofbraeuhaus in the Munich old town, with 167 rooms, seven conference rooms, corridors, lobby, bars and restaurant refurbished since 2015.
locations.facilities: Underground car park with 55 spaces at 1.85 m clearance, inner courtyard of about 150 sq m with vehicle access up to 3.4 m, 32 A power

locations.name: Polizeipraesidium Ulm
locations.setting: Regional police headquarters in Ulm listed as a filming location by the Baden-Wuerttemberg film commission, with offices, corridors and public service areas.

locations.name: Porsche Leipzig
locations.setting: Porsche's Leipzig production site, combining a working car factory with a 32 metre diamond-shaped Experience Centre building set in landscaped grounds.

locations.name: Pressnitztalbahn (Museumsbahn Steinbach-Joehstadt)
locations.setting: A narrow gauge heritage railway opened in 1892 running about eight kilometres between Steinbach and Joehstadt in the Erzgebirge, with restored locomotives and carriages from the 1960s to 1980s.

locations.name: Rammelsberg Mine
locations.setting: Ore mine above Goslar closed in 1988, with 1930s surface buildings, ore processing halls, a chain hoist room and accessible underground galleries.

locations.name: Rathaus Heppenheim
locations.setting: A Renaissance town hall on Heppenheim's market square, rebuilt in Baroque style after a 1693 town fire, still the seat of the town administration and a protected monument.

locations.name: Rathaus Wernigerode
locations.setting: A half-timbered Gothic and Renaissance town hall on Wernigerode's market square, a building group combining the Rathaus, a former weigh house and a later savings-bank building.

locations.name: Raumfabrik Frankfurt
locations.setting: A former metalware factory hall from the 1960s in Frankfurt's Heddernheim district, converted into a roughly 2,100 square metre event and production space that keeps its industrial character.

locations.name: Rhein-Ruhr-Zentrum
locations.setting: Covered shopping centre of 1973 in Muelheim an der Ruhr with long indoor malls, shop fronts, food court and multi storey car parks, listed in the NRW catalogue.

locations.name: RheinEnergieStadion
locations.setting: Football stadium in Cologne with four corner floodlight towers, tiered stands, hospitality levels and back of house corridors, listed in the NRW location catalogue.

locations.name: Rheinhotel Dreesen
locations.setting: Riverside hotel of 1894 in Bonn-Bad Godesberg with panelled function rooms, a ballroom, a terrace on the Rhine and period guest floors, hired for events.
locations.suitability: Function rooms, ballroom and terrace are hired for meetings and celebrations; listed in the Film Commission NRW catalogue.

locations.name: Ruhr University Bochum
locations.setting: A large 1960s brutalist university campus on a hillside above Bochum, with concrete tower blocks, lecture halls and connecting terraces.

locations.name: Saarlaendisches Staatstheater
locations.setting: State theatre of 1938 on the Saar in Saarbruecken, with a colonnaded front, an auditorium, stage machinery, workshops and rehearsal rooms.

locations.name: Salzspeicher Luebeck
locations.setting: Row of six brick salt warehouses of the 16th to 18th century beside the Trave in Luebeck, with stepped gables, loading doors and the Holstentor alongside.

locations.name: Schauspielhaus Bochum
locations.setting: Repertory theatre in Bochum with a 1950s auditorium, stage house and rehearsal spaces, one of Germany's leading state theatres.
locations.facilities: Four venues: Schauspielhaus (up to 800 seats), Kammerspiele (400 seats), Oval Office (100 seats) and Theaterrevier (own site).

locations.name: Schiffshebewerk Rothensee
locations.setting: A 1938 ship lift on the Mittelland Canal north of Magdeburg, an engineering monument that connected canal traffic to the Elbe until 2001.

locations.name: Schlenkerla Brauereigaststaette
locations.setting: Brewery tavern in a timber framed house in the Bamberg old town with five rooms and a beer garden, including a bar room of 1405 and a vaulted Dominican hall painted in 1310.
locations.logistics: Old town access up to an 18 tonne vehicle, no parking at the house, public car park a few minutes away

locations.name: Schlossbergbunker Boeblingen
locations.setting: Second World War air raid bunker under the Schlossberg in Boeblingen, with bare concrete tunnels, chambers and stairs.

locations.name: Schlosshotel Kronberg
locations.setting: A former Prussian imperial residence in the Taunus hills, run as a hotel, with wood-panelled halls, a library and formal gardens.

locations.name: Schumann's Bar am Hofgarten
locations.setting: Munich bar by the Hofgarten finished in shell limestone, serpentine, American walnut and grained leather, with a ground floor bar room, the Camparino side room and a first floor bar.
locations.facilities: Main room about 150 sq m, Camparino about 25 sq m, upstairs bar about 20 sq m, large lorry access, 16 A power

locations.name: Schuppen 50 (Hafenmuseum Hamburg)
locations.setting: Last imperial era quay sheds on the Bremer Kai in Hamburg, timber framed halls with a restored event floor, a row of historic cranes and the harbour railway.
locations.suitability: The commission page states the sheds can be asked for shoots, night filming is possible and there is a helicopter landing area in front of the building.

locations.name: Schwaebische Waldbahn
locations.setting: Heritage railway between Schorndorf and Welzheim in the Swabian Forest, with steam worked branch line trains, small country stations, viaducts and a tunnel.

locations.name: Schwimmoper Wuppertal
locations.setting: A landmark 1950s indoor swimming hall with a sweeping shell roof, built for the 1957 German swimming championships and still in public use.

locations.name: Seebrücke Sellin
locations.setting: Pleasure pier of the Baltic resort of Sellin on Rügen, a rebuilt wooden and steel structure reaching out over the sea with a restaurant at its end.

locations.name: Seegut Zeppelin
locations.setting: Design hotel on the shore at Friedrichshafen with direct access to Lake Constance, a small harbour, restaurant and park grounds.

locations.name: Siedlung Dahlhauser Heide
locations.setting: Miners' garden estate built from 1907 in Bochum-Hordel, with paired cottages, shutters, front gardens, stables and quiet cobbled streets in a listed layout.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Rasi57 assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Skywalk Willingen
locations.setting: A 665-metre pedestrian suspension bridge about 100 metres above ground, running beside the Muehlenkopfschanze ski jump where the annual World Cup ski jumping event is held.
locations.suitability: Filming on both sides of the bridge, on the bridge deck and on the approach paths; further options nearby by arrangement

locations.name: Speicherstadt
locations.setting: The world's largest historic warehouse district, red-brick blocks on timber piles crossed by canals and iron bridges, part now a museum quarter.
locations.facilities: The Speicherstadtmuseum can be rented as an event location after closing (17:00 on weekdays, 18:00 at weekends) for a party, reception or presentation. Seated dining fits up to 60 people; standing receptions fit up to 100. Dancing events are not possible.

locations.name: Spinnerei Leipzig
locations.setting: Former cotton mill in Leipzig's Plagwitz district, once continental Europe's largest, now a complex of galleries, artist studios and industrial halls around cobbled courtyards.

locations.name: St Michaelis Hamburg
locations.setting: Hamburg's principal baroque church, known locally as the Michel, with a copper-clad tower, a light-filled nave and a crypt, available for hire outside services.
locations.facilities: The church, the crypt (described by the venue as the largest in Northern Europe) and rooms in the 1950s community house can be booked for corporate concerts, readings, workshops, lectures and seminars.

locations.name: Staatstheater Stuttgart
locations.setting: A large state theatre complex by the palace gardens, housing opera, ballet and drama stages behind an early-20th-century facade.

locations.name: Stadtbad Chemnitz
locations.setting: A Neue Sachlichkeit swimming hall completed in 1935, the largest and most modern in Europe at the time, with a clear and functional layout of interlocking pool spaces inside and out.

locations.name: Stadtbuecherei Muenster
locations.setting: City library of 1993 in Muenster, a split building of glass and brick with a reading gallery, open stacks, a bridge over the lane and public counters.

locations.name: Stadthaus Ulm
locations.setting: White modernist civic building by Richard Meier on the cathedral square in Ulm, holding exhibition rooms, a hall and a cafe against the gothic minster.

locations.name: Stadtverwaltung Gera, Baudezernat (Amthorstrasse)
locations.setting: A 1970s office complex in Gera originally built for the district's socialist-era administration, with conference rooms, a wood-panelled canteen and a large event hall in near-original condition.

locations.name: Stations of the Harzer Schmalspurbahnen
locations.setting: 43 stations along the steam-hauled Harzquerbahn, Selketalbahn and Brockenbahn narrow-gauge network across the Harz mountains, many with buildings from the turn of the 20th century.

locations.name: Studio Babelsberg
locations.setting: The world's oldest large-scale film studio, in operation since 1912, with sound stages, workshops and permanent backlot sets.
locations.known_for: Metropolis, Inglourious Basterds, Bridge of Spies
locations.facilities: 21 sound stages totalling 300,000 sq ft on a 42-acre lot, largest Stage 20 at 75,826 sq ft (7,041 m2) and Stage 19 at 59,998 sq ft; indoor water tank of 500,000 litres and 4 m depth; 15,000 m2 Metropolitan Backlot with 54 facades of 12 to 15 m and 5,500 m2 of streets; exterior green screen wall, 9-acre open lot, set construction and a prop department with over a million items.
locations.suitability: Offers production services with internationally experienced crews, set construction, props and co-production and financing options; the backlot's four street sets can be dressed as Berlin, New York, London or Paris and carry vehicles up to 20 tonnes. Premises are not open to the public.
locations.logistics: August-Bebel-Strasse 26-53, Potsdam: from Berlin via the A115 to exit Potsdam-Babelsberg; S7 to Potsdam Hauptbahnhof or RE7 to Medienstadt Babelsberg (7-minute walk); from BER airport by RB22 to Griebnitzsee and bus 696.

locations.name: Studio Balan
locations.setting: Munich rental stage of 320 sq m with a cyclorama 7 metres high, wide and deep, a full height window wall for daylight work, full blackout and level drive in access for vehicles.
locations.facilities: 320 sq m stage, 7 m cyclorama, open kitchen and catering area, public car park opposite, 16 A, 32 A and 64 A power

locations.name: Studio Berlin Adlershof
locations.setting: Ten sound stages from 630 to almost 2,400 square metres on the Adlershof media campus in Berlin, with two control rooms for studio-based TV and drama production.
locations.facilities: Studios A 968 m2, B 634 m2, C 636 m2, D 636 m2, E 636 m2, F 633 m2, G 2,392 m2, H 2,374 m2, K 1,689 m2, L 1,381 m2, plus two control rooms (Regie 1 and Regie 2).
locations.logistics: Am Studio 20, 12489 Berlin (Adlershof).

locations.name: Studio Hamburg
locations.setting: Six sound stages of roughly 500 to 1,000 square metres at Studio Hamburg's Tonndorf site, built for TV drama, entertainment shows and commercial production.
locations.logistics: Jenfelder Allee 80, 22045 Hamburg (Tonndorf).

locations.name: STUDIOPARK KinderMedienZentrum
locations.setting: Four production studios from 165 to 954 square metres at the STUDIOPARK KinderMedienZentrum in Erfurt, next to the MDR and KiKA broadcast centre, built for children's and family TV.
locations.facilities: Studio A: 954 m2 (34 x 28 m), 7 m usable ceiling height, 6 m horizon, horizontal rail cyclorama system, 44 lighting positions; plus Studios B and C and daylight Studio D. Described by the operator as the largest contiguous studio complex in Thuringia.
locations.logistics: Erich-Kastner-Strasse 1/1a/1b, 99094 Erfurt.

locations.name: Stuttgart Hauptbahnhof
locations.setting: Stuttgart's main railway station, a 1920s stone terminus building with a tower, currently being converted into an underground through-station as part of the Stuttgart 21 project.

locations.name: Tabakquartier
locations.setting: Former Brinkmann cigarette factory in Bremen-Woltmershausen, brick production halls and a heating plant converted into offices, lofts and event floors.
locations.suitability: The site markets itself as a location for film, video and photo projects and is listed in the nordmedia location guide.

locations.name: Technik Museum Speyer
locations.setting: Transport museum in Speyer with a former aircraft hall, a jumbo jet and a Buran shuttle outdoors, plus locomotives, submarine interiors and vintage vehicles.

locations.name: Tempelhof Airport
locations.setting: Former Berlin city airport with a terminal building over a kilometre long, vast disused hangars and a 300-hectare former airfield now a public park, hired for filming, events and trade fairs.
locations.known_for: Bridge of Spies (2015), The Hunger Games: Mockingjay Part 2 (2015)
locations.facilities: The open apron area covers about 25 hectares, described on the site as the largest open-air space within a city in the world. Halls have ceiling heights up to 18 metres. The main building is over 1.2 kilometres long. Spaces (Haupthalle, hangars, the Vorfeld apron) can be booked separately or combined; hangar doors can be opened as needed and there is overhead cover for outdoor events.
locations.suitability: The site says it has hosted more than 50 film productions, including Billy Wilder's Eins, Zwei, Drei, Operation Walkuere, The Bourne Ultimatum and The Hunger Games. It receives more than 1,000 enquiries a year for events, filming and photography, and offers on-site location management and crew support.

locations.name: Teufelsberg
locations.setting: Cold War listening station of geodesic radomes and control buildings on an artificial hill of wartime rubble in the Grunewald forest, with derelict interiors and open roof terraces.
locations.facilities: Exclusive event hire requires a minimum of 50 people; venue includes flexible multi-purpose rooms and one of Berlin's highest roof terraces (own site).

locations.name: TextilWerk Bocholt
locations.setting: Working weaving mill and spinning mill in Bocholt with rows of running looms, a boiler house, offices and workers' housing, part of the LWL industrial museum.

locations.name: Truppenuebungsplatz Oberlausitz
locations.setting: Saxony's only active military training ground, set in the Muskau Heath, the largest inland dune landscape in eastern Germany, with flat plains and steep enclosed dune terrain.

locations.name: Turm Triva
locations.setting: Fortress tower in the Klenzepark at Ingolstadt built between 1828 and 1841 to designs by Leo von Klenze, restored in 1992 and now holding the Bavarian Police Museum.
locations.facilities: About 1,000 sq m, parking in the Tilly underground car park, low entrance limits lorry access, weight limits apply

locations.name: U-Bahnhof Westfriedhof
locations.setting: Munich underground station opened in 1998 under Orpheusstrasse in Moosach, lit by eleven dome lamps of 3.8 metres by Ingo Maurer that wash the platform in blue, red and yellow.
locations.logistics: Parking must be applied for through the City of Munich film service office

locations.name: Uberseestadt Bremen
locations.setting: A former harbour district of quays, warehouses and cranes redeveloped into offices, studios and event spaces, keeping much of its industrial waterfront look.
locations.facilities: The district's event locations page lists venues including Alte Werft Dock 1 (2,500 m2, max 850 guests), BOLZEREI (3,500 m2), Alte Kranhalle (2,000 m2) with Generatorenhalle (200 m2), KABA-Eventhalle (880 m2 over two levels, about 199 seated), Schuppen Eins (100 to 2,000 m2, 10 to 1,200 people), GOP Variete-Theater (400 seated, restaurant about 200, ADIAMO up to 350), and smaller venues such as Aromatico Coffee Hub (115 m2, up to 60), Deck 20 (up to 60), Hafenrummel (15 to 60) and Lloyd Caffee (30 to 50).

locations.name: Universitaet Witzenhausen
locations.setting: The Witzenhausen campus of the University of Kassel, an internationally known centre for agricultural and international food science set in a small historic north Hesse town.

locations.name: University of Gottingen
locations.setting: A long-established university with a historic auditorium, library and mixed 19th and 20th century institute buildings across the old town of Gottingen.

locations.name: University of Tubingen
locations.setting: A historic university town campus on the Neckar river, mixing a medieval old town core with 19th and 20th century faculty buildings.

locations.name: urbanharbor Ludwigsburg
locations.setting: Transformed industrial estate of about 200,000 sq m in Ludwigsburg, mixing listed halls including a Zollinger timber roof with a boulevard, culture works, studios and the old administration building.

locations.name: V8 Hotel Boeblingen
locations.setting: Themed hotel in the Motorworld Region Stuttgart at Boeblingen, set in a former airport building with car themed rooms, workshop style interiors and a restaurant.

locations.name: Veltins-Arena
locations.setting: Covered football stadium in Gelsenkirchen with a retractable roof, a sliding pitch, players' tunnel, dressing rooms and press areas, also used as a concert arena.

locations.name: Verlagsgebaeude der Leipziger Volkszeitung
locations.setting: The central Leipzig headquarters of the city's largest daily newspaper, a historic industrial building converted into a modern office block with editorial rooms and meeting spaces.

locations.name: Viktualienmarkt
locations.setting: Munich's permanent daily food market next to the old town, with stalls, a beer garden and a maypole, run by the city as a public market square.

locations.name: Völklinger Hütte
locations.setting: Disused nineteenth-century ironworks in Völklingen, a UNESCO World Heritage site with blast furnaces, ore bunkers, a power hall and elevated walkways through the plant.
locations.price_note: A usage fee for commercial filming and photography is set in a prior written agreement; the cost depends on subject prominence, technical and personnel effort and intended use, quoted only after the application is reviewed (own site).
locations.suitability: Standard filming/photo permit requests must be submitted at least 10 working days ahead, drone permits at least 25 working days ahead. No filming on weekends or public holidays. Drones are not allowed without separate state-level authorisation. Interior wedding shoots are not permitted; exterior wedding shoots are allowed with advance notice. Equipment may not be placed on the heritage structures, and access is limited to the visitor pathways. Private, non-commercial photography is allowed without a permit (a declaration form at the ticket office is requested) (own site).

locations.name: Volucap Max (Studio Babelsberg FX Center)
locations.setting: A 170 square metre volumetric video capture stage at Studio Babelsberg's FX Center in Potsdam, recording performers from multiple angles at once for virtual production.
locations.facilities: 170 m2 volumetric capture stage (Volucap Max) inside Studio Babelsberg's FX Center, with over 65 megapixels per camera and more than 3,000 combined megapixels of volumetric processing.
locations.logistics: Studio Babelsberg FX Center, Stahnsdorfer Strasse area, Potsdam-Babelsberg.

locations.name: Weingut Klaus Zimmerling
locations.setting: A working winery on the steep, pyramid-shaped Roesselberg slope of the historic Pillnitz royal vineyard near Dresden, producing about 10,000 litres of wine a year under organic methods.

locations.name: Weissenhofsiedlung
locations.setting: 1927 modernist housing estate on a Stuttgart hillside designed by Mies van der Rohe, Le Corbusier and other Weimar-era architects, with flat-roofed white houses, two of them open as a museum.

locations.name: Weserstadion
locations.setting: Football stadium on the Weser in Bremen, a closed bowl clad in solar panels with steep stands, dressing rooms, press areas and a riverside approach.

locations.name: Westerham Factory
locations.setting: Loft studio in a former paper mill south east of Munich, with a column free hall, exposed concrete floor and a glazed gallery at 4 metres.
locations.facilities: 250 sq m ground floor plus 50 sq m gallery, parking in front of the hall, lorry access to the hall, 16 A and 32 A power

locations.name: Westfalenhallen
locations.setting: Exhibition and event complex in Dortmund with several linked halls, including a large arena hall, built from the 1920s onward and still used for trade fairs, sport and concerts.
locations.facilities: Westfalenhalle arena seats up to 16,140; Messe Dortmund exhibition space totals 60,000 sqm, divisible from 1,000 to 10,000 sqm; Kongress Dortmund congress rooms hold 10 to 10,000 guests; the building is heritage-protected (own site).

locations.name: Wiede-Fabrik
locations.setting: Former gasworks in Munich Johanneskirchen used since 1992 as an artists' factory, with about 2,000 sq m of built space, some 25 studios from 35 to 250 sq m and open green yards.
locations.facilities: Access for all common vehicle types, limited parking, extra car park for about 50 vehicles can be hired, house supply or generator
locations.suitability: Individual studios can be used for interior shoots on request

locations.name: Wirtshaus im Schlachthof
locations.setting: Listed 1879 brick building in the Munich slaughterhouse quarter, with dark board floors, original panelling, cast iron columns and four rooms plus a small tavern garden.
locations.facilities: Four rooms of about 200, 100, 50 and 50 sq m, lorry access, delivery ramp, limited free parking around the house, 16 A power

locations.name: Wohnstadt Asemwald
locations.setting: Three high rise residential slabs of the early 1970s on the southern edge of Stuttgart, with long balcony fronts, internal streets and open ground between the blocks.

locations.name: World Conference Center Bonn
locations.setting: Conference complex on the former parliamentary quarter in Bonn, combining the old Bundestag plenary chamber with modern halls, lobbies and press rooms.

locations.name: World Trade Center Dresden
locations.setting: An office complex in Dresden that is part of the worldwide World Trade Center network, with flexibly divided office units available for rent by the day.

locations.name: Wünsdorf Garrison Town
locations.setting: Former Wehrmacht and later Soviet military headquarters town near Zossen, with barracks, a domed former officers' club and rows of abandoned housing blocks.

locations.name: Z-Bau Haus fuer Gegenwartskultur
locations.setting: Former Nazi era barracks block in Nuremberg with a large car park, now a culture house with three concert stages, one a high ceilinged industrial style hall, plus bars, workshops and studios with graffiti inside and out.
locations.facilities: 5,500 sq m indoors and outdoors, access for lorries and articulated vehicles, large parking area, 16 A to 64 A outlets

locations.name: Zeche Ewald
