locations.setting: Former colliery in Herten with two winding towers, a machine hall and cleared yards, redeveloped as a business and events site with open ground for large units.

locations.name: Zeche Zollern
locations.setting: Former colliery in Dortmund with an Art Nouveau machine hall, ornate portal building and preserved pit head machinery, run as part of the Westphalian Industrial Museum.
locations.price_note: Room hire from EUR 200 to EUR 2,200 per day plus VAT depending on space (own site): Magazin/conference hall EUR 1,300, Maschinenhalle EUR 2,200, Lohnhalle EUR 800, Seminar Rooms 1-4 EUR 200 each. Cleaning fees range EUR 80 to 800 depending on space.
locations.facilities: Magazin/conference hall about 350 m2 total (280 m2 usable), row seating for up to 300, parliamentary seating for 140, with a built-in stage of about 40 m2, sound system, video/presentation technology and an interpreter booth. Maschinenhalle about 2,138 m2 total with 750 m2 usable, seated capacity up to 689. Lohnhalle 255 m2, used for evening events after 6pm. Seminar Rooms 1-4 are 50 to 54 m2 each, for up to 20 people, with projectors. All spaces have climate control/heating.

locations.name: Zeche Zollverein
locations.setting: Former coal mine and coking plant in Essen, a UNESCO World Heritage site with Bauhaus-style winding towers, coking ovens, conveyor bridges and vast industrial halls now used for exhibitions and events.
locations.facilities: About 18,000 m2 of event space across more than 50 rooms, halls and buildings from 10 location providers on site (including Grand Hall Zollverein, Casino Zollverein, PACT Zollverein, SANAA, Erich Brost-Pavillon, Bistro Schacht XII, Oktogon, The Mine and ZukunftsZentrum Zollverein), plus 100 hectares of outdoor grounds.
locations.suitability: The site describes the UNESCO World Heritage Site as long established as a location for photo shoots and film productions, with sound, lighting and film studio technology available in some spaces.

locations.name: Zenith Halle
locations.setting: Listed iron framed works hall built between 1916 and 1918 in Munich Freimann, used in turn as a Krupp press shop, a railway boiler smithy and an S-Bahn repair works, now a concert hall.
locations.facilities: 4,130 sq m, 11 m ceiling height, drive in access for cars and lorries, 16 A and 32 A power

locations.name: Zollernalb-Kaserne Messstetten
locations.setting: Disused Bundeswehr barracks at Messstetten on the Swabian Alb, with accommodation blocks, workshops, drill ground and service buildings, now run as an industrial park.

locations.name: Zuckerfabrik Oldisleben
locations.setting: The world's only sugar beet factory preserved as a technical monument, near Oldisleben, keeping its production line and the social spaces used by its workers.

locations.name: Academy of Athens
locations.setting: Neoclassical seat of Greece's national academy of sciences and letters on Panepistimiou Street in central Athens, with a colonnaded portico and tall columns topped by statues of Athena and Apollo.

locations.name: Achilleion Palace
locations.setting: Neoclassical summer palace built for Empress Elisabeth of Austria above Gastouri, Corfu, with a garden of statues, a colonnaded terrace and sea views, run today as a museum.

locations.name: Allatini Factory
locations.setting: A 19th century flour mill and brewery complex in Thessaloniki with brick industrial buildings and tall chimneys, partly disused, used as an industrial period backdrop.

locations.name: Anargyrios and Korgialenios School of Spetses
locations.setting: Historic boarding school building on the island of Spetses, listed by the Hellenic Film Commission as a filming location among its historic sites.

locations.name: Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus
locations.setting: Fourth-century BC stone amphitheatre seating around thirteen thousand, renowned for its acoustics and still used each summer for live theatre performances.

locations.name: Ano Poli (Thessaloniki Old Town)
locations.setting: Hillside old quarter of Thessaloniki above the Byzantine walls, with narrow lanes, Ottoman-era houses and views down over the modern city and the Thermaic Gulf.

locations.name: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
locations.setting: Greece's largest university, its main campus built from the 1950s in central Thessaloniki with lecture halls, a library, faculty buildings and open campus grounds.

locations.name: Aslan Pasha Mosque
locations.setting: An 18th century Ottoman mosque inside Ioannina Castle, now housing the municipal ethnographic museum, with a domed prayer hall and minaret used for period Ottoman-era scenes.

locations.name: Athens City Hall
locations.setting: Seat of the Athens municipal council on Kotzia Square, a 19th-century building with a council chamber, offices and an inner courtyard used for civic scenes.

locations.name: Athens Conservatoire
locations.setting: Music conservatory building in central Athens, listed by the Hellenic Film Commission among its Modern Greece filming locations.

locations.name: Benaki Museum, Piraeus Street building
locations.setting: One of the Benaki Museum's Athens buildings, on Pireos street in the Rouf district, used for exhibitions and events and listed as a modern Greece filming location by the Hellenic Film Commission.

locations.name: Chalki Port (Emporeio)
locations.setting: Small harbour of Emporeio, the main village of Chalki island in the Dodecanese, lined with restored neoclassical captains' houses and the working ferry and fishing quay.

locations.name: Chalkida
locations.setting: The main town of Evia on the narrow Evripos Strait, linked to the mainland by a sliding bridge, with a working waterfront used for town and bridge scenes.

locations.name: Chania Old Town
locations.setting: Venetian harbour town on Crete with a stone lighthouse, waterfront arsenali warehouses, a former mosque and a maze of Venetian and Ottoman-era lanes behind the quay.

locations.name: City Link
locations.setting: A shopping, dining and entertainment complex in central Athens near Panepistimiou street, listed as a modern Greece filming location by the Hellenic Film Commission.

locations.name: Corfu Old Town
locations.setting: Fortified Ionian old town shaped by Venetian, French and British rule, with two citadels, a cricket ground on the Spianada and narrow Venetian-style lanes known as kantounia.

locations.name: Diakofto-Kalavryta Rack Railway
locations.setting: Narrow-gauge rack-and-pinion heritage railway climbing the Vouraikos Gorge from the coast at Diakofto to the mountain town of Kalavryta, using original early twentieth-century rolling stock.

locations.name: Elefsina Industrial Heritage Sites
locations.setting: Cluster of disused nineteenth and twentieth-century factory buildings, including a former soap works and oil mill, along the Elefsina waterfront, reused as venues since the town's 2023 European Capital of Culture year.

locations.name: EMST, National Museum of Contemporary Art
locations.setting: Athens contemporary art museum housed in the former Fix Brewery building on Kallirois Avenue, listed by the Hellenic Film Commission as a filming location.

locations.name: Factory, Heraklion
locations.setting: A working factory building on the outskirts of Heraklion in Crete, listed by the national film commission as an industrial location for interior and exterior filming.

locations.name: Fertilizer Factory, Drapetsona
locations.setting: A derelict phosphate fertiliser plant on the Piraeus waterfront at Drapetsona, with rusted processing towers and silos used as a decayed industrial backdrop.

locations.name: Fiskardo Port
locations.setting: A small working fishing harbour on the northern tip of Kefalonia lined with pastel Venetian-style buildings, used for coastal village and harbour scenes.

locations.name: Hellenic Parliament
locations.setting: Former royal palace on Syntagma Square that now houses the Hellenic Parliament, with a long neoclassical facade overlooking the square and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

photo.author: Αλέξης Τσίπρας Πρωθυπουργός της Ελλάδας from Greece

locations.name: Hotel Grande Bretagne
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century grand hotel on Athens' Syntagma Square, with a marble lobby, ballrooms, a rooftop restaurant facing the Acropolis and a long history as the city's diplomatic hotel.

locations.name: Kapa Studios
locations.setting: A 70,000 sqm studio complex in Spata, Attica, with twelve sound stages from 400 to 2,100 sqm, plus a 20,000 sqm backlot with standing sets including a 1960s Greek village and a reality-TV house.
locations.known_for: House of David, Tehran, The Witch, Sasmos
locations.facilities: 12 sound stages (Spata and Markopoulo sites) from 400 sqm/7.3m height to 2,100 sqm/18m height, HD-equipped control rooms, generators and climate control; a 20,000 sqm open backlot with standing sets: a Big Brother house (700 sqm on a 5,000 sqm plot with pool), a 1960s-style Greek village (6,000 sqm) and a church set with a 70-seat amphitheatre (5,000 sqm).
locations.suitability: Indoor sound stages for studio-based production plus outdoor backlot shooting on standing sets; the company describes itself as serving both Greek and international productions.
locations.logistics: Two sites in Attica: Thesi Gialos-Stimonari, Spata, and 2 Eratosthenous street, Markopoulo Mesogaias. The studios state a five minute drive from Athens International Airport and a 15 minute drive from the centre of Athens.

locations.name: Karystos
locations.setting: A harbour town on the southern coast of Evia below Mount Ochi, documented as a filming location in the Hellenic Film Commission's catalogue.

locations.name: Kavala
locations.setting: A port city on Greece's northern coast with a Byzantine aqueduct, a hilltop old town and a working harbour, used for historic townscape and waterfront scenes.

locations.name: Kotzia Square
locations.setting: Central Athens square in front of the City Hall, with an excavated ancient road visible under glass, arcaded 19th-century buildings and the National Bank headquarters nearby.

locations.name: Lavrio Technological and Cultural Park
locations.setting: Former nineteenth and twentieth-century silver and lead mining and smelting works at Lavrio, with brick furnace buildings, workshops and ore-washing structures now reused as a research and cultural park.

locations.name: Linoperamata Power Plant
locations.setting: A public power station on the coast west of Heraklion, listed as an industrial landscape filming location by the Hellenic Film Commission.

locations.name: Megalo Livadi Mines, Serifos
locations.setting: The disused iron ore loading and mining works at Megalo Livadi on Serifos, with rusted machinery, jetties and mine galleries left from the island's early 20th century mining industry.

locations.name: Megaron, The Athens Concert Hall
locations.setting: Marble-clad concert hall complex in central Athens with several auditoriums, the largest seating around two thousand, plus rehearsal and conference spaces.
locations.facilities: Christos Lambrakis Hall: fixed theatre-style seating for 1,960 (1,100 stalls, 860 circle) with 2,500 m2 of foyer space and 24 stage fly bars. Alexandra Trianti Hall: fixed seating for 1,500, 1,200 m2 of foyer space, 4 stage platforms of 4m x 16m each, a central stage revolve, and loading-bay access to stage level for one 18m truck (45 tonnes) plus one 10m truck.

locations.name: Meteora
locations.setting: Byzantine monasteries perched on sheer sandstone rock pillars rising above the Thessalian plain.

locations.name: Milos Mines
locations.setting: Disused open-cast sulphur and perlite mining area on the island of Milos, with cut rock faces, old loading structures and access roads near the port town of Adamas.

locations.name: Milos Mining Museum
locations.setting: Museum at Adamas on Milos covering the island's sulphur, bentonite and perlite mining industry, with equipment and the surrounding quarried volcanic landscape.

locations.name: Nafpaktos Port
locations.setting: A small circular Venetian-era harbour in the town of Nafpaktos on the Gulf of Corinth, enclosed by old fortifications, used for historic port and townscape scenes.

locations.name: Nafplio
locations.setting: Former first capital of modern Greece on the Argolic Gulf, with a Venetian old town, two hilltop fortresses and a small fort standing on an islet in the harbour.

locations.name: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
locations.setting: The neoclassical main building of Greece's oldest university on Panepistimiou Street in central Athens, part of the 19th century Athens Trilogy, used for grand academic and civic interiors and facades.

locations.name: National Bank of Greece Headquarters
locations.setting: Head office building of Greece's National Bank in central Athens, listed by the Hellenic Film Commission among its Modern Greece filming locations.

locations.name: National Garden of Athens
locations.setting: 19th-century public park behind the Greek Parliament in central Athens, with shaded paths, ponds, ancient fragments and a small zoo, bordering the Zappeion grounds.

locations.name: National Historical Museum (Old Parliament House)
locations.setting: The former Greek Parliament building on Stadiou Street in Athens, now the National Historical Museum, with 19th century chambers and a grand facade used for period government scenes.

locations.name: National Library of Greece, old building
locations.setting: Neoclassical former home of the National Library of Greece on Panepistimiou Street, part of the Athens Trilogy with a domed reading room and a marble double staircase.

locations.name: Nestos Railway
locations.setting: A stretch of the historic railway line between Xanthi and Kavala that follows the Nestos river gorge, with track, bridges and forested slopes for period rail scenes.

locations.name: Nu Boyana Hellenic Film Studios
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex near Thessaloniki airport with eight sound stages totalling about 15,000 square metres and a 25,000 square metre backlot.
locations.facilities: 10 sound stages from 290 m2 to 1,764 m2. Largest are Stage 6 at 1,764 m2 (49m x 36m, 12m height), Stage 5 at 1,500 m2 (60m x 25m, 11.95m height) and Stage 7 at 1,470 m2 (49m x 30m, 12m height). Also includes a dedicated underwater tank stage (Stage 9, 1,180 m2, 13m height) and a motion capture stage (Stage 4, 290 m2).

locations.name: OAKA Athens Olympic Sports Complex
locations.setting: Olympic athletics stadium and sports complex in Athens with a Santiago Calatrava glass and steel roof, an indoor arena, velodrome and swimming pools on the same grounds.
locations.facilities: Central Olympic Stadium seats 69,618, with a football pitch of 105m x 68m and a 400m athletics track with 9 lanes. Includes 14 official suites, 480 press seats and 2 TV broadcast suites. The roof, added for the 2004 Olympics, was designed by Santiago Calatrava.
locations.logistics: 3 parking facilities at the stadium.

locations.name: Old Tobacco Warehouses, Xanthi
locations.setting: A cluster of late 19th and early 20th century tobacco processing and storage warehouses in Xanthi's old town, with brick facades and large open floors used for industrial and period townscape scenes.

locations.name: Phaistos Rural Fields
locations.setting: Open farmland and olive groves on the Phaistos plain in south-central Crete, with the Minoan palace ruins nearby and views over the Messara valley to the Psiloritis range.

locations.name: Port of Piraeus
locations.setting: Greece's main passenger and container port beside Athens, with working quays, ferry terminals, a fishing harbour and the older Mikrolimano marina nearby.

locations.name: Port of Thessaloniki
locations.setting: Working container and passenger port on Thessaloniki's waterfront, with cargo piers, a passenger terminal and the early twentieth-century customs house pier 1 warehouses.

locations.name: Power Plant, Katerini
locations.setting: An industrial power plant near Katerini in Central Macedonia, listed by the national film commission as a large-scale industrial filming location.

locations.name: Power Station of Lavrio
locations.setting: A power station on the coast at Lavrio in southern Attica, part of the town's industrial mining and metallurgy heritage, used as a large-scale industrial backdrop.

locations.name: Rethymno Venetian Harbour
locations.setting: Working Venetian-era harbour of Rethymno, Crete, with a stone lighthouse, quayside tavernas and fishing boats moored below the old town and the Fortezza fortress.

locations.name: Rio-Antirrio Bridge
locations.setting: Cable-stayed suspension bridge nearly three kilometres long crossing the Gulf of Corinth on four pylons, linking the Peloponnese at Rio to Antirrio on the mainland.

locations.name: Serifos City Hall
locations.setting: The town hall of the Cycladic island of Serifos, a small cubic municipal building in the hilltop settlement of Chora, used for island town and civic scenes.

locations.name: Skopelos
locations.setting: Pine-fringed Aegean island with pebble coves, a whitewashed harbour town and the clifftop chapel of Agios Ioannis.

locations.name: Spinalonga
locations.setting: A fortified islet off Elounda that served as a leper colony from 1904 to 1957 after centuries as a Venetian and Ottoman stronghold, now an uninhabited archaeological site reached by boat.
locations.known_for: To Nisi (2010 TV series based on Victoria Hislop's The Island)

locations.name: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Centre
locations.setting: Cultural complex on the Faliro waterfront in Athens housing the Greek National Opera and National Library, listed by the Hellenic Film Commission as a filming location.

locations.name: Studio Karamanos
locations.setting: Television and event studio in Ilion, Athens, combined with a camera and lighting equipment rental house, used for entertainment shows and commercials.
locations.known_for: MasterChef, Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
locations.facilities: Site describes it as the largest TV studio in Greece and one of the largest in the Balkans; camera equipment (Arri film and digital cameras, lenses, monitors), lighting (HMI, LED, tungsten, moving heads, dimmers, trusses), camera cars and lighting trucks
locations.suitability: Hosts multiple concurrent television and commercial productions.
locations.logistics: 58 Dragoumanou St, Ilion, Attica 13122, Athens

locations.name: Symi Port (Gialos)
locations.setting: Working harbour of Symi town, Gialos, ringed by pastel-coloured neoclassical houses on the hillside, with fishing boats, cafes and the old customs house on the quay.

locations.name: Thessaloniki City Hall
locations.setting: The seat of the Thessaloniki municipal government on Vasileos Georgiou Square, listed as a modern architecture filming location by the Hellenic Film Commission.

locations.name: Tichero Railway Station
locations.setting: A small railway station in the village of Tichero in the Evros region of northeastern Greece, on a rural line used for period and rural transport scenes.

locations.name: Toplou Monastery
locations.setting: A fortified Orthodox monastery in eastern Crete with thick defensive walls, a bell tower and an inner courtyard, still an active working monastery with its own wine and olive oil estate.

locations.name: Venetian Shipyard, Corfu
locations.setting: A former Venetian-era shipyard site near Corfu's Old Fortress, with stone quays and boat sheds from the island's maritime history, used for historic waterfront scenes.

locations.name: Vikos Gorge
locations.setting: Deep limestone gorge in the Zagori region of the Pindus mountains, with sheer cliff walls, a hiking trail along the riverbed and stone-built villages on its rim.

locations.name: Zappeion Hall
locations.setting: A 19th century exhibition and conference hall next to the National Garden in Athens, with a colonnaded courtyard and grand halls used for formal indoor and exterior scenes.

locations.name: A38 Ship
locations.setting: A converted Ukrainian stone-carrier ship moored on the Danube in Budapest, run as a concert and event venue with a hall, roof terrace and bow terrace.
locations.facilities: Concert hall, roof terrace, bow terrace and separate studio space

locations.name: Adria Palota
locations.setting: An 1902 neo-Baroque office palace on Szabadság tér, built for a shipping company by architect Artúr Meinig, now vacant and decaying behind a marble staircase and Adriatic-themed frescoes.

locations.name: Akvarium Klub
locations.setting: A club and event venue built partly below street level on Erzsebet ter in central Budapest, with a large hall, a smaller hall and an outdoor terrace.

locations.name: Andrassy Avenue
locations.setting: Tree-lined boulevard of ornate 19th-century palaces and villas running from the city centre to City Park, with the Metro's first continental underground line beneath it.
locations.known_for: Munich, Bel Ami, Houdini, Genius: Picasso

locations.name: Aquaticum Debrecen
locations.setting: A large thermal spa and wellness hotel complex in Debrecen's Great Forest park, with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas and function space that the operator lists for conferences and events.

locations.name: Aquincum Museum
locations.setting: The excavated civilian town of the Roman settlement of Aquincum in north Budapest, with an open-air archaeological park of house foundations and a museum building of Roman finds from the site.
locations.suitability: Site publishes rentable venues (berelheto helyszinek) for weddings and events

locations.name: Balna Budapest
locations.setting: Row of 1880s Danube-side public warehouses extended in 2013 with a glass and steel shell, turning the brick halls into an exhibition and events building on the riverbank.
locations.known_for: The Martian, Berlin Station, Six Underground, Black Widow

locations.name: Batthyany Square Market Hall
locations.setting: A steel-framed 19th century covered market hall on the Buda bank of the Danube at Batthyany ter, in daily use for food stalls beside a metro and suburban rail interchange.

locations.name: Budapest Congress Centre
locations.setting: A conference and exhibition complex in the Buda Hills attached to a four-star hotel, with a main auditorium, 20 further meeting rooms and up to 4,000 square metres of exhibition space.
locations.facilities: 20 multifunctional rooms, up to 4,000 sqm exhibition space, catering, AV support, adjoining 319-room hotel
locations.suitability: Congresses, gala dinners for up to 900 guests, exhibitions and corporate events

locations.name: Budapest Keleti Railway Station
locations.setting: Budapest's largest main-line terminus, built in the 1880s with a glazed central hall, monumental facade and ornate waiting rooms that remain in daily use for rail traffic.
locations.known_for: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol, Inferno, The Luzhin Defence, Einstein and Eddington

locations.name: Budapest Music Center
locations.setting: A modern concert hall and music institute in the Ferencvaros district of Budapest, with a flexible-configuration auditorium used for concerts and corporate or cultural events.
locations.facilities: Flexible-configuration concert hall with technical and catering services

locations.name: Budapest Nyugati Railway Station
locations.setting: Iron-framed terminus completed in 1877 by the Eiffel company's Paris workshops, with a glass and steel train shed and a Baroque Revival facade on the Grand Boulevard.

locations.name: Budapest Prison Museum
locations.setting: The Hungarian Prison Service's professional history collection in Budapest, exhibiting uniforms, restraints, firearms and other institutional material from the Austro-Hungarian era to the present.
locations.suitability: Site publishes guided tours by advance reservation, for groups of 8 to 20 people

locations.name: Budapest-Deli Railway Station
locations.setting: Socialist-era terminus on the southern slope of Castle Hill, rebuilt in the 1970s as two linked concrete and glass halls with copper railing details and marbled concourses.

locations.name: Children's Railway (Gyermekvasut)
locations.setting: A narrow-gauge forest railway in the Buda hills staffed on-train by schoolchildren under adult supervision, running steam and diesel services between Huvosvolgy and Szechenyi-hegy.
locations.suitability: Site offers hire of a special carriage or special train for private and corporate events

locations.name: Csepel Works
locations.setting: Former state ironworks on Csepel Island with factory halls, chimneys, a free port and a disused water treatment plant, still partly in industrial use.

locations.name: Diosgyor Castle
locations.setting: Restored fourteenth-century royal castle in Miskolc with four corner towers around a rectangular courtyard, offering both a walled interior yard and open battlements.
locations.suitability: Publishes a dedicated filming and photography information page

locations.name: Dreher Breweries
locations.setting: A working brewery complex in the Kobanya district of Budapest, Hungary's best known beer producer, offering organised factory tours of its production halls.
locations.suitability: Site offers bookable factory visits (gyarlatogatas) of the working brewery

locations.name: Eszterhaza (Esterhazy Palace)
locations.setting: Rococo palace of the Esterhazy princes near Sopron, known as Hungary's Versailles, with a mirrored ballroom, a puppet theatre and a Chinese-style music pavilion once staffed by Joseph Haydn.
locations.suitability: Publishes filming information on its own site

locations.name: Fertorakos Quarry (Kofejto)
locations.setting: A disused limestone quarry near Sopron with an open cave chamber converted into a cave theatre, used for opera and concerts and hired out for weddings and corporate events.
locations.suitability: Site lists weddings, receptions and corporate events alongside its theatre programme

locations.name: Fisherman's Bastion
locations.setting: Neo-Romanesque viewing terrace of 1902 on Castle Hill, with white limestone turrets and staircases overlooking the Danube and the Parliament building.
locations.known_for: I Spy, The Borgias, Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, Maigret

locations.name: Fono Budai Zenehaz
locations.setting: A folk music venue in Budapest's Kelenfold district, built around a dance-house hall used for Hungarian, Balkan and other traditional folk dance and concert programmes, with rooms available together or separately.
locations.suitability: Site states its rooms can be rented together or separately, by individual quote

locations.name: Fort Monostor
locations.setting: A 19th-century brick fortress complex on the edge of Komarom, with casemates, tunnels and a separate star-shaped outer fort, now a heritage site with its own wedding and conference venues.
locations.facilities: Star Fort conference room is about 240 m2 with capacity for 140 people, with a projector, wifi, a podium and sound and projection equipment; the adjoining restaurant area seats 65. The site has two large open courtyards, 64,000 m2 at Monostori Fort and 35,000 m2 at Igmandi Fort, plus indoor exhibition and event rooms. Power supply is 3x200 amp at the Danube bastion and 3x160 amp elsewhere at Monostori Fort, and mains power in the museum and air-raid shelter at Igmandi Fort (own site).
locations.logistics: Visitor parking at Monostori Fort for 68 cars and 7 buses, VIP parking for 12 cars, plus 600 further car spaces on the eastern counterslope; parking at Igmandi Fort is arranged in the outdoor areas. All three forts are accessible from Budapest, Gyor and northern Komarom, Slovakia (own site).

locations.name: Fővárosi Nagycirkusz
locations.setting: Hungary's permanent state circus building beside Városliget park and the zoo, a purpose-built circus hall used for shows and private bookings such as birthday events.

locations.name: Gellert Baths
locations.setting: Art Nouveau thermal bathhouse of 1911 at the Buda end of Liberty Bridge, with turquoise Zsolnay tiling, majolica columns and a glass-roofed wave pool.

locations.name: Gerbeaud Cafe
locations.setting: Confectionery and cafe on Vorosmarty Square dating to 1858, with wood-panelled salons, chandeliers and a period patisserie counter, named among Budapest's historic cafes by the national film commission.

locations.name: Globus Konzervgyár, Kőbánya
locations.setting: A canning factory in the Kőbánya district whose castellated brick exterior gives it the look of an old fortress rather than a working food plant.

locations.name: Godollo Royal Palace
locations.setting: Baroque palace east of Budapest, the favourite residence of Empress Elisabeth of Austria-Hungary, with gilded state rooms, a riding hall and formal gardens.
locations.suitability: Publishes filming information on its own site

locations.name: Gozsdu Udvar
locations.setting: A chain of seven connected courtyards running between two parallel streets in Budapest's Jewish Quarter, formed by 19th century apartment blocks and now lined with bars, restaurants and a regular weekend market.
locations.suitability: Site publishes a regular weekend market and day and night programming through the courtyards

locations.name: Great Market Hall (Nagyvasarcsarnok)
locations.setting: Budapest's largest and oldest indoor market hall on Fovam ter, a steel-framed 19th century building with a Zsolnay-tiled roof, in daily use as a food market with stalls on three levels.
locations.suitability: Evening and nighttime events for over 1,000 people can be organised in the hall, per the operator's site

locations.name: Groupama Arena
locations.setting: The football stadium of Ferencvarosi TC on Ulloi ut in Budapest, a modern all-seater ground also used for concerts and other events.
locations.suitability: Site references events and concerts hosted at the stadium beyond football matches

locations.name: Gundel Restaurant
locations.setting: A landmark Hungarian restaurant in City Park operating since the 1890s, its upstairs rooms in the historic building used as a formal events venue for weddings, conferences and banquets.
locations.suitability: Corporate events, weddings, conferences and private celebrations

locations.name: Hortobagy National Park
locations.setting: UNESCO-listed alkaline grassland on the Great Hungarian Plain near Debrecen, with an unbroken horizon, traditional shadoof wells and grazing herds of Hungarian grey cattle.

locations.name: House of Hungarian Music
locations.setting: A 2022 concert and exhibition building by Sou Fujimoto in Budapest's City Park, with a canopy roof cut by tree-shaped openings over glass-walled halls, a 360-degree dome cinema and recording studios.
locations.suitability: Site publishes room hire (teremberles) for its halls and studios

locations.name: Hungarian National Theatre
locations.setting: The national repertory theatre of Hungary in a purpose-built 2002 building beside the Danube in southern Pest, home to its own drama company and visiting productions.
locations.suitability: Theatre operates a dedicated events organisation department for bookings and rentals

locations.name: Hungarian Open Air Museum (Skanzen)
locations.setting: An open-air ethnographic museum near Szentendre with reconstructed village buildings, farmhouses, churches and a mill relocated from different regions of historic Hungary, set among fields and orchards.
locations.suitability: Site publishes a dedicated event venue (rendezvenyter) with wedding hire and wedding-photography terms

locations.name: Hungarian Railway History Park
locations.setting: An open-air railway museum in Budapest with a working turntable, roundhouse and rolling stock from steam to electric era, plus an 870-metre operating narrow-gauge line.
locations.facilities: Orient Hall (up to 2,500 people), Kando Room (40 people) and outdoor grounds for hire

locations.name: Hungarian State Opera House
locations.setting: Miklós Ybl's neo-Renaissance opera house of 1884 on Andrássy Avenue, with a gilded horseshoe auditorium, marble staircases and an arcaded stone facade.

locations.name: Hungarospa Hajduszoboszlo
locations.setting: A large thermal and wellness bath complex on the Great Plain, combining a medicinal thermal bath, an indoor adventure pool, an aquapark and an open-air beach area with an on-site hotel and campsite.
locations.suitability: Site lists event venues (rendezvenyhelyszinek) among its facilities

locations.name: Kaloczy Square Event Center
locations.setting: A renovated riverside boathouse on Kaloczy square in Gyor, on the bank of the Mosoni-Duna, run as an event venue for weddings and corporate and family gatherings.

locations.name: Kecskemetfilm Animation Studio
locations.setting: A working animation studio in Kecskemet producing short and feature animated films, also home to the Kecskemet Animation Film Festival, with facilities visited on organised studio tours.
locations.suitability: Studio offers organised visits (studiolatogatas) to its production facility

locations.name: Kelenfold Power Plant
locations.setting: Art Deco power station built on the Buda bank in the late 1930s, with glass-block floors, spiral staircases and a control hall named a filming location by the national film commission.

locations.name: Kincsem Park
locations.setting: Hungary's only horse racing track, an 86-hectare site in Budapest with grandstands, a panorama restaurant with VIP boxes and grounds used for galloping, trotting and greyhound racing.
locations.facilities: Panorama restaurant with separated VIP boxes overlooking the track
locations.suitability: Site publishes corporate event, conference and private celebration hire, customised to the event type

locations.name: Kodaly Center
locations.setting: A modern concert hall in Pecs's Zsolnay Quarter, home to the Pannon Philharmonic Orchestra, with a main concert hall, a studio theatre space and conference rooms.
locations.suitability: Site publishes event and conference venue rental services alongside a recording studio

locations.name: Kolcsey Center
locations.setting: A large concert and conference venue in Debrecen with a main hall, several function rooms and a glass-fronted foyer, hired out through its own events office for conferences and functions.

locations.name: Korda Studios
locations.setting: Studio complex in Etyek west of Budapest with seven sound stages, a 400 cubic metre water tank and three backlots built as a medieval street, a Renaissance square and a New York street.
locations.known_for: Poor Things, Halo, Blade Runner 2049, The Martian
locations.facilities: 16,500 sqm of soundstages, 5,500 sqm workshops and storage, 15 hectares of secured exterior construction area
locations.logistics: At Korda ut 1572 hrsz, Etyek, 25 km from Budapest and 45 minutes from Budapest (BUD) airport.

locations.name: Lake Balaton (Balatonfured)
locations.setting: Resort town on the north shore of Central Europe's largest lake, with a yacht harbour, a lakeside promenade and hills of vineyards rising behind the waterfront.

locations.name: Lipotmezo Sanatorium
locations.setting: Abandoned former psychiatric hospital in the Buda hills, with high-ceilinged corridors, exposed pipework and a decayed operating theatre listed as a filming site by the national film commission.

locations.name: Liszt Ferenc Airport Terminal 1
locations.setting: Mid-twentieth-century former main terminal of Budapest's international airport, now used for general aviation and charter traffic, with its original modernist facade and interiors intact.
locations.known_for: Inferno, Atomic Blonde, Spy, Terminator: Dark Fate

locations.name: Magyar Szentföld-templom, Hűvösvölgy
locations.setting: An unfinished 1940s reinforced-concrete church in a Buda woodland suburb, meant to unite replicas of Holy Land pilgrimage sites, left as a roofless shell of bare columns.

locations.name: MÁVAG Colony
locations.setting: A early-20th-century workers' housing colony built for the MÁVAG railway-equipment works in Kőbánya, its closed rows of company housing largely unchanged since the era of state industry.

locations.name: MET Arena Szekesfehervar
locations.setting: A modern indoor arena in an industrial zone of Szekesfehervar, built for a top-division handball club, marketed on its own site as a venue for sport, concerts and conferences.
locations.facilities: Seating for up to 5,900 (1,542 on a mobile stand); the arena floor holds 2,000 for concerts. Includes a 100-person and a 50-person meeting room, 3 rentable conference rooms, a VIP Lounge for up to 150, a VIP restaurant for 130, 14 VIP boxes, 800 lockers, broadband optical internet and public wifi, electrical connections at all four corners of the arena floor, and technical facilities for TV broadcasts. Outdoor paved and grass event spaces with power connections are also available. Fully wheelchair accessible (own site).

locations.name: Metropolitan Ervin Szabó Library
locations.setting: Budapest's central public library, its reading rooms fitted into the ornate former Wenckheim Palace with gilded ceilings and marble staircases behind the working library shelving.

locations.name: Millenaris Park
locations.setting: Former Ganz electrical works converted into a public cultural and exhibition park, keeping several industrial hall structures alongside gardens and event spaces.
locations.suitability: Publishes a filming-permits page for productions

locations.name: MODEM Modern and Contemporary Arts Center
locations.setting: A glass-fronted exhibition building in central Debrecen with large open gallery halls and a minimal facade, used for contemporary art shows and with its rooms listed for hire on its own site.

locations.name: MOM Cultural Center
locations.setting: A multidisciplinary cultural centre in the Nemetvolgy area of Budapest with a theatre hall, a domed hall and several named function rooms, plus an open-air stage and promenade.
locations.suitability: Site publishes an event venue (rendezvenyhelyszin) section for hiring its halls

locations.name: MOME Zugliget Campus
locations.setting: Hillside campus of the Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design, with white-walled contemporary buildings, exposed concrete and large glazed studio spaces.

locations.name: Mupa Budapest
locations.setting: Riverside performing arts complex opened in 2005 on the Pest embankment, combining a concert hall, a multipurpose festival theatre and exhibition galleries under one roof.
locations.logistics: Complimentary parking for visitors with paid tickets. Accessible by car from Soroksari ut, Konyves Kalman korut and Rakoczi Bridge. Served by trams 1, 2 and 24, buses 54 and 15, and the H7 suburban railway (HEV). Address: 1095 Budapest, Komor Marcell u. 1 (own site).

locations.name: MVM Dome
locations.setting: A large modern indoor arena on Ulloi ut in Budapest's Nepliget district, built for concerts, sports events and expos with VIP hospitality areas and on-site parking.

locations.name: Nagyerdei Stadion
locations.setting: The football stadium of Debreceni VSC on the edge of the Nagyerdo forest park in Debrecen, with VIP and skybox hospitality areas alongside the pitch and stands.
locations.suitability: Club site lists stadium facility rental among its services, alongside VIP and skybox packages

locations.name: New York Cafe
locations.setting: Ornate fin-de-siecle grand cafe on the ground floor of the New York Palace, with gilded columns, frescoed ceilings and marble tables, listed by the national film commission among Budapest's historic coffee houses.
locations.price_note: Conference package from EUR 115 per person per day, including room rental, coffee breaks, lunch and AV equipment (own site).
locations.facilities: Twelve meeting rooms. Rome hall: 441 sqm (550 theatre / 320 banquet) with a 770 sqm foyer. Rossini: 178 sqm (150 theatre / 100 banquet). Vivaldi: 126 sqm (120 theatre / 90 banquet). Bellini, Verdi and Puccini: 40 theatre / 30 banquet each. New York Cafe hall and Marble Salon: 120 banquet each. Red Salon: 30 banquet. An additional 240 sqm of walkway space on the first and second floors. Some rooms can be darkened (own site).
locations.logistics: A freight elevator allows equipment and vehicles to be brought inside. Events require a minimum of 15 guests (own site).

locations.name: NFI Costume Warehouse, Fót
locations.setting: A 2,500 square-metre costume store run by the National Film Institute near Fót, holding about 130,000 costumes and accessories from medieval dress to 20th-century uniforms for hire to productions.
locations.known_for: Rise of the Raven, Fairy Garden, Son of Saul, Hadik
locations.facilities: Warehouse of more than 2,500 square metres holding close to 130,000 costumes, with garments and accessories from medieval outfits to 20th century uniforms, including period costumes from productions such as Hunyadi - Rise of the Raven, Fairyland, Son of Saul, Sunset, Bet on Revenge and Robin Hood. Costumes are hired out for films and commercials, for theatre performances and for private events. The warehouse was renewed in 2025 with a new rental system and updated storage conditions.
locations.suitability: Costume hire for film shoots, theatrical productions, museum exhibitions and themed events

locations.name: NFI Studios
locations.setting: State-run 31-hectare studio complex near Fot, visited by filmmakers since the 1970s, with eight soundstages, over 20,000 square metres of buildable backlot and the largest outdoor filming tank in continental Europe.
locations.known_for: Dune: Part Three, Shadow and Bone, The Witcher, Terminator: Dark Fate
locations.facilities: 12,670 sqm of soundstage space, 24,700 sqm assigned for set construction, outdoor water tank of 4,700 cubic metres
locations.logistics: 20 minutes from central Budapest, about 30 minutes from Liszt Ferenc Airport by car

locations.name: North Pest Hospital
locations.setting: Part-disused Art Nouveau and Modernist hospital complex in North Pest, with broken-windowed wards and a glazed dome over the main building, catalogued as a filming site by the national film commission.

locations.name: Óbuda Experimental Housing Estate
locations.setting: A late-1960s housing estate in Óbuda built as a testbed for precast-concrete residential forms, still standing as an example of state-era experimental design.

locations.name: Obuda Gas Factory
locations.setting: Former municipal gasworks on the Danube in Obuda, its striped brick gasholders and domed towers now enclosed within a riverside office and technology park.
locations.facilities: 165,000 sqm total site area, 82,000 sqm gross leasable area, over 2,000 underground parking spaces (own site).
locations.logistics: Address 1031 Budapest, Zahony utca 7, Obuda, about 6 km from the centre of Budapest. Over 2,000 underground parking spaces (own site).

locations.name: Óbuda Stocking Factory
locations.setting: A clinker-brick hosiery factory complex in Óbuda whose blank walls and towers resemble a Hanseatic warehouse district rather than a 20th-century textile plant.

locations.name: OKISZ Headquarters
locations.setting: Reinforced-concrete office headquarters in the Zuglo villa district, an example of Late Modern architecture with a retracted facade and a working paternoster lift.

locations.name: Opusztaszer National Heritage Park
locations.setting: An open-air heritage park on the Great Plain marking the site of Hungary's first national assembly, with a rotunda housing the Feszty circular panorama painting, reconstructed period buildings and an ethnographic skanzen.
locations.suitability: Park's tourist office organises weddings and events on site

locations.name: Origo Studios
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex in Budapest with eleven stages, including nine soundstages and around 19,000 square metres of filming space, plus backlot areas and underwater filming facilities.
locations.facilities: 11 stages totalling over 19,000 m2: nine soundstages (largest Stage 6, 4,373 m2 and 20 m high; Stages 3 and 4, 2,662 m2 each) and two VFX stages with a 100 m2 greenbox; a 23 x 18.5 x 3 m water tank, 4-hectare backlot, about 4,000 m2 of production offices in four buildings with makeup and dressing rooms, and 8,409 m2 of warehouses and workshops in 15 units.
locations.suitability: Soundproofed, heated and air-conditioned stages with overhead grids and loading doors, offered for features, series, animation and documentaries; the studio cites the 30 percent Hungarian tax credit and runs on solar energy and district heating.

locations.name: Palace Hotel Lillafured
locations.setting: A castle-style hotel built in the 1920s in the Bukk Mountains near Miskolc, overlooking the Szinva valley, Hamori Lake and a waterfall, with period interiors and historical exhibitions.
locations.suitability: Site lists corporate events, team-building and weddings among its services

locations.name: Pannonhalma Archabbey
locations.setting: A working Benedictine monastery on a hilltop above the town of Pannonhalma, with a basilica, cloister, library and vineyard, part of it open to visitors and hired out for weddings and corporate events.
locations.facilities: Six rentable rooms: the Ceremonial Hall (250 m2, theatre-style up to 268, with microphone, projector, screen and wifi), the Viator centre (120 m2, up to 120 theatre-style, wifi), the Habsburg room (129 m2, up to 80 theatre-style, wifi), the Gyongyossy room (70 m2, up to 82 theatre-style, wifi), the Prelatura (63 m2, up to 20, TV, wifi), and the Teleki room (58 m2, up to 60, TV, projector, screen, wifi). Overall the venue can host up to 268 people with catering and full service (own site).

locations.name: Papp László Budapest Sportaréna
locations.setting: Budapest's main indoor arena, opened in 2003 on the site of an earlier hall destroyed by fire, hosting concerts, championship sport and corporate events.
locations.facilities: Variable seating: 12,500 for concerts, 12,000 for handball, 11,390 for boxing, 9,479 for ice hockey
locations.suitability: Concerts, sporting events, business meetings and corporate events

locations.name: Parisi Udvar
locations.setting: A restored 1817 shopping arcade in central Budapest under a stained-glass and mosaic dome mixing Gothic, Moorish and Art Nouveau detail, now the lobby and restaurant of a hotel.
locations.suitability: Hotel publishes photography and event hosting as services

locations.name: Piarist Centre
locations.setting: Central Pest school and monastery building on Marcius 15 Square, mixing a neo-Baroque shell with a 21st-century glazed extension and an internal theatre hall.

locations.name: Puskas Arena
locations.setting: Hungary's national football stadium in Budapest, rebuilt on the site of the old Nepstadion, with tiered event spaces from a Sky Lounge to VIP suites alongside the pitch and stands.
locations.facilities: Business VIP, VIP Club, Sky Lounge and Sky Lobby event spaces for 20 to 1,000 people, plus stadium tours

locations.name: Rudas Baths
locations.setting: Sixteenth-century Ottoman-era bathhouse on the Buda riverbank, with an octagonal domed central pool lit by star-shaped skylights.

locations.name: Satoraljaujhely Prison Museum
locations.setting: A prison museum in the town of Satoraljaujhely, next to the still-operating Satoraljaujhely Prison and Detention Facility, displaying the history of the Hungarian penal system from feudal punishments to the modern era.
locations.suitability: Site publishes museum visits and school group programmes run with the local Crime Prevention Committee

locations.name: Sopron Old Town
locations.setting: Medieval old town near the Austrian border with an almost intact street plan, a firewatch tower and Castle District monuments, named a strong option for historical productions by the national film commission.

locations.name: Sostoi Muzeumfalu
locations.setting: An open-air ethnographic museum near Nyiregyhaza with relocated village houses, a windmill, a church and a school laid out as a walkable historic village, with its own page for hiring the site for photo and film shoots.

locations.name: Stern Film Studio
locations.setting: A four-stage studio complex in Pomaz near Budapest, built on a former industrial site, with a 5,000m2 backlot and a water tank built into one of the stages.
locations.known_for: Dracula, The Alienist, Berlin Station, Dune: Prophecy
locations.facilities: Stage A: 2,280m2, 12.5m height. Stage B: 1,482m2, 12.5m height, with a water pool. Stage C: 837m2, 5.3m height. Stage D: 148m2, 6m height. Offices 1,295m2, workshops 4,421m2, backlot 5,000m2, extras holding, dressing/hair/make-up rooms, catering area, theatre/meeting room (198m2), car park/unit base 2,500m2.
locations.logistics: Bihari Janos utca 1, Pomaz, about 20 minutes from Budapest.

locations.name: Szazados Road Art Colony
locations.setting: Early-twentieth-century artists' colony of studio houses set among trees in Zuglo, still used as working studios and listed as a location by the national film commission.

locations.name: Szechenyi Chain Bridge
locations.setting: Suspension bridge opened in 1849 linking Buda and Pest across the Danube, with cast-iron chain cables and stone lion sculptures at each bridgehead.
locations.known_for: I Spy, In Secret, 12 Monkeys, Gemini Man

locations.name: Szechenyi Thermal Bath
locations.setting: One of Europe's largest bath complexes in City Park, with a fresco-decorated dome hall, indoor and outdoor thermal pools and elegant colonnaded corridors.
locations.known_for: Mata Hari, Evita, The Luzhin Defence, Gemini Man
locations.facilities: Marble Hall holds up to 150 people (130 with a dance floor, 120 theatre-style); Small Cupola Room up to 70; Palm House 50 to 80 for evening events; Private Spa rooms for 2 each, 26 in total (own site).
locations.logistics: Accessible by public transport; parking at the 24-hour Zooparking or nearby streets. City Park, Vajdahunyad Castle and Heroes' Square are nearby (own site).

locations.name: Szeged New Synagogue
locations.setting: An Art Nouveau synagogue in Szeged completed in 1903 by architect Lipot Baumhorn, mixing secession, historicist and Gothic Revival forms under a large central dome.
locations.suitability: Site publishes guided tours and hosts concerts and cultural events, with groups of up to 100 accommodated

locations.name: Tihany Abbey
locations.setting: A Benedictine abbey on a peninsula above Lake Balaton, nearly 1,000 years old, with a baroque twin-towered church, a crypt holding the tomb of King Andrew I and a museum on the monastic community.
locations.suitability: Abbey's public calendar shows the church closed to visitors for weddings on published dates

locations.name: Tokaj
locations.setting: Small wine town at the meeting of the Tisza and Bodrog rivers, surrounded by centuries-old volcanic-soil vineyards and deep cellar systems used for ageing sweet Tokaji Aszu wine.

locations.name: Trafó House of Contemporary Arts
locations.setting: A contemporary dance, music and exhibition venue in Ferencváros housed in a former electrical transformer station, its industrial hall kept largely as found.
locations.suitability: Hosts performances and events with image and video recording

locations.name: University of Debrecen Main Building
locations.setting: A neo-baroque university building from 1932 in Debrecen with a domed central hall, a long facade and formal gardens, still used daily for teaching and by the university's own event office.

locations.name: University of Szeged Main Building
locations.setting: The historic central building of the University of Szeged on Dugonics ter, an early 20th century academic building used for teaching, administration and formal university functions.
locations.suitability: University publishes its central building as an event venue (rendezvenyhelyszin)

locations.name: Urania National Film Theatre
locations.setting: Art Nouveau cinema and event hall of 1896 on the Grand Boulevard, with a Moorish-influenced facade and a decorated auditorium ceiling, named by the national film commission among Budapest's classic movie theatres.
locations.facilities: Grand Hall (Diszterem): 425 seats for screenings, up to 460 for other events; stage area about 100 sqm with a high ceiling; three theatre dressing rooms plus one VIP dressing room. Two chamber rooms with 46 seats each. Cafe seats up to 200 when combined with the upstairs mirror room. Retractable screen 820 x 480 cm. 22,000 ANSI lumen full HD cinema projector. Sound system with 8 NEXO speakers and 2 subwoofers, installed 2013 (own site).

locations.name: Vajdahunyad Castle
locations.setting: Eclectic replica castle of 1896 on a lake island in Budapest's City Park, combining Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque wings within a few hundred metres.

locations.name: Veszprem Arena
locations.setting: A modern indoor sports and event hall on the edge of Veszprem, home to a top-division handball club, with a rentable arena floor and function rooms used for concerts and corporate events.
locations.facilities: Arena floor, lobby (up to 500), conference room (up to 50) and VIP room (up to 100) available to hire, with optional staging, sound, lighting, LED wall/cube and screen equipment. Concerts have been held for up to 5,300 spectators (own site).

locations.name: Vigado Concert Hall
locations.setting: An 1865 concert and ballroom building on the Pest riverbank of the Danube, restored with its historic hall and staircases, used for concerts, galas and exhibitions.
locations.suitability: Site states the building offers space for cultural and business events, galas and representative occasions

locations.name: Vigszinhaz (Vig Theatre)
locations.setting: A large historic theatre on Szent Istvan korut in Budapest, with a main stage and several affiliated smaller stages across the district, offering backstage tours of the building.
locations.suitability: Theatre operates a dedicated organisation office for event bookings and offers facility tours (VigTour)

locations.name: Wekerle Estate
locations.setting: Early-twentieth-century garden suburb of low Art Nouveau terraced houses laid out around a central square, built as a model workers' estate on the edge of Pest.

locations.name: Zsolnay Cultural Quarter
locations.setting: A former 19th-century Zsolnay ceramics factory in Pecs with preserved kilns, chimneys and workshop halls, now a cultural quarter of museums and function spaces hired out for weddings and corporate events.
locations.facilities: Multiple rentable venues: E78 Concert Hall (460 m2, up to 400 seated theatre-style or 1,000 standing), E78 Panorama Room (223 m2, up to 110 seated), E78 Music Room (83 m2, up to 50 seated), E78 Classroom (73 m2, up to 35 seated), the Pirogranit Courtyard (1,877 m2, up to 660 seated or 2,000 standing), the Apostolos Room (143 m2, up to 95 seated), the Julia Room (80 m2, up to 40 seated), the M21 Gallery (over 1,000 m2, ceiling height 6 to 8 metres, up to 400 seated or 685 standing), and the Bobita Puppet Theatre (main hall 185, chamber hall 70) (own site).

locations.name: Akureyrarkirkja
locations.setting: A 1940 Lutheran church on a hill above central Akureyri, designed by Gudjon Samuelsson with a stepped concrete facade related to his Hallgrimskirkja in Reykjavik.

locations.name: Blue Lagoon
locations.setting: A geothermal spa with milky blue water set in a black lava field on the Reykjanes Peninsula, with a bathhouse and treatment building on its edge.

locations.name: Dettifoss
locations.setting: A wide, high-volume waterfall on the Jokulsa a Fjollum river in a barren canyon, with grey glacial water dropping between near-vertical rock walls.

locations.name: Djupavik Herring Factory
locations.setting: Disused 1930s herring-oil factory on a remote fjord in the Strandir area, with rusted machinery and concrete tanks left largely intact next to a small hotel in the former workers' housing.
locations.known_for: Justice League, Sigur Ros music video

locations.name: Grandi (Reykjavik Old Harbour)
locations.setting: The working fishing harbour at Grandi on Reykjavik's western shore, with slipways and fish-processing buildings now shared with whale-watching boats, seafood restaurants and design studios.

locations.name: Hafnarfjordur Harbour
locations.setting: A working fishing and cargo harbour in the town of Hafnarfjordur just south of Reykjavik, with quays and warehouses set against black lava rock.

locations.name: Hafnarhus (Reykjavik Art Museum)
locations.setting: A former harbourside warehouse at Reykjavik's old docks, converted into the main building of the Reykjavik Art Museum with large open exhibition halls under its original roof structure.

locations.name: Harpa Concert Hall
locations.setting: Glass-clad concert and conference hall on the Reykjavik waterfront, its honeycomb facade covering several auditoriums and a large public lobby used for performances and events.
locations.known_for: Sense8, Black Mirror (Crocodile), The Bachelor, Heart of Stone
locations.facilities: Eldborg concert hall: up to 1,734 seats, 1,008 sq m, 4 floors. Silfurberg: 735 sq m, 7.7 m ceiling. Nordurljos: 540 sq m, 9 m ceiling. Kaldalon: 165-195 seats, 198 sq m, 8 m ceiling. Rima: 130 seats, 144 sq m, 3.8 m ceiling. Horpuhorn: 500 sq m, 26 m ceiling. Bjortuloft: 407 sq m over 2 floors. Haaloft: 200 sq m. Floi: 1,000 sq m. Eyri: up to 400 guests, 365 sq m.

locations.name: Hofdi
locations.setting: A 1909 timber house on Reykjavik's waterfront, owned by the city and used for official receptions, with the flags of the United States and the Soviet Union still hung inside.
locations.known_for: 1986 Reykjavik Summit (Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev)

locations.name: Jokulsarlon
locations.setting: A glacial lagoon at the edge of Vatnajokull where icebergs calve from an outlet glacier and drift toward the sea, with a black sand beach across the road.
locations.known_for: A View to a Kill, Die Another Day, Lara Croft: Tomb Raider, Batman Begins

locations.name: Kringlan
locations.setting: Iceland's second-largest shopping centre in Reykjavik, with more than 180 shops and restaurants plus a library, theatre and cinema under one roof, featured in a 2010 Icelandic feature film.

locations.name: Lake Myvatn
locations.setting: A shallow volcanic lake ringed by lava formations, pseudocraters and geothermal ground, with wetlands used by large numbers of breeding ducks.

locations.name: Laugardalslaug
locations.setting: Iceland's largest conventional swimming pool complex, in Reykjavik's Laugardalur valley, with an indoor Olympic-size pool, a 50 metre outdoor pool, eight hot pots and a steam bath.

locations.name: Perlan
locations.setting: A domed observation building on Oskjuhlid hill in Reykjavik, built over old geothermal water storage tanks, combining a museum, planetarium and viewing deck.
locations.facilities: On-site restaurant, bar, cafe, ice cream parlour, gift shop and observation deck alongside the exhibitions (own site).

locations.name: Reykjavik City Hall
locations.setting: The seat of Reykjavik's city government on the edge of the Tjornin pond, a low glass and stone building from 1992 that also hosts exhibitions, concerts and public functions.

locations.name: Reynisfjara
locations.setting: Black volcanic sand beach near Vík with hexagonal basalt columns, the Reynisdrangar sea stacks offshore and powerful Atlantic surf.
locations.known_for: Noah (2014), Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)

locations.name: RVK Studios
locations.setting: Around 8,000 square metres of stages in a converted fertiliser plant at Gufunes, with three large studios a short drive from downtown Reykjavík.
locations.facilities: Three acoustically isolated stages of 2,775, 1,506 and 1,317 m2, all 16 m high, with 733 m2 of props and set storage next to Stage 1; dressing, makeup and wardrobe rooms, casting suites, open-plan and private offices, meeting rooms, a cafeteria and post-production with six edit suites and a 4K screening room.
locations.suitability: Full production services for films, series, commercials, music videos and photo shoots; stage floors take heavy loads and large access doors let vehicles inside. The studio cites Iceland's 25 to 35 percent rebate.
locations.logistics: Thengilsbas 14, Gufunes: a 7-minute drive from downtown Reykjavik, with parking on site and limited air traffic overhead.

locations.name: Studio Syrland
locations.setting: Reykjavik production facility running since 1988, combining a recording stage with camera, lighting and grip equipment rental, listed under Film in Iceland's studio category.
locations.facilities: Studio A and control room; camera, lighting, grip, truck and power equipment rental in partnership with Storyline Studios Scandinavia.
locations.logistics: Vatnagardar 4, Reykjavik.

locations.name: Sundholl Reykjavikur
locations.setting: A 1937 indoor municipal swimming pool in central Reykjavik with a functionalist facade, white-tiled changing rooms and an outdoor terrace with hot tubs added later.

locations.name: Svínafellsjökull
locations.setting: Heavily crevassed outlet glacier of Vatnajökull ending in a small lagoon, reachable in minutes from the Ring Road inside Vatnajökull National Park.

locations.name: Thingvellir National Park
locations.setting: A rift valley and former open-air assembly site where the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates meet, with a gorge, lava fields and Iceland's largest natural lake.

locations.name: University of Iceland
locations.setting: Iceland's oldest and largest university, founded in 1911, with its main building and campus grouped around Sudurgata in central Reykjavik.

locations.name: Vik i Myrdal
locations.setting: A small coastal village with a black-steepled church on a hill above a cluster of houses, close to black sand cliffs and sea stacks.

locations.name: 14 Henrietta Street
locations.setting: A Georgian townhouse on Henrietta Street that later became a tenement, now a museum of Dublin housing history with restored interiors and original wallpaper found during conservation work.

locations.name: Adare Manor
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic mansion and golf resort on the River Maigue in County Limerick, with oak-panelled interiors, cloistered gardens and a 19th-century monastic ruin on the grounds.
locations.known_for: The Last Remake of Beau Geste (1977)

locations.name: Ardfert Cathedral
locations.setting: A group of three medieval churches near Tralee dedicated to St Brendan, including a 12th-century cathedral with a 13th-century window and a Romanesque chapel, open for venue hire including filming.

locations.name: Ardmore Studios
locations.setting: Ireland's longest-established film studios, offering sound stages, workshops and production offices on an 18-acre site in Bray.
locations.facilities: Eight sound stages from 3,000 to 23,250 sq ft (Stage F 23,250 sq ft at 21 ft high, Stage H 21,000 sq ft at 43 ft), over 120,000 sq ft of creative space with 25,000 sq ft of production offices and 57,000 sq ft of support space; a 120,000-litre underwater tank with camera pit in Stage A, workshops, backlot areas, hair and makeup, props and wardrobe departments.
locations.suitability: Self-contained, secure 18-acre site with drive-in access on selected stages, meeting rooms and secure broadband; the on-site team offers space planning for interior and exterior sets.
locations.logistics: Herbert Road, Bray, County Wicklow, 12 miles south of Dublin; ample parking on site.

locations.name: Ashford Studios
locations.setting: A film and TV production studio at Ballyhenry near Ashford in County Wicklow, about 40 minutes from Dublin, offering sound stages and access to surrounding countryside locations; its backlot has stood in for the Vikings series.
locations.facilities: Four stages: Gasworks Stage 30,000 sq ft (156 ft long plus a 55 ft annex, 160 ft wide plus an 80 ft annex, 40 ft working height), Box Stage 14,400 sq ft (180 x 80 ft, 40 ft), Christmas Tree Stage 12,600 sq ft (180 x 70 ft, 40 ft) and Dairy Stage 6,500 sq ft (121 x 54 ft, 20 ft). Existing stage space totals 55,000 sq ft with 88,000 sq ft of support space; a further 170,000 sq ft of stage space and 523,000 sq ft of support space are listed as under construction, with stages dividable and working heights up to 60 ft.
locations.logistics: At Ballyhenry, Ashford, County Wicklow, 40 minutes from Dublin and Dublin airport.

locations.name: Aughnanure Castle
locations.setting: Six-storey tower house of the O'Flaherty clan on a rocky outcrop above Lough Corrib near Oughterard in County Galway, with a banqueting hall and watchtower.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park on site.

locations.name: Ballycorus Leadmines
locations.setting: A ruined 19th-century lead-smelting works on the Dublin/Wicklow border near Kilternan, with a tall chimney and the remains of a flue running up the hillside, listed by Screen Ireland as a hidden-gem filming location.

locations.name: Bantry House and Garden
locations.setting: A stately home overlooking Bantry Bay in West Cork, owned by the White family since 1739, with Italianate formal gardens and a fine art and furniture collection, hired for weddings and events.

locations.name: Bord Gáis Energy Theatre
locations.setting: A large modern theatre on Grand Canal Square in Dublin's Docklands, designed by Daniel Libeskind, listed by Screen Ireland among its science-fiction filming locations.

locations.name: Borris House
locations.setting: A Regency country house at Borris in County Carlow, seat of the MacMorrough Kavanagh family, hired out in full for weddings, corporate events and productions, with gardens overlooking the River Barrow.
locations.suitability: Whole-house hire for weddings, corporate events and celebrations

locations.name: Céide Fields Visitor Centre
locations.setting: An award-winning visitor centre at Glenurla near Ballycastle in north Mayo, built beside a 110-metre sea cliff, interpreting the Neolithic field system preserved in the surrounding bog.

locations.name: Charles Fort
locations.setting: Star-shaped 17th-century coastal fortification above Kinsale harbour in west Cork, with bastions, gun batteries and barrack ruins overlooking the Atlantic approach.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park and coach parking on site.

locations.name: CHQ Building
locations.setting: Restored 1820 bonded warehouse on Custom House Quay in Dublin's docklands, now a glass-roofed hall with retail units, food outlets and hireable event and exhibition space.

locations.name: Cobh Heritage Centre
locations.setting: Emigration and maritime history exhibition in Cobh's former Victorian railway station, on the harbour town that was the Titanic's last port of call.

locations.name: Cork City Gaol
locations.setting: Restored 19th-century prison on a hillside above Cork city, with galleried cell blocks and warders' quarters, hired out for corporate events and filming or photo shoots.
locations.suitability: The West Wing is offered for corporate events, product launches and filming or photo shoots, described as a space that can be adapted to a production's requirements.

locations.name: Cork City Hall
locations.setting: 1936 limestone civic building on the River Lee in Cork, with a domed concert hall, council chamber and function rooms available through the council's facilities-hire process.

locations.name: Cork Opera House
locations.setting: A roughly 1,000-seat theatre on Cork's Emmet Place, rebuilt in 1965 after fire destroyed the original 1855 building, hosting drama, opera, music and comedy.

locations.name: Curragh Camp
locations.setting: The Irish Defence Forces' main training base on the Curragh plain, with parade grounds, barrack blocks and a military college, home to around 2,000 personnel.

locations.name: Derrynane House
locations.setting: Coastal home of nineteenth-century political leader Daniel O'Connell on the Ring of Kerry, with period rooms, a walled garden and dunes running down to the Atlantic.
locations.facilities: Lift access and WiFi available on site.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park and bicycle parking on site.

locations.name: Donegal Castle
locations.setting: Restored 15th-century tower house and Jacobean wing in the centre of Donegal town, once the stronghold of the O'Donnell clan, on the banks of the River Eske.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.

locations.name: Doneraile Court
locations.setting: Georgian house and deer park in north Cork, with a walled garden, follies and grazing red deer, cared for by the Office of Public Works.
locations.facilities: Lift access on site.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park and coach parking on site.

locations.name: Dublin Castle
locations.setting: Former seat of British administration in Ireland in central Dublin, with state apartments, a medieval tower, Georgian interiors and a courtyard used for state events.
locations.facilities: Nine event spaces: Printworks 726 sq m (up to 600 theatre-style), Conference Centre 323 sq m (up to 330), St Patrick's Hall 335 sq m (up to 300 theatre-style), George's Hall 230 sq m (up to 240), Portrait Gallery 213 sq m (up to 200), Throne Room 147 sq m (up to 100), Gothic Room 90 sq m (up to 60), Bedford Hall 108 sq m (up to 80), and Castle Gardens 1,885 sq m (up to 4,000 theatre-style).
locations.suitability: The Dublin Castle campus is closed to the public until January 2027 while it hosts events for Ireland's Presidency of the Council of the EU; bookings for 2027 are being taken through the Events team.

locations.name: Dublin Port
locations.setting: Ireland's largest port, on the north bank of the River Liffey, with container terminals, ferry berths, cranes and working quaysides close to the city centre.

locations.name: Dún Aonghasa
locations.setting: Prehistoric stone fort on a sheer cliff edge on Inishmore in the Aran Islands, with concentric ramparts and a defensive band of upright stones.

locations.name: Dwyer McAllister Cottage
locations.setting: A restored thatched and whitewashed cottage at Derrynamuck near Donard, rebuilt after an 1799 skirmish of the 1798 rebellion, with period furnishings on display.

locations.name: Emo Court
locations.setting: Neoclassical domed mansion designed by James Gandon in County Laois, with formal lawns, a lake and an avenue of Wellingtonia trees, managed by the OPW.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park on site.

photo.author: National Library of Ireland on The Commons

locations.name: Farmleigh House and Gardens
locations.setting: The Irish state's 78-acre guesthouse estate near Phoenix Park, an Edwardian mansion built for the Guinness family with walled gardens, lakeside walks and a working farm, its grounds open to the public and available for filming.

locations.name: Fonthill Studios
locations.setting: A single large sound stage on Dublin's western edge, listed by Screen Ireland as the country's only dedicated motion-capture performance facility.
locations.facilities: One stage, 65 m long by 24 m clear width (up to 40 m overall width), 10-11.5 m height, fully draped walls and ceiling; Screen Ireland lists it as approximately 30,000 sq ft. Three floors of office and production space with air conditioning, power distribution and dedicated broadband.
locations.logistics: Unit 19, Fonthill Business Park, Dublin 22, D22 Y9Y9 (own site).

locations.name: Fort Dunree
locations.setting: A coastal artillery fort on the Inishowen peninsula overlooking Lough Swilly, with gun emplacements, tunnels and a military museum spread across several linked batteries.
locations.facilities: The Saldanha Suite is available for exhibitions and conferences; the venue also hosts civil ceremonies and receptions (own site).

locations.name: Fota Arboretum and Gardens
locations.setting: An 11-hectare arboretum on Fota Island in Cork Harbour with rare trees and shrubs, an ornamental pond, an orangery and formal gardens laid out in the early 19th century, open for filming and photography by arrangement.

locations.name: Galway Cathedral
locations.setting: The Catholic Cathedral of Our Lady Assumed into Heaven and St Nicholas, on Gaol Road on Galway's Nun's Island, built on the site of the former city gaol.

locations.name: Glendalough
locations.setting: Early medieval monastic site in a glaciated Wicklow valley, with a round tower, ruined stone churches and two lakes, managed by the Office of Public Works.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park on site.

locations.name: Government Buildings, Dublin
locations.setting: A working government complex on Upper Merrion Street housing the Department of the Taoiseach, the Department of Finance and the Attorney General's office, completed in 1922 and open for free guided tours on Saturdays.
locations.facilities: Guided tours, wheelchair access and lift, assistance dogs only

locations.name: Killarney National Park
locations.setting: Ireland's first national park, around the Lakes of Killarney and the MacGillycuddy's Reeks mountains, with oak woodland, waterfalls and a resident red deer herd.

locations.name: Killruddery House
locations.setting: Elizabethan-revival mansion on the edge of Bray with a domed Victorian conservatory, formal gardens with twin canals, woodland walks and a working farmyard on the wider estate.
locations.known_for: Excalibur, My Left Foot, The Tudors, Fate: The Winx Saga
locations.facilities: Four hireable spaces: the Grain Store, a 19th-century barn with a full bar and kitchen (500 standing, 300 seated, 180 dining); Killruddery Yard for full estate hire (up to 500 guests); the Long Room, a former dairy with integrated AV (100 standing, 40 seated); and the Pizza Shed with a wood-fired oven (100 standing indoors, 60 seated).
locations.suitability: The estate is available for private hire, including corporate away days, gala receptions and private screenings.

locations.name: Kilmainham Gaol
locations.setting: Preserved nineteenth-century prison with a galleried Victorian east wing, stone corridors and bare exercise yards, now a museum.
locations.known_for: The Italian Job (1969), In the Name of the Father, Paddington 2
locations.price_note: OPW heritage sites: filming fees charged per the OPW Fees Schedule depending on nature and location of filming; a nominal EUR 50 administrative fee applies for student projects needing extra staffing; cancellation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, or the full fee if cancelled within 48 hours (OPW policy, applies to this OPW-managed site).
locations.suitability: Drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites; at least two weeks' notice is requested for filming and photography requests; political, paranormal, inappropriate and product-promotion filming is not permitted (OPW policy).

locations.name: King's Inns, Dublin
locations.setting: Ireland's oldest law school and sole Inn of Court, in a James Gandon building of 1806 on Constitution Hill in Dublin, with a 110,000-volume library, offering its halls for venue hire.

locations.name: Living Bridge, University of Limerick
locations.setting: A curved pedestrian suspension bridge over the River Shannon on the University of Limerick campus, listed by Screen Ireland among its science-fiction filming locations.

locations.name: Lough Gur
locations.setting: Archaeological landscape around a horseshoe-shaped lake in County Limerick, with a Stone Age visitor centre, a stone circle and Iron Age hut sites.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Christian1965~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Milk Market
locations.setting: Limerick's covered market square dating to the Georgian era, with a glazed roof over stalls, a weekend food and craft market, and a permanent cafe and bar.

locations.name: Mizen Head Signal Station and Bridge
locations.setting: A former fog-signal station on Ireland's most south-westerly point in West Cork, reached by a footbridge across a deep chasm, listed by Screen Ireland as a hidden-gem filming location.

locations.name: Muckross House
locations.setting: A Victorian mansion within Killarney National Park, with furnished period rooms, walled gardens and a working farm, run as a visitor attraction with corporate hire.
locations.price_note: OPW heritage sites: filming fees charged per the OPW Fees Schedule depending on nature and location of filming; a nominal EUR 50 administrative fee applies for student projects needing extra staffing; cancellation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, or the full fee if cancelled within 48 hours (OPW policy, applies to this OPW-managed site).
locations.suitability: Drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites; at least two weeks' notice is requested for filming and photography requests; political, paranormal, inappropriate and product-promotion filming is not permitted (OPW policy).

locations.name: Newmills Corn and Flax Mills
