locations.setting: A working 19th-century flax and corn mill complex on Churchill Road near Letterkenny, with a forge, scutcher's cottage and one of the largest working waterwheels still turning in Ireland.

locations.name: Pearse Museum & St Enda's Park
locations.setting: Former school run by Patrick Pearse in a Georgian house in Rathfarnham, south Dublin, set in a public park with woodland, a walled garden and a stream.
locations.facilities: Lift access on site.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Coach parking on site; the site is about 8 km from Dublin city centre.

locations.name: Portumna Castle and Gardens
locations.setting: Early 17th-century semi-fortified house on Lough Derg in east Galway, with restored formal gardens, a kitchen garden and a woodland park managed by the OPW.
locations.facilities: WiFi available on site.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.
locations.logistics: Car park and coach parking on site.

locations.name: Powerscourt Estate
locations.setting: A Palladian mansion and formal gardens in the Wicklow hills, with terraces, a walled garden, a waterfall and outbuildings converted into shops and a restaurant.

locations.name: Reginald's Tower, Waterford
locations.setting: A Norman stone tower on the Waterford quays, in continuous use for over 800 years and now a branch of the Waterford Museum of Treasures with Viking-era exhibits and a spiral staircase.

locations.name: Richmond Barracks
locations.setting: A former British Army barracks in Inchicore built from 1810, now a heritage centre with a restored gymnasium hall, library and gardens, and a published venue hire service.
locations.facilities: Five hireable spaces that can be taken separately or combined, including three sizeable rooms for meetings or workshops, a large garden space, and a tent in the garden suitable for performances; chairs, tables, projector and screen, lectern, microphones and a PA system available on request (own site).

locations.name: Royal Hospital Kilmainham (IMMA)
locations.setting: A 17th-century former retirement home for army pensioners on Military Road, Kilmainham, now the Irish Museum of Modern Art, with formal courtyards and grounds available for filming and events.
locations.suitability: Venue hire for weddings, corporate events, community gatherings and filming/photography projects

locations.name: Skellig Michael
locations.setting: Steep rocky island in the Atlantic off the Kerry coast, topped by a sixth-century monastic settlement of stone beehive huts.
locations.known_for: Star Wars: The Force Awakens, Star Wars: The Last Jedi

locations.name: Sligo Abbey
locations.setting: Ruined 13th-century Dominican friary in Sligo town, with a carved altar, cloister arcade and medieval tomb sculptures, open seasonally under the OPW.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.

photo.author: National Library of Ireland on The Commons

locations.name: Spike Island
locations.setting: A fortified island in Cork Harbour with a star-shaped fort and a Victorian-era prison, now open to visitors with cell blocks, tunnels and gun batteries.

locations.name: St Audoen's Church and Visitor Centre
locations.setting: Dublin's only remaining medieval parish church, on Corn Market near High Street, with an active Church of Ireland section and a 15th-century tomb monument, open to visitors and venue hire.

locations.name: Strokestown Park House
locations.setting: Palladian-style Georgian house in County Roscommon set on about 300 acres, with a walled garden, the National Famine Museum and its own listed film location page.
locations.suitability: Filming permission must be sought and secured in advance and is agreed on a project-by-project basis.
locations.logistics: Under about 2 hours' drive from Dublin Airport.

locations.name: Telegael Studios
locations.setting: A Gaeltacht production base on Galway Bay combining two sound stages with an established animation, dubbing and post-production house.
locations.facilities: 2 stages totalling 14,000 sq ft plus 3,000 sq ft of office space (Screen Ireland listing). On-site animation, live-action, dubbing, subtitling and audio-description production.
locations.logistics: Spiddal / Na Forbacha, County Galway (own site).

locations.name: The Blasket Centre (Ionad an Bhlascaoid)
locations.setting: A heritage visitor centre at Dún Chaoin on the Dingle Peninsula documenting the Irish-speaking Blasket Islands community, with a clifftop viewing platform over the islands, refurbished in 2022.

locations.name: The Custom House Visitor Centre
locations.setting: Neoclassical 18th-century government building on the Liffey quays in Dublin, with a visitor centre in the vaulted basement telling the story of its construction and 1921 fire.
locations.facilities: Lift access and WiFi available on site.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography require prior written permission from the site's OPW contact; drones/UAVs are prohibited at all OPW heritage sites, and promotional filming is normally capped at 10 cast and crew for up to 2 hours with minimal equipment. At least two weeks' notice is requested; cancelling after confirmation costs 50 percent of the agreed fee, and cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs the full fee.

locations.name: The English Market
locations.setting: Covered Victorian food market in the centre of Cork, trading since 1788, with cast-iron arcades, fishmongers, butchers and a fountain courtyard; filming is arranged through Cork City Council.
locations.suitability: Filming applications are handled jointly by Aramark Management (market operator) and Cork City Council; enquiries go through englishmarket@corkcity.ie with a separate contact for detailed queries and an application form (Cork City Council).

locations.name: The Main Guard, Clonmel
locations.setting: A restored 17th-century courthouse and former barracks on Sarsfield Street in Clonmel, with a sandstone arcade and exhibition and event spaces, available for venue hire including filming.

locations.name: The Wonderful Barn
locations.setting: An 18th-century corkscrew-shaped grain storage tower near Leixlip, built as a famine-relief project, with a spiral external staircase, listed by Screen Ireland as a hidden-gem filming location.

locations.name: Trinity College Dublin
locations.setting: Ireland's oldest university, with cobbled squares, Georgian and Victorian quadrangles and the Long Room library, on a walled campus in the centre of Dublin.
locations.known_for: Educating Rita, Michael Collins, Circle of Friends

locations.name: Troy Studios
locations.setting: A four-stage, 100,000-square-foot film and TV studio complex at the National Technology Park in Castletroy, Limerick, with a 5-acre backlot and on-site parking for large productions.
locations.facilities: Five stages, all 43 ft to the grid with a further 12 ft to the gantry except T Stage: A Stage 30,814 sq ft (2,863 sq m), B Stage 17,685 sq ft (1,642 sq m), C Stage 17,921 sq ft (1,665 sq m), D Stage 32,668 sq ft (3,035 sq m) and T Stage 5,042 sq ft (468.5 sq m) at 32 ft to the roof. The 26-acre site holds 100,000 sq ft of stage space within 350,000 sq ft under one roof, plus a 5-acre backlot.
locations.logistics: National Technology Park Plassey, Castletroy, Limerick. A 35 minute drive from Shannon International Airport, with Dublin city centre 2.5 hours by car. On-site parking for 623 cars, 30 truck spaces and bike storage for 50 bicycles. Access is by appointment only, there are no public tours, and security checks visitors against a list at the main gate; office hours are Monday to Friday 08.00 to 17.30.

locations.name: University of Galway
locations.setting: A university on the River Corrib with a 19th-century Tudor-Gothic quadrangle building alongside later teaching blocks, laboratories and student residences.

locations.name: West Cork Film Studios
locations.setting: A full-service studio on a 6.4-acre site near Skibbereen, with two sound stages close to West Cork's coastal and countryside locations.
locations.facilities: Stage A: 1,040 sq m. Stage B: 650 sq m (Screen Ireland gives a combined total of about 18,000 sq ft). Reception, parking, offices, construction workshop, props department, hair and makeup, wardrobe department, green-screen capability, on a 6.4-acre site.
locations.logistics: Baltimore Rd, Skibbereen, Co. Cork, P81 TY06 (own site).

locations.name: Wicklow's Historic Gaol
locations.setting: Former county gaol in Wicklow town, in use from 1702 to 1924, with narrow cell blocks, a condemned cell and exercise yards preserved as a visitor attraction.

locations.name: 10 Watt Location
locations.setting: A multi-studio complex in Milan's Navigli district with several naturally lit photo and video studios for advertising and events, listed by Lombardy's film commission since 2004.
locations.facilities: Six spaces with published specifications: Spazio Light 200 mq, ceiling up to 6.10 m, 30 kW three-phase and single-phase power; Spazio Color 245 mq plus a 25 mq mezzanine, up to 6.10 m, 30 kW and four ethernet ports; Spazio Yori Studio 220 mq, up to 6.10 m, 25 kW; Spazio Lounge 75 mq, up to 6.10 m, sharing the 30 kW supply with Light; Spazio Acqua & Gym 75 mq, up to 3.50 m, 2 x 32 A single phase; and a 60 mq outdoor area with perimeter 1 x 16 A sockets. All indoor spaces are daylit and can be partially or fully blacked out, with WiFi up to 1000/300 Mb on two lines and audio, video and lighting available.
locations.suitability: Advertised for advertising photo and video production as well as corporate events; spaces are furnished and technically equipped and can be booked for production or events.
locations.logistics: Via Giacomo Watt 10 in the Navigli district of Milan. Loading and unloading for Light, Lounge and Yori runs through the outdoor area, for Color through Light and Lounge, and for Acqua & Gym internally from the Lounge; the outdoor area has vehicle access and two spaces in the underground car park.

locations.name: Aeroporto di Bolzano
locations.setting: South Tyrol's only airport with scheduled and charter flights, established in 1926 and modernised in the 1990s, with a runway just over 1,700 metres about six kilometres south of Bolzano.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles, off-road and on foot

locations.name: Aeroporto Gianni Caproni, Trento
locations.setting: A small regional airport south of Trento in the Adige valley, handling private and tourist flights, with an aviation museum and a helicopter base on site.

locations.name: Aeroporto San Francesco d'Assisi, Perugia
locations.setting: Umbria's civil airport at Sant'Egidio between Perugia and Assisi, renovated in 2011 to a Gae Aulenti design of red concrete pavilions with green copper roofs and glazed views toward Assisi.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, wheelchair accessible, road and helicopter access

locations.name: Antico Caffè Greco
locations.setting: Coffee house on Via Condotti in Rome open since 1760, with a chain of small salons hung with paintings and 19th-century furnishings, among the city's oldest surviving interiors.

locations.name: Arca Studios
locations.setting: A production facility in the Docks Dora industrial complex in Turin, with two soundproofed recording studios and around 400 square metres of flexible set and event space for small and medium productions.
locations.facilities: Two soundproofed studios for dubbing, sound recording and Foley; two multi-purpose halls (Sala Rossa and Sala Bianca); about 400 sqm of rentable space in total; two coworking areas and two meeting rooms with fibre internet.
locations.suitability: Advertised for short- and long-term hire of equipped spaces for film and photo sets.

locations.name: Arena di Verona
locations.setting: 1st-century Roman amphitheatre in central Verona, its arena floor and stone tiers used since 1913 for outdoor opera performances every summer.

locations.name: Arsenale di Venezia
locations.setting: The historic Venetian state shipyard, a walled complex of docks, cranes and covered building halls dating back to the twelfth century, partly used today for exhibitions.

locations.name: Aula Magna, Free University of Bozen-Bolzano
locations.setting: The main auditorium of the Free University of Bozen-Bolzano, a modern lecture hall with simultaneous interpretation booths, full AV equipment and wifi.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Base Milano
locations.setting: Former Ansaldo machine works in Milan's Tortona district, converted into a co-working and cultural hub whose large industrial halls host exhibitions, fashion events and shoots.
locations.facilities: The venue's own venue fact sheet (2025) lists: Ground Hall 400 sqm, ceiling height 8.3 m, capacity 200 seated or 1,000 standing; Bistro 120 sqm, 80 seated or 150 standing; Room 1400 1,200 sqm, 350 seated or 1,000 standing; Room 2100 2,000 sqm, divisible into Room 2100/2 at 800 sqm; YesRoom 185 sqm, capacity 80; rooftop Terrazza, capacity up to 70. Rigging points rated 100 kg per point, freight lift shared between rooms, heating and air conditioning, wifi on request, blackout curtains in the Ground Hall.
locations.suitability: The fact sheet lists photo and video shoots among permitted uses for Room 1400, Room 2100, CasaBASE and the rooftop terrace, and offers a permits and security-protocol management service as an extra.
locations.logistics: Entrances at Via Bergognone 34 and Via Tortona 54, Milan; extra services listed include guest accreditation, security and permit management.

locations.name: Belmond Hotel Cipriani
locations.setting: Hotel on Giudecca island in Venice with gardens, an outdoor pool and lagoon-facing rooms in a converted 16th-century building, reached from Saint Mark's Square by private launch.
locations.facilities: Event venues accommodate 10 to 300 people. The hotel has 55 rooms, 20 suites and 4 signature suites available for guests during events.

locations.name: Biblioteca Regionale Bruno Salvadori, Aosta
locations.setting: A 1996 glass-fronted regional library in Aosta built against a 17th-century noble residence and the ruins of a medieval charity hospice, over a Roman-era gate.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Biblioteca Universitaria Alessandrina, Roma
locations.setting: A university library founded in 1667, moved in 1935 to Rome's Citta Universitaria campus behind the rectorate, now run by the Italian ministry of culture.

locations.name: Bocconi University
locations.setting: Milan business university campus that includes the Grafton Architects-designed SDA building, with lecture halls, a library, courtyards and contemporary architecture around Via Sarfatti.

locations.name: Caffè Florian
locations.setting: Coffee house on Saint Mark's Square in Venice open since 1720, with a sequence of small decorated rooms, mirrors and painted panels largely unchanged since the 19th century.
locations.suitability: The venue states it has been a filming location for films, citing The Talented Mr. Ripley, and says it is frequently requested for advertisements, photo shoots and fashion productions.

locations.name: Caffe Meletti
locations.setting: A Liberty-style historic cafe on the main square of Ascoli Piceno, with marble tables, mirrored walls and an upstairs anisette museum, open to the public since 1907.

locations.name: Campo Imperatore, Gran Sasso
locations.setting: High plateau beneath the Gran Sasso massif in Abruzzo, known locally as Italy's Little Tibet, with wide alpine grassland and a former ski hotel where Mussolini was briefly held in 1943.

locations.name: Cantiere Ernesto Riva, Laglio
locations.setting: A boatyard on Lake Como founded in 1771 at Laglio, still building and restoring wooden rowing, sailing and motor boats, with a second workshop opened at Maslianico in 2010.

locations.name: Carcere Borbonico di Santo Stefano
locations.setting: A disused 1795 island prison off Ventotene built on a Panopticon plan, used to hold political prisoners into the 20th century and closed in 1965, now inside a state nature reserve.

locations.name: Carcere di Accadia
locations.setting: A prison building completed in 1993 in the Apulian hill town of Accadia with capacity for 90 inmates, never used as a jail and now owned by the municipality as a storage depot.

locations.name: Carcere di Volturara Appula
locations.setting: A former small-town prison building in the hill village of Volturara Appula, in the Daunian Mountains, listed in Italy's national locations database as a disused institutional building.

locations.name: Caserma Villarey, Ancona
locations.setting: An 1865-67 military barracks in Ancona built to hold over 1,200 soldiers, now home to the economics faculty of the Marche Polytechnic University.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles and on foot

locations.name: Cava di Bauxite di Spinazzola
locations.setting: A red bauxite quarry inside Alta Murgia National Park between Andria and Spinazzola, worked from 1950 to 1978, with unpaved tracks crossing bare eroded terrain.
locations.facilities: No water or mains power on site, unpaved and off-road vehicle access

locations.name: Cava di Pusiano
locations.setting: A disused stone quarry near Lake Pusiano, worked for decades and later used as an illegal dump before the municipality reclaimed it and reopened the site in 2004.
locations.facilities: Mains power but no running water on site, car access

locations.name: Cave di Carrara
locations.setting: Working marble quarries in the Apuan Alps about ten kilometres above Carrara, cut into the mountain since antiquity and still the source of stone used by Michelangelo and Canova.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, unpaved access road

locations.name: Cave Dipinte di Rubbio
locations.setting: A group of former limestone quarries at 1,057 metres above Bassano del Grappa, their rock amphitheatres painted with murals by local artist Toni Zarpellon since the 1980s.
locations.facilities: No water or mains power on site, reached by paved road, unpaved track or footpath

locations.name: Centrale Elettrica di Fies
locations.setting: An early 20th century hydroelectric plant on the Sarca river near Dro, partly still in operation, since 2002 also run as Centrale Fies, a laboratory for theatre, cinema and performance.

locations.name: Centrale Idrodinamica e Sottostazione Elettrica, Trieste
locations.setting: A restored 1887 to 1890 hydraulic power station in Trieste's Porto Vecchio that once pressurised water for the port's cranes and hoists, with accumulator towers, a boiler house and a tall chimney, now a museum building.

locations.name: Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia - Sicilia
locations.setting: The Sicilian branch of Italy's national film school, housed in the Cantieri Culturali alla Zisa cultural complex in Palermo, with a 250 square metre sound stage and audio and color grading suites.
locations.facilities: Housed in pavilion 6 of the Cantieri culturali alla Zisa in Palermo, with 1,800 square metres of covered space: an events area with a 100-seat auditorium (sala Bianca), an 80-seat cinema (sala Blu), a 250 square metre sound stage (teatro di posa), audio post-production and colour-correction booths and four teaching rooms equipped with editing technology.
locations.suitability: Mainly used for the film school's own training and student productions; the page does not publish hire terms for outside productions, so external availability should be confirmed directly with the school or Sicilia Film Commission.

locations.name: Cinecittà
locations.setting: Historic Rome studio complex founded in 1937, with sound stages including the vast Teatro 5 and permanent backlot sets such as ancient Rome.
locations.known_for: Ben-Hur (1959), La Dolce Vita (1960), Rome (2005-2007, HBO/BBC)
locations.facilities: 22 soundstages (24 planned) from 380 to 3,500 m2, the largest Stage 22 (3,500 m2) and Stage 5 (2,880 m2), each with dressing rooms, offices, makeup rooms and workshops; an LED volume in Stage 18 with a 452 m2 curved wall (8 m high, 52 m long), a 417 m2 motorised ceiling and a 25 m rotating platform; a backlot of nearly 10 hectares with power and water and permanent sets, plus set construction, film lab and audio and video post-production.
locations.suitability: Stages are soundproof, air conditioned and many have waterproof trapdoors for effects; they can be booked individually or in combination. Five new soundstages and four renovations are announced for 2026.

locations.name: Cinema Fulgor, Rimini
locations.setting: A historic single screen cinema inside a rebuilt 18th century palazzo in central Rimini, associated with Federico Fellini's childhood and evoked in his films, restored in 2018 with sets by Dante Ferretti.

locations.name: Cineporto dell'Emilia-Romagna
locations.setting: A privately built production studio near Modena with a column free sound stage, offices and post-production suites, designed for film, advertising and photo shoots with easy truck access.

locations.name: Cineporto di Bari
locations.setting: A production support centre for Apulia Film Commission inside the Fiera del Levante exhibition grounds in Bari, with production offices, casting and costume facilities and a small in-house cinema.
locations.price_note: Use of the Cineporti and Apulia Film House spaces run by the foundation is free of charge for applicants, subject to assessment and approval by the general management (Regolamento Cineporti di Puglia, April 2022).
locations.facilities: About 1,200 sqm total: equipped production offices, casting rooms, hair and make-up rooms, costume storage, a set-design workshop, and an HD screening room with 98 seats.
locations.suitability: Used by Apulia Film Commission as the logistical base for productions shooting in the region; also hosts festival screenings and casting calls.
locations.logistics: Padiglione 180, Fiera del Levante, Lungomare Starita 1, Bari. Space is requested by e-mail using the application form in the regulation, stating the days and hours required (Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00). Cars, motorcycles and other vehicles may not enter the Bari exhibition quarter without prior authorisation from Apulia Film Commission.

locations.name: Cineteca di Bologna (Cinema Lumiere)
locations.setting: A film archive and cinema complex in Bologna's former Manifattura delle Arti tobacco factory, with two screening theatres and a laboratory that restores classic films.

locations.name: Città della Scienza
locations.setting: Science museum and congress centre on the former Bagnoli industrial waterfront in Naples, with interactive exhibition halls, an auditorium and modular event spaces for hire.

locations.name: Comiso Airport
locations.setting: A regional airport in south-eastern Sicily built on a former NATO air base, with 1980s military hangars and runway infrastructure alongside its current civilian terminal.

locations.name: Corviale
locations.setting: A single kilometre-long social housing block on Rome's southwest edge, built in 1972 to a rationalist design with a repeating concrete facade and long open access corridors.
locations.known_for: Christian, Lovely Boy, Siccità, The Iris Affair
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles, cable-car access

locations.name: Craco
locations.setting: Abandoned hilltop town in Basilicata, evacuated after a 1963 landslide, with medieval stone houses, a tower and a church left standing on the exposed ridge.
locations.known_for: The Passion of the Christ (2004), Quantum of Solace (2008), Wonder Woman (2017)

locations.name: Distretto Campano dell'Audiovisivo
locations.setting: A production hub for Film Commission Regione Campania in a former NATO Southern Europe base at Bagnoli, Naples, with offices, workshops and a screening and color grading room across 10,000 square metres.
locations.facilities: 10,000 sqm across 4 levels in the former San Laise Park education/NATO complex: casting rooms, wardrobe/props/set-decoration workrooms and storerooms, production and direction offices, a screening room, a color grading and audio mix room, a render farm and animation labs, plus co-working space.
locations.suitability: Built as a Cine-Hub offering temporary production facilities (offices, casting, wardrobe and props workrooms) for productions filming in Campania, alongside a business incubator and training programme; confirmed in operation by a Film Commission event held on site in March 2026.

locations.name: Domus Mercatorum, Verona
locations.setting: A medieval merchants' guild hall on Piazza Erbe in Verona, built under the Scaligeri lords with a brick portico, mullioned windows and Ghibelline battlements.

locations.name: Ex Base NATO di Calice Ligure
locations.setting: A disused NATO military installation in the Ligurian Apennines above Calice Ligure, fenced and surrounded by forest with views over the coast, reached by provincial road.
locations.facilities: No water or mains power on site, road access for large vehicles, off-road and by helicopter

locations.name: Ex Base USAF Troposcatter, Monte Limbara
locations.setting: A fenced former US Air Force radio relay station at about 1,300 metres on Monte Limbara, operated from 1966 to 1993 and now owned by the Sardinian regional government.
locations.facilities: Mains power but no running water on site, road access for large and off-road vehicles

locations.name: Ex Carcere di Trento
locations.setting: A late-19th-century Habsburg-era prison in Trento built from local red stone, with its original vestibule entrance and balustraded balcony intact, closed as a jail since 2010.
locations.facilities: No water or mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Ex Carcere Le Nuove, Torino
locations.setting: A former Turin prison built from 1857 for solitary confinement, used to hold political prisoners under fascism and the Nazi occupation, closed in the 1980s and now housing court offices, a museum and an air raid bunker.

locations.name: Ex Centrale Idroelettrica di Malnisio
locations.setting: The Pitter hydroelectric plant near Pordenone, one of the first in Italy, built in 1895-96 on the Cellina river and preserved today as an industrial heritage museum in wooded foothill surroundings.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access

locations.name: Ex Manifattura Tabacchi, Rovereto
locations.setting: A former Austro-Hungarian state tobacco factory in Rovereto's Borgo Sacco quarter, running from 1854 with over a thousand workers by the century's end and now an eco-innovation business incubator.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Ex Ospedale Carlo Forlanini, Roma
locations.setting: A closed 1930s tuberculosis sanatorium in Rome, built as a self-contained horseshoe-shaped campus with wards, laboratories, a theatre and a cinema, vacated in 2015.

locations.name: Ex Ospedale Psichiatrico dell'Osservanza, Imola
locations.setting: A 19th-century psychiatric hospital near Imola covering about 12 hectares of symmetrical two-storey pavilions and gardens, closed under Italy's 1978 Basaglia law and vacant since 1996.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Ex Reggiane, Reggio Emilia
locations.setting: A derelict early-20th-century rail, munitions and aircraft factory beside Reggio Emilia's railway station, with about twenty halls and three office blocks now partly reclaimed by street art.
locations.facilities: No water or mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Ex Stabilimento Elettrochimico di Papigno
locations.setting: A 105,000 square-metre former calcium carbide and electrochemical works near Terni, built in 1901 and run until the mid-1980s, standing beside the Marmore Falls.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access on foot, not wheelchair accessible

locations.name: Ex Zuccherificio Eridania, Ceggia
locations.setting: A disused sugar refinery in the countryside near Ceggia in the Veneto, first run as a distillery in 1936 and closed in 2001, with brick factory halls, storage buildings and water settling tanks.

locations.name: Fabbrica Borroni, Bollate
locations.setting: An 1890 textile mill near Milan, family-run from 1925 to 2001, now an events space of three halls including one with cast-iron columns and another with 7.5-metre vaulted ceilings.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access

locations.name: Fabbrica del Vapore
locations.setting: Former 19th-century tram and rail-carriage factory in Milan, now a municipal cultural centre with industrial brick halls and an outdoor yard used for exhibitions and events.
locations.facilities: The spaces page lists: Spazio Cattedrale (three naves plus atrium), Sala Colonne (four internal pillars), Spazio Messina (two levels with lift access), Spazio Cisterne (two levels with roof terrace), Atelier Cisterne, Sala Conferenze (chairs, table, projector) and an outdoor Piazzale. No square meters or capacities are published.
locations.suitability: The site states that photographic, cinematographic and television filming is allowed, subject to checking space availability by email and downloading an authorisation request form.

locations.name: Forte di Bard
locations.setting: A nineteenth-century Savoy fortress rebuilt on a rock outcrop above the village of Bard, now housing museum galleries and event spaces within its stone ramparts over the Dora Baltea valley.

photo.author: Hagai Agmon-Snir حچاي اچمون-سنير חגי אגמון-שניר

locations.name: Grand Hotel et de Milan
locations.setting: 1863 hotel in central Milan near La Scala, with period salons, an internal courtyard and rooms including the suite where composer Giuseppe Verdi lived and died.

locations.name: Grand Hotel Rimini
locations.setting: A Belle Epoque seafront hotel from 1908 with formal gardens, a domed reception hall and period guest rooms facing the Adriatic, long associated with Rimini's own Federico Fellini.

locations.name: Grand Hotel Villa Serbelloni
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century lakeside hotel on the Bellagio promontory overlooking Lake Como, with period public rooms, terraced gardens and views over both branches of the lake.

photo.author: This picture belongs to Xavier Caré. Please credit : Xavier Caré / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-SA. If you would like speci

locations.name: Grande Miniera di Serbariu
locations.setting: Former coal mine at Carbonia in Sardinia, its headframe, washery buildings and underground galleries preserved as a mining museum with period machinery and accessible tunnel sections.

locations.name: Hotel Stammer, Chiusa
locations.setting: An early 20th century mountain hotel in the Val di Funes near Chiusa in South Tyrol, extended through the mid-century, now standing empty with period interiors and alpine surroundings.

locations.name: Interporto di Padova
locations.setting: A large freight and logistics hub south-east of Padua, with warehouses, container yards, rail sidings and road access built for intermodal cargo handling.

locations.name: Lingotto Rooftop Track and Pinacoteca Agnelli
locations.setting: Former Fiat car factory in Turin with a rooftop test track encircling the building, now containing exhibition halls, a hotel and the Pinacoteca Agnelli art gallery beneath a glass pavilion.

locations.name: Magazzino del Sale, Cervia
locations.setting: A 1712 dockside salt warehouse in Cervia of about 4,000 square metres, once able to hold up to 100,000 quintals of salt loaded onto flat-bottomed boats via the town's canal port.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles and by boat

locations.name: Manifattura Tabacchi
locations.setting: Former state tobacco factory in Florence, redeveloped into a mixed district with courtyards, industrial-style halls and a dedicated events venue called Motel.
locations.facilities: The Motel event space (Building B3, available from March 2026) has 3,000 sqm of usable area, offered in configurations of 500, 1,000 or 1,500 sqm.
locations.suitability: The venue's own page lists fashion shows, photo shoots and conventions among permitted uses, and describes the space as a film and television location.

locations.name: Manifatture Digitali Cinema - MDC Prato
locations.setting: A production support centre run by Toscana Film Commission in Prato, offering infrastructure for audiovisual productions alongside a tailoring workshop and a theatre nearby in the same district.
locations.facilities: Cineporto with three furnished temporary production offices with fast internet, a casting room with waiting area, a make-up and hairdressing room and a costume room with dressing rooms; the Teatro Francesco Nuti is a 240 mq multipurpose hall with 90 seats used for streaming and TV broadcasts, web and TV formats and small film sets; an external courtyard of 700 mq.
locations.suitability: Spaces are assigned by Toscana Film Commission against an expense reimbursement, with priority set by the type of production, the budget spent in Tuscany and calendar availability.

locations.name: Masseria Marinella
locations.setting: A working fortified farmhouse estate on the plateau outside Altamura, with whitewashed courtyard buildings, olive groves and grazing land typical of the Murgia countryside.

locations.name: Masseria Tagliente, Martina Franca
locations.setting: A mid-19th century fortified farmhouse estate in the Murge hills near Martina Franca, with a manor house, chapel and around twenty trulli, still run as a working agricultural and livestock estate.

locations.name: MAXXI - National Museum of 21st Century Arts
locations.setting: Zaha Hadid's 2010 museum building in Rome, built on the site of a former army barracks, with curving concrete galleries, a black steel staircase and large open exhibition halls.

locations.name: Mercato Centrale Firenze
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century iron-and-glass covered market near San Lorenzo in Florence, with a ground-floor produce market and an upper-floor food hall of stalls and communal tables.

locations.name: Mercato Coperto, Trieste
locations.setting: A 1936 covered market in Trieste with a rationalist facade, wide glazed windows and a spiral ramp linking two trading floors of food, clothing and footwear stalls.

locations.name: Mercato della Vucciria, Palermo
locations.setting: A historic market quarter in central Palermo once devoted to the meat and fish trade, today a reduced but atmospheric warren of stalls, street food stands and nightlife.

locations.name: Mercato delle Erbe, Bologna
locations.setting: A covered food market in central Bologna built in 1910 with an iron and glass roof on a Greek cross plan, rebuilt after wartime bomb damage and now combining market stalls with bars and restaurants.

locations.name: Mercato Ittico di Ancona
locations.setting: A fish market and cold storage warehouse by Ancona's docks, designed by Gaetano Minnucci, where wholesale auctions for trawled and blue fish are still held on weekday mornings.

locations.name: Milano Centrale Railway Station
locations.setting: Monumental 1931 railway terminus in Milan with a vast steel-and-glass train shed, marble ticket halls and Art Deco and Assyrian-influenced decoration across several levels.
locations.suitability: The national rail operator's site states that its stations can host film and TV sets, photo shoots, commercials and music videos, subject to advance email notice to reorganise station flows. Note: the page covers the station network generally (it names Napoli Centrale and Torino Porta Susa as examples) and does not name Milano Centrale specifically.
locations.logistics: Filming requests go through productplacement@fsitaliane.it (own site).

locations.name: Miniera di Raibl, Cave del Predil
locations.setting: A former lead and zinc mine near Tarvisio with 120 kilometres of galleries, closed in 1990 and now a geo-mining park with a mining museum and an electric train tour through the tunnels.

locations.name: Miniera di Sale, Raffo
locations.setting: One of Europe's largest rock-salt deposits in the hills near Petralia Soprana, with over 40 kilometres of tunnels reached 50 metres underground, mined industrially since 1972 and now partly a contemporary art museum.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access

locations.name: Miniera Montecatini, San Giovanni Rotondo
locations.setting: A former bauxite mine in the Gargano hills near San Giovanni Rotondo, worked by the Montecatini company from 1937 to 1973, left as an industrial and quarrying landscape.

locations.name: Miniera Trabonella, Caltanissetta
locations.setting: A former sulphur mine near Caltanissetta worked from around 1825 to 1950, one of Sicily's deepest at 270 metres, with surviving administration buildings, kilns and winding gear.

locations.name: Mole Antonelliana - National Cinema Museum
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century domed landmark in Turin housing the National Cinema Museum, with a spiral ramp, a central exhibition hall beneath the dome and a glass panoramic lift to the top.
locations.suitability: The museum's own event page states its spaces lend themselves to photo shoots and film/TV productions, with a separate contact for filming and photography requests (comunicazione@museocinema.it) distinct from press enquiries (ufficiostampa@museocinema.it).

locations.name: MUSE - Science Museum of Trento
locations.setting: Renzo Piano's 2013 science museum in Trento, a stepped glass and steel structure across several floors of exhibition space, part of the redeveloped Le Albere riverside district.

locations.name: Museo del Vetro di Piegaro
locations.setting: A former nineteenth-century glass furnace in the hill town of Piegaro, converted into a museum that preserves the kilns and displays glassware made on site until the factory closed in 1968.

locations.name: OGR Torino
locations.setting: Former 19th-century railway repair workshop in Turin, restored into a steel-and-glass exhibition and event hall with an attached production and rehearsal wing.
locations.facilities: The corporate events page lists two main halls: one of 4,000 sqm (including stage and backstage) holding up to 2,750 people standing in an empty configuration, and a second hall of 300 sqm with a maximum of 150 seated theatre-style, rented empty with no in-house technical equipment. A staffed cloakroom holds up to 900 items.
locations.logistics: Loading access for large vehicles is about 30 m from the stage for the main hall and about 20 m from the second hall, with level access throughout (own site).

locations.name: On Air Milano
locations.setting: A virtual production studio in Milan built around an LED-wall stage for commercials and television, running since 1991 with in-house post-production alongside the shooting stage.
locations.facilities: An LED-wall virtual production stage plus 12 post-production workstations on site.
locations.suitability: Runs full virtual-production workflows from concept to final master, including studio hire, virtual environment creation and on-set consultation.

locations.name: Ortigia
locations.setting: Historic island core of Syracuse in Sicily, with a baroque cathedral built into the columns of a Greek temple, narrow lanes, a waterfront promenade and a Norman castle at its tip.

locations.name: Ospedale Molinette, Torino
locations.setting: A large active university hospital in Turin opened in 1935, built as a self-contained health campus of dozens of pavilions linked by covered walkways and underground tunnels.

locations.name: PalaFlorio
locations.setting: An indoor arena in Bari used for basketball, concerts and trade events, with tiered seating around a large flat floor.
locations.facilities: The venue has 3 meeting/conference rooms (up to 50 people each) plus exhibition areas, 4 bar stations and a control booth. On-site services include audio system rental, chair rental, ticket office management, catering and dressing room management, security and transfers.
locations.suitability: Hosts sporting events, concerts, congresses, galas, shows, conventions, trade fairs and banquets, with in-house logistics and technical support for organisers.

locations.name: Palazzo dei Congressi, EUR
locations.setting: Rationalist congress hall in Rome's EUR district, built for a cancelled 1942 world's fair, with a marble facade, a colonnaded portico and a large domed hall, managed by EUR SpA.
locations.facilities: The venue's own page states: 30,000 sqm total surface, Salone della Cultura 1,450 sqm with 27 m ceiling height, Auditorium Capitalis 792 seats, Terrazza posteriore amphitheatre for 500, Foyer Kennedy and Foyer Arte 800 sqm each, Terrazza frontale 1,085 sqm, a rear stage area of 774 sqm, and up to 26 meeting rooms ranging from 20 to 250 person capacity.
locations.logistics: The site states 1,600 hotel rooms lie within a 2.5 km radius.

locations.name: Piscina delle Rose
locations.setting: A 1950s open-air lido in Rome's EUR district, with a large rectangular pool, sunbathing terraces and Rationalist-style changing pavilions.

locations.name: Porticoes of Bologna
locations.setting: Covered walkways lining central Bologna's streets, including the roughly 3.8 km arcade climbing to the Sanctuary of San Luca, a UNESCO World Heritage arrangement of porticoes.

locations.name: Porto Antico di Genova
locations.setting: Nineteenth-century harbour warehouses and docks in Genoa, redeveloped for Expo 1992 into a waterfront of piazzas, a marina, an aquarium and event spaces along the old quays.
locations.facilities: The site lists 13 halls of varying capacity across the complex, 8,500 sqm gross of exhibition space in the Magazzini del Cotone modules, and a total complex area of 130,000 sqm, stating it hosts over 250 events a year.
locations.suitability: The venue's own page describes the complex as a setting for photo and video shoots.

locations.name: Porto di Ancona
locations.setting: A natural harbour port in the Marche used since antiquity, today Italy's leading port for vehicle and passenger ferry traffic and among the busiest on the Adriatic for container freight.

locations.name: Porto di Brindisi
locations.setting: Brindisi's harbour beside the city's Roman-era terminal columns, in continuous use since antiquity and now handling ferry and commercial shipping.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, car access and on foot

photo.author: The original uploader was Zappuddu at Italian Wikipedia.

locations.name: Porto di Cagliari
locations.setting: A multifunction commercial and passenger port in the Gulf of Angels at Cagliari, developed over centuries into today's terminal and still central to Sardinia's shipping trade.

locations.name: Porto di Gioia Tauro
locations.setting: Italy's largest container transshipment port on the Calabrian coast, with long quays, gantry cranes and stacked container yards handling international freight.

photo.author: The original uploader was Istvánka at Hungarian Wikipedia.

locations.name: Porto di Livorno
locations.setting: Central Italy's main seaport, with 11 kilometres of quays and 100 berths, including the historic Darsena Vecchia built under the Medici on Livorno's west bank.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, car access

locations.name: Porto di Napoli
locations.setting: A major container and passenger port on the Bay of Naples with shipyards, warehouses and the modernist Casa del Portuale building, among the city's most requested filming locations.

locations.name: Porto di Taranto
locations.setting: A working commercial and industrial port on the Ionian coast in Apulia, among Italy's busiest for freight, with a separate marina in the old town offering berths and boat services.

locations.name: Porto di Termoli
locations.setting: A 45,000 square-metre Adriatic harbour in Termoli with a tourist marina on one mole and shipyards on the other, used by fishing boats, ferries to the Tremiti Islands and the coast guard.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large and off-road vehicles

locations.name: Porto Flavia, Iglesias
locations.setting: An early 20th century mineral loading facility cut into a coastal cliff near Iglesias, part of an underground tunnel system that loaded ore directly onto ships, now inside a mining heritage park.

locations.name: Porto Vecchio di Trieste
locations.setting: Disused free port in Trieste with about seventy hectares of 19th-century warehouses, rail sidings and quays between the city centre and the sea, now under partial redevelopment.

locations.name: Quartiere EUR
locations.setting: A 1930s planned district built for a cancelled world's fair, laid out in wide rationalist boulevards around the square-arched Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana and an artificial lake.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, accessible by large vehicles, by car and on foot

locations.name: Quartiere Falchera, Torino
locations.setting: A postwar workers' housing district on Turin's northern edge, designed by architect Giovanni Astengo and built 1952-54 as a self-contained neighbourhood of low apartment blocks around courtyards.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Quartiere Garbatella
locations.setting: A 1920s garden-city district of Rome built around communal courtyards, with low three-storey villini in varied styles rather than uniform apartment blocks.
locations.known_for: Caro Diario, Esterno Notte, Gli anni più belli, I Cesaroni
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, wheelchair accessible, paved road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Real Fabbrica di San Leucio
locations.setting: A royal silk-manufacturing complex built by the Bourbon court above Caserta, with weaving halls, workers' housing and machinery from its eighteenth-century silk mill, part of the Caserta Palace UNESCO site.

locations.name: Salone degli Incanti, Trieste
locations.setting: Trieste's former central fish market of 1913, an eclectic-style hall shaped like a basilica on the waterfront, now used as an exhibition and events space.
locations.known_for: The Godfather Part II, The Invisible Boy
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, paved road access

locations.name: San Siro Stadium (Stadio Giuseppe Meazza)
locations.setting: Multi-tiered football stadium in Milan shared by AC Milan and Inter, with a distinctive spiral-ramp exterior and seating for over 75,000.
locations.facilities: The stadium's event page states it has 40 hospitality rooms totalling 3,160 sqm, with a combined event capacity of 2,154 people (1,264 for seated dinners), across Sala Executive 1-3, Sala Arancio, Sky Lounge, Sky Box and Sala Interviste. This is hospitality/event capacity, not match-day stadium capacity.

locations.name: Sassi di Matera
locations.setting: Ancient cave-dwelling districts carved into a limestone ravine, frequently standing in for biblical-era Jerusalem.
locations.known_for: The Passion of the Christ (2004), Wonder Woman (2017), No Time to Die (2021)

locations.name: Scuola Grande di San Giovanni Evangelista, Venezia
locations.setting: A 13th century confraternity building in Venice with a Gothic hall, a Renaissance staircase by Mauro Codussi and a baroque chapter hall, now run as a museum and event venue.

locations.name: Stadio Olimpico
locations.setting: Rome's main stadium in the Foro Italico complex, with tiered seating for over 70,000 used for football, athletics, concerts and other large events.

locations.name: Stazione di Porta Nuova, Torino
locations.setting: Turin's main railway station, opened in 1861 as the gateway to the new capital of a unified Italy, pairing a formal street facade with a wide iron and glass train shed.
locations.known_for: Così ridevano, Finale: Allegro, La meglio gioventù
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles and by car

locations.name: Stazione di Porta Susa, Torino
locations.setting: A modern high speed rail hub in Turin with a 385 metre steel and glass concourse, built over a buried through line, used for contemporary station and transit scenes.

locations.name: Stazione Marittima di Salerno
locations.setting: A Zaha Hadid-designed ferry and cruise terminal on Salerno's Molo Manfredi, opened in 2016 with an oyster-shaped shell reaching toward the sea, also used for public events.
locations.known_for: Mare Fuori, Vincenzo Malinconico, avvocato d'insuccesso
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Teatro alla Scala
locations.setting: 1778 opera house in central Milan with a gilded horseshoe auditorium, tiered boxes, a museum wing and a stage house used for opera, ballet and concerts.

locations.name: Teatro di San Carlo, Napoli
locations.setting: An 18th century royal opera house beside Naples' Palazzo Reale, seating around 1,400 across five tiers of boxes, still in regular use for opera, ballet and concerts.

locations.name: Teatro Massimo
locations.setting: Largest opera house in Italy, in central Palermo, with a neoclassical facade, a horseshoe auditorium seating around 1,300 and backstage and rehearsal spaces.

locations.name: Teatro Massimo Bellini, Catania
locations.setting: An 1890 opera house in Catania with an eclectic facade and a horseshoe auditorium of four tiers of boxes seating around 2,000, still used for opera and concerts.

locations.name: Teatro Petruzzelli
locations.setting: Bari's late nineteenth-century opera house, one of Italy's largest theatres, rebuilt after a 1991 fire with its horseshoe auditorium and gilded boxes restored.

locations.name: Teatro Tre
locations.setting: A production studio in Milan offering sound-stage space for advertising, fashion and television shoots alongside its own set-design, scenography and costume workshops, operating since 1984.
locations.facilities: Three stages: Teatro Grande 646,35 mq, Teatro Medio 240,75 mq and Teatro Piccolo 110 mq, with floor plans published as PDF and DWG. On site: canteen, dressing rooms, meeting room, paint booth, carpentry workshop and electrical store.
locations.suitability: Listed by Lombardy's film commission under sound stages/photo studios (studi/fotografici/teatri di posa), with in-house scenography, costume and make-up services.

locations.name: Teatro Verdi, Pisa
locations.setting: A 19th century theatre in central Pisa with a neoclassical facade and portico, built 1865 to 1867, with one of the largest stages in Italy at 26 by 32 metres.

locations.name: Toledo Metro Station
locations.setting: Underground metro station in central Naples built around 40 metres deep, with a mosaic-lined vaulted concourse known as the Crater de Luz, part of the city's art-station network.

locations.name: Tropea
locations.setting: Clifftop town on Calabria's Tyrrhenian coast, with a historic centre of stone lanes and balconies overlooking the beach and the offshore Santa Maria dell'Isola sanctuary.

locations.name: Universita degli Studi di Napoli Federico II
locations.setting: The neo-baroque main building of one of the world's oldest universities on Corso Umberto I in Naples, built 1897 to 1908 with a grand staircase and a former Jesuit cloister behind it.

locations.name: Universita degli Studi Mediterranea, Reggio Calabria
locations.setting: Calabria's first university, founded in 1968, with a hillside 1990s campus at Feo di Vito focused on architecture, engineering and agricultural sciences.

locations.name: Università della Calabria, Arcavacata
locations.setting: A 1968 university campus on over 200 hectares of hillside at Rende, designed by Vittorio Gregotti around a 2-kilometre elevated walkway spanning the Crati valley.
locations.facilities: Water and mains power on site, road access for large vehicles

locations.name: Videoporto Genova
locations.setting: A production support centre run by Genova-Liguria Film Commission inside Villa Durazzo Bombrini in Cornigliano, Genoa, with a sound stage, guest accommodation and workshop space for visiting productions.
locations.facilities: Sound stage with a perimeter cyclorama rail at 5 m, fixed and mobile overhead rails with pantographs for lighting at 7 m, a green screen limbo 5 m high and 10 m long in the centre section (8 m left, 4 m right), lighting load up to 35 kW. Furnished temporary production offices with fast internet, 4 dressing rooms (10 positions) with toilets and showers, a costume/tailoring room, a carpentry and set workshop, and guest accommodation (foresteria).
locations.suitability: Advertised by the film commission as available for hire to local, national and international productions.
locations.logistics: Parking area of about 2000 mq for cars and technical vehicles, at the former steelworks site in Genova Cornigliano.

locations.name: Villa del Balbianello
locations.setting: Eighteenth-century villa on a wooded promontory of Lake Como with terraced gardens and open lake panoramas, now a FAI heritage property.
locations.known_for: Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (2002), Casino Royale (2006)
locations.facilities: The venue's own page gives room-by-room figures: La Loggia Durini 60 sqm (ceremony 80-100 people, max 60 seated), Terrazzo a Lago 240 sqm (dinners up to 130), Loggia 90 sqm indoor (dinners up to 75) or 170 sqm indoor plus outdoor (up to 100), Terrazzo Canfora 80 sqm (standing buffet up to 100).
locations.suitability: The site states the villa hosts ceremonies, receptions, corporate meetings and 'set cinematografici e pubblicitari' (film and advertising shoots), and says it has served as the backdrop for numerous film and advertising productions. Photo services such as weddings are paid and require advance booking via a named contact.

locations.name: Villa Necchi Campiglio
locations.setting: 1930s rationalist villa in central Milan designed by Piero Portaluppi, with period interiors, a garden, swimming pool and tennis court, run as a house museum by FAI.
locations.facilities: The venue's own page lists: Sale Pomara Scibetta (basement), 3 adjoining multipurpose rooms totalling 200 sqm; Sala da Pranzo, 43 sqm on the piano nobile; a multipurpose hall of 380 sqm plus a service block (4 toilets, cloakroom, technical room) in the former tennis-court building, with heating and air conditioning; and a garden of 2,000 sqm, partly walkable, with a historic non-swimmable pool.
locations.suitability: The site states the villa is used for photo and film shoots ('set fotografici e cinematografici') and names 'Io sono l'amore' (I Am Love, Luca Guadagnino) and 'House of Gucci' (Ridley Scott) as productions filmed there.

locations.name: Y-40 The Deep Joy
locations.setting: An underwater filming tank inside the Hotel Terme Millepini in Montegrotto Terme, with thermal water down to 42 metres, used for underwater photo and video shoots and advertising campaigns.
locations.facilities: Pool of 21 m x 18 m holding 4,300 cubic metres of thermal water at 32-34 degrees C. Platforms at -1.3 m (18 x 5 m), -5 m, -6 m and -8 m (5 x 4 m each), -10 m (14 x 9 m), -12 m (6 x 4 m), -15 m (7 x 7 m) and a -42.15 m cylinder of 6 m diameter; 60 m of underwater caves between -8 and -10 m; a 13 m transparent tunnel between -2.5 and -5 m with 4 windows of 3 x 1.6 m and 5 of 1 x 1.6 m at -4 m. Ceiling 5 m above the water with two 30 m beams rated 1 t/m for trusses and lights; underwater anchor points along the walls; full blackout of the 40 m glass wall and windows is possible. Rooms on the pool deck and ground floor for production offices, make-up, hair and wardrobe.
locations.suitability: Advertised for underwater photo shoots, video and advertising campaigns, with underwater DoP supervision, professional divers, lighting, backdrop installation and make-up/wardrobe support on site.
locations.logistics: Vehicle access to the pool deck through a 2.30 x 2.20 m door next to a loading and unloading area; a 1 x 4 m raft moves material to the centre of the pool. A 4-star thermal hotel with 100 rooms in the same park is connected by an internal road, with a price agreement for crews; the hotel restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner. Open all year, day and night.

locations.name: Aerodium Vertical Wind Tunnel
locations.setting: Open vertical wind tunnel beside the Riga to Sigulda road, used for free-fall and flying shots with performers held in a controlled air column.
locations.suitability: Listed by the Riga film office among production facilities for skydiving and free-fall cinematography

locations.name: Baltic Beach Hotel
locations.setting: Large seafront hotel and spa at Majori with a 1960s block extended in the 2000s, a glass-fronted restaurant, pools, treatment rooms and direct access to the dune beach.
locations.logistics: Juras iela 23/25, Majori, about 25 km west of Riga

locations.name: Baltic Sound Stage
locations.setting: Single-stage rental facility in a Riga industrial area: a clear floor of 48 by 24 metres with a 7 metre working height, blackout, heating and four make-up rooms.
locations.facilities: Stage 48 x 24 m (1,150 sq m) inside a 1,500 sq m building, working height 7 m, two 3.5 x 5 m gates, 300 kW power, smoke extraction, heating, prop and costume store, four make-up rooms, production office and client lounge, in-house catering

locations.name: Berga Bazars
locations.setting: Late 19th century shopping arcade of linked brick courtyards between Elizabetes and Dzirnavu streets, with small shops, cafes and passageways off the street.

locations.name: Birini Castle
locations.setting: Neo-gothic manor house of 1860 in red brick beside a lake, with a tower, wood-panelled halls and a park, run as a hotel and event venue.
locations.suitability: The house and park are hired for weddings, conferences and other events

locations.name: Cape Kolka
locations.setting: Sand spit where the Gulf of Riga meets the open Baltic, with shallow water, drifted tree stumps, a wide empty beach and pine forest of Slitere National Park behind.

locations.name: Cesis Castle
locations.setting: Ruined Livonian Order castle of the 13th century with towers, cellars visited by lantern, an adjoining 18th century new castle and a landscaped park.

locations.name: Cesu Alus Brewery
locations.setting: Brewery on the edge of Cesis combining 19th century brick buildings with modern brewhouse and packaging halls, tanks, pipework and a visitor route through production.
locations.suitability: Brewery tours are run for visitors

locations.name: Cinevilla Studio Backlot
locations.setting: Outdoor backlot of about 150 hectares in flat farmland, with medieval and 19th century streets, a railway platform and tram, prison, church, ship and metro sets, plus five pavilions.
locations.known_for: Defenders of Riga, Blizzard of Souls, Sisi, Raven's Hollow
locations.facilities: Five pavilions, make-up and dressing rooms, green screen, cinema, cafe, on-site hotel and camping
locations.logistics: Slampe parish in Tukums Municipality, roughly an hour and a half by car from Riga

locations.name: Corner House (former KGB building)
locations.setting: Art nouveau corner block on Brivibas iela used by the Soviet security service, with preserved cells, interrogation rooms, corridors and a closed inner courtyard.
locations.logistics: Brivibas iela 61, corner of Stabu iela, central Riga

locations.name: Dailes Theatre
locations.setting: Modernist theatre of 1976 on Brivibas iela with a travertine-clad front, a large fan-shaped auditorium, deep stage and wide concrete foyers.

locations.name: Daugavpils Fortress
locations.setting: Complete early 19th century fortress town on the Daugava with earth ramparts, brick gates, parade ground, barracks and an arsenal, much of it still in everyday residential use.
locations.logistics: North bank of the Daugava, about 2 km from Daugavpils city centre

locations.name: Dzintari Concert Hall
locations.setting: Seaside concert venue in the pines at Dzintari, combining a 1936 timber small hall with an open-sided large hall seating around two thousand.

locations.name: Ethnographic Open-Air Museum of Latvia
locations.setting: Eighty-seven hectares of pine forest on Lake Jugla holding more than a hundred relocated farmsteads, windmills, a wooden church and a fishing village, all pre-industrial.
locations.logistics: Brivibas gatve 440, north east edge of Riga, on the shore of Lake Jugla

locations.name: Freeport of Riga
locations.setting: Working port on both banks of the Daugava with container and bulk terminals, cranes, rail sidings and quays, plus the older Andrejsala berths close to the city centre.

photo.author: The original uploader was Anonīms at Latvian Wikipedia.

locations.name: Freeport of Ventspils
locations.setting: Ice-free cargo port at the mouth of the Venta with oil and chemical terminals, bulk berths, long breakwaters and rail yards on the Baltic coast.

locations.name: Gauja National Park
locations.setting: Broad forested valley of the Gauja with red Devonian sandstone cliffs and caves, river bends, castles and manor parks, the largest national park in Latvia.

locations.name: Great Amber Concert Hall
locations.setting: Amber-coloured glass concert hall of 2015 on the trade canal in Liepaja, with a tilted faceted shell, a main hall for about a thousand people and glazed foyers.

locations.name: Gulbene to Aluksne Narrow Gauge Railway
locations.setting: Working 750 mm narrow gauge line of 33 km through forest and farmland, with period stations, a depot at Gulbene, steam and diesel locomotives and wooden coaches.
locations.facilities: Historic locomotives and coaches, depot and turntable at Gulbene, intermediate stations along the line

locations.name: Hotel Bergs
locations.setting: Hotel in the Berga Bazars courtyard block, mixing a restored 19th century brick facade with plain contemporary suites, a glazed atrium and a quiet inner yard.

locations.name: Jelgava Palace
locations.setting: Large baroque palace of the 1730s on an island in the Lielupe, now the main building of the life sciences university, with a long symmetrical front and inner courtyard.

locations.name: Jurmala Beach
locations.setting: Some 25 km of flat white sand backed by low dunes and pine woods, with wooden resort villas and the pedestrian Jomas iela a short walk inland.
locations.logistics: Between Lielupe and Kemeri, about 25 km west of Riga, served by suburban trains

locations.name: Kalnciema Quarter
locations.setting: Restored block of 19th century wooden houses in Pardaugava, with a cobbled yard used for a weekly market, a bakery, wine shop and small event halls.
locations.suitability: The courtyard and halls are hired out for markets, concerts and private events

locations.name: Karosta Northern Forts
locations.setting: Broken concrete coastal artillery forts of the tsarist naval fortress, partly collapsed into the sea, standing on an open beach north of Liepaja.

locations.name: Karosta Prison
locations.setting: Former naval garrison prison built in the early 20th century, in use until 1997, with cell blocks, solitary cells, guard corridors and a bare exercise yard kept as found.
locations.facilities: Cells, punishment cells, visitor centre, canteen, overnight stays in cells
locations.logistics: Invalidu iela 4, Karosta district, about 6 km north of Liepaja centre

locations.name: Kemeri National Park
locations.setting: Raised bog with pools and boardwalks, wet forest, sulphur springs and the shallow Lake Kanieris, close to the coast west of Jurmala.

locations.name: Kemeri Resort Park and Kemeri Hotel
locations.setting: Empty neo-eclectic spa hotel of 1936 by Eizens Laube standing in a laid-out resort park with sulphur springs, timber pavilions, canals and footbridges.
locations.logistics: Kemeri district of Jurmala, next to Kemeri National Park, about 45 km from Riga

locations.name: Krimulda Manor
locations.setting: Classical manor house of 1822 on the high bank above the Gauja valley, with a colonnaded front, plain plastered rooms, outbuildings and a park, run as a guest house.
locations.logistics: Gauja National Park near Sigulda, reached by cable car or road from the town

locations.name: Kuldiga Old Town
locations.setting: Small Kurzeme town of low wooden and brick houses on a regular street grid, listed as a world heritage site, with the Venta rapids and a long brick road bridge.

locations.name: Latgale Embassy GORS
locations.setting: Concert house of 2013 in Rezekne with two halls, a cinema, glazed foyers and rehearsal rooms, standing on open ground on the edge of the town centre.

locations.name: Latvian Academy of Sciences
locations.setting: Stalinist high-rise of 1958 near the Central Market, with a stone-clad tower, marble lobbies, wide staircases and a public viewing terrace on the 17th floor.

locations.name: Latvian National Museum of Art
locations.setting: Baroque revival museum of 1905 in the Esplanade park, with a grand marble staircase, top-lit galleries and a modern basement extension under the forecourt.

locations.name: Latvian National Opera and Ballet
locations.setting: Classical opera house of 1863 beside the city canal, with a colonnaded portico, gilded horseshoe auditorium, foyers, rehearsal rooms and a modern rear extension.

locations.name: Latvian Railway History Museum
locations.setting: Museum in a former locomotive depot on the left bank with steam and diesel locomotives, wagons, a snow plough and track on an open yard beside the line.
locations.facilities: Historic rolling stock, depot building, outdoor track and yard

locations.name: Latvian War Museum
locations.setting: Museum inside the medieval Powder Tower and an adjoining 1930s wing at the edge of the old town, with thick stone walls, vaulted rooms and period exhibition halls.

locations.name: Mentzendorff House
locations.setting: Merchant house of 1695 in the old town with painted wall and ceiling decoration, a dark kitchen, tiled stoves, cellars and an attic, furnished as an 18th century home.
locations.logistics: Grecinieku iela 18, old town Riga

locations.name: National Library of Latvia
locations.setting: Glass and concrete library of 2014 on the left bank of the Daugava, with a full-height atrium, tiered reading rooms and long river-facing windows.
locations.suitability: Halls and conference rooms are available to hire for events

locations.name: Oskars Kalpaks Bridge
locations.setting: Steel swing bridge of 1906 over the Karosta canal in Liepaja, carrying road traffic on a riveted span that pivots to let ships pass.

locations.name: Peter's Market (Petertirgus)
locations.setting: Liepaja's market on Kursu laukums, with an 1910 brick and iron hall, outdoor stalls and surrounding shopfronts in the older part of the town.

locations.name: Port of Liepaja
locations.setting: Cargo and fishing port inside the Liepaja special economic zone, with quays along the trade canal, warehouses, cranes and open yards next to the former naval base.

locations.name: Riga Art Nouveau Centre
locations.setting: Restored apartment of 1903 at Alberta iela 12 with original spiral staircase, tiled stove, panelled dining room and period furniture, in the middle of the art nouveau district.

locations.name: Riga Carriage Building Works (RVR)
locations.setting: Rolling stock plant north east of the centre with tall assembly halls, overhead cranes, test track and rail sidings, parts of the site standing empty.

locations.name: Riga Central Market
locations.setting: Market of 1930 built from five reused Zeppelin hangars, with steel-ribbed halls for meat, fish, dairy and produce plus open stalls, night storage cellars and a rail siding.
locations.logistics: Negu iela 7, between the central station and the Daugava

photo.author:
David Holt

locations.name: Riga Central Station
locations.setting: Main railway station of Latvia, a 1960s concourse rebuilt with a glass shopping level over the platforms, with a clock tower and long open platform canopies.

locations.name: Riga Film Studio
locations.setting: Latvia's oldest studio, with three sound stages of 1,248, 1,067 and 223 square metres, working heights of 12, 9 and 5 metres, a water tank, workshops and a costume and prop store.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 42 x 29.7 m, height 12 m, with water tank. Stage 2: 35.94 x 29.68 m, height 9 m, green screen. Stage 3: 17.43 x 12.81 m, height 5 m. Workshops, production offices, costume and prop hire.
locations.suitability: Stages are also hired for television production and events; guided tours run on the site.

locations.name: Riga Old Town
locations.setting: Compact medieval core on the Daugava with cobbled lanes such as Jauniela, merchant houses, guild halls, church spires and squares, listed as a world heritage site.

locations.name: Riga Radio and TV Tower
locations.setting: Concrete tower of 1986 on Zakusala island in the Daugava, 368 metres high on three splayed legs, with a public observation deck at 97 metres.

locations.name: Rundale Palace
locations.setting: Baroque summer palace by Rastrelli, built from 1736, with a gilded Golden Hall, White Hall, long enfilades of restored rooms and a formal French garden.
locations.logistics: Pilsrundale, about 12 km west of Bauska and 77 km from Riga

locations.name: Spikeri Quarter
locations.setting: Row of 19th century red brick warehouses between the Central Market and the Daugava, converted to offices, galleries and event halls, with cobbled service lanes between the blocks.
locations.facilities: Office space and event areas for hire, open-air courtyards used for markets and screenings

locations.name: Splendid Palace
locations.setting: Cinema of 1923 with a neo-baroque and rococo auditorium, ornamented balcony, chandeliers, marble stair hall and a smaller second screening room.
locations.logistics: Elizabetes iela 61, central Riga

locations.name: Turaida Museum Reserve
locations.setting: Red brick castle of 1214 with a round tower above the Gauja valley, set in a reserve with a wooden church, manor outbuildings and a sculpture park.

locations.name: University of Latvia main building
locations.setting: Nineteenth century academic building on Raina bulvaris with a columned Great Hall, galleried staircase, lecture theatres and corridors lined with dark panelling.

locations.name: VEF Culture Palace
locations.setting: Factory culture palace of 1960 with a columned front, a theatre auditorium, ballroom, club rooms and wide stone staircases, still used for concerts and classes.
locations.suitability: Halls and rooms are let for events and rehearsals

locations.name: VEF Quarter
locations.setting: Red brick halls and interwar office blocks of the former VEF electrical works on Brivibas gatve, now let as offices, workshops and event space, with long corridors and factory yards.
locations.suitability: Premises are advertised for office and event hire

locations.name: Ziemelblazma Culture Palace
locations.setting: Restored culture house of 1913 in Vecmilgravis with a white classical facade, galleried hall, side rooms and a surrounding park near the Daugava.

locations.name: Arena Vilnius
locations.setting: Indoor arena on Ozo street seating around 11,000, with a bowl, concourses, locker rooms and a large flat floor used for concerts and sport.

locations.name: Aukstaitija Narrow Gauge Railway
locations.setting: Working 750 mm gauge railway of 1899 with steam and diesel locomotives, wooden carriages, a depot in Panevezys and small country halts along the line.

locations.name: Chaim Frenkel Villa
locations.setting: Art nouveau villa of 1908 built for a leather manufacturer, with a stained glass staircase, panelled salons, a ballroom and a park with the former factory nearby.

locations.name: Contemporary Art Centre
locations.setting: Modernist 1967 exhibition building at the edge of the Old Town, with wide halls, terrazzo staircases and glazed frontage, used as a gallery and event space.

locations.name: Energy and Technology Museum
locations.setting: The city's first power station, in use from 1903 to 1998, keeping boilers, turbines, control panels, pipework and brick machine halls beside the river.

locations.name: Fabijoniskes housing estate
locations.setting: Late Soviet estate of prefabricated panel blocks with wide courtyards, playgrounds and unchanged 1980s facades, used repeatedly to double for cities in the former Soviet bloc.

locations.name: Hales Market
locations.setting: Covered market of 1906 with a cast iron and glass roof, stalls on two levels, cellars and a produce yard, trading daily at the edge of the Old Town.

locations.name: Hill of Crosses
locations.setting: Pilgrimage mound north of Siauliai covered with tens of thousands of crosses of all sizes, reached by a boardwalk across open farmland.

locations.name: Hotel Pacai
locations.setting: Seventeenth century Pac Palace on Didzioji street converted into a hotel, keeping frescoed ceilings, a stone courtyard, vaulted cellars and a grand staircase.

locations.name: Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant
locations.setting: Decommissioned station with two RBMK reactors of the Chernobyl type, keeping turbine halls, corridors and a control room simulator that is open to guided visits.

locations.name: Juozas Miltinis Drama Theatre
locations.setting: Panevezys theatre founded in 1940 and rebuilt in the 1960s, with a main auditorium, a small stage, rehearsal rooms and modernist foyers.

locations.name: Kaunas Castle
locations.setting: Fourteenth century brick castle at the meeting of the Nemunas and Neris, with a round tower, curtain wall, moat and open riverside ground.

locations.name: Kaunas Central Post Office
locations.setting: Interwar modernist post office of 1932 on Laisves Avenue, with a stone facade, a double height public hall, patterned floors and original counters and fittings.

locations.name: Kaunas National Drama Theatre
locations.setting: Theatre on Laisves Avenue combining a 19th century auditorium with 1980s extensions, several stages, foyers and workshops.

locations.name: Kaunas Ninth Fort
locations.setting: Fortress of 1902 later used as a prison and execution site, with casemates, cell corridors, earth ramparts, a museum block and a concrete memorial on open ground.

locations.name: Kaunas Seventh Fort
locations.setting: Nineteenth century fort in the north of Kaunas with brick barracks, tunnels, powder magazines, dry ditches and open glacis, run as a museum and event site.

locations.name: Kernave Archaeological Site
locations.setting: UNESCO listed site of five hill forts above the Neris terrace, with open meadows, a reconstructed settlement and a small village, an hour from Vilnius.

locations.name: Kino Manufaktura
locations.setting: Studio space in the former industrial quarter on Manufakturu street, listed by the Vilnius Film Office among the city studios available for hire.

locations.name: Klaipeda Culture Factory
locations.setting: Former factory near the centre converted into a creative incubator, with brick halls, a black box theatre, studios and a yard used for events.

locations.name: Klaipeda Theatre Square
locations.setting: Cobbled square in the old quarter framed by German half timbered and 19th century houses, the drama theatre and the Simon Dach fountain.

locations.name: KS Independent Film Studio
locations.setting: Independent studio on the old Minsk road outside Vilnius offering stage space and production facilities in a rural setting with room for exterior sets and unit parking.

locations.name: Laisves Aleja
locations.setting: Pedestrian avenue of about 1.6 kilometres lined with interwar modernist blocks, shops, cafes and lime trees, running from the Old Town to the basilica.

locations.name: Lithuanian Film Studio
locations.setting: Working studio complex founded in 1940 that rents out stages, production offices and technical services for feature, television and commercial shoots in Vilnius.

locations.name: Lithuanian National Drama Theatre
locations.setting: State drama theatre on Gedimino Avenue with several stages, rehearsal rooms, dressing rooms and a sculpted facade on the city's main street.

locations.name: Lithuanian National Opera and Ballet Theatre
locations.setting: Opera house opened in 1974 with a 1,000 seat auditorium, chandeliered foyers, marble staircases and backstage areas typical of Soviet era civic architecture.

locations.name: Lithuanian National Philharmonic Hall
locations.setting: Concert hall of 1902 with a gilded neo-baroque auditorium, balconies and mirrored foyers, dressed as an imperial palace interior for period drama.

locations.name: Lithuanian Sea Museum
locations.setting: Museum inside the 19th century Kopgalis fort on the Curonian Spit, with casemates, an aquarium, a dolphinarium, quays and dunes around it.

locations.name: Lithuanian Writers' Union Palace
locations.setting: Nineteenth century town palace on K. Sirvydo street with period rooms, a staircase hall and a garden courtyard, used for club, salon and residence interiors.

locations.name: Loftas Art Factory
locations.setting: Former fuel equipment plant turned event complex, with raw concrete halls, loading bays, a yard and gantry structures used for concerts and shoots.

locations.name: Lukiskes Prison 2.0
locations.setting: Prison built in 1904 and closed in 2019, now a cultural venue: cell blocks, galleries, exercise yards, a chapel and the original barred corridors are open for events and shoots.

locations.name: Martynas Mazvydas National Library of Lithuania
locations.setting: Monumental 1960s state library rebuilt in 2016, with a stone colonnade, long reading rooms, stacks and modern atria suitable for institutional and archive scenes.

locations.name: Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights
locations.setting: Former KGB headquarters on Auku street with the basement prison preserved: cells, padded isolation rooms, an interrogation wing and the execution chamber, plus 1950s office interiors.

locations.name: National Gallery of Art
locations.setting: Gallery on the right bank rebuilt in 2009 from a 1980 museum, with grey stone volumes, a long ramp, high white halls and a terrace over the river valley.

locations.name: Palace of the Grand Dukes of Lithuania
