locations.setting: Shopping centre with an indoor market hall and restaurants built over the international bus station, with a planted roof used as a public park.

locations.name: Orava Castle
locations.setting: Castle on a rock above the Orava river combining Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque work, on several levels linked by stairs and terraces.

photo.author: The original uploader was Jurbox at Polish Wikipedia.

locations.name: Original 1930s Villa, Palisady
locations.setting: Detached 1930 house in the Palisady district of the Old Town, partly altered in the 1970s and otherwise unchanged, offered to productions with parking at the house.
locations.suitability: Reserved primarily for filming, suitable as a full production base.
locations.logistics: Free parking at the house, further parking nearby with a permit pass.

locations.name: Piestany Spa Island
locations.setting: Island spa quarter on the Vah with thermal springs at 67 to 69 degrees, mud baths, colonnade buildings, an open air thermal pool and a landscaped park with fountains.

locations.name: Port of Bratislava
locations.setting: River port on the left bank of the Danube in two parts, cargo and passenger, with quays, cranes, warehouses and rail sidings.

locations.name: Railway Secondary School, Bratislava
locations.setting: State railway secondary school in Bratislava whose premises have stood empty since 2014, offering unused classrooms, halls and stairwells.

locations.name: Reduta, Slovak Philharmonic
locations.setting: Historic concert building in the city centre, restored, with a 708 seat concert hall, a 200 seat small hall and representative rooms used for receptions and congresses.

locations.name: Salvator Pharmacy
locations.setting: Working pharmacy in the Old Town with Baroque fittings more than 300 years old, a national cultural monument used for period filming.
locations.suitability: Offered as a film location for historical and period productions.

locations.name: Shining Studio
locations.setting: Studio and lighting rental base in Stupava north of Bratislava, listed by the Slovak Film Commission under studios and equipment rental.

locations.name: Sky Bar Bratislava
locations.setting: Bar and restaurant on two upper floors above Hviezdoslav Square, with a glazed terrace and an open terrace in summer looking over the city centre.

locations.name: Slovak National Archives
locations.setting: Brutalist archive building designed by Vladimir Dedecek and built between 1976 and 1983, with exposed concrete volumes, reading rooms and repository floors.

locations.name: Slovak National Theatre, Historical Building
locations.setting: Theatre of 1886 by Fellner and Helmer, a protected monument whose facade, auditorium, entrance foyer and first floor salon survive in their original form.

locations.name: Slovak National Theatre, New Building
locations.setting: Seven storey theatre complex of over two thousand rooms near the Danube, with an opera and ballet stage, a drama stage and a studio space.

locations.name: Slovak Radio Building
locations.setting: Inverted pyramid of steel and glass completed in 1983, 80 metres high, containing studios, offices and a 522 seat concert hall with a large organ.

locations.name: Slovak Television Building, Mlynska dolina
locations.setting: Twenty eight storey broadcasting tower of 1975 in the Mlynska dolina valley, for a long time the tallest building in Czechoslovakia and now standing unused but maintained.

locations.name: Slovak University of Agriculture, Nitra
locations.setting: Campus built between 1961 and 1966 to a design by Vladimir Dedecek and Rudolf Minovsky, with concrete lecture blocks, ramps and long glazed corridors.

locations.name: Solivar Salt Works
locations.setting: Seventeenth century brine pumping and salt boiling complex in Presov, including the late Baroque salt warehouse with its timber roof structure and chambers, a national cultural monument.

locations.name: Spis Castle
locations.setting: One of the largest castle ruins in Europe, built from the twelfth century on a limestone hill, with several courtyards, curtain walls and open views over the Spis plain.
locations.known_for: Dragonheart, Kull the Conqueror, The Last Legion, The Lion in Winter

locations.name: State Theatre Kosice
locations.setting: Neo-Baroque theatre of 1879 to 1899 on the main square of Kosice, with a lyre shaped stage and a painted ceiling of scenes from Shakespeare.

locations.name: Strbske Pleso
locations.setting: Glacial tarn at 1,346 metres in the High Tatras, 19.8 hectares in area, frozen for about 155 days a year, with hotels, ski jumps and mountain paths around it.

locations.name: Sugar Refinery Surany
locations.setting: Sugar factory and refinery in production from 1854, the oldest refinery in the former Habsburg monarchy, now a disused plant of tanks, silos and brick halls beside the town.

locations.name: Svit Railway Station
locations.setting: Station on the Zilina to Kosice line below the High Tatras, begun in 1948 and opened in 1969, with the original design left partly unfinished.

locations.name: Tobacco Factory Smolnik
locations.setting: Former chamber theatre converted into a tobacco factory in 1872 and closed for more than ten years, standing empty in a mining village in the Slovak Ore Mountains.

locations.name: Vlkolinec
locations.setting: UNESCO listed hamlet in the Velka Fatra with log cottages, a wooden bell tower and unpaved lanes, kept as a folk architecture reservation.

locations.name: Zehnhaus Colony
locations.setting: Workers' housing colony of 1902 on Palarikova Street, ten symmetrical blocks with bare brick facades, high windows and tall rooms, listed as a national cultural monument.

locations.name: Anthony's Shaft, Idrija Mercury Mine
locations.setting: Mine entrance in use since 1500 at Idrija, with a stone gatehouse, timbered galleries, water channels and hand cut drifts on a guided underground route.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Žiga assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Arena Stozice
locations.setting: Indoor arena of 2010 sunk into a former landfill, with a shallow domed roof, tiered seating for basketball and concerts and a football stadium in the same park.

locations.name: Brdo Estate
locations.setting: State protocol estate near Kranj with a Renaissance manor, halls used for state visits, a hotel, a golf course, lakes and several hundred hectares of managed parkland.

locations.name: Cankarjev dom
locations.setting: National congress and culture centre under Republic Square, with a large main hall, several smaller halls, wide marble foyers and an underground car park.
locations.suitability: The centre lists venue hire for events and conferences on its own site.

locations.name: Celje Old Castle
locations.setting: Largest castle ruin in Slovenia on a ridge above Celje, with curtain walls, a keep known as Friderikov stolp, open courtyards and views over the Savinja valley.

locations.name: Center Rog
locations.setting: Former Rog bicycle factory beside Trubarjeva cesta, reopened in 2024 as a public production centre that keeps the concrete frame and adds workshops, studios and a yard.

locations.name: Coal Mining Museum of Slovenia
locations.setting: Former Skale pit at Velenje with a headframe, miners changing rooms, a cage descent to 160 metres and long galleries fitted with cutting machines and an underground railway.

locations.name: Cukrarna
locations.setting: Nineteenth century sugar refinery on the Ljubljanica rebuilt as a gallery, keeping the long brick shell around a tall open hall crossed by steel walkways and bridges.
locations.suitability: The gallery advertises hire of its spaces (Najem prostora) for events.

locations.name: Grand Hotel Union
locations.setting: Secession hotel of 1905 on Miklosiceva cesta, with a domed corner, a mirrored Grand Hall used for balls and congresses and long period corridors and staircases.

photo.author: This Photo was taken by Wolfgang Moroder. Feel free to use my photos, but please

locations.name: Hostel Celica
locations.setting: Austro-Hungarian military prison in the Metelkova barracks turned into a hostel, where twenty cells keep barred doors and thick walls along vaulted corridors.

locations.name: Kempinski Palace Portoroz
locations.setting: Restored 1910 seaside palace hotel above Portoroz bay, with a marble lobby, a ballroom, a colonnaded garden terrace and a modern wing holding pools and a spa.

locations.name: Krizanke Summer Theatre
locations.setting: Former Teutonic Order monastery reworked by Plecnik into an open air theatre, with an arcaded courtyard, cloister galleries and a movable roof over the stage.

locations.name: Kromberk Castle, Goriska Museum
locations.setting: Seventeenth century square castle above Nova Gorica with corner towers, an arcaded courtyard and painted rooms, in use as the regional museum and its picture galleries.

locations.name: Lake Bled
locations.setting: Glacial lake with a wooded island and church, a castle on a cliff above the north shore, a lakeside promenade, rowing course and the Julian Alps behind.

locations.name: Lake Bohinj
locations.setting: Alpine lake inside Triglav National Park, with a stone bridge and church at Ribcev Laz, forested shores, a gravel beach and mountain walls closing the valley.

locations.name: Lipica Stud Farm
locations.setting: Stud farm founded in 1580 on the Karst plateau, with white stable ranges, a riding hall, a chapel, avenues of oaks and open pasture grazed by Lipizzaner horses.

locations.name: Ljubljana Central Market
locations.setting: Plecnik's riverside market colonnade between the Triple Bridge and the Dragon Bridge, with open stalls on Pogacarjev trg, a covered arcade and a fish market below.

locations.name: Ljubljana Joze Pucnik Airport
locations.setting: Slovenia's main airport at Brnik, with a 1960s modernist terminal beside a newer passenger building, open aprons, a cargo area and one runway in flat farmland.

locations.name: Ljubljana Railway Station
locations.setting: Main station of the Slovenian network north of the old town, with a long low concourse building, through platforms under canopies and the bus station on the same square.

locations.name: Ljubljana Town Hall
locations.setting: Civic hall on Mestni trg rebuilt in Venetian Baroque style, with an arcaded inner courtyard, a stone staircase, a council chamber and a clock tower over the street.

locations.name: Maribor Edvard Rusjan Airport
locations.setting: Quiet regional airport at Orehova vas with a runway of about 2,500 metres, a small terminal, hangars and wide apron space used for cargo, training and general aviation.

locations.name: Metelkova Mesto
locations.setting: Former Yugoslav army barracks in central Ljubljana, squatted since 1993 as an autonomous cultural centre with painted facades, small clubs, studios and a sculpture yard.

locations.name: Museum of Contemporary History, Cekin Mansion
locations.setting: Baroque mansion in Tivoli Park with a symmetrical front, stucco ceilings and period rooms, in use as the national museum of twentieth century history.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Žiga assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Museum of Hostages, Begunje
locations.setting: Wing of the Katzenstein mansion at Begunje used as a Gestapo prison from 1941 to 1945, with preserved cells, prisoner inscriptions on the plaster and a memorial park behind.

locations.name: National and University Library of Slovenia
locations.setting: Library completed by Joze Plecnik in 1941, with a rough stone and brick facade, a dark marble entrance staircase and a top lit reading room lined in wood.

locations.name: Neboticnik
locations.setting: Thirteen storey tower of 1933 with a spiral staircase, a period lift lobby and a top floor cafe and open terrace looking across the rooftops of central Ljubljana.

locations.name: Plecnik House
locations.setting: The architect Joze Plecnik's own house in Trnovo, left as he used it, with a round glazed extension, a study, a workshop and a walled garden of columns and planting.

locations.name: Port of Koper
locations.setting: Slovenia's cargo port on the Bay of Koper, with container, car and bulk terminals, gantry cranes, rail sidings, warehouses and open quays.

locations.name: Postojna Cave
locations.setting: Karst cave system with more than twenty kilometres of passages, an electric cave railway, large chambers with stalactite growth and a concert hall sized hall.

locations.name: Predjama Castle
locations.setting: Castle built into a cave mouth in a 123 metre cliff, with a vertical front of windows, small vaulted rooms, a drawbridge and passages into the rock behind.

locations.name: Ptuj Old Town
locations.setting: Oldest town in Slovenia, with a Roman and medieval street plan, a monastery, a city tower and low painted houses climbing from the Drava to the castle hill.

locations.name: Rimske Terme
locations.setting: Nineteenth century spa resort in a wooded valley near Lasko, with historic bath houses, a colonnaded hall, thermal pools and a park of villas along the valley road.

locations.name: Rogatec Open-Air Museum
locations.setting: Reconstructed Stajerska village of thatched farmhouses, granaries, a smithy, a toll house and beehives, laid out around farmyards with no modern buildings in shot.

locations.name: RTV Slovenija Television Centre
locations.setting: Headquarters of the national public broadcaster on Kolodvorska ulica, holding multi camera television studios, control rooms, radio recording rooms and scenery workshops.

locations.name: Secovlje Salina Nature Park
locations.setting: Working salt pans at the Croatian border, with a grid of shallow basins, earth embankments, wooden sluices, salt workers houses and wide flat horizons.

locations.name: Sitarjevec Mine, Litija
locations.setting: Former lead, zinc and barite mine above Litija, with a narrow main adit, timbered side galleries and coloured limonite formations growing on the tunnel walls.

locations.name: Skocjan Caves
locations.setting: UNESCO listed cave park where the Reka river runs through a canyon up to 140 metres high, crossed by a footbridge, with collapse dolines and karst villages above.

locations.name: Skofja Loka Old Town
locations.setting: Walled medieval town square with pastel merchant houses, a plague column, a stone bridge over the Selscica and the bishops castle on the slope above.

locations.name: Slovene Ethnographic Museum
locations.setting: Museum in the Metelkova barracks quarter combining a restored nineteenth century block with a glazed new wing, holding open depots and large neutral exhibition floors.

locations.name: Slovene National Opera and Ballet Theatre Ljubljana
locations.setting: Neo-Renaissance opera house of 1892 with a horseshoe auditorium, tiered boxes and a painted ceiling, joined to a modern backstage block with rehearsal rooms.

locations.name: Slovene National Theatre Maribor
locations.setting: Theatre complex in central Maribor joining a nineteenth century auditorium to a glazed 1990s extension, holding drama, opera and ballet stages with workshops behind.

locations.name: Slovenian Railway Museum
locations.setting: Working roundhouse at Parmova ulica with a locomotive turntable, halls of preserved steam engines and carriages, and exhibition buildings on signalling and track.

locations.name: Soca Valley at Bovec
locations.setting: Upper Soca valley around Bovec, with a turquoise river in gravel beds and gorges, hay meadows, scattered stone villages and the Julian Alps on both sides.
locations.known_for: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian

locations.name: Sostanj Thermal Power Plant
locations.setting: Working lignite power station in the Salek valley with cooling towers, a chimney of 350 metres, coal handling yards and large boiler and turbine halls.

locations.name: Stara Sava Ironworks Quarter, Jesenice
locations.setting: Preserved ironworking quarter at Jesenice with a blast furnace chimney, the Kasarna workers block, a forge and the Ruard manor that houses the Upper Sava Valley Museum.

locations.name: Steklarna Hrastnik Glassworks
locations.setting: Glass factory working in the Zasavje coal valley since 1860, with furnace halls, hot end production lines, moulding shops and a works site pressed against wooded slopes.

locations.name: Studio 303
locations.setting: Shared production space at Cesta 24. junija in the Crnuce district, built as one open multi purpose room with an infinity wall for video, photo and audio work by small crews.
locations.facilities: Infinity wall shooting set, sound design and voice recording room, video editing and colour grading, camera and lighting rental.
locations.suitability: Studio rental for video, photo and podcast production, with equipment rental and crew for hire.

locations.name: Tartini Square, Piran
locations.setting: Oval paved square on the site of the filled inner harbour of Piran, ringed by Venetian and neoclassical fronts, with narrow lanes running to the sea walls.

locations.name: Technical Museum of Slovenia, Bistra
locations.setting: Former Carthusian monastery at Bistra holding transport, forestry and printing collections, with vaulted halls, a water powered sawmill and courtyards beside the mill stream.

locations.name: Titov trg, Velenje
locations.setting: Planned 1950s town centre built for the coal basin, with a wide axial square, arcaded blocks, a modernist cultural centre and a large statue of Tito.

locations.name: Triple Bridge and Presernov trg
locations.setting: Plecnik's three part river crossing joining Presernov trg to the old town, with balustrades, stairs down to the embankment and the pink Franciscan church behind.

locations.name: Underground of Peca, Mezica Mine
locations.setting: Disused lead and zinc mine inside Mount Peca with kilometres of rail served tunnels, ore chambers and flooded sections reached by mine train, bicycle or kayak.

locations.name: University of Ljubljana Main Building
locations.setting: Former provincial parliament of Carniola on Kongresni trg, now the university rectorate, with a stone staircase, a ceremonial hall and panelled offices.

photo.author: Architecture: Jan Vladimír Hráský (1857-1939), Josef Hudetz (1842-1909)Photo: An

locations.name: Viba Film Studio
locations.setting: State run national film base in the Stegne industrial zone of Ljubljana, with two sound stages of about 665 and 476 square metres plus set building, wardrobe and prop departments.
locations.facilities: Two stages of 665 m2 and 476 m2, set construction and paint shops, wardrobe and prop stores, four audio suites, video mixing room, 45 seat screening room, lighting and grip rental.
locations.suitability: Studio space, technical equipment, props and wardrobe, plus picture and sound post production, offered to domestic and foreign productions.

locations.name: Vila Bled
locations.setting: Former Yugoslav state residence on the shore of Lake Bled, with 1950s interiors, a mural covered reception hall, wide terraces and a private park down to a boathouse.

locations.name: 297Studio
locations.setting: A column free 700 sqm sound stage in Leganes, south of Madrid, with a large cyclorama, dressing rooms and direct street level vehicle access for series, commercials and photo shoots.
locations.price_note: Rates on request; electricity billed separately at EUR 0.55 per kWh (own site).
locations.facilities: Column-free main stage 21.8 x 30.6 m x 5.0 m high (about 700 sqm); cyclorama 11.55 m wide x 5.4 m deep x 3.9 m high; four dressing rooms with showers; 26 private parking spaces plus adjacent public parking; direct street access with a goods lift rated to 2 tonnes.
locations.suitability: The stage is available 24 hours; night and weekend shoots may carry a surcharge. A stage manager is included in every rental to coordinate the set and supervise safety; equipment is not included by default, but a basic support kit and technical crew (gaffer, sound, camera) can be added on request. Volume discounts apply when several services are combined, and weekly or monthly package prices exist.
locations.logistics: In Leganes, south of Madrid; direct street-level access, goods lift and on-site parking (own site).

locations.name: A Punt Media Studios
locations.setting: Broadcast centre of the Valencian public media corporation at Burjassot, with television studios, news and drama sets, control galleries and technical support areas.

locations.name: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport
locations.setting: Madrid's main international airport, operated by Aena, with passenger terminals and airside areas listed under transport locations in the Madrid Film Office catalogue.
locations.facilities: Four operational terminals (T4 opened February 2006); electrical hookup and a loading dock with restricted loading hours; production offices, dressing rooms, a catering area, storage and restrooms available, subject to availability (own site).
locations.suitability: Filming is possible at various locations within the airport, subject to airport security and operational constraints; a filming request form and defined filming rates exist (own site).
locations.logistics: Located 12 km northwest of Madrid; vehicle access is permitted and a dedicated parking area is available (own site).

locations.name: Albarracin
locations.setting: Walled hill town of pink plastered houses, wooden balconies and stepped lanes above a river gorge, with a castle, cathedral and long stretch of town wall.

locations.name: Almaden Mining Park
locations.setting: A former mercury mine in Ciudad Real with headframes, shafts and underground galleries open for visits, worked from Roman times until closure in 2001.

locations.name: Almadraba de Monteleva
locations.setting: Salt works village inside the Cabo de Gata natural park, with evaporation pans, a salt loading pier, a lone white church and abandoned workers' buildings.

locations.name: Anden 0 (Chamberi Ghost Station)
locations.setting: A disused 1919 Madrid Metro station preserved with its original tiled advertisements and platform furniture, opened to the public as a small museum called Anden 0.

locations.name: Antigua Carcel Provincial de Huelva
locations.setting: Disused provincial prison in Huelva with cell wings, barred galleries, exercise yards and a gatehouse, held in the Andalusia Film Commission catalogue as a prison location.

locations.name: Arriaga Theatre
locations.setting: Neo baroque city theatre of 1890 on the Bilbao riverbank, rebuilt after fire and flood, with a horseshoe auditorium, boxes, foyers and a stage house.

locations.name: Arsenal de la Carraca
locations.setting: Eighteenth century naval arsenal on the Bay of Cadiz at San Fernando, with dry docks, rope walks, workshops, barrack ranges and quays inside a walled military compound.

locations.name: Astican Shipyard
locations.setting: Working ship repair yard in the port of Las Palmas with floating docks, gantry cranes, dry berths and large open quaysides, a heavy industrial backdrop on the water.

locations.name: Astilleros Nereo
locations.setting: Traditional wooden boatyard on Pedregalejo beach in Malaga, still building and repairing hulls on open sand, with timber sheds, slipways and hand tools.

locations.name: Ateneo Mercantil de Valencia
locations.setting: Private members' institution on Plaza del Ayuntamiento with a 1930s marble staircase, a domed ballroom, panelled meeting rooms, a library and a rooftop terrace.

locations.name: Auditorio Alfredo Kraus
locations.setting: Concert hall by Oscar Tusquets at the end of Las Canteras beach, with a stone tower, symphony auditorium, chamber hall and foyers looking straight onto the Atlantic.

locations.name: Auditorio de Tenerife
locations.region: Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands
locations.setting: A sail-shaped concert hall on the Santa Cruz de Tenerife waterfront designed by Santiago Calatrava, with a curved white concrete shell around the main auditorium.
locations.facilities: More than 15 multi-purpose spaces for events, described as having over 100 different corners, equipped with technical facilities for conferences and events.
locations.suitability: Interior and exterior filming, photoshoots, vehicle catalogue shoots, fashion and advertising productions are hosted; enquiries go through a dedicated filming contact (localizaciones@auditoriodetenerife.com), separate from the general events and conferences contact.

locations.name: Auditorio El Batel
locations.setting: Auditorium and congress centre sunk into the quay at Cartagena, with a main hall for about 1,400, chamber hall, glazed foyers and coloured cladding facing the harbour.

locations.name: Azkuna Zentroa
locations.setting: A former wine and grain warehouse, the Alhondiga, in Bilbao rebuilt by Philippe Starck behind its original brick facade, with 43 varied columns under a rooftop pool and terrace.

locations.name: Baluarte
locations.setting: Congress centre and auditorium of 2003 next to the citadel, faced in black Zimbabwe granite, with a 1,568 seat hall, chamber hall and large glazed foyers.

locations.name: Banzai Studio
locations.setting: A 400 sqm soundproofed sound stage in an industrial estate in Badalona, near Barcelona, with two permanent cycloramas, used for commercials, music videos and virtual production.
locations.price_note: Published packs, all excluding VAT: Pack 1 (stage, camera and lights) EUR 1,950 per shooting day of 08:00 to 20:00; Pack 3 (tungsten lighting package) EUR 250 per day. Pack 2 combines the 400 m2 stage with a set built to your design, priced on the design (own site).
locations.facilities: 400 sqm soundproofed, climate-controlled stage with 600 sqm of adjoining service areas; two permanent cycloramas in an L-infinity chroma-key configuration with fibre-optic lighting; dressing rooms, make-up area, client lounge, offices and kitchen.
locations.suitability: Positioned for advertising, music videos, film, TV series and photo shoots (own site).
locations.logistics: In an industrial estate in Badalona (Barcelones), north-east of Barcelona (own site).

locations.name: Bardenas Reales
locations.setting: A semi-desert badlands landscape in southern Navarre with eroded clay buttes, plateaus and canyons, crossed by marked tracks inside a managed nature reserve.

locations.name: Barrio Reina Victoria
locations.setting: Company housing estate built by the Rio Tinto Company from 1916 in Huelva, rows of low English style cottages with gables, porches, hedges and quiet planted streets.

locations.name: Basque Country Mining Museum
locations.setting: Museum in the Gallarta iron ore district, with mining machinery, a reconstructed gallery and access to the open cast workings and spoil landscape of Meatzaldea.

locations.name: Belchite (old town)
locations.setting: The ruined shell of a town destroyed in the 1937 Battle of Belchite, left standing as a memorial with intact facades, a bell tower and rubble-filled streets open to visitors.
locations.known_for: The Adventures of Baron Munchausen (1988), Pan's Labyrinth (2006)

locations.name: Benidorm Levante Seafront
locations.setting: Dense high rise seafront on Levante beach, with towers, a curved promenade, bar and hotel frontage and a skyline used to stand in for larger resort cities.

locations.name: Biblioteca de Catalunya (former Hospital de la Santa Creu)
locations.setting: Fifteenth century hospital wards in the Raval, now the national library: long Gothic naves with pointed stone arches, reading rooms, a courtyard and a chapel.

locations.name: Bilbao Airport
locations.setting: Aena airport at Loiu with Santiago Calatrava's white winged terminal of 2000, a bright open concourse, glazed piers and aprons in a valley setting.

locations.name: Bilbao Metro
locations.setting: A metro network known for Norman Foster's glass-tube station entrances, locally called fosteritos, running through Bilbao and under the Nervion estuary.

locations.name: Bodegas Alvear
locations.setting: Working winery in Montilla, Córdoba, founded in 1729, with barrel cellars, courtyards and production buildings used for the local Montilla-Moriles wines.

locations.name: Bodegas Osborne
locations.setting: Sherry cellars at El Puerto de Santa Maria, tall whitewashed naves with rows of oak butts, sand floors, arched aisles and shafts of light from high windows.

locations.name: Bombas Gens
locations.setting: A former water-pump factory in Valencia built in Art Deco style, its restored halls now an art foundation with gallery and workshop spaces.

locations.name: Calle Laurel
locations.setting: Narrow old town street in Logrono lined with about fifty small tapas bars, each with its own dish, giving dense night time frontage and interiors.

locations.name: Camp Nou
locations.setting: FC Barcelona's stadium in the Les Corts district, one of Europe's largest football grounds, with tiered stands, a museum and tour access during redevelopment.
locations.facilities: The stadium includes a presidential box and VIP lounge, press rooms and television studios, and the FC Barcelona club museum.

locations.name: Canfranc International Railway Station
locations.setting: A Beaux-Arts railway station in the Pyrenees built for a cross-border line to France, its platforms and grand hall largely disused since 1970 and now under partial restoration.

locations.name: Cardona Salt Mountain Cultural Park
locations.setting: Former potash and salt mine open to visitors 86 metres underground, with galleries of grey and white salt plus surface pithead buildings and machinery.

locations.name: Casa Botines
locations.setting: Gaudi building of 1892 in central Leon, in grey stone with corner turrets and a moat, holding a restored warehouse floor, offices and period apartments.

locations.name: Casa Cuartel de la Guardia Civil, Aracena
locations.setting: Civil Guard barracks in Aracena in the Sierra de Huelva, listed by the regional film commission under its heritage-architecture and prison-building category.

locations.name: Casa Vicens
locations.setting: Gaudi's first house, built 1883 to 1885 in Gracia, with tiled facades, stencilled and painted period rooms, a small garden and a roof terrace, open for hire.

locations.name: Casco Histórico y Mercado de Villa de Vallecas
locations.setting: The old quarter of Villa de Vallecas in southeast Madrid, with its historic square and adjoining municipal market, catalogued by Madrid Film Office for street and market scenes.

locations.name: Castell de Bellver
locations.setting: Gothic circular hilltop castle overlooking Palma, built in the early 14th century as a royal residence, later used as a military prison, now a history museum with spaces the city council makes available for hire.

locations.name: Castillo de Almodóvar del Río
locations.setting: A restored medieval hilltop castle above the Guadalquivir in Almodóvar del Río, listed in Andalucía Film Commission's network of singular private venues.
locations.facilities: Industrial-grade power supply and production offices available on site (own site).
locations.suitability: Open to the public since 2001 (own site).
locations.logistics: Vehicle access described as easy, with parking available for technical vehicles (own site).

locations.name: Centro Botin
locations.setting: Renzo Piano arts centre of 2017 raised on columns over Santander bay, with two curved ceramic clad volumes, glazed walkways, an auditorium and gallery floors.

locations.name: Centro Comercial Arturo Soria Plaza
locations.setting: A 7,000 square metre shopping centre in Ciudad Lineal with two retail floors, renovated in 2019, listed on the Madrid Film Office catalogue with production offices and loading access.
locations.facilities: Production offices, dressing rooms, catering space, storage, electric hookups, loading dock, parking

locations.name: Centro Comercial El Muelle
locations.setting: Shopping centre built over the Santa Catalina quay in Las Palmas, with glazed galleries, escalator atriums, chain stores, a cinema and rooftop views over the cruise berths.

locations.name: Cesar Manrique Foundation (Taro de Tahiche)
locations.setting: The artist's former home at Tahiche, built over five volcanic bubbles, with white modernist rooms above and lava caves, a pool and a palm courtyard below ground.

locations.name: Cesar Manrique Lanzarote Airport
locations.setting: Aena run island airport near Arrecife with two passenger terminals, a single runway across lava ground, baggage halls, boarding gates and apron stands.

locations.name: Chiringuito Serenade, Bolonia
locations.setting: Beach bar on Bolonia beach near Tarifa, a simple wood-built restaurant serving the dune-backed beach beside the Baelo Claudia Roman ruins.

locations.name: Citadel of Pamplona
locations.setting: Sixteenth century star shaped military citadel with bastions, moats, a powder magazine, an arsenal and barracks buildings, now a public park and exhibition space.

locations.name: City of Arts and Sciences
locations.setting: A cluster of white concrete and glass structures by Santiago Calatrava and Felix Candela beside the old Turia riverbed, including a planetarium dome, an opera house, a science museum and an oceanarium.
locations.facilities: Six buildings (Palau de les Arts Reina Sofia, Hemisferic, Museu de les Ciencies, Umbracle, Agora and Oceanografic) across a 350,000 m2 site along a two-kilometre axis.
locations.suitability: The complex's buildings have been used for business launches, photo shoots, feature films, advertising, catalogues and music videos, both indoors and outdoors, nationally and internationally.

locations.name: City of Culture of Galicia
locations.setting: A hilltop complex of curved stone and glass buildings by Peter Eisenman above Santiago de Compostela, combining library, museum and archive functions on wide open plazas.
locations.price_note: Space rental fees (own site, General tariff for private for-profit hire): Floor -1 hall (1,731 m2, up to 800 people) EUR 4,800/day; Fontan Auditorium (694 seats) EUR 2,100/day; CINC Convention Hall (250 people) EUR 1,250/day; Museum/Tirantes Hall (up to 300 people) EUR 1,800/day; outdoor squares and enclosures EUR 500/day; other indoor spaces EUR 600/day. A Reduced tariff for public bodies and non-profits is roughly half these rates.
locations.facilities: Nine main rentable spaces: the Fontan Auditorium (836 m2, 694 seats, dividable), CINC's Auditorium 1 (177 seats), Auditorium 2 (106 seats) and Convention Hall (250 people), the Gaias Centre Museum's Floor -1 hall (1,731 m2, up to 800 people in theatre layout) and Museum Hall (1,081 m2, up to 300 people for a cocktail reception), the Library's Xose Neira Vilas Auditorium (121 seats), meeting rooms from 26 to 168 m2 (8 to 50 people), and outdoor squares and enclosures.
locations.logistics: On-site covered parking is available at EUR 30/month.

locations.name: Ciudad de la Luz
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio complex beside the Mediterranean on the edge of Alicante, with large sound stages, exterior water tanks and production support buildings, reopened to shoots in 2022.
locations.known_for: Asterix at the Olympic Games (2008), The Impossible (2012)
locations.facilities: Six sound stages from 1,620 to 2,340 m2 (Plato 3: 2,340 m2 and 2,000 kVA; Plato 4: 1,794 m2; Platos 1, 2, 5 and 6: 1,620 m2, 12.5 m high, 10 x 8 m door, 1,250 kVA), interior tanks in Platos 3 and 5; an exterior 100 x 80 m water tank (8,000 m2, 1.2 m base, 5.2 m in a 30 x 30 m pit, 120 x 12 m green screen) with an infinity horizon to the Mediterranean; Backlot 1 of 42,367 m2 and Backlot 2 of 75,246 m2, each with 4,000 kVA; production buildings, workshops, storage, auditorium and post-production.
locations.suitability: Stages have NC-25 acoustic insulation and silent air conditioning; the tank offers up to 16 m underwater visibility, wave and water cannon systems and fills in 48 hours. 24-hour private security and access control let production teams work at any hour.
locations.logistics: On the edge of Alicante; the site cites an international airport nearby and Madrid under two hours by AVE high-speed train.

locations.name: Ciudad Encantada
locations.setting: A karst rock park near Cuenca where erosion has carved limestone into towers and shapes along a signed walking route through pine forest.

photo.author: Turol Jones, un artista de cojones from Villanueva del Cascajal, República Independiente de Mi Casa

locations.name: Ciudad Pegaso
locations.setting: A 1955 workers housing estate in San Blas-Canillejas with low rise apartment blocks, single family homes, a parish church and shared sports ground, catalogued by Madrid Film Office.
locations.suitability: Residential streets and building exteriors; filming permit issued through Madrid's Negociado de Autorizaciones de Rodajes.

locations.name: Colegio Aleman de Madrid
locations.setting: German international school built in 2015 on a 34,700 square metre campus in Fuencarral, with a courtyard, assembly hall, sports hall and football pitch, filmed only outside term time.
locations.facilities: Courtyard, assembly hall, sports hall, football pitch, production offices, dressing rooms, catering area, own parking
locations.suitability: Filming only on non-school days (weekends, holidays)

locations.name: Colonia Guell
locations.setting: Preserved textile factory village of the 1890s with brick mill sheds, workers' housing, a school, a cooperative and Gaudi's unfinished crypt, 15 km from Barcelona.

locations.name: Comillas Pontifical University Building
locations.setting: Nineteenth century seminary building above Comillas by Domenech i Montaner and Gaudi's circle, with a long stone facade, cloisters, chapel and lecture rooms.

locations.name: Complutense University of Madrid
locations.setting: A large 1930s university campus, Ciudad Universitaria, west of central Madrid, with monumental faculty buildings, an observatory and open lawns.

locations.name: Conde Duque
locations.setting: A former 18th-century army barracks in Madrid with a long baroque facade and large parade-ground courtyards, converted into a public cultural centre.
locations.price_note: Filming day rates set by Madrid Destino (own site, tariff effective July 2025) vary by room, e.g. Patio Central EUR 10,000/day for a commercial, EUR 7,000/day for a feature film or series, EUR 1,050/day for a short film or documentary; smaller rooms from EUR 1,000/day for a commercial. Technical equipment is not included in the published rate for the Auditorium/Concert Hall or the Assembly Hall (Salon de Actos).
locations.facilities: Rentable spaces include Sala de Bovedas 1 and 2 (basement), the Auditorio/Sala de Conciertos, Sala Polivalente/Cafeteria, Sala de Exposiciones 2, Patio Central, Patio Sur and Patio Norte (ground floor), a Teatro, Salon de Actos, two rehearsal rooms and the Terraza Mirador (first floor).
locations.suitability: Filming requests are handled by Madrid Film Office, with a minimum of 10 working days to process the contract, and use must be compatible with the centre's own programming.

locations.name: Cooperativa Olivarera Nuestra Señora del Puerto
locations.setting: Working olive oil cooperative in the small Sierra de Huelva town of Zufre, with mill buildings, storage tanks and loading areas used to process the local harvest.

locations.name: Corral de Comedias de Almagro
locations.setting: Open air courtyard playhouse of 1628 on the main square of Almagro, with wooden galleries on two levels, a raised stage and benches, still in use for festivals.

locations.name: Corralejo Dunes Natural Park
locations.setting: A protected dune field and beach on the north coast of Fuerteventura, with shifting white sand hills managed by the island council.

locations.name: Coto de las Canteras
locations.setting: Disused sandstone quarry at Osuna worked since Roman times, with sheer cut walls, carved chambers, an amphitheatre space and rubble floors in the open air.

locations.name: CRTVG San Marcos Studios
locations.setting: Broadcast centre of the Galician public media company at San Marcos, Santiago, with television studios, news and drama sets, control rooms and technical areas.

locations.name: Cuatro Vientos Airport
locations.setting: General-aviation aerodrome opened in 1911, 8km from central Madrid, mixed civil-military use with flying schools, hangars, workshops and three control towers, no scheduled passenger traffic.
locations.facilities: Hangars, workshops, terminal building with cafeteria, parking for about 220 vehicles
locations.suitability: Availability depends on the project and space required

locations.name: Destilerias Arehucas
locations.setting: Rum distillery working since 1884 in Arucas, with an American oak cask cellar, copper stills, bottling lines and stone industrial buildings open to guided visits.

locations.name: Es Baluard Museum
locations.setting: Modern art museum set inside the Renaissance sea wall of Palma, mixing stone bastions and a water filled moat with concrete galleries and a rooftop terrace over the bay.

locations.name: Estadio Mestalla
locations.setting: Valencia CF's stadium near the city centre, one of Spain's older large football grounds, with pitch, stands and hospitality areas available through the club.

locations.name: Estadio Nuevo Colombino
locations.setting: Football stadium in Huelva, home ground of Recreativo de Huelva, with a modern bowl-shaped stand used for sports and crowd scenes.

locations.name: Estadio Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán
locations.setting: Sevilla FC's stadium in Nervión, built in 1958, with pitch, stands, dressing rooms, press areas and an adjoining sports complex of 13 pitches offered for filming.

locations.name: Estadio Vallehermoso
locations.setting: Municipal athletics stadium reopened in 2019 in Chamberi, with a partly covered 10,000-seat stand around a lime-green 400m track, a covered training straight and a natural grass infield.
locations.facilities: Access control, offices, changing rooms, storage, technical rooms, covered training straight

locations.name: Euskalduna Palace
locations.setting: A congress and concert hall in Bilbao built in weathered steel on the site of the former Euskalduna shipyard, its shape referencing a ship's hull under construction.

locations.name: ExpoMeloneras Convention Centre
locations.setting: Purpose built congress centre at Meloneras with a large auditorium, column free exhibition halls, foyers and glazed frontage, usable as conference, gala or corporate interiors.

locations.name: Fabra i Coats
locations.setting: A former 19th-century textile mill in Barcelona's Sant Andreu district, its long brick sheds and chimney now used as artist studios and a cultural centre.

locations.name: Fira de Barcelona (Montjuïc venue)
locations.setting: Barcelona's historic trade fair complex on Montjuïc by Plaça d'Espanya, with several exhibition halls and a central avenue used for conventions, launches and large events.
locations.facilities: The Montjuic venue covers 150,000 square metres of exhibition space (own site).

locations.name: Former Hospital de San Juan de Dios, Jaén
locations.setting: Former hospital building in the historic centre of Jaén, listed by the regional film commission under historic centres and hospitals; coordinates mark the town centre.

locations.name: Fort Bravo / Texas Hollywood
locations.setting: A permanent western style backlot in the Tabernas desert with a saloon, jail, church and ranch buildings, built for spaghetti westerns and still used for filming and photography.
locations.known_for: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, The Sisters Brothers, That Dirty Black Bag
locations.price_note: Published admission (PVP, no filming rate is published): adults from 18 years EUR 22.90, children 5 to 11 EUR 12.90, ages 12 to 17, pensioners and visitors with a disability EUR 18.90; the ticket covers the whole day (own site).
locations.facilities: Western town backlot with saloon, jail, church, ranch houses and stables; horse-drawn carriages and livestock on site; on-site restaurant/bar and swimming pool.
locations.suitability: Open daily 09:00 to 18:00, with closing moved to 19:00 from 29 March; the site stays open to visitors and states more than 300 productions have shot there.
locations.logistics: In the Tabernas desert, Almeria province; on-site restaurant, bar and overnight stays in bungalows or camping pitches for cast and crew (own site).

locations.name: Fortalesa de la Mola
locations.setting: Nineteenth century Isabel II fortress guarding the mouth of Mahon harbour, with gun galleries, tunnels, barrack blocks, a military prison and open glacis above the sea.

locations.name: Fuerteventura Airport
locations.setting: The island airport of Fuerteventura, operated by Aena, catalogued by Canary Islands Film Commission under its airport locations.

locations.name: Fundacion Carlos de Amberes
locations.setting: Private cultural foundation in a former 1584 church in the Salamanca district, protected as a site of cultural interest, with its chapel, two exhibition rooms and an auditorium with a dressing room and translation booth.
locations.facilities: Chapel, two exhibition rooms, auditorium with dressing room and translation booth, terrace access
locations.suitability: Restricted hours around regular activities, difficult vehicle access

locations.name: Gabinete Literario
locations.setting: Nineteenth century cultural society building on Plaza de Cairasco in Las Palmas, with a modernist facade, a gilded golden hall, library rooms and a restaurant terrace, available for hire.

locations.name: Galaxia Studios
locations.setting: A studio complex in Paterna near Valencia with four sound stages from 200 to 1,000 square metres, production offices, dubbing studios and control rooms, beside the V-30 motorway.
locations.facilities: Plato 1: 1,000 sq m, 28x40 m, 7 m to catwalks, 800 kW. Plato 2: 600 sq m, 17x34 m, 6.5 m, 500 kW. Plato 3: 400 sq m, 17x23 m, 6.5 m, 500 kW. Plato 4: 200 sq m, 15x13.5 m, 3.5 m, 50 kW. Also 3,000 sq m of production offices, 30 multipurpose rooms, 15 post-production suites, 6 sound/dubbing studios, 3 control rooms and two 2 MW power transformer centres
locations.suitability: Stages adaptable for cinema, fiction series, entertainment programmes, advertising and photography
locations.logistics: 10 minutes from Valencia city centre, next to the V-30 motorway, 5 minutes from Valencia airport, 15 minutes from Joaquín Sorolla train station

locations.name: Garachico
locations.setting: Small port town on the north coast rebuilt after the 1706 eruption, with cobbled colonial streets, balconied houses, convents, a sea castle and lava rock pools.

locations.name: Gran Canaria Airport
locations.setting: Aena run international airport at Gando with two runways, a long linear terminal, check in halls, boarding gates and apron areas, plus an adjoining air force base perimeter.

locations.name: Gran Canaria Platos
locations.setting: A publicly owned studio complex on Gran Canaria with two large sound stages, one built as a virtual production volume with a curved LED wall, plus two backlot plots.
locations.known_for: The Abyss, Deep Water, The Penguin Lessons, Die drei Fragezeichen
locations.price_note: Stage 1 (LED volume in use): from EUR 11,700 per weekday (1-day minimum) down to EUR 6,000 per weekday for bookings of 72+ days, plus non-working-day surcharges; non-LED setup/wrap days from EUR 2,000 per weekday. Stage 2: from EUR 1,500 per weekday (1-day minimum) down to EUR 1,275 per weekday for bookings of 90+ days (own published tariff, May 2026).
locations.facilities: Stage 1 (Estudio Virtual XR): 1,220 sqm rodaje zone (48 x 25 m), 12 m to catwalk, noise floor under 20 dBA, 400-1,200 kW power; LED volume with a 40 x 8 m curved wall plus two moving screens and two ceiling screens (9x10 m and 9x5 m); workshop, dressing rooms, hair/make-up and wardrobe areas, 21 parking spaces. Stage 2: 1,800 sqm rodaje zone (56.25 x 32 m), same height and power range, workshop and storage. Two adjoining plots of bare land: 1,447 sqm and 2,513 sqm, each with water/power connection.
locations.suitability: Standard use hours Monday-Friday 08:00-20:00 and Saturday 08:00-15:00 (Sunday and holidays 08:00-20:00); use outside these hours is billed extra per 15-minute block (own published terms).
locations.logistics: On Gran Canaria; about 20 km from the island's airport (own site).

locations.name: Gran Teatre del Liceu
locations.setting: Barcelona's main opera house on La Rambla, with a gilded horseshoe auditorium, a grand foyer and a stage house rebuilt after a 1994 fire.

locations.name: Gran Teatro Falla
locations.setting: Red brick neo Mudejar theatre in Cadiz opened in 1910, with a horseshoe auditorium in three tiers, painted ceiling, boxes and a horseshoe arched facade.

locations.name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
locations.setting: Frank Gehry's titanium clad museum of 1997 on the Nervion, with a tall atrium, curved galleries, a 130 metre long hall and riverside terraces.

locations.name: Hacienda del Buen Suceso
locations.setting: Nineteenth century manor house turned rural hotel outside Arucas, set in a working banana plantation, with courtyards, period rooms, gardens and volcanic stone facades.

locations.name: Hacienda La Buzona
locations.setting: Andalusian farmstead near Carmona built round a walled courtyard, with an olive press range, tower, stables and whitewashed living quarters in open countryside.

locations.name: Harinera del Guadaira
locations.setting: Former flour mill on the river at Alcala de Guadaira, brick and iron industrial halls with milling floors and tall windows, now in public use and listed by the film commission.

locations.name: Hospital 12 de Octubre
locations.setting: Large public hospital complex opened in 1973 in Usera, with a 15-storey red brick inpatient tower, a semicircular maternity building and a newer glass outpatient block around wide gardens and its own helipad.
locations.suitability: Contact point covers exterior filming on the surrounding public street only; interior or grounds filming needs separate agreement with the site manager

photo.author: Gonzalo Alzamora Puente from Madrid, Spain.

locations.name: Hospital de Sant Pau
locations.setting: A former working hospital in Barcelona built as a campus of Art Nouveau pavilions with domes, mosaics and underground connecting tunnels, now a monument and event venue.
locations.facilities: Event spaces in the Administration Pavilion: the Lluis Domenech i Montaner Room (170 m2), Sala Pau Gil (245 m2), Francesc Cambo room (245 m2), the Hipostyle Hall (465 m2, drinks reception up to 300 people), a Board room (109 m2), eight meeting rooms (six of 45 m2, two of 90 m2, the latter splittable), the 1902 Room with a private terrace, and outdoor garden areas.

locations.name: Hospital de Tavera
locations.setting: Sixteenth century hospital outside the walls of Toledo, with a double marble patio, a church nave, a period pharmacy, a hospital ward and panelled palace rooms.

locations.name: Hospital Real, Granada
locations.setting: Sixteenth century royal hospital that now houses the rectorate of the University of Granada, with four cloistered patios, a coffered library hall and plateresque doorways.

locations.name: Hotel Alfonso XIII
locations.setting: A 1928 regionalista hotel built for the Ibero-American Exposition in Seville, with mudejar and baroque details, columned courtyards and a tower, listed in Andalucía Film Commission's network of singular venues.
locations.known_for: The Crown, Berlin, Lawrence of Arabia
locations.facilities: Standard electrical grid, production offices, limited technical parking, adjacent gardens

locations.name: Hotel Carlton
locations.setting: Grand hotel of 1926 on Plaza Moyua, seat of the Basque government during the Civil War, with a stained glass rotunda, marble lobby and period bedrooms.

locations.name: Hotel Maria Cristina
locations.setting: Belle epoque hotel of 1912 on the Urumea in San Sebastian, with a marble lobby, ballroom, panelled bar and river facing suites, used during the film festival.

locations.name: Hotel Oromana
locations.setting: Hotel set among pinewoods above Alcalá de Guadaíra near Seville, a low-rise building with gardens and a pool used for period and contemporary hospitality scenes.

locations.name: Hotel Palacio Marques de la Gomera
locations.setting: Eighteenth century baroque palace in Osuna working as a hotel, with a carved stone portal, arcaded patio, chapel, panelled salons and period bedrooms.

locations.name: Huelva Bus Station
locations.setting: City bus station in Huelva with a covered concourse, ticket desks, numbered bays and coach apron, a plain working transport interior listed for filming.

locations.name: Ibiza Airport
locations.setting: Aena run island airport at Es Codolar with a single terminal, arrivals and departures halls, boarding gates, apron stands and a runway beside the salt pans.

locations.name: Institute of Legal Medicine and Forensic Sciences, Huelva
locations.setting: Working forensic institute in Huelva with laboratories, examination rooms, corridors and an institutional entrance, offered through the Andalusia Film Commission catalogue.

locations.name: Instituto Cervantes Headquarters
locations.setting: A 1918 former bank headquarters on Calle Alcala known as the Edificio de las Cariatides, with a caryatid facade, a stained glass domed lobby, a vault-turned-exhibition room and a rooftop terrace.
locations.facilities: Lobby, exhibition hall, original elevators, main staircase, assembly hall, vault room, rooftop terrace
locations.suitability: Restricted hours: Monday is the most workable filming day, Saturday mornings possible at extra cost, difficult vehicle access

locations.name: Itzurun Beach and Basque Coast Geopark Flysch
locations.setting: Beach at Zumaia backed by vertical flysch rock layers, part of a protected geopark, with wave cut platforms, cliffs and a hermitage on the headland.

locations.name: Jaen Air Raid Shelter
locations.setting: Civil war air raid shelter under the centre of Jaen, a long brick vaulted tunnel system with benches, latrines and narrow stair entrances, open as a museum.

locations.name: Jameos del Agua
locations.setting: Cesar Manrique venue built inside a collapsed lava tube, with an underground salt lake, a white terrace pool, a bar cut into rock and a concert cave used as an auditorium.

locations.name: Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport
locations.setting: Spain's second busiest airport, run by Aena, with Ricardo Bofill's glass Terminal 1, long check in halls, boarding piers, aprons and a general aviation area.

locations.name: Kursaal Congress Centre
locations.setting: 1999 congress and concert building by architect Rafael Moneo on the San Sebastian seafront, two glass cube auditoria that host the San Sebastian Film Festival and rentable event spaces.

locations.name: La Model
locations.setting: Barcelona's former Model prison in the Eixample, closed in 2017 after 113 years, now a memorial space with courtyard tours ahead of redevelopment into public facilities and housing.

locations.name: La Nave Madrid
locations.setting: Former 1940s elevator factory of the Boetticher company in Villaverde, converted into a public innovation centre with a large open barrel-vaulted hall, a tower, classrooms and an auditorium.
locations.facilities: Large open industrial hall, tower, classrooms, auditorium, rooftop with views over Villaverde

locations.name: La Térmica
locations.setting: A provincial council cultural centre in Málaga with halls, a courtyard and exhibition spaces used for screenings and events, available for external space bookings.
locations.suitability: Space requests must be submitted at least three months in advance, via a downloadable request form (own site).

locations.name: La Vega Arms Factory
locations.setting: Closed state arms factory in Oviedo covering about 115,000 square metres, with 19th and 20th century workshop halls, offices, a chapel and open yards.

locations.name: Laboral Ciudad de la Cultura
locations.setting: Former 1950s vocational university complex in Gijon, one of Spain's largest buildings, with a tall tower, a domed theatre and courtyard, now a cultural centre offering spaces for hire and its own filming rental process.

locations.name: Las Arenas Balneario Resort
locations.setting: Seafront hotel on Malvarrosa beach built around a 1930s neoclassical bathing pavilion, with colonnades, a large pool terrace, ballrooms and sea view suites.

locations.name: Las Medulas
locations.setting: A red-cliffed landscape left by Roman open-cast gold mining, honeycombed with tunnels and covered in chestnut trees, managed as a protected heritage site in the Bierzo hills.

locations.name: Madrid Arena
locations.setting: Circular multipurpose arena with a glazed dome on the Casa de Campo exhibition ground, three connected floors, a retractable seating rack and a tunnel link to two neighbouring pavilions.
locations.facilities: Retractable seating, changing rooms, dressing rooms, cafeteria, press boxes, vehicle access to the main floor, outdoor area for trucks and mobile units

locations.name: Madrid Content City
locations.setting: A production complex in Tres Cantos, north of Madrid, with two large sound stages, twelve smaller warehouse units, production offices and crew facilities, built on the former Secuoya Studios site.
locations.facilities: Two sound stages of 2,350-2,800 sqm built (1,500-2,000 sqm usable recording space each, independently operable), plus 12 warehouse units of about 800 sqm on two floors, production offices, a training school, student residence, 11 restaurants and about 2,500 sqm of parking.
locations.logistics: Tres Cantos, about 18 km north of central Madrid; about 15 minutes from Plaza Castilla and 20 minutes from Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas airport (own site).

locations.name: Matadero Madrid
locations.setting: A former municipal slaughterhouse and cattle market beside the Manzanares river, its early 20th-century brick pavilions converted into galleries, studios and event spaces.
locations.price_note: Filming day rates set by Madrid Destino (own site, tariff effective July 2025) vary by space and production type, e.g. Nave 16 (complete) EUR 16,000/day for a commercial, EUR 12,500/day for a feature film or series, EUR 2,300/day for a short film or documentary; Plaza Matadero (A+B) EUR 8,750/day for a commercial, EUR 1,250/day for a short film or documentary. Half-day rates are about 60% of the full-day rate.
locations.facilities: Rentable filming spaces include Plaza Matadero (sections A and B, combinable), Nave 16 (full nave or modules), the Naves Teatro Espanol (Sala Fernando Arrabal, Sala Max Aub, Nave 12-Cafeteria), Sala 2, Terrario, Espacio Taller, and the Cineteca (Sala Azcona, Sala Borau, vestibule, set and archive).
locations.suitability: Filming requests are handled by Madrid Film Office (info@madridfilmoffice.com), with a minimum of 10 working days to process the contract once documentation is received. Use must be compatible with the centre's own programming, and outdoor areas stay open to the public and cannot be closed off entirely. A full filming day is a maximum of 12 hours; night sessions (up to 10 hours) carry a 25% surcharge and Sunday/holiday sessions a 40% surcharge, both subject to the centre's approval. Discounts of up to 100% apply for feature films, series, documentaries, shorts and music videos backed by ICAA or Comunidad/Ayuntamiento de Madrid, up to 90% for TV entertainment programmes, and up to 50% for advertising productions.
locations.logistics: The producer or organiser covers costs such as security, cleaning and supplies, and must take out an insurance policy covering the space's use.

locations.name: Mercado Central de Abastos, Cadiz
locations.setting: Neoclassical market of 1838 in the old town of Cadiz, a colonnaded square enclosing fish and produce stalls, with a modern food court along one side.

locations.name: Mercado Central de Valencia
locations.setting: A 1928 Art Nouveau market hall in central Valencia with domed ceilings, stained glass and stalls trading under an iron and tile structure.

locations.name: Mercado de Abastos de Santiago
locations.setting: Granite market of 1941 built as eight linked stone halls in the old town, with fish, meat and produce stalls, arcades and small bars between the buildings.

locations.name: Mercado de Anton Martin
locations.setting: Three-storey covered food market from the historic centre of Madrid, mixing traditional butcher, fishmonger and grocery stalls with newer restaurant units and a flamenco dance school on the top floor.
locations.facilities: Freight lift, mains power, extra production space available, suitable for direct sound indoors
locations.suitability: Night and weekend filming possible at extra cost, vehicle access is limited in the surrounding residential streets

locations.name: Mercado de Colón
locations.setting: A 1916 modernist market hall in Valencia's Eixample designed by Francisco Mora, its original iron and glass structure now housing cafes and restaurants.
locations.facilities: Total surface area of 3,500 square metres across 8 available spaces; the venue hosts more than 500 events a year (own site).

locations.name: Mercado de Feria
locations.setting: Covered municipal market on Calle Feria in Seville's Macarena district, said to be the city's oldest, with iron-framed stalls selling fresh produce, fish and tapas bars.

locations.name: Mercado de la Esperanza
locations.setting: Iron and glass market hall of 1904 behind Santander city hall, with a fish and shellfish floor, produce stalls upstairs and a glazed roof over the aisles.

locations.name: Mercado de la Ribera
locations.setting: A large Art Deco covered market on the Nervión riverbank in Bilbao's old town, with several trading floors of food stalls.

locations.name: Mercado de San Miguel
locations.setting: A restored early 1900s cast-iron and glass market hall next to Plaza Mayor in Madrid, now a covered food and tapas market.

locations.name: Mercado de Triana
locations.setting: Covered market on the Triana bank of the Guadalquivir, built over the remains of the castle of San Jorge, with fish, produce and tapas stalls under an iron and glass roof.

locations.name: Mercado de Vegueta
locations.setting: The oldest covered market in Las Palmas, opened in 1858 in the Vegueta old town, with an iron roofed hall, fish, meat and produce stalls and narrow surrounding streets.

locations.name: Mercado Municipal de Vallehermoso
locations.setting: A 1930 municipal market hall in Chamberí with a coloured corner facade, its stalls and storage areas offered for filming outside main trading hours.
locations.facilities: Vehicle access, restricted loading hours, catering area, storage space, restrooms
locations.suitability: Best available Sunday evenings and Mondays; other schedules negotiable with the market.

locations.name: Mercat de Sant Antoni
locations.setting: Restored 1882 iron and glass market hall on a cross shaped plan, with food and clothing stalls, a Sunday book market and a basement showing Roman remains.

locations.name: Mina Agrupa Vicenta
locations.setting: Nineteenth century iron mine in the Sierra Minera at La Union, an underground chamber about 80 metres across held up on rock pillars, reached by a sloping gallery.

locations.name: Mini Hollywood (Oasys Parque Tematico)
locations.setting: A preserved western film set in the Tabernas desert built for 1960s Spaghetti Westerns, with a saloon, jail and main street still used for stunt shows and shoots.
locations.known_for: A Fistful of Dollars (1964), For a Few Dollars More (1965)
locations.facilities: Western town set with saloon, stables, an Indian encampment and a photo studio with period costumes; a zoo reserve with more than 800 animals, an aquatic zone with pool and water slides, museums of cinema, cars and carriages, and five catering outlets (Restaurante Arizona, Grill Mirador Okavango, Chiringuito Africa Snack, Heladeria-Bocateria La Reserva and Saloon The Yellow Rose). Located in the Tabernas desert, Almeria.

locations.name: Mining and Industry Museum of Asturias
locations.setting: Museum at El Entrego built around a headframe, with a reconstructed underground mine, machinery halls, a lamp room and industrial exhibits in the Nalon valley.

locations.name: MotorLand Aragon
locations.setting: Motor racing complex at Alcaniz with a Grand Prix circuit, pit lane and garages, a technology park, karting and off road tracks and large paddock areas.

locations.name: Muelle de la Rio Tinto Company Limited
locations.setting: Historic ore-loading pier built by the Rio Tinto Company on the Huelva waterfront, an iron-framed structure once used to load mineral trains onto ships.

locations.name: Museo ABC de Dibujo e Ilustracion
locations.setting: Former Mahou brewery building from 1891 near Plaza Espana, refurbished into a museum of illustration with six floors around an interior courtyard, exposed brick and a 200 square metre main exhibition hall.
locations.facilities: Main exhibition hall, glass room, cube room, mains power, extra production space, suitable for direct sound
locations.suitability: Night and weekend filming possible at extra cost, fixed filming rates, subject to project approval

locations.name: Museo Chicote
locations.setting: Art Deco cocktail bar on the Gran Via opened in 1931, with its original 1930s wood and chrome interior by Luis Gutierrez Soto intact, plus an in-house sound and lighting rig.
locations.facilities: Storage area, catering area, dressing rooms, restrooms, vehicle access with restricted load/unload hours

locations.name: Museo del Ferrocarril de Madrid
locations.setting: Spain's railway museum, housed in the former Delicias terminus with its 19th-century iron and glass trainshed, displaying historic locomotives and carriages.
locations.facilities: Multiple hireable spaces: Nave Central 5,640 sqm (or a 3,240 sqm configuration, cocktail capacity 2,800), Nave de Fomento 422 sqm (cocktail 380), Sala Arganzuela 275 sqm (cocktail 240), Sala Javier Aranguren/Juan B. Cabrera 155 sqm, Sala Maria Cristina 177 sqm (cocktail 150), and the outdoor Playa de Vias 1,265 sqm (cocktail 750). Wifi is available in most spaces, audiovisual equipment in some rooms, and climate control in Sala Javier Aranguren (own site).
locations.suitability: Listed as suitable for film shoots (rodajes cinematograficos), though no specific filming conditions are published (own site).

locations.name: Museo Nacional de Artes Decorativas
locations.setting: Decorative arts museum from 1912 in a 19th century Madrid townhouse near the Retiro park, with four floors of period rooms including a Valencian 18th century tiled kitchen and an Imperial staircase.
locations.suitability: Restricted hours around the museum's own opening times, fee applies

locations.name: Museo Vostell Malpartida
locations.setting: Former wool washing works of the eighteenth century among the granite boulders of Los Barruecos, now a Fluxus art museum with stone halls, water tanks and yards.

locations.name: Museum of Human Evolution
locations.setting: Juan Navarro Baldeweg museum of 2010 on the Arlanzon in Burgos, with a fully glazed facade, open floor plates, wide ramps and daylit exhibition levels.

locations.name: Museum of Iron and Steel and Mining of Castile and Leon
locations.setting: Museum in the 1846 San Blas ironworks at Sabero, a stone hall in neo Gothic form with tall arched windows, machinery displays and mining buildings around it.

locations.name: National Museum of Science and Technology of Catalonia (mNACTEC)
locations.setting: Modernista steam powered textile mill of 1909 in Terrassa, with a glazed sawtooth roof, wide column free machine halls and working looms, engines and boilers.

locations.name: Nau Bostik
locations.setting: Former glue factory in La Sagrera run as a cultural centre, with a large open hall, bare brick and concrete rooms, an enclosed yard and painted walls, all hireable.

locations.name: Navantia Ferrol Shipyard
locations.setting: State owned naval shipyard on the Ferrol estuary, with covered building halls, dry docks, gantry cranes, fitting out quays and heavy workshop interiors.

locations.name: Nave Bellver
locations.setting: Former sawmill in Tetuan converted into an events space, keeping its high ceilings, natural light and worn industrial character, now used for cultural events and shoots.
locations.facilities: Dressing rooms, catering area, restrooms, vehicle access
locations.suitability: Filming rates scale with the size of the shoot

locations.name: Oficinas Room Mate
locations.setting: Former 18th century tapestry factory palace in central Madrid, restored in 2011 as offices for the Room Mate hotel chain, with a soundproofed 450 square metre event hall, a small cinema and a rooftop terrace.
locations.facilities: Soundproofed main hall, small screening room, rooftop terrace, freight lift, production offices, dressing rooms, catering area, own parking

locations.name: Palacio de Cibeles / CentroCentro
locations.setting: Madrid's ornate former post office building on Plaza de Cibeles, now the city hall, with a public exhibition centre, a rooftop viewpoint and a domed central hall.
locations.price_note: Filming day rates set by Madrid Destino (own site, tariff effective July 2025) vary by room, e.g. Patio de Operaciones EUR 10,000/day for a commercial, EUR 7,000/day for a feature film or series, EUR 1,500/day for a short film or documentary; Galeria de Cristal EUR 9,200/day for a commercial. Half-day rates are about 60% of the full-day rate.
locations.facilities: Rentable rooms include the Galeria de Cristal, the Pasaje Galeria de Cristal, the Patio de Operaciones, the Auditorio Caja de Musica, the Mirador (7th floor), the Capilla, Carmen Santonja and Sigfrido Martin Begue rooms (2nd floor), the Jorge G. Berlanga room, an exhibition space on the 1st floor, and the Area Social (6th floor mezzanine).
locations.suitability: Filming requests are handled by Madrid Film Office, with a minimum of 10 working days to process the contract. Use must be compatible with the centre's own programming; cultural-interest filming or reporting about the centre's own activities can be authorised free of charge, while commercial filming that identifies the CentroCentro brand needs approval from the Artistic Direction and Management.

locations.name: Palacio de Festivales de Cantabria
locations.setting: Regional performing arts centre of 1991 in Santander, with a main hall of about 1,600 seats, a chamber hall, wide marble foyers and backstage areas.

locations.name: Palacio de la Aljaferia
locations.setting: Fortified 11th century Moorish palace in Zaragoza, with horseshoe arches and a courtyard garden, later remodelled by the Catholic Monarchs and now home to the Aragonese regional parliament.

locations.name: Palacio de la Magdalena
locations.setting: Early 20th century royal summer residence on its own peninsula park in Santander, English and Montanes-style architecture, now a summer university campus that also hosts conferences and weddings.

locations.name: Palacio Domecq
locations.setting: A historic sherry house palace in Jerez de la Frontera, listed in Andalucía Film Commission's network of singular private venues.
locations.facilities: Standard electrical network on site; production offices not available (own site).
locations.logistics: Vehicle access and technical vehicle parking are both described as limited (own site).

locations.name: Palau de Congressos de Valencia
locations.setting: 1998 convention centre by architect Norman Foster in northern Valencia, with a marble-clad hall, a large auditorium and multiple meeting rooms available for hire.

locations.name: Palau de la Musica Catalana
locations.setting: A Modernista concert hall in Barcelona by Lluis Domenech i Montaner, with a stained-glass skylight, sculpted facades and an ornate main auditorium.
locations.facilities: Rentable spaces listed are the Concert Hall, Petit Palau, Foyer, Rehearsal Hall, Lluis Millet Room and a Terrace.
locations.suitability: Space rental is offered specifically for filming and recordings, in addition to musical activities and corporate/social events, each with its own dedicated contact line.

locations.name: Palau Guell
locations.setting: Gaudi town mansion off La Rambla, with stone stables in the basement, a parabolic central hall, dark panelled reception rooms and a roof of tiled chimneys.

locations.name: Palau Sant Jordi
locations.setting: An indoor arena on Montjuïc designed by Arata Isozaki for the 1992 Olympics, used for concerts, sports events and large productions.

locations.name: Palma de Mallorca Airport
locations.setting: Aena run airport at Son Sant Joan, one of the busiest in Spain, with four passenger modules, long finger piers, baggage halls and two parallel runways.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. AleXorz assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Palma Pictures
locations.setting: A production services company in Marratxi near Palma with a 1,000 square metre sound stage, production offices and in-house camera, grip and lighting kit for hire on Mallorca.
locations.facilities: 1,000 sq m sound stage (partly solar powered), on-site production offices, in-house camera, grip, lighting and location support equipment
locations.suitability: Production services company covering scripted, unscripted, commercials and photo/motion work, based on Mallorca with reach across mainland Spain, the Canary Islands and Portugal

locations.name: Paraninfo of the University of Zaragoza
locations.setting: Nineteenth century university building in central Zaragoza, with a brick and stone facade, a ceremonial assembly hall, galleried courtyard and museum rooms.

locations.name: Parc Audiovisual de Catalunya
locations.setting: A former hospital in Terrassa converted into a studio park with four sound stages from 400 to 1,260 sqm, offices and interior sets, run by the city council and the Catalan government.
locations.facilities: Plato 1: 1,200 sqm (38 x 28 m, 9.75 m to catwalk, 400 kW, 50 dB soundproofing, silent climate control). Plato 2: 600 sqm (28 x 18 m, 7.75 m, 200 kW, 12 x 5 m cyclorama). Plato 3: 1,260 sqm (40.83 x 30.98 m, 9.79 m, 320 kW, 75 dB soundproofing). Plato 4: 400 sqm (U-shaped cyclorama 12.3 x 11.1 m, 6.5 m high, 160 kW, 75 dB). All stages have vehicle access doors and fibre internet.
locations.logistics: On the former Sant Llatzer hospital grounds in Terrassa (Valles Occidental), with office space and location scouting support on site (own site).

locations.name: Peniscola Castle and Old Town
locations.setting: Templar sea castle on a rock joined to the shore by a sand bar, with vaulted halls, ramparts and a walled white town of narrow streets below.
locations.known_for: Game of Thrones, El Cid, Calabuch

locations.name: Playa de las Catedrales
locations.setting: A tidal beach at Ribadeo shaped by sea arches and cliffs up to 30 metres high, fully walkable only at low tide and reached with a free timed permit in summer.

photo.author: Jose Luis Cernadas Iglesias from Coruña, España

locations.name: Plaza de Toros de Las Ventas
locations.setting: Madrid's Neo-Mudejar bullring seating over 23,000, with brick and ceramic tile facades, tiered stands and an on-site bullfighting museum.

locations.name: Poblado Dirigido de San Cristóbal de los Ángeles
locations.setting: A 1959 social housing scheme in Villaverde built as open superblocks around courtyards, with two 12 and 14 storey towers and a surviving brick factory chimney, listed by Madrid Film Office.

locations.name: Poble Espanyol
locations.setting: Open-air architecture museum on Montjuic built for the 1929 exhibition, recreating streets and squares from across Spain with more than 100 full-scale building facades, workshops and courtyards.

locations.name: Poligono Industrial Ceramica
locations.setting: Small 1980s industrial estate in Puente de Vallecas, built as repetitive brick warehouses with two-pitched roofs along a single curved access street, used by small and medium local businesses.

locations.name: Poligono Industrial Julian Camarillo
locations.setting: Industrial estate built between the 1950s and 1970s near the M-30 and M-40 ring roads, mixing surviving factories, warehouses and workshops with converted offices, low-rise housing and some abandoned units.

locations.name: Port of Alicante
locations.setting: City centre port with a cruise terminal, container and bulk quays, a marina, a long promenade quay and warehouses under the castle hill.

locations.name: Port of Barcelona
locations.setting: Working Mediterranean port managed by a public authority, with container terminals, cruise quays, the older Port Vell basins, warehouses and a swing bridge.

locations.name: Port of Gijon (El Musel)
locations.setting: Bulk cargo port west of Gijon, with coal and ore stockyards, unloading gantries, long breakwaters, container quays and a nearby steelworks and power plant.

locations.name: Port of Palma
locations.setting: Working port run by the Balearic port authority, with cruise berths, ferry ramps, container quays, fuel jetties and marina pontoons under the cathedral skyline.

locations.name: Port of Sagunto
locations.setting: Industrial port north of Valencia, with bulk and steel quays, cranes and open storage yards, next to the surviving blast furnace and workshops of the old steelworks.

locations.name: Port of Santa Cruz de Tenerife
locations.setting: Commercial and cruise port run by Puertos de Tenerife, with container terminals, ferry ramps, fuel jetties, warehouses and long quays right against the city centre.

locations.name: Port of Santander
locations.setting: Bay port with a ferry terminal for the United Kingdom, car export yards, bulk quays, warehouses and cranes, close to the city centre and the beaches.

locations.name: Port of Vigo
locations.setting: Large fishing and cargo port on the Vigo ria, with fish market halls, container and car terminals, a cruise quay, shipyards and quaysides in the city centre.

locations.name: Pozo Soton
locations.setting: Former coal mine of 1917 kept as a heritage site, with two headframes, winding engines, lamp room, baths and guided access to galleries several hundred metres down.

locations.name: Proima Zebra Astur
locations.setting: A television production complex in Oviedo with four stages (1,268, 492 and 350 square metres, plus a 150 square metre chroma stage), built for broadcaster RTPA and hired out for other productions.
locations.known_for: Siempre al Día, Conexión Asturias, Asturias.Report, Babel
locations.facilities: Plato 1: 1,268 sq m. Plato 2: 492 sq m. Plato 3: 350 sq m. Chroma stage: 150 sq m
locations.suitability: Purpose-built as the main production base for regional broadcaster RTPA, also used for TV production, brand content and events

locations.name: Public University of Navarre
locations.setting: Modern campus on the edge of Pamplona, with brick faculty blocks, lecture theatres, laboratories, a library, sports halls and open landscaped grounds.

locations.name: Puerto de Bilbao
locations.setting: The port of Bilbao at the mouth of the Nervión estuary, with container terminals, quaysides and breakwaters managed by the Bilbao Port Authority.

locations.name: Puerto de Las Palmas
locations.setting: The commercial and passenger port of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, with quaysides, terminal buildings and the Santa Catalina wharf, catalogued by Canary Islands Film Commission's ports category.

locations.name: Puy du Fou Espana
