locations.setting: Historical show park outside Toledo with built medieval and Renaissance villages, a large night show arena, stage machinery, costume workshops and stables.

locations.name: Real Alcázar of Seville
locations.setting: Mudéjar royal palace complex in central Seville with tiled courtyards, arched ceremonial halls and lush formal gardens.
locations.known_for: Lawrence of Arabia (1962), Kingdom of Heaven (2005), Game of Thrones (season 5, Dorne)

photo.author: Ajay Suresh from New York, NY, USA. Edited by MenkinAlRire

locations.name: Real Casino de Murcia
locations.setting: Nineteenth century members' club on Calle Traperia with a Moorish patio, a mirrored ballroom, a domed ladies' powder room, a library and billiard rooms, open to visitors.

locations.name: Recinto Ferial de Tenerife
locations.setting: Trade fair and congress centre by Santiago Calatrava in Santa Cruz, with a wide ribbed concrete canopy, open exhibition floor, meeting rooms and loading access for large builds.

locations.name: Residencia de Estudiantes
locations.setting: Student residence founded in 1910 in a Mudejar-style cluster of pavilions from 1915, once home to Garcia Lorca, Dali and Bunuel, with a historic assembly hall, twin residential wings and a historic garden.
locations.facilities: Assembly hall, twin residential pavilions, garden, office wing, rooftop, own parking with access to the building
locations.suitability: Weekend filming preferred, night filming possible, script and ethical review required before booking

locations.name: Riojaforum
locations.setting: Conference and concert centre in Logrono, with an auditorium of about 1,000 seats, a multipurpose hall, meeting rooms and a glazed foyer beside the park.

locations.name: Riotinto Mining Park
locations.setting: An open-cast copper and mineral mining landscape in Huelva province with reddened terrain, a heritage mining railway and a mining museum.

locations.name: Riyadh Air Metropolitano
locations.setting: Atlético Madrid's stadium in San Blas-Canillejas, built with conference and event functions alongside football, offering outdoor areas for private functions.

locations.name: Robolt Studio
locations.setting: A virtual production studio in Madrid's Tetuan district with four stages, including an 800 sqm LED volume stage with a robotic motion-control rig, used for commercials and music videos.
locations.known_for: Erborian, Nike, Mutua Madrilena, Benidorm Fest
locations.facilities: Studio XL: 800 sqm, 7.2 m ceiling (4.5 m at sides), 12.16 x 4.32 m LED wall (1.8 mm pitch) plus a 5 x 3 m ceiling LED screen, robotic motion-control arm on a 9 m track, 31 kW power. Studio L: 380 sqm with a 10 x 3.8 m cyclorama. Studio M: 240 sqm, U-shaped cyclorama, capacity 60 people, podcast room included. Studio S: 150 sqm. Total complex about 1,500 sqm across four stages.
locations.logistics: About 3 minutes on foot from Francos Rodriguez metro station; 3 on-site parking spaces; vehicle access up to 3 m height (own site).

locations.name: Roman Theatre of Merida
locations.setting: Roman theatre of 15 BC managed by the Consorcio de Merida, with a two storey columned stage front, semicircular stone seating for about 6,000 and the adjoining amphitheatre.

locations.name: Roque de los Muchachos Observatory
locations.setting: Astronomical observatory at 2,400 metres run by the Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias, with white telescope domes, control rooms, service corridors and a ridge road above the clouds.

locations.name: Royal Glass Factory of La Granja
locations.setting: Eighteenth century royal glassworks at San Ildefonso, with a vast pillared factory hall, domed furnace houses, workshops and a working glass blowing school.

locations.name: Royal Tapestry Factory
locations.setting: A working tapestry and carpet workshop in Madrid founded in 1721, still weaving on wooden looms in its original workshop halls, open for guided tours.

locations.name: Salinas de Janubio
locations.setting: Working sea salt works on the south west coast, a grid of shallow evaporation pans in pink and white beside black lava cliffs, with pumps, channels and salt piles.

locations.name: Santa Catalina, a Royal Hideaway Hotel
locations.setting: Colonial style grand hotel of 1890 in Doramas Park, Las Palmas, with wooden balconies, a marble lobby, ballroom, period suites and a garden pool terrace.

locations.name: Santa Justa Station
locations.setting: Seville's main railway station, a large modern terminus with a vaulted departure hall serving high-speed AVE trains and regional services across Andalusia.

locations.name: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium
locations.setting: Real Madrid's stadium in central Madrid, seating over 80,000 under a retractable roof, with dressing rooms, a trophy room and pitch-level tour access.

locations.name: Sargadelos Ceramics Factory
locations.setting: Working porcelain factory at Cervo founded on an 18th century ironworks site, with round white workshop buildings, kilns, moulding shops and a museum.

locations.name: Seville Airport
locations.setting: Aena run airport at San Pablo with a Rafael Moneo terminal of blue arched halls, check in rows, boarding gates, apron stands and a single runway on flat farmland.

locations.name: Seville City Hall
locations.setting: City hall between Plaza Nueva and Plaza de San Francisco, joining a carved plateresque wing to a nineteenth century front, with council chamber, staircase and offices.

locations.name: Soller Railway
locations.setting: A narrow-gauge heritage railway on Mallorca linking Palma to Soller through the Serra de Tramuntana, still running vintage wooden carriages dating from 1912.

locations.name: Tabakalera
locations.setting: A former state tobacco factory in San Sebastian, its early 20th-century industrial halls converted into a contemporary culture and creation centre.
locations.facilities: Ten rentable spaces: Patio (620 m2, 10 m high; banquet 220 / cocktail 600 / theatre 400), Cine hall (327 m2, 5 m high; theatre or classroom 229), Sala 1 (184 m2, 5.5 m high; banquet 80 / cocktail 120 / theatre 120 / classroom 80), Prisma + Terraza (309 + 139 m2; banquet 180 / cocktail 285 / theatre 200), Plaza (492 m2, 23-27 m high; banquet 180 / cocktail 430 / theatre 200), Nave 1 (211 m2, cocktail 220), Nave 2 (343 m2, cocktail 171), the film and audiovisual lab (265 m2, cocktail 130), Terraza Este (200 m2, outdoor, cocktail 200), and the first-floor Distribuidor (335 m2, cocktail 170).

locations.name: Tabernas Desert
locations.setting: Europe's only true desert, with eroded badlands, dry riverbeds and surviving western town sets from the spaghetti-western era.
locations.known_for: Lawrence of Arabia (1962), The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966), Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)

locations.name: Teatre Principal de Palma
locations.setting: Nineteenth century opera house in central Palma with a horseshoe auditorium, tiered boxes, painted ceiling, orchestra pit and a smaller studio hall.

locations.name: Teatro Alameda, Tarifa
locations.setting: Municipal cinema and theatre on the Alameda in Tarifa's old town, a public building used for screenings, performances and civic events on Spain's southernmost point.

locations.name: Teatro Calderon
locations.setting: City theatre of 1864 in Valladolid, restored in the 1990s, with a horseshoe auditorium of about 1,200 seats, tiers of boxes, foyers and a deep stage.

locations.name: Teatro Campoamor
locations.setting: Opera house of 1892 in Oviedo, rebuilt after the Civil War, with a horseshoe auditorium of about 1,300 seats, boxes, a large stage and formal foyers.

locations.name: Teatro Central
locations.setting: Contemporary theatre on the Isla de la Cartuja built for Expo 92, with a black box stage, flexible seating, technical galleries and a metal clad exterior.

locations.name: Teatro Guimera
locations.setting: The oldest theatre in the Canaries, opened in 1851 in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, with a horseshoe auditorium, boxes, a neoclassical foyer and a domed corner facade.

locations.name: Teatro La Latina
locations.setting: 900-seat theatre on the Plaza de la Cebada spread over three floors, with a lobby, club level and boxes, and an upper amphitheatre with good sightlines and acoustics.
locations.known_for: El Corte Ingles Emidio Tucci advert (2023)
locations.facilities: Lobby, stalls, club level, boxes, amphitheatre, dressing rooms, catering area, storage
locations.suitability: Subject to the theatre's regular show schedule

locations.name: Teatro Romea
locations.setting: City theatre of 1862 in central Murcia with a horseshoe auditorium in three tiers, a painted dome, gilt boxes, a marble foyer and a classical portico.

locations.name: Technical University of Cartagena
locations.setting: University spread through restored military and civic buildings in Cartagena, with an old artillery barracks campus, lecture halls, laboratories and stone courtyards.

locations.name: Teide National Park
locations.setting: High volcanic caldera around the Teide summit at over 2,000 metres, with lava fields, ochre rock towers, cinder plains and long empty access roads used as off world terrain.
locations.known_for: One Million Years B.C., Clash of the Titans, Wrath of the Titans, Fast & Furious 6

locations.name: Tenerife South Airport
locations.setting: Aena run holiday airport at Reina Sofia with a single runway, open air walkways between terminal and gates, arrivals hall, apron and car park decks.
locations.suitability: Tenerife Film Commission publishes a separate filming permit route for the island airports.

locations.name: Teruel Airport
locations.setting: Airport used for aircraft storage, maintenance and dismantling, with rows of parked airliners on a wide apron, a long runway and hangars in dry open country.

locations.name: Timanfaya National Park
locations.setting: A national park on Lanzarote covering volcanic terrain formed by 18th-century eruptions, with lava fields, craters and a visitor route by coach.

locations.name: Tower of Hercules
locations.setting: A still-operating Roman lighthouse on a headland outside A Coruna, the oldest lighthouse in continuous use in the world, refaced in granite in the 18th century.

locations.name: Túneles M-30
locations.setting: Underground service galleries and technical chambers within Madrid's M-30 ring road tunnels, reaching about 60 metres deep, made available by the road operator for corridor and underground scenes.
locations.logistics: Access via Calle Méndez Álvaro 95; arranged through the tunnel operator Madrid Calle 30.

locations.name: University of Alcala
locations.setting: A 16th-century university campus in Alcala de Henares, centred on the Colegio de San Ildefonso with its plateresque facade and a historic assembly hall.

locations.name: University of La Laguna
locations.setting: Public university spread over La Laguna with a 1960s rectorate block, faculty buildings, lecture halls, laboratories and campus greens beside the UNESCO listed old town.

locations.name: University of La Rioja
locations.setting: Compact city campus in Logrono, with brick and glass faculty buildings, lecture theatres, laboratories, a library and a sports centre around open squares.

locations.name: University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (Tafira Campus)
locations.setting: Hillside university campus above Las Palmas with faculty blocks, lecture theatres, laboratories, a library and open plazas, giving modern institutional interiors and exteriors.

locations.name: University of Navarra Museum
locations.setting: Rafael Moneo museum of 2015 on the university campus, with concrete and glass galleries, a theatre, wide ramps and daylit halls suited to interior work.

locations.name: University of Oviedo Historic Building
locations.setting: Sixteenth century university building in central Oviedo, with an arcaded stone courtyard, a ceremonial hall, historic library rooms and lecture theatres.

locations.name: University of Salamanca
locations.setting: Spain's oldest university, with a 16th-century plateresque facade, cloisters and historic lecture halls set around Salamanca's old town.
locations.price_note: Weekend and holiday use of university spaces is charged at a 25 percent surcharge over standard rates, VAT excluded (own site)
locations.suitability: Space use requires at least 30 days advance notice and prior written authorisation from the General Secretariat; institutional needs take priority over external requests, and payment must be made in advance (own site).

locations.name: University of Santiago de Compostela
locations.setting: University founded in 1495, with a neoclassical faculty building and cloister in the old town plus 20th century campuses, lecture halls and libraries.

locations.name: University of Seville (Rectorado)
locations.setting: Seville's university rectorate housed in the former Royal Tobacco Factory, an 18th-century industrial building with long stone facades, courtyards and vaulted halls.

locations.name: Valencia Airport
locations.setting: Aena run airport at Manises with a single passenger terminal, glazed departure hall, aprons, a cargo area and adjoining general aviation hangars.

locations.name: Villa Winter
locations.setting: Isolated 1940s house with a round tower on the Cofete plain under the Jandia massif, reached by a dirt track, with bare rooms, a walled garden and no near neighbours.

locations.name: Vivanco Museum of Wine Culture
locations.setting: Winery and wine museum at Briones, with stainless steel and barrel halls, an underground cellar, exhibition galleries and vineyards on the Ebro valley slopes.

locations.name: Vizcaya Bridge
locations.setting: A working transporter bridge over the Ria de Bilbao between Portugalete and Las Arenas, carrying a suspended gondola across the estuary since 1893, with a walkway on top.
locations.facilities: Rentable spaces include four open-air terraces above the estuary, the elevated walkway (Pasarela, 50 metres above the estuary), and the gondola (Barquilla, which carries an in-cabin TV channel running 24 hours a day), plus advertising spots (posters and shop-window displays) inside and outside the gondola.
locations.suitability: The bridge hosts private events such as parties and receptions on the open-air terraces or on the elevated walkway; marquees can also be rented for the terraces.

photo.author: Javier Mediavilla Ezquibela Esta imagen tiene una licencia libre (que puedes ver abajo), pero si la usas fuera de los pr

locations.name: Water Control Pavilion, Cristóbal Colón Power Station
locations.setting: Water intake control building of the Cristóbal Colón combined-cycle power station on the Huelva estuary, a compact industrial structure among pipework and cooling infrastructure.

locations.name: Zona Industrial Villa de Vallecas
locations.setting: A small industrial pocket of Villa de Vallecas with narrow streets, warehouses and low workshop buildings on distinctive corner plots, catalogued by Madrid Film Office.

locations.name: Zorrotzaurre
locations.setting: Former dock island in the Bilbao estuary now being redeveloped, mixing empty warehouses and quay walls with new bridges, waterfront paths and apartment blocks.

locations.name: Abisko National Park
locations.setting: National park in Swedish Lapland around Lake Tornetrask, with birch forest, mountain heath, the Abisko canyon and a mountain station used as a base for hiking and aurora viewing.

locations.name: Avicii Arena
locations.setting: A spherical indoor arena in Johanneshov, Stockholm, one of the largest hemispherical buildings in the world, used for concerts, sport and large-scale events with a SkyView cable car running up its outer shell.
locations.suitability: Arena bookable for events (own site: 'Moten & Event', 'Book arena')

locations.name: Chalmers University of Technology
locations.setting: A research university campus along Kungsportsavenyen in Gothenburg, with early 20th-century main buildings and later science and engineering blocks around a long central mall.

locations.name: Dalhalla
locations.setting: Open-air amphitheatre built into a flooded former limestone quarry near Rattvik in Dalarna, with a stage, restaurant and glamping accommodation beside the water.
locations.facilities: Restaurant, glamping tents, transfer buses for events

locations.name: Eriksdalsbadet
locations.setting: Stockholm's largest public swimming complex on Sodermalm, with an Olympic-sized 50 metre indoor pool, an outdoor pool and diving towers used for competitions.

locations.name: Falu Gruva (Falun Mine)
locations.setting: UNESCO-listed copper mine in Falun, Dalarna, with underground tour routes, a mine museum, historic miners' cottages and a large open pit.

locations.name: Fårö
locations.setting: Small Baltic island north of Gotland with limestone rauk stacks, shingle shores and windswept heathland, where Ingmar Bergman lived and filmed for decades.
locations.known_for: Persona (1966), Through a Glass Darkly (1961), Scenes from a Marriage (1973)

locations.name: Feskekorka
locations.setting: A neo-Gothic fish market hall in central Gothenburg, built in 1874 to resemble a church, with fish counters and small restaurants inside its single vaulted space.
locations.suitability: Space available for corporate events, weddings and kickoffs (own site: 'Foretagsevent', 'Brollop', 'Boka Event')

locations.name: Film i Väst
locations.setting: Regional film fund and studio base in Trollhättan, nicknamed Trollywood, whose stages and industrial halls have held full-scale purpose-built sets.
locations.price_note: Studio Fares SEK 25,000 for the first day and SEK 20,000 per following day, plus 25 percent VAT (own site)
locations.facilities: Studio Fares: one 1,100 m2 sound stage (31.3 x 36.1 m, 10 m to the gallery) with a telfer system of 40 hoists, 1,000 A permanent power plus 1,000 A temporary, and doors 4.5 m high; props storage, carpentry workshop, production offices with 26 desks on two floors, three dressing rooms, makeup and wardrobe and a 50-seat cafe with kitchen.
locations.suitability: Rented primarily to Film i Vast co-productions under a licence agreement; external bookings are accepted at most two months ahead. The rent includes utilities, parking, cleaning and use of the facilities.
locations.logistics: Trollhattan; gated, secure parking with four EV charging points. Website in Swedish only.

locations.name: Filmhuset
locations.setting: The Brutalist 1970 headquarters of the Swedish Film Institute in Gardet, Stockholm, built to resemble a camera, housing a film archive, offices and two public cinemas.
locations.known_for: Guldbagge Awards ceremony, Stockholm International Film Festival industry programme
locations.facilities: Two cinemas (Bio Victor and Bio Mauritz) available for public rental, a large film archive, open plan offices

locations.name: Grona Lund
locations.setting: A small, densely packed amusement park on Djurgarden's waterfront in Stockholm, open since 1883 with over 30 rides and three indoor and outdoor stages used for summer concerts.

locations.name: Icehotel
locations.setting: Hotel rebuilt each winter from ice and snow from the Torne River in Jukkasjarvi, Swedish Lapland, alongside a year-round warm wing, with conference and wedding facilities.
locations.facilities: Conference and events facilities, weddings program

locations.name: Innovatum
locations.setting: A former NOHAB locomotive and engine works in Trollhattan, its brick factory halls now a business park, science centre and meeting venue around the old workshop buildings.

locations.name: Kaggeholms Gård
locations.setting: A lakeside manor building on Ekero outside Stockholm that houses a folk high school with media production courses, used as the boarding school interiors and exteriors in a Netflix teen drama.

locations.name: Kiruna Mine (LKAB)
locations.setting: A working underground iron-ore mine beneath Kiruna with an ore body 4 kilometres long, its headframes and processing plant dominating the edge of the town.

locations.name: Konserthuset Stockholm
locations.setting: The main concert hall for orchestral music in Stockholm, overlooking Hotorget, home to the Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra and the venue for the annual Nobel Prize ceremony.

locations.name: Kulturhuset Stadsteatern
locations.setting: Culture house and municipal theatre on Sergels torg in central Stockholm, with several stages, exhibition halls, a library and rooms available for hire.
locations.facilities: Spaces listed for hire: Foajé 3, Hörsalen, Klarabiografen (cinema), Lilla studion, Studion and the galleries.

locations.name: Langholmen
locations.setting: Former state prison on a small island in central Stockholm, closed in 1975 and converted into a hotel, hostel and restaurant that keeps its original cell wings.
locations.facilities: Hotel, hostel, restaurant and conference rooms in former cell wings

locations.name: Lindholmen
locations.setting: Former shipyard peninsula in Gothenburg redeveloped since the 1990s into a science park of offices, test beds and studios jointly run by the city and industry.

locations.name: Liseberg
locations.setting: Amusement park in central Gothenburg with rides, stages and gardens, plus on-site hotels and dedicated conference and event spaces for hire.
locations.facilities: Conference spaces at the park, Lisebergsbyn and Grand Curiosa Hotel

locations.name: Lund University
locations.setting: One of Northern Europe's oldest universities, its 19th-century main building facing the historic Lundagard park next to Lund Cathedral in the centre of Lund.

locations.name: Malmo Live
locations.setting: Concert hall and congress centre in Malmo, home to the Malmo Symphony Orchestra, with a main concert hall and several smaller performance spaces.
locations.logistics: Stage entry at Beringsgatan 5; loading access at Beringsgatan 1-3; visiting address Dag Hammarskjölds torg 4, Malmo.

photo.author: This image was produced by me, David Castor (user:dcastor). The pictures I submit to the Wikipedia Project are released

locations.name: Marinmuseum (Naval Museum), Karlskrona
locations.setting: Sweden's naval museum on the island of Stumholmen in Karlskrona, part of the country's only baroque naval town and still-active naval base, with historic ships moored alongside.

locations.name: Naas Slott
locations.setting: A lakeside castle and former handicraft teacher-training seminary near Gothenburg with function rooms, guest wings and parkland, publishing its own photography and filming service and used in a Swedish period TV drama.

locations.name: Nalen
locations.setting: A 1920s entertainment building in central Stockholm combining a concert hall, restaurant and function rooms, long associated with Swedish jazz and now hired out for concerts, dinners and conferences.
locations.suitability: Rooms and hall available for booking (own site: 'Bokningsforfragan', 'Moten & fest')

locations.name: Ostermalms Saluhall
locations.setting: A market hall on Ostermalmstorg in Stockholm, open since 1888, with stalls and small restaurants for fish, meat, cheese and produce under an iron-framed roof.

locations.name: Port of Gothenburg
locations.setting: The largest port in the Nordic countries, handling nearly 30 percent of Sweden's foreign trade across container, roro, ferry and energy terminals along the Gota Alv river mouth.

locations.name: Royal Swedish Opera
locations.setting: National opera and ballet house on Gustav Adolfs torg in Stockholm, founded in 1773, with a 19th-century auditorium due for renovation from 2027.
locations.facilities: The Golden Foyer, the space published for hire, seats up to 120 or holds up to 200 standing, and includes a terrace overlooking Gustav Adolfs torg, weather permitting.

locations.name: Skansen
locations.setting: Open-air museum on Djurgarden in Stockholm, the oldest of its kind in the world, with about 190 historic buildings relocated from across Sweden plus a zoo.
locations.facilities: Business bookings and bookable group experiences

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Basilivh assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Slagthuset
locations.setting: A former municipal abattoir in Malmo's harbour district converted into an event venue, keeping its industrial brick halls for concerts, conferences and large private functions.
locations.facilities: Multiple named halls of different sizes: Saluhallen up to 1500, Restauranggatan up to 1020, Teatern up to 921, Hantverksgangen up to about 350, Sodra Hallen up to 350, Norra Hallen up to 250 (own site, standing/event capacities).

locations.name: Stora Sundby Slott
locations.setting: A 19th-century turreted castle near Eskilstuna with 52 rooms and a hunting estate, open for tours and events, used for the royal palace scenes in a Netflix teen drama.

locations.name: Turning Torso
locations.setting: A twisting residential skyscraper on Malmo's Vastra Hamnen waterfront, completed in 2005 to a Santiago Calatrava design of nine rotating cube sections, formerly the tallest building in the Nordic region.

locations.name: Universeum
locations.setting: Sweden's national science centre in Gothenburg, a ten-floor building with rainforest and ocean exhibits, a visualisation dome and dedicated event and conference spaces.
locations.facilities: Published event packages: dinner and drinks in the Ocean zone (max 250), dinner with Wisdome show (max 250), conference (max 30), and hire of the entire venue (over 500).

locations.name: Uppsala University Main Building
locations.setting: The main hall (Universitetshuset) of Sweden's oldest university, a domed 19th-century building in central Uppsala used for ceremonies, lectures and public ceremonies.

locations.name: Vasa Museum
locations.setting: Maritime museum on Djurgarden in Stockholm built around the salvaged 17th-century warship Vasa, which sank on its maiden voyage in 1628.
locations.facilities: Ship Hall, the main event space next to the ship Vasa: up to 800 guests seated for dinner or up to 2,000 for a standing reception. Adjoining restaurant: up to 150 guests seated or standing.

locations.name: Visby
locations.setting: Medieval walled town on Gotland and a UNESCO World Heritage site, with a 3.4 kilometre town wall, cobbled lanes and ruined medieval churches.

locations.name: Ystad
locations.setting: Medieval coastal town with half-timbered houses, cobbled streets and a sandy Baltic shoreline, home to the Ystad Studios film facility.

locations.name: Ystad Studios
locations.setting: Two 600m2 sound stages in Ystad built for the Wallander and Bron/The Bridge productions, now run by the regional film fund and hired out to other productions.
locations.price_note: Ernst Hugo stage from SEK 10,000/day or SEK 50,000/week; Anna Q stage from SEK 8,000/day or SEK 40,000/week, excl. VAT (Film i Skane).
locations.facilities: Ernst Hugo stage: 600m2, virtual production with a 25x4m projection screen in a 180-degree semicircle. Anna Q stage: 600m2, set-construction stage. 6 production offices, conference room for 20, 2 dressing rooms, make-up/costume areas, green room, dining hall, wardrobe storage, parking.
locations.logistics: Elis Nilssons vag 12, Ystad.

locations.name: 1291 Productions Studios
locations.setting: Two adjoining sound stages at Burglen in Thurgau that can be run as one space or divided by soundproof walls, hired by the hour, day or week.
locations.facilities: Two connected soundstages, soundproof dividing walls, in-house production services

locations.name: Abbey Library of Saint Gall
locations.setting: Rococo library hall of 1767 in the abbey district of St. Gallen, with inlaid wood floors, galleried book walls, ceiling paintings and adjoining baroque abbey rooms.

locations.name: Academy of Architecture, Mendrisio
locations.setting: Architecture school in Mendrisio built around a nineteenth century villa and park with newer teaching pavilions, listed among the Ticino film commission locations.

locations.name: Alte Kaserne Winterthur
locations.setting: Nineteenth century barracks on Technikumstrasse in Winterthur, now a cultural centre with a parade yard, long corridors, drill halls and plain institutional rooms for hire.

locations.name: Ancien Penitencier, Sion
locations.setting: Former cantonal prison below the castles of Sion, run by the Valais cantonal museums as an exhibition building, keeping its cell block structure and vaulted corridors.

locations.name: Attisholz Areal
locations.setting: Disused cellulose factory on the river Aare at Riedholz, with large production halls, silos, pipework and open yards used for events and temporary hire while the site is redeveloped.

locations.name: Ballenberg Open-Air Museum
locations.setting: Open air museum near Brienz with more than a hundred rebuilt farmhouses, barns, workshops and gardens from across Switzerland, set over 66 hectares of meadow and woodland.

locations.name: Beau-Rivage Palace
locations.setting: Belle epoque lakeside hotel at Ouchy in Lausanne, with a domed ballroom, marble halls, formal gardens and terraces facing Lake Geneva and the Savoy Alps.

locations.name: Berghotel Schatzalp
locations.setting: Former sanatorium of 1900 above Davos, reached by funicular, with long south balconies, art nouveau public rooms and corridors that read as a period clinic.

locations.name: Blonay-Chamby Museum Railway
locations.setting: Preserved narrow gauge line on the slope above Montreux with period stations, a stone viaduct, a depot of historic steam and electric stock and views over Lake Geneva.

locations.name: Burgenstock Resort
locations.setting: Hotel estate on a ridge 500 metres above Lake Lucerne, with several hotels, a cliff walk, an outdoor rock lift and modern spa and conference interiors.

locations.name: Cafe Odeon
locations.setting: Viennese style cafe and bar of 1911 on Limmatquai in Zurich, with marble tables, mirrors, chandeliers and a corner position on the river.

locations.name: Castelgrande, Bellinzona
locations.setting: Rock fortress in the centre of Bellinzona, part of a World Heritage group of three castles, with curtain walls, two towers, a lift through the rock and modern halls by Aurelio Galfetti.

locations.name: CERN
locations.setting: Particle physics laboratory at Meyrin on the French border, with 1950s office blocks, control rooms, assembly halls and underground experiment caverns on the accelerator ring.
locations.suitability: Filming on site is arranged through the laboratory's press office

locations.name: Chillon Castle
locations.setting: Island castle on Lake Geneva near Montreux, with vaulted cellars, a great hall, painted chambers, a keep and courtyards, run as a museum by a public foundation.

locations.name: Cinema Lux, Massagno
locations.setting: Neighbourhood art house cinema at Massagno beside Lugano, listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue and marked there as a green location.

locations.name: Confiserie Sprungli, Paradeplatz
locations.setting: Confectioner's shop and first floor cafe on Paradeplatz in Zurich, trading since 1859, with counters, a tram square outside and bank facades on all sides.

locations.name: Content Park Operations
locations.setting: Private studio group in Schlieren west of Zurich, with sound stages up to about 400 square metres and 7.5 metres clear height plus a fully rigged TV studio.
locations.facilities: Several rental sound stages and a TV studio across sites in Zurich and Schlieren, about 3,000 square metres in total

locations.name: ETH Zurich main building
locations.setting: Semper's 1864 main building of the federal technical university above central Zurich, with a domed hall, stone stairs, lecture theatres, laboratories and a terrace over the city.

locations.name: Ex Piscina Pompeiana, Arzo
locations.setting: Disused open air swimming pool at Arzo near the marble quarries, laid out in a Pompeian style and listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue.

locations.name: Federal Palace, Bern
locations.setting: Seat of the Swiss parliament and government on the Aare terrace in Bern, a domed sandstone building of 1902 with two chambers, a lobby hall and a public square in front.
locations.suitability: Filming inside the parliament building requires accreditation from the parliamentary services

locations.name: Fotohalle
locations.setting: Column free hall of about 420 square metres at Schlieren used as a photo, film and event studio, with a drive in entrance and blackout capability.
locations.facilities: About 420 square metres of studio floor, blackout curtains, vehicle access

locations.name: Furka Steam Railway
locations.setting: Volunteer run metre gauge steam line over the Furka pass between Realp and Oberwald, with a depot at Realp, timber station buildings, rack sections and high alpine bridges.

locations.name: Geneva Airport
locations.setting: City airport on the French border with a single runway, a compact terminal and an east wing extension, ten minutes by rail from central Geneva.

locations.name: Grand Hotel Muralto
locations.setting: Large belle epoque hotel of 1876 on the lake front at Muralto next to Locarno, long out of use, listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue.

locations.name: Grand Theatre de Geneve
locations.setting: Opera house of 1876 on Place Neuve in Geneva, rebuilt after a 1951 fire, with a stone facade, a grand staircase, a 1,500 seat auditorium and modern stage machinery.

locations.name: Grande Dixence Dam
locations.setting: Concrete gravity dam of 285 metres at the head of the Val des Dix, with a crest walkway, inspection galleries inside the wall and a visitor centre at the foot.

locations.name: Grandhotel Giessbach
locations.setting: Belle epoque hotel of 1875 above Lake Brienz beside the Giessbach falls, reached by a funicular, with a period dining room, salons, terraces and a wooded park.

locations.name: Hallenstadion
locations.setting: Indoor arena of 1939 at Oerlikon in north Zurich, rebuilt in 2005, seating about 13,000 for concerts, ice hockey and six day track racing, with a wide flat floor.

locations.name: Hotel Vezia
locations.setting: Roadside hotel at Vezia just north of Lugano listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue, with garden, pool and plain modern guest rooms.

locations.name: Hotel Waldhaus Sils
locations.setting: Family run grand hotel of 1908 on a wooded rise at Sils in the Upper Engadine, with a hall, panelled salons, a ballroom and largely unaltered early twentieth century interiors.

locations.name: Jungfrau Railway and Jungfraujoch station
locations.setting: Rack railway running inside the Eiger and Monch to Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 metres, with tunnel galleries, an ice tunnel system and terraces over the Aletsch glacier.

photo.author: NOTE: This image is a panorama of Jungfraujoch Sphinx-Observatory consisting of 5 frames that were merged or stitched in

locations.name: Kaserne Basel
locations.setting: Former cavalry barracks on the Rhine in Kleinbasel, a long classical block around a large courtyard, now a performance house with halls, foyers and bare service rooms.

locations.name: Klybeck industrial site, Basel
locations.setting: Former chemical works of Ciba and Novartis in north Basel, a closed quarter of laboratory blocks, production buildings and internal streets now in transformation.

locations.name: Kraftwerk Zurich
locations.setting: Former municipal power station on Selnaustrasse in central Zurich, now a work and event house keeping the turbine hall volume, steel windows and machine room detail.

locations.name: Kronenhalle
locations.setting: Restaurant and bar of 1924 near the Zurich opera, with dark panelling, brass lamps, leather banquettes and paintings by Chagall, Miro and Picasso on the walls.

locations.name: Lagerplatz Winterthur
locations.setting: Former Sulzer works yard in Winterthur, a block of brick halls, workshops and open yards let to craft and creative tenants, with raw industrial surfaces and gantry structures.

locations.name: Lake Lucerne paddle steamers
locations.setting: Fleet of five historic paddle steamers and salon motor vessels working Lake Lucerne from the quays beside Lucerne station, with period saloons, open decks and visible engines.

locations.name: Landwasser Viaduct
locations.setting: Curved limestone viaduct of 1902 on the Rhaetian Railway near Filisur, 65 metres high, running straight from the last pier into a tunnel mouth in the rock face.
locations.suitability: Photo and film projects on the Rhaetian Railway network are handled by the railway's media office

locations.name: Lavaux Vineyard Terraces
locations.setting: Terraced vineyards on the north shore of Lake Geneva between Lausanne and Montreux, with stone walls, wine villages, a lakeside railway and paths through the plots.

locations.name: Lokremise St. Gallen
locations.setting: Round locomotive shed of 1903 beside St. Gallen station, kept with its turntable and radial bays and used as a theatre, cinema and art space.

locations.name: Maison Blanche
locations.setting: First house Le Corbusier built on his own account, finished in 1912 above La Chaux-de-Fonds, with white rendered walls, period interiors and a hillside garden.

locations.name: Markthalle Basel
locations.setting: Domed market hall of 1929 beside Basel station, a 60 metre concrete rotunda now filled with food stalls, bars and event space under the ring of clerestory windows.

locations.name: Monte Verita
locations.setting: Hill above Ascona holding the Bauhaus style hotel of 1927 by Emil Fahrenkamp, the wooden Casa Anatta and a park, run as a conference and museum estate.

locations.name: Nebel Studios
locations.setting: Production studio at Grancia south of Lugano, listed by the national film commission as one of the studio facilities available to visiting productions in Italian speaking Switzerland.

locations.name: Palais des Nations
locations.setting: United Nations European headquarters in the Ariana park above Geneva, a 1930s monumental complex of assembly halls, marble corridors, council chambers and a modern extension.
locations.suitability: Access for media and filming runs through United Nations accreditation

locations.name: Papieri Cham
locations.setting: Former paper mill on the Lorze in Cham, a walled riverside works of machine halls, chimneys and workers buildings being converted into a mixed quarter.

locations.name: Parco Villa Costanza, Viganello
locations.setting: Public park around a nineteenth century villa at Viganello in Lugano, with mature trees, terraces and lawns, listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue.

locations.name: Ponte via Interlenghi, Chiasso
locations.setting: Road bridge in the border town of Chiasso listed in the Ticino film commission location catalogue, close to the customs area and the railway yards on the Italian frontier.

locations.name: Port of Switzerland, Basel
locations.setting: Rhine river ports at Kleinhuningen and Birsfelden, the country's only cargo harbour, with quays, cranes, silos, container terminals and barge traffic on the German border.

locations.name: REDFOX Studio
locations.setting: Studio at Ursy in the Fribourg countryside between Lausanne and Bern, listed by the national film commission among the production studios open to hire.

locations.name: Rolex Learning Center, EPFL
locations.setting: Single storey library and study building by SANAA on the EPFL campus at Ecublens, a continuous undulating slab with circular patios and long glazed sightlines.

locations.name: RSI Studios Comano
locations.setting: Television and multimedia base of Italian speaking Swiss public broadcasting on the hill above Lugano, with production studios, control rooms and technical halls.

locations.name: RTS Studios Geneva
locations.setting: Broadcast centre of French speaking Swiss public television on Quai Ernest-Ansermet in Geneva, with news and talk studios and 1970s broadcast architecture.

locations.name: Salt Mines of Bex
locations.setting: Working salt mine above Bex with kilometres of galleries, timber and rock chambers, a narrow gauge mine train and underground halls open to visitors.
locations.logistics: Reached by road from Bex in the Rhone valley, about 25 minutes from Montreux

locations.name: Schilthorn Piz Gloria
locations.setting: Summit station at 2,970 metres above Murren, reached by cable car, with a revolving restaurant, viewing terraces and a Bond themed exhibition inside the building.

locations.name: Siedlung Halen
locations.setting: Dense terraced housing estate of 1961 by Atelier 5 in woodland above the Aare near Bern, with concrete row houses, narrow lanes, private patios and a shared pool.

locations.name: Soundville Media Studios
locations.setting: Combined sound and film studio complex in Lucerne, in operation since 1980, offering a film stage alongside recording and post production rooms.

locations.name: SRF Studio Zurich Leutschenbach
locations.setting: Headquarters and broadcast complex of Swiss German public television in north Zurich, with news, sport and talk studios, galleries, newsroom floors and a 1970s office block.

locations.name: Studio 13
locations.setting: Film and photo studio on Route de Riddes in Sion, the studio the Valais film commission and the national commission point productions to for interior work in the Rhone valley.

locations.name: StudioGutenswil
locations.setting: Rental studio in the village of Gutenswil east of Zurich, in use since the 1960s and quiet enough for live sound recording during filming.
locations.suitability: Quiet enough for original sound recording, used for film productions and photo shoots

locations.name: Swiss Museum of Transport
locations.setting: Transport museum on the lake shore in Lucerne with halls of locomotives, aircraft, cable cars and cars, a planetarium and a large format cinema.

locations.name: Swiss National Museum, Zurich
locations.setting: Historicist museum castle of 1898 beside Zurich main station, with courtyards, towers, vaulted galleries and a 2016 concrete extension by Christ and Gantenbein.
locations.suitability: The museum publishes a request procedure for photography and filming on its premises

locations.name: Tram-Museum Zurich
locations.setting: Working tram depot at Burgwies in Zurich holding around twenty historic trams and buses from 1897 onward, with inspection pits, overhead wire and a depot hall open for hire.

locations.name: USI Lugano campus
locations.setting: University campus in the Lugano district of Besso, with lecture blocks, courtyards and modern teaching interiors, entered in the Ticino film commission location catalogue.

locations.name: Villa Le Lac
locations.setting: Small lakeside house of 1923 built by Le Corbusier for his parents at Corseaux, a single storey plan of 64 square metres with a long horizontal window and a walled garden.

locations.name: Villa Patumbah
locations.setting: Ornate 1885 merchant villa in the Zurich Seefeld quarter with painted salons, carved timber, a conservatory and a public park, run as a heritage centre with rooms for hire.

locations.name: Zurich Airport
locations.setting: Switzerland's largest airport at Kloten, with three terminals, an airside dock, an underground people mover and the Circle office and hotel complex at the landside edge.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography at the airport require a film or photo permit applied for through the airport company

locations.name: Zurich Hauptbahnhof
locations.setting: Main station of Zurich, a nineteenth century head house over a wide train hall with modern through platforms and a shopping level below, busy from early morning to late night.
locations.suitability: Filming on railway property is arranged through the operator SBB

locations.name: Zurich Opera House
locations.setting: Neo baroque opera house of 1891 on Sechselautenplatz in Zurich, with a horseshoe auditorium of about 1,100 seats, gilded tiers, foyers and a studio stage.

locations.name: Aerospace Bristol
locations.setting: Aviation museum on the former Filton airfield site with a hangar housing a preserved Concorde alongside earlier Bristol-built aircraft.
locations.facilities: Spaces for hire include the Concorde Gallery and Balcony, the John James Theatre (raked seating), the Studio Space, and the Miami, Washington and New York rooms; the Heritage Hangar is used for drinks receptions. The Concorde Gallery seats up to 500 guests for a three-course dinner, and the Concorde Hangar can be turned around for a 300-guest event in under 2.5 hours.

locations.name: Alexandra Palace
locations.setting: Victorian exhibition palace on a hill in north London with a 10,000 capacity great hall, restored BBC television studios, a Victorian theatre, ice rink and 196 acres of park.
locations.known_for: A Lizard in a Woman's Skin, The X Factor

locations.name: Allianz Stadium, Twickenham
locations.setting: 82,000-seat national rugby stadium with four concourse levels, 34 event suites, a gym and an on-site hotel, hired out as a filming location and unit base outside match days.
locations.facilities: Onsite and nearby crew parking, multiple kitchens, gym and pool access, 150-bedroom on-site hotel
locations.suitability: Concourse and event-space filming available outside match days, custom hours negotiated per production

locations.name: Alnwick Castle
locations.setting: Medieval border castle with a walled outer bailey, gatehouse, keep and Italianate state rooms, set in a Capability Brown park above the River Aln.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, Downton Abbey, Elizabeth
locations.suitability: The castle runs a filming enquiries page and lists what it can offer productions.

locations.name: Amberley Museum
locations.setting: Open-air industrial heritage museum on a former chalk quarry near Arundel, with narrow-gauge railways, a lime works, workshops and period industrial buildings.

locations.name: Arbeia Roman Fort
locations.setting: A reconstructed Roman fort and supply base at South Shields, with a rebuilt gatehouse, barrack blocks and commanding officer's house on the original foundations.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Ardverikie Estate
locations.setting: Scottish baronial house of the 1870s on Loch Laggan with panelled interiors, stable courtyard, estate cottages, farm buildings, moor, forest and loch shore.
locations.known_for: Monarch of the Glen, The Crown, Mrs Brown, Salmon Fishing in the Yemen
locations.suitability: The estate runs a film and television locations page and takes production enquiries for house, grounds and wider estate.

locations.name: Assembly Rooms
locations.setting: Category A-listed Georgian assembly rooms on George Street in Edinburgh's New Town, council-owned and hired out for events, conferences and film shoots.

locations.name: Audley End House and Gardens
locations.setting: Jacobean mansion near Saffron Walden remodelled in the eighteenth century, with state rooms, a service wing and Capability Brown parkland.

locations.name: Avoncroft Museum of Historic Buildings
locations.setting: 19-acre open-air museum near Bromsgrove with 30 rescued historic buildings including a medieval town house, a 1940s prefab and a working windmill, available for commercial filming.

locations.name: Ayr Racecourse
locations.setting: Scotland's principal racecourse on the Ayrshire coast, with grandstands, a parade ring and parkland hired for events between race meetings.

locations.name: Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art
locations.setting: Nineteen fifties Baltic Flour Mills on the Gateshead quayside converted into a gallery, keeping the brick silo walls, with tall open galleries and a rooftop river view.
locations.suitability: Baltic hires out galleries, riverside spaces and the rooftop for events and shoots.

locations.name: Barbican Centre
locations.setting: Brutalist arts complex of concrete terraces, lakeside walkways, a conservatory, foyers and concert halls, set inside the Barbican housing estate in the City.

locations.name: Barnsley Metrodome
locations.setting: Sports and leisure complex in Barnsley from 1989 with a sports hall, dressing rooms and a ten-pin bowling centre that hosts international tournaments.

locations.name: Barrowland Ballroom
locations.setting: Category B listed 1930s dance hall and live music venue in Glasgow's East End, with its original sprung floor and a neon sign facade on the Gallowgate.

locations.name: Battersea Arts Centre
locations.setting: Former Battersea town hall in south London: grand hall with a rebuilt lattice ceiling, council chamber, tiled corridors, staircases and small studio rooms.
locations.known_for: Slade in Flame, Portrait Artist of the Year

locations.name: Battersea Power Station
locations.setting: Decommissioned Thames-side coal power station with four white chimneys, its turbine halls and boiler house now restored inside a mixed-use redevelopment.
locations.known_for: The King's Speech, Children of Men
locations.facilities: Event spaces include Control Room A (max 220 people), the Arcade Food Hall (max 600) and The Cinema in The Power Station (max 350).

locations.name: Beamish Museum
locations.setting: Open-air museum in County Durham recreating a Georgian, Victorian and 1950s north-east England landscape with a working colliery, tramway, town street and farm.

locations.name: Belfast Castle
locations.setting: Scottish baronial mansion of 1870 on the slopes of Cave Hill, with a serpentine stair, panelled reception rooms, cellar restaurant and terraced gardens over the city.
locations.suitability: Belfast City Council hires out the castle and publishes separate guidance for filming on its property.

locations.name: Belfast City Hall
locations.setting: Baroque Revival city hall of 1906 in central Belfast, with a domed rotunda, marble entrance hall, council chamber and banqueting hall.
locations.facilities: Great Hall: theatre 500, round dinner 400 (40 tables), standing reception 500. Banqueting Hall: theatre 225, round dinner 150 (15 tables), standing reception 250. Reception Room: theatre 100, round dinner 80 (8 tables), standing reception 120. Event spaces are on the first floor and accessible to visitors with disabilities.
locations.logistics: Booking requires a completed booking form at least eight weeks before the proposed event; applications are reviewed monthly by the Strategic Policy and Resources Committee.

locations.name: Belfast Harbour Studios
locations.setting: Purpose-built film and television studio complex on Belfast's Queen's Island, including the former Paint Hall shipyard building converted into sound stages.

locations.name: Bentwaters Parks
locations.setting: Former USAF cold war air base near Woodbridge with hardened aircraft shelters, a control tower, bunkers, hangars, runways and empty roads.

locations.name: Big Pit National Coal Museum
locations.setting: Former working coal mine at Blaenavon in the South Wales valleys, part of a World Heritage industrial landscape, with pithead buildings and an underground tour.
locations.suitability: Written permission is required before using images or film in any commercial capacity; commercial shoots must be arranged in advance with the in-house team (venuehire@museumwales.ac.uk). Flash, camera supports and selfie sticks are not permitted without prior permission, and areas marked 'no photography or filming' are off-limits.

locations.name: Birmingham Hippodrome
locations.setting: Edwardian theatre in Birmingham's Southside, a working proscenium arch auditorium with a fly tower, used for touring opera, ballet and musicals.

locations.name: Black Country Living Museum
locations.setting: Open air museum on a former colliery site in Dudley with a rebuilt 1930s high street, canal arm and boat dock, back to back houses, pit head and working workshops.
locations.suitability: The museum runs a filming and photography page and takes production bookings for its streets and buildings.

locations.name: Black Hangar Studios
locations.setting: A converted airfield hangar studio in Hampshire with one of the UK's largest uninterrupted sound stages and a permanent green-screen cyclorama.
locations.known_for: Dumbo, Jeepers Creepers: Reborn, Dance Monsters
locations.facilities: Main stage of 32,000 sq ft of open, flexible space with the UK's largest permanent green-screen cyclorama; large workshops for set construction and prop fabrication; production offices; post-production (editing, sound, finishing); back lot for exterior sets; additional office units and parking.
locations.logistics: Address: Lasham Airfield, Alton, Hampshire GU34 5SR; about 45 minutes from west London and Heathrow Airport (own site).

locations.name: Blackness Castle
locations.setting: Fifteenth century artillery fortress shaped like a ship on the south shore of the Forth, with a curtain wall, tower house, prison pit and a stone pier.
locations.suitability: Historic Environment Scotland handles commercial filming at its sites.

locations.name: Blaenavon Ironworks
locations.setting: UNESCO World Heritage ironworks in the South Wales valleys with ruined blast furnaces, a water balance tower and rows of furnished workers' cottages, hired for filming and photography.

locations.name: Bletchley Park
locations.setting: Wartime codebreaking site at Milton Keynes with a Victorian mansion, wooden huts, brick blocks, a lake and period offices kept as they were in the 1940s.

locations.name: Blists Hill Victorian Town
locations.setting: Reconstructed late Victorian industrial town in the Ironbridge Gorge with a high street of shops, a bank, chapel, foundry, blast furnaces, canal inclined plane and mine.
locations.suitability: The Ironbridge Gorge Museum Trust offers venue hire and handles filming requests at its sites.

locations.name: Bluebell Railway
locations.setting: 11-mile heritage steam railway through the Sussex Weald with three Victorian stations and large carriage sheds also used for indoor and green-screen filming.

locations.name: Bluewater
locations.setting: Large shopping centre in a chalk quarry near Dartford with three malls, glazed roofs, service corridors, lakes and extensive car parks.

locations.name: Bo'ness and Kinneil Railway
locations.setting: Preserved standard gauge line on the Forth with a rebuilt Victorian station, signal boxes, goods yard, steam and diesel stock and a large covered museum shed.
locations.suitability: The railway publishes a filming page and takes location enquiries for the station, trains and lineside.

locations.name: Bodleian Library
locations.setting: Historic university library in central Oxford with the vaulted Divinity School and Duke Humfrey's medieval reading room, hired for filming by arrangement.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
locations.price_note: Filming from GBP 500 per hour plus VAT for crews of up to 10 people, GBP 1,000 per hour plus VAT for crews of 10 or more; rate varies with crew size and equipment (own site)
locations.suitability: Filming is generally restricted to before 8:30am or after closing hours; daytime filming in Duke Humfrey's Library is limited to 7:30-8:30am on weekday mornings. All lighting must be LED and no smoke, atmosphere haze or hot works are permitted. Large-scale filming requires at least 3 months' notice; filming involving collection items requires at least 28 days' notice, with risk assessment paperwork due 1 month ahead. Public liability insurance is required and filming must be under the Bodleian's own contract terms.
locations.logistics: No water or electricity supply on site, so crews must bring their own generators. Public parking is arranged separately via Location Oxfordshire. The Bodleian has no jurisdiction over Radcliffe Square; filming there needs separate permission from Brasenose College.

locations.name: Bodmin Jail
locations.setting: Georgian county gaol of 1779 in granite, part restored as an attraction and part left as roofless ruin, with cell wings, barrel vaulted corridors and an execution pit.
locations.suitability: The site takes venue hire and event bookings across the restored and ruined wings.

locations.name: Borough Market
locations.setting: Covered Victorian food market south of London Bridge with wrought-iron arcades, market stalls and surrounding cobbled streets.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban, Bridget Jones's Diary
locations.suitability: Personal photography and small content-creator crews (handheld, max 2 people) do not need permission. Professional crews or commercial filming need written permission from the Market with at least 14 days notice, via a request form covering purpose, crew size, equipment and dates/times. Long-lensed cameras and tripods are not permitted for personal photography.
locations.logistics: Address: 8 Southwark Street, London SE1 1TL.

locations.name: Bourne Woods
locations.setting: Forestry England woodland near Farnham with a natural bowl clearing used for battle scenes and forest exteriors, bookable through the national filming team.

locations.name: Bovingdon Airfield Studios
locations.setting: Studio complex on a former RAF airfield near Hemel Hempstead with sound stages, workshops, offices and large open backlots on the runway and taxiways.

locations.name: Bradford-on-Avon Tithe Barn
locations.setting: 14th-century stone tithe barn built for Shaftesbury Abbey, its vast timber roof space used as a medieval interior for filming.

locations.name: Bray Studios
locations.setting: A riverside Thames-valley studio near Windsor with over 95,000 sq ft of stages, a backlot and a long history of horror and blockbuster production.
locations.known_for: The Rings of Power, Dracula, Kingsman, Rocketman, Alien, The Mummy
locations.facilities: Over 95,000 sq ft (8,900 sq m) of purpose-built stages across a 33-acre site; 10 workshops and 45,000 sq ft (4,300 sq m) of office/support space; 4-acre backlot; parking for around 600 vehicles.
locations.logistics: Address: Windsor Road, Water Oakley SL4 5UJ; 25 minutes from Heathrow Airport, 55 minutes from Soho (own site).

locations.name: Bressingham Steam and Gardens
locations.setting: Steam preservation site near Diss with narrow-gauge railways, a collection of traction engines and steam locomotives, and surrounding show gardens.

locations.name: Brighton Dome
locations.setting: Former royal stables next to the Royal Pavilion, converted into a domed concert hall with a corn exchange and a studio theatre in the same block.

locations.name: Bristol Old Vic
locations.setting: Working eighteenth-century theatre in central Bristol, one of the oldest continuously operating in the English-speaking world, with a Georgian auditorium and backstage spaces.

locations.name: Brocket Hall
locations.setting: Palladian house of 1760 near Welwyn with a painted saloon, ballroom, lake and Paine bridge, set in an estate with golf courses and woodland belts.
locations.known_for: The Queen, Johnny English Reborn, Night of the Demon

locations.name: Brodsworth Hall and Gardens
locations.setting: Preserved Victorian country house near Doncaster with original 1860s interiors and terraced Italianate gardens, let for costume drama filming.
locations.known_for: Darkest Hour, Testament of Youth, Victoria

locations.name: Brooklands Museum
locations.setting: Site of the world's first purpose-built motor racing circuit near Weybridge, with a surviving banked track section, aircraft hangars and early aviation and motoring exhibits.
locations.price_note: Charge applies for filming and photography on site; rates are discussed once an enquiry is made (own site)
locations.facilities: Edwardian Grade II listed Clubhouse (1907); Aircraft Factory hangar with a Wellington Bomber; Flight Shed with a Hawker Harrier and Sopwith Camel; Barnes Wallis-designed Stratosphere Chamber (1946); Aircraft Park including Concorde; Jackson Shed with historic F1 cars; Racing Sheds; the original 1907 motor racing circuit.
locations.suitability: Filming welcomed outside opening hours where possible; daytime filming possible on weekdays but no filming inside the Museum at weekends. Crews must hold public liability insurance of at least GBP 10m and provide risk assessments, method statements and a signed contract. Requests should be made at least two weeks in advance.
locations.logistics: Located between Weybridge and Byfleet, Surrey, a few minutes from Junction 10 of the M25 and the A3, about 30 minutes by train from London Waterloo. Free on-site parking, a cafe, and areas usable as dressing rooms, green rooms and production offices; catering can be arranged for out-of-hours filming.

locations.name: Brown's Hotel
locations.setting: Mayfair townhouse hotel behind a row of Georgian facades, with panelled drawing rooms, a fireplace lounge, small private dining rooms and stair halls.

locations.name: Butser Ancient Farm
locations.setting: Open-air archaeological site near Chalton with reconstructed Iron Age roundhouses, a Roman villa and Anglo-Saxon buildings set in working farmland.

locations.name: Camden Market
locations.setting: Sprawling market complex of stalls, warehouses and canalside units in Camden Town, licensed for professional filming through its own film office.

locations.name: Canary Wharf
locations.setting: Privately managed estate of high rise offices, dock water, malls, roof gardens and underground service roads in east London, with an in house filming team.

locations.name: Cardiff Castle
locations.setting: City centre castle combining a Roman wall, a Norman shell keep on its motte and Victorian Gothic revival apartments by William Burges, with a large green interior court.
locations.suitability: The castle publishes a filming page covering the Norman keep, grounds and Burges interiors.

locations.name: Cardington Studios
locations.setting: Two former airship sheds near Bedford converted into some of the largest indoor filming spaces in Europe, used for blockbuster sets and stadium-tour rehearsals.
locations.facilities: Main stages 1-4: one undivided space 248 m x 55 m, 55 m (180 ft) to roof pitch, 37.3 m (122.5 ft) to eaves, divisible for pricing; Stage 5 (first floor, blacked out): 32 m x 16 m x 10 m high. Refurbished production offices, health and safety office, medic room, workshops, holding areas, catering and acres of external parking and backlot space.
locations.suitability: Own site describes it as one of the largest indoor spaces in Europe, used for blockbuster film productions and large stadium-tour rehearsals.
locations.logistics: Hangar 2, Cardington Airfield, Bedford MK42 0TF (own site).

locations.name: Castell Coch
locations.setting: Victorian Gothic Revival castle above Cardiff, rebuilt from a ruined 13th-century fortress with richly decorated interiors, hired out for filming.

locations.name: Castle Acre Priory
locations.setting: Ruined Cluniac priory in a Norfolk village with an ornate carved west front and extensive monastic remains, used as a fantasy filming location.

locations.name: Castlefield
locations.setting: Mixed historic and modern quarter of central Manchester with a Roman fort site, canals, red-brick Victorian warehouses and a disused railway viaduct alongside glass towers.
locations.known_for: Peaky Blinders, Fool Me Once, World on Fire, The Irregulars, Cold Feet, Coronation Street

locations.name: Celtic Manor Resort
locations.setting: Large resort hotel above the Usk valley with a glass atrium lobby, ballrooms, a convention centre, spa, lodges and three golf courses on a two thousand acre estate.
locations.suitability: The resort publishes a meetings and events section listing its hireable spaces.

locations.name: Charlestown Harbour
locations.setting: Small Georgian-era dry-dock harbour near St Austell, still used by tall ships, with quayside cottages and period pilchard cellars around the basin.
locations.facilities: Inner Harbour is 151m long, 33m wide and 5m deep, holding over 5,400 sq m of water; vessels up to 75m length and 4m draught can sail in directly from the open sea; described as one of the largest marine filming tanks in the world with access to open sea.
locations.suitability: Unspoilt South Cornish coastline location providing shelter from adverse marine conditions, enabling 'at sea' footage to be shot in rough weather; marine coordination, rigging services and prop hire available on site.
locations.logistics: Address: Charlestown Harbour, St Austell, Cornwall PL25 3NT.

locations.name: Chatsworth House
locations.setting: Baroque country house in the Derwent valley with painted hall, sculpture gallery, state apartments, stable block and a thousand acre park laid out by Capability Brown.
locations.known_for: Pride and Prejudice, The Duchess, Peaky Blinders
locations.suitability: The estate publishes a location page for film, television and stills and takes production enquiries.

locations.name: Cheddar Gorge
locations.setting: England's largest gorge, with 130-metre limestone cliffs, show caves and a clifftop footpath managed as part of the Longleat Estate.

locations.name: Chiltern Open Air Museum
locations.setting: 45-acre open-air museum of rescued historic buildings near Chalfont St Peter, from rustic farmsteads and Victorian cottages to wartime Nissen huts, hired out for filming.
locations.known_for: Call the Midwife, Downton Abbey, Midsomer Murders, Grantchester, Taskmaster

locations.name: Chiswick House and Gardens
locations.setting: Palladian villa and 18th-century gardens in west London with courtyards and a walled kitchen garden, booked through Film Fixer for filming.
locations.known_for: Bridgerton, The Sandman, The Great, You, Red White & Royal Blue, Pennyworth

locations.name: Chiswick Park
locations.setting: A landscaped west London business park of glass office buildings around a lake, promoted by its operator as a filming location for adverts and corporate shoots.

locations.name: Christ Church, Oxford
locations.setting: Oxford college and cathedral with Tom Quad, a hammerbeam dining hall, cloisters, the Bodley staircase and a meadow running to the river.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, The Golden Compass

locations.name: City Halls and Old Fruitmarket
locations.setting: Victorian civic hall in the Merchant City with a galleried recital room and, alongside it, the cast iron Old Fruitmarket with its balconies and market signage kept intact.
locations.suitability: Both halls are available for hire through Glasgow Life.

locations.name: City Varieties Music Hall
locations.setting: Victorian music hall in Leeds city centre, built 1865 and little altered since, with an intact period auditorium once used for the BBC's The Good Old Days.
locations.known_for: Ghost Stories, Testament of Youth, The ABC Murders

locations.name: Claridge's
locations.setting: Mayfair hotel with an art deco lobby and staircase, mirrored ballroom, panelled suites and private event rooms, hired for events and shoots.

locations.name: Clifton Suspension Bridge
locations.setting: Brunel designed chain suspension bridge of 1864 spanning the Avon Gorge seventy five metres above the river, with Egyptian style towers and vaulted abutments.
locations.suitability: The bridge trust publishes filming and photography guidance and handles requests for the bridge and its vaults.

locations.name: Cliveden
locations.setting: Italianate mansion above the Thames at Taplow, now a hotel, with formal parterre gardens, a walled garden and woodland grounds managed by the National Trust.

photo.author: Antony McCallum. The original uploader was Wyrdlight at English Wikipedia.

locations.name: Colne Valley Railway
locations.setting: Heritage standard-gauge railway on the Essex-Suffolk border with a rebuilt country station, signal box and steam and diesel locomotives.
locations.suitability: The railway can be used as a period setting for filming, using steam trains and staff in period costumes, or as a modern railway environment using contemporary rolling stock (steam and diesel locomotives, DMUs and InterCity 125 trains), avoiding the need to film on the national network.
locations.logistics: Large on-site car park; good access for lorries and vans.

locations.name: Conway Hall
locations.setting: Grade II listed ethical society hall in Holborn with a main hall, library and characterful corridors and basements hired out for filming.

locations.name: Conwy Suspension Bridge
locations.setting: 1826 Thomas Telford suspension bridge across the Conwy estuary in north Wales, beside Conwy Castle, with its original tollhouse kept furnished.

locations.name: Coombe Abbey Hotel
locations.setting: Former Cistercian abbey turned country house hotel outside Coventry, with cloister remains, a Victorian wing, medieval style banqueting rooms and five hundred acres of parkland.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes conference and private hire pages for its rooms and grounds.

locations.name: Copper Box Arena
locations.setting: A copper clad multi sport arena built for the 2012 Olympics in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, with a sprung floor hall hired for filming, sport and events.
locations.facilities: Multi-purpose arena (capacity 7,500) with hospitality suites, VIP lounges, private bars, meeting rooms for breakout spaces, and an open-air plaza (Eastcross Square). Located in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Stratford, East London.

locations.name: Corinthia London
locations.setting: Hotel in the former Metropole building at Whitehall Place with a domed lobby, chandelier atrium, marble spa and Victorian facades near the river.

locations.name: Cotswold Airport
locations.setting: Former RAF airfield near Cirencester with active runways, hangars and a stored Boeing 747 available for interior and exterior aviation filming.
locations.facilities: Runways, hangars, Boeing 747 'Negus' for exterior and interior filming, secure discrete site

locations.name: Cotswold Farm Park
locations.setting: A working rare breeds farm in the Cotswolds founded by broadcaster Adam Henson, with barns, fields and animal enclosures across open hillside.

locations.name: Coventry Transport Museum
locations.setting: Museum in central Coventry holding one of the largest collections of British-made cars, motorcycles and bicycles, with large open display halls.
locations.price_note: Midweek day delegate rate from GBP 45.00 per person excluding VAT, including conference room hire, three tea/coffee services, buffet lunch and museum entry (own site)
locations.facilities: Hire spaces: Bettmann Suite (60 people), Starley Suite (150), Swift Centre (30) and Mezzanine Gallery (200). Onsite Baxter Cafe seats 120. Equipment includes wifi, projectors, video equipment, PA and sound systems, flipcharts and whiteboards.
locations.logistics: 3 onsite parking spaces plus 300 offsite spaces; city centre location around a 15-minute walk from the train station; served by buses 17, 27 and 49.

locations.name: Crich Tramway Village
locations.setting: National Tramway Museum built as a period street in a limestone quarry, with a working tram line, cobbles, gas lamps, shopfronts, pub and large depot sheds.
locations.suitability: The museum publishes a photography and filming page and hires the street and trams to productions.

locations.name: Cromford Mills
locations.setting: Arkwright's water powered cotton mill complex of 1771, the earliest of its kind, with gritstone mill blocks, wheel pits, leats, yards and a walled site by the Derwent.
locations.suitability: The Arkwright Society hires out mill buildings, yards and spaces on the World Heritage site.

locations.name: Crossness Pumping Station
locations.setting: A Victorian sewage pumping station in south east London, its ornate cast iron interior housing a restored beam engine and hired for filming.

locations.name: Crumlin Road Gaol
locations.setting: Former Victorian prison in north Belfast, closed in 1996, with its radial cell wings, a tunnel to the courthouse and an execution chamber preserved for tours and hire.

locations.name: Cutty Sark
locations.setting: A preserved nineteenth century tea clipper in dry dock at Greenwich, its decks, rigging and cargo hold open for events and location hire.

locations.name: Dean Clough
locations.setting: Former Crossley's carpet mill complex in Halifax, a chain of Victorian stone mill buildings around courtyards now used as offices, galleries and studios.

locations.name: Delapre Abbey
locations.setting: Country house on the site of a Cluniac nunnery just south of Northampton, with Georgian reception rooms, a stable courtyard, servants quarters and walled gardens.
locations.suitability: The house publishes venue hire information covering rooms, courtyard and grounds.

locations.name: Discovery Museum
locations.setting: A free museum in Newcastle housed in Blandford House, an Edwardian former Co-operative Wholesale Society warehouse, with galleries and a turbine ship on display.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Discovery Point and RRS Discovery
locations.setting: Antarctic research ship of 1901 moored on the Tay beside a visitor centre, with rigging, wardroom, cabins, engine room and galley kept as they were.
locations.suitability: Dundee Heritage Trust offers venue hire at Discovery Point and on board the ship.

locations.name: Doune Castle
locations.setting: Late fourteenth century courtyard castle with a gatehouse tower, great hall with open timber roof, kitchen tower and a walled yard above the River Teith.
locations.known_for: Monty Python and the Holy Grail, Outlander, Game of Thrones
locations.suitability: Historic Environment Scotland handles commercial filming at its sites.

locations.name: Dovecot Studios
locations.setting: Tapestry studio and gallery in the former Infirmary Street Baths, keeping the top lit swimming hall, viewing balcony and tiled Edwardian entrance.
locations.suitability: The building is hired out for events and shoots through its venue hire team.

locations.name: Dragon Studios
locations.setting: A 100-acre production complex in Welsh countryside near Bridgend, with five sound stages, private woodland, a lake and extensive backlot space.
locations.known_for: Willow, Brave New World, Keeping Faith
locations.facilities: 5 sound-treated stages, 10,000 to 28,000 sq ft; 100,000 sq ft of support space including production offices, workshops and post-production hubs across 9 creative hubs; private woodlands, a lake and extensive backlot; on-site gym; 24/7 security.
locations.logistics: Pencoed, Bridgend, about 20 minutes from Cardiff, within an hour of four Welsh cities (own site).

locations.name: Dreamland Margate
locations.setting: A restored 1920s seaside amusement park on the Kent coast with a wooden scenic railway and vintage rides, used as a period seaside backdrop.
locations.facilities: Spaces include a Grade II* listed Art Deco Ballroom with Boardroom/Foyer, a Vintage Arcade, Retro Roller Rink and Roller Diner with retro-fitted booths, plus vintage rides. Green room facilities, an onsite technical/production team and security on site are provided.
locations.suitability: Pitched for traditional seaside and period scenes; beach filming nearby is possible, with contacts provided for the permits needed to shoot outside the venue.
locations.logistics: 5 minutes from the train station; shops and hotels nearby.

locations.name: Dunsfold Aerodrome
locations.setting: Working airfield and business park in Surrey with runways, taxiways, hangars, a control tower and a Boeing 747 kept on site for filming.
locations.facilities: Hangars, runways and taxiways, a Boeing 747 available exclusively for filming, operational flying
locations.logistics: About 40 miles from central London

locations.name: Durham Cathedral
locations.setting: Norman cathedral of 1093 on a wooded peninsula, with massive incised piers, the earliest rib vault of its scale, a cloister, chapter house and monastic ranges.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, Avengers: Endgame, Elizabeth
locations.suitability: The cathedral documents its filming history and offers venue hire of parts of the building.

locations.name: Dyrham Park
locations.setting: Baroque country house near Bath set in a steep deer park, with panelled state rooms, a Delftware collection and a walled garden.

locations.name: Ealing Studios
locations.setting: The UK's oldest working film studio in west London, with historic 1930s stages, a new net-zero-carbon stage and adjoining production offices.
locations.known_for: Kind Hearts and Coronets, The Lavender Hill Mob, Shaun of the Dead, Downton Abbey
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 14,229 sq ft, new net-zero-carbon stage (opening 2025). Stage 2: 125 x 75 ft, 34 ft working height, water tank 25 x 20 x 7 ft, built 1931. Stage 3: 85 x 70 ft, 32 ft working height, water tank 30 x 15 x 7.5 ft, built 1933. Stage 4: 85 x 75 ft, 32 ft working height, water tank 35 x 20 x 7.5 ft, built 1933. Stage 5: 42 x 22 ft, 16 ft working height, small-format stage for interviews, model and pack shots. Total of five stages, 37,000 sq ft. Production offices (25,500 sq ft across two buildings), workshops, hair and makeup, prop storage.
locations.logistics: Address: Ealing Green, London W5 5EP; 15-20 minutes from Heathrow Airport and central London (own site).

locations.name: Eden Project
locations.setting: Environmental attraction built into a former china clay pit near St Austell, with two giant geodesic biome domes housing rainforest and Mediterranean planting.

locations.name: Elstree Studios
locations.setting: Film and television studio complex at Borehamwood with several sound stages, dating back to the 1920s and long used for major British productions.
locations.known_for: Star Wars, Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
locations.facilities: 9 film and TV stages with over 90,000 sq ft of filming space plus a backlot. The two George Lucas stages are 15,770 sq ft each with a height of 50 ft; the Platinum Stages (3 and 4) add 34,000 sq ft. On-site Production Village, workshops, production offices, dressing rooms and make-up rooms.
locations.logistics: Located at Shenley Road, Borehamwood, Herts WD6 1JG, 20 minutes from central London.

locations.name: Ely Cathedral
locations.setting: Norman cathedral above the fens with a long nave, the octagon lantern tower, Lady Chapel and monastic buildings, used to double for larger abbeys.
locations.known_for: The Crown, The King's Speech, Elizabeth: The Golden Age, The Other Boleyn Girl
locations.suitability: Experienced with productions of over 500 cast and crew as well as small television recordings

locations.name: English Institute of Sport Sheffield
locations.setting: Indoor multi-sport arena in Sheffield with a 200m track, several sports halls and a large gym, built as a national athletics training base.

locations.name: Epping Forest
locations.setting: Ancient wood pasture of 6,000 acres on the north east edge of London with pollarded hornbeams, heath, ponds and green rides, managed by the City of London.
locations.known_for: Monty Python and the Holy Grail

locations.name: Epping Ongar Railway
locations.setting: Preserved former Central line branch in Essex with country stations at North Weald and Ongar, a signal box, steam and diesel stock and heritage buses.

locations.name: Exeter College, Oxford
locations.setting: City-centre Oxford college with a Gothic Revival chapel, front quad and gardens on Turl Street, used as a filming location for period and detective drama.
