locations.name: Explosion Museum of Naval Firepower
locations.setting: Former Royal Navy armaments depot at Priddy's Hard, Gosport, with magazine buildings and quaysides on Portsmouth Harbour, welcoming TV, radio and commercial filming.

locations.name: Fairfield Halls
locations.setting: Refurbished 1960s concert hall and theatre complex in central Croydon with a 1,800 seat auditorium, studio theatre, foyers and terrazzo staircases.

locations.name: Falkirk Wheel
locations.setting: A rotating boat lift connecting two canals near Falkirk, managed by Scottish Canals with a visitor centre, basin and towpaths around it.

locations.name: FirstStage Studios
locations.setting: A dockside studio complex in Leith, Edinburgh, with stages up to 24,000 sq ft, workshops and production offices on an 8.9-acre site.
locations.facilities: Multiple stages from 9,752 to 24,000 sq ft, up to 115,000 sq ft of stage space in total; around 35,000 sq ft of workshops across four workrooms including a mill; 18,000 sq ft of flexible production office space; 300+ vehicle parking; access for full-size articulated trucks.
locations.logistics: Leith, Edinburgh, near The Shore; 15 minutes from Edinburgh Waverley, 35 minutes from Edinburgh Airport (own site).

locations.name: Fleet Air Arm Museum
locations.setting: Naval aviation museum on the working airbase at RNAS Yeovilton with historic aircraft, a Concorde and hangar interiors, welcoming TV, radio and commercial filming.

locations.name: Fort Amherst
locations.setting: Napoleonic-era fortification above Chatham with brick ramparts, gun batteries and a network of tunnels cut into the chalk.

locations.name: Foxton Locks
locations.setting: Grade II listed staircase of ten locks, the longest flight in Britain, on the Grand Union Canal, with a former inclined boat lift and towpath open for filming under Canal and River Trust permit.

photo.author: The original uploader was StephenDawson at English Wikipedia.

locations.name: Freemasons' Hall
locations.setting: Art deco masonic headquarters in Covent Garden with the Grand Temple, bronze doors, long processional corridors and marble stairs, released to crews on non event days.
locations.known_for: Assassin's Creed, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Hustle
locations.suitability: Filming and photography in the Grand Temple, corridors and staircases when the building is not in ceremonial use

locations.name: Freshwater West
locations.setting: Wide Atlantic surf beach backed by dunes and low cliffs on the open Pembrokeshire coast.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1, Robin Hood (2010), Their Finest

locations.name: Fulham Palace
locations.setting: Moated former residence of the Bishop of London beside the Thames at Putney, combining Tudor courtyards, Georgian rooms and walled gardens available for filming.
locations.facilities: Tudor courtyard, Georgian rooms and 13 acres of garden.
locations.suitability: Welcomes large filming projects as well as smaller photoshoots. Interior locations include the Great Hall, Chapel, Bishop Porteus's Library and drawing rooms.
locations.logistics: Described as easily accessible by London public transport.

locations.name: Gainsborough Old Hall
locations.setting: One of England's best-preserved medieval manor houses, in the town of Gainsborough, with a great hall and timber-framed rooms used for period filming.

locations.name: Garden Studios
locations.setting: A B-Corp certified studio campus in west London with eight sound stages plus a dedicated LED virtual production volume.
locations.facilities: 8 sound stages, 5,000 to 23,000 sq ft: Iris Stage 1 23,414 sq ft (10.7 m), Rose Stage 1 15,207 sq ft (7.1 m), Orchid Stage 1 15,026 sq ft (9.9 m), Orchid Stage 2 12,863 sq ft (9.9 m), Iris Stage 2 11,819 sq ft (10.7 m), Orchid Stage 3 7,187 sq ft (9.6 m), Iris Stage 3 5,005 sq ft (10.7 m), all rated NR25 for sound. Virtual production LED volume 24 m wide by 5 m high, soundproofed ceiling, up to 250 kVA power.
locations.logistics: Address: 21 Waxlow Road, London NW10 7NU (own site).

locations.name: Geevor Tin Mine
locations.setting: Former working tin mine on the Cornish coast near Pendeen, with headframes, processing mills, underground tunnels and dressing floors preserved as a museum.

locations.name: Glasgow Royal Concert Hall
locations.setting: City centre concert hall at the top of Buchanan Street with a two thousand seat main auditorium, wide foyers, a strathclyde suite and back of house corridors.
locations.suitability: Glasgow Life hires the hall and its foyers out for events and filming.

locations.name: Gleneagles
locations.setting: Nineteen twenties country hotel in Perthshire with marble halls, a ballroom, panelled lounges, spa, stables and three golf courses on an eight hundred acre estate.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes an event spaces and venue hire section covering its ballroom, private rooms and grounds.

locations.name: Glenfinnan Viaduct
locations.setting: Curved 21-arch concrete railway viaduct of 1901 carrying the West Highland Line above the head of Loch Shiel.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets, Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

locations.name: Goodwood Estate
locations.setting: Sussex estate of 11,000 acres with a Regency house, motor circuit, aerodrome, racecourse, farm buildings and downland, handled by an in house locations team.

locations.name: Grand Opera House
locations.setting: Frank Matcham theatre of 1895 with an oriental themed auditorium, gilded boxes, elephant head consoles, horseshoe balconies and a restored Victorian foyer.
locations.suitability: The theatre publishes a venue hire page covering the auditorium and function rooms.

locations.name: Great Central Railway
locations.setting: Double track heritage main line between Loughborough and Leicester North with four period stations, signal boxes, a locomotive shed, bridges and open lineside.
locations.suitability: The railway publishes a filming page and takes bookings for stations, trains and lineside work.

locations.name: Great Point Studios Wales
locations.setting: A Cardiff sound-stage complex at St Mellons (formerly Seren Stiwdios / Pinewood Wales), with seven stages and dedicated wardrobe, mill and scenic-dock space.
locations.facilities: 7 stages: Stage 1 21,000 sq ft, Stage 2 19,200 sq ft, Stage 3 16,000 sq ft, Stage 4 16,500 sq ft, plus stages 5-7 (20,000-23,000 sq ft) opening 2026. Support space: 5,000 sq ft wardrobe, 8,000 sq ft offices, 12,000 sq ft scenic/props, 15,000 sq ft mill space; loading docks and crew/truck parking.
locations.logistics: Wentloog Avenue, St Mellons, Cardiff CF3 2GH (own site).

locations.name: Green Park Station
locations.setting: Former Midland Railway terminus of 1870 in Bath with a curved iron and glass trainshed, a Georgian style stone frontage and brick vaults beneath the platforms.
locations.suitability: The trainshed and vaults are hired out for markets and events, and the station appears in the Bath Film Office location database.

locations.name: Grim's Dyke
locations.setting: Norman Shaw country house of 1872 at Harrow Weald, now a hotel, with oak panelling, a galleried music room, terrace and wooded grounds on the edge of London.

locations.name: Guildhall
locations.setting: Medieval great hall of the City of London with a stone porch, crypts, art gallery and the remains of a Roman amphitheatre below, hired for events and filming.

locations.name: Hackney Empire
locations.setting: Frank Matcham variety theatre of 1901 in east London with a gilded auditorium, boxes, orchestra pit, fly tower and terracotta facade.
locations.known_for: The British Soap Awards, Opportunity Knocks

locations.name: Hackney Town Hall
locations.setting: Art deco civic building of 1937 with marble entrance hall, council chamber, assembly hall and panelled committee rooms, hired out through the council's venue team.

locations.name: Haddon Hall
locations.setting: Fortified medieval and Tudor manor above the Wye with a banqueting hall, long gallery, chapel with wall paintings, kitchens and terraced gardens, little altered since 1600.
locations.known_for: Jane Eyre, The Princess Bride, The Other Boleyn Girl, Elizabeth
locations.suitability: The hall keeps a film and television page and takes location enquiries for house and grounds.

locations.name: Halifax town centre
locations.setting: West Yorkshire mill town with Georgian townhouses, a Victorian arcade, cobbled streets, pubs and a working indoor market, used repeatedly for period and present-day drama.
locations.known_for: Ackley Bridge, Gentleman Jack, Last Tango in Halifax

locations.name: Hatfield House
locations.setting: Jacobean house of 1611 with a marble hall, carved staircase and long gallery, next to the surviving wing of the Tudor Old Palace and formal gardens.
locations.known_for: Batman, Shakespeare in Love, Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, Hot Fuzz

locations.name: Heaton Park
locations.setting: Large historic park on the edge of Manchester with Heaton Hall, play areas, a boating lake, golf course and open grounds adaptable for period or contemporary scenes.
locations.known_for: Coronation Street, It's a Sin, Brassic, Ridley, Bancroft

locations.name: Hedsor House
locations.setting: Georgian house above the Thames near Taplow with a domed entrance hall, ballroom, marble staircase and private parkland, hired exclusively.

locations.name: Here East
locations.setting: A converted Olympic press and broadcast centre beside the canal in Hackney Wick, now offices, television studios and workshop space.
locations.facilities: Campus totals 1.2 million sq ft of flexible space; around 6,500 people work and study on site.

locations.name: Hever Castle
locations.setting: Moated Tudor castle, childhood home of Anne Boleyn, with panelled rooms, a drawbridge, Italian garden, lake and Edwardian Tudor style wing.

locations.name: HMS Caroline
locations.setting: First World War Royal Navy light cruiser preserved as a museum ship in Belfast's Titanic Quarter, with its decks and machinery spaces open for TV, radio and commercial filming.

locations.name: HMS Trincomalee
locations.setting: Britain's oldest floating warship, an 1817 frigate preserved at Hartlepool's Maritime Experience quayside, with decks and rigging open for TV, radio and commercial filming.

locations.name: Holy Trinity Church, Goodramgate
locations.setting: Small parish church in a secluded churchyard in York, with fabric from the 12th to 15th centuries, box pews and 1470s stained glass, hired out for period filming.

locations.name: Horniman Museum and Gardens
locations.setting: South London museum with a Victorian conservatory, bandstand, aquarium and 16.5-acre gardens overlooking the city, hired for filming and photography by arrangement.

locations.name: Hylands House
locations.setting: Neoclassical villa near Chelmsford set in landscaped parkland, with Regency reception rooms available for filming and events.

locations.name: Ikon Gallery
locations.setting: Contemporary art gallery in a restored Victorian board school building in Birmingham's Brindleyplace, with galleries, a tower and a public square outside.
locations.facilities: Victorian building with versatile spaces accommodating 10 to 500 guests (own site).

locations.name: Inveraray Jail
locations.setting: Georgian county courthouse and two nineteenth century prison blocks kept as a museum, with cells, airing yards, a semicircular courtroom and original ironwork.

locations.name: Keighley and Worth Valley Railway
locations.setting: Five-mile heritage railway between Keighley and Oxenhope with preserved stations and rolling stock giving period scenes from the 1860s to the 1960s.
locations.known_for: The Railway Children, The Railway Children Return, Peaky Blinders, All Creatures Great and Small

locations.name: Kelvin Hall Studios
locations.setting: A BBC Studioworks television studio built inside the historic Kelvin Hall exhibition building in Glasgow's west end.
locations.known_for: Balamory, Pointless, The Weakest Link, Bridge of Lies, Frankie Boyle's New World Order
locations.facilities: One studio of 10,500 sq ft, 115 x 92 ft, 33.5 ft height, with advanced LED lighting, production, lighting and sound galleries, green rooms, make-up rooms and dressing areas.
locations.logistics: 1445 Argyle St, Glasgow G3 8AW; 15 minutes from Glasgow Central and Queen Street stations, 15 minutes from Glasgow Airport (own site).

locations.name: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum
locations.setting: Red sandstone Edwardian museum and art gallery in Glasgow's West End, with an organ-fitted central hall, galleries and a park setting beside the River Kelvin.
locations.suitability: Commercial filming and sound recording requires permission from Glasgow Life (contact glasgowmuseumshire@glasgowlife.org.uk); personal filming/photography equipment such as selfie sticks, tripods, monopods, gimbals and lighting is not allowed.

locations.name: Kempton Park Racecourse
locations.setting: A Jockey Club racecourse near Sunbury with grandstands, a parade ring and open parkland, hired for filming and photography between race meetings.

locations.name: Kempton Steam Museum
locations.setting: Edwardian water pumping station at Hanworth with two triple expansion steam engines in a tall galleried engine house, plus boiler house, yard and narrow gauge railway.
locations.known_for: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, Holmes & Watson, Poirot

locations.name: Kent & East Sussex Railway
locations.setting: Preserved light railway from Tenterden to Bodiam with period stations, signal boxes, steam locomotives, carriages and ten miles of rural line.

locations.name: Kenwood House
locations.setting: Neoclassical villa on the edge of Hampstead Heath with Robert Adam interiors and a fine art collection, its library and grounds used for period romance filming.
locations.known_for: Belle, Mansfield Park, Notting Hill, Venus

locations.name: King Street, Manchester
locations.setting: 18th and 19th-century shopping street in central Manchester lined with former bank and insurance buildings now used as shops and restaurants.
locations.known_for: Peaky Blinders, Genius, Boiling Point, The Stranger

locations.name: King's College, Cambridge
locations.setting: Cambridge college with a perpendicular Gothic chapel and fan vault, a front court, dining hall and lawns running down to the river and the Backs.

locations.name: Kirby Hall
locations.setting: Part-ruined Elizabethan mansion near Corby with elaborate carved stone facades and formal gardens, used as a country-house filming location.

locations.name: Knebworth House
locations.setting: Gothic revival house with turrets and gargoyles near Stevenage, with Victorian panelled rooms, a banqueting hall, courtyard and 250 acres of park.
locations.known_for: Batman, The King's Speech, Nanny McPhee, Eurovision: The Story of Fire Saga
locations.facilities: On site catering, support staff, out of hours access possible
locations.logistics: 29 miles from London

locations.name: Knole
locations.setting: Sprawling calendar house near Sevenoaks with medieval and Tudor courtyards, a deer park and largely unaltered seventeenth-century state rooms.

locations.name: Komedia Bath
locations.setting: Comedy and music venue in Bath's former Beau Nash cinema, keeping the art deco auditorium, balcony and foyer, with a flat floor main room and bar.
locations.suitability: Available for venue hire and listed in the Bath Film Office location database.

locations.name: Lancaster House
locations.setting: Government mansion beside St James's Palace with a Versailles style staircase hall, a 35 metre long gallery, Louis XIV interiors and a walled garden, run by the FCDO.
locations.known_for: The Crown, The King's Speech, National Treasure: Book of Secrets, Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
locations.logistics: Five minutes on foot from Green Park underground station, central London

locations.name: Landguard Fort
locations.setting: Coastal artillery fort at the mouth of the River Orwell near Felixstowe, rebuilt in stages from the seventeenth to the twentieth century with gun casemates and magazines.

locations.name: Leadenhall Market
locations.setting: Victorian covered market in the City of London with ornate painted ironwork and a glass roof over its cobbled arcades, filmed as the entrance to Diagon Alley.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, Lara Croft: Tomb Raider

locations.name: Leeds Castle
locations.setting: Castle on two islands in a lake near Maidstone with a gatehouse, medieval and 1930s interiors, a maze, aviary and 500 acres of parkland.
locations.known_for: Kind Hearts and Coronets, Doctor Who: The Androids of Tara

locations.name: Leeds Corn Exchange
locations.setting: A domed Victorian former corn trading hall in Leeds city centre, now independent shops and studio units under a cast iron and glass roof.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Jungpionier assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Lincoln Castle
locations.setting: Norman castle in Lincoln whose Victorian separate-system prison building, with its wedge-shaped chapel and cells, is used as a filming location.

locations.name: Lincoln's Inn
locations.setting: Inn of Court off Chancery Lane with a Great Hall, chapel, library, crypt and Georgian squares, hired out for film, television and photography with an on-site recce available.

locations.name: Littledean Jail
locations.setting: A former Victorian prison and police lock up in the Forest of Dean, now a museum with original cell blocks and a courtroom.

locations.name: London Museum of Water & Steam
locations.setting: Victorian waterworks in Brentford with a brick standpipe tower, working beam engines, boiler house, workshops and a cobbled yard, hired for filming and events.
locations.known_for: Doctor Who: Remembrance of the Daleks, The Bill, EastEnders

locations.name: Longcross Studios
locations.setting: A large Surrey studio site on former defence land with stages up to 46,000 sq ft, extensive workshop space and backlot and woodland grounds.
locations.known_for: Skyfall, Doctor Strange, Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Andor
locations.facilities: Over 250,000 sq ft of stage space in stages from 10,000 to 46,000 sq ft; more than 150,000 sq ft of workshops; over 9 acres of backlot; over a mile of controlled road for vehicle work plus woodland filming locations; production offices.
locations.logistics: Longcross, Chertsey KT16 0DS; about 30 miles from London and 20 minutes from Heathrow Airport (own site).

locations.name: Loseley Park
locations.setting: Elizabethan mansion near Guildford with panelled state rooms, a walled garden and surrounding parkland, hired for filming.
locations.known_for: Bridget Jones's Diary, The Wedding Date
locations.facilities: The Great Hall has oak panelling and an imposing fireplace; the Tithe Barn is a restored 17th-century barn with high beams; outdoor grounds and gardens are also available.
locations.suitability: Used as a filming location for period dramas, television series and feature films, citing its architectural heritage and landscapes.

locations.name: Lucknam Park
locations.setting: Palladian country house hotel near Bath approached by a mile long beech avenue, with panelled drawing rooms, a walled garden, equestrian centre and spa in the grounds.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes a meetings and events section covering exclusive use of the house and estate.

locations.name: Lulworth Estate
locations.setting: Twelve thousand acre estate on the Jurassic Coast taking in Durdle Door, Lulworth Cove, chalk cliffs and downland, plus a seventeenth century castle and a walled park.
locations.suitability: The estate publishes a film and photography locations page and issues permits for shoots on its land.

locations.name: Magdalen College, Oxford
locations.setting: Medieval Oxford college with a bell tower, cloisters, deer park and riverside walk, hired for documentary, feature film and photography outside term time.

locations.name: Manchester Central Convention Complex
locations.setting: Former Manchester Central railway station, a wrought iron and glass Victorian train shed converted into an exhibition and convention venue in the city centre.

locations.name: Margam Country Park
locations.setting: Council run estate with a Tudor Gothic mansion of the 1830s, an eighteenth century orangery, abbey ruins, walled gardens, deer park and farm buildings.
locations.suitability: The park offers venue hire of the castle, orangery and grounds.

locations.name: MediaCity Studios
locations.setting: A purpose-built television production hub at MediaCityUK in Salford, formerly branded dock10, with ten studios from small green-screen sets to the UK's largest television studio.
locations.known_for: The Voice (ITV), Match of the Day, Wheel of Fortune
locations.facilities: 10 studios: HQ1 (UK's largest TV studio) 1,165 sq m, audience 1,000; HQ2 710 sq m, audience 600; HQ3 422 sq m, audience 200; HQ4 583 sq m, audience 300; HQ5-7 91-150 sq m; HQ8 green-screen studio 66 sq m; HQ9 orchestral specialist 593 sq m, audience 250; HQ10 audio studio 140 sq m, audience 100. High-speed fibre network and international connectivity; on-site post-production.
locations.logistics: MediaCityUK, Salford Quays, Greater Manchester (own site).

locations.name: MediaCityUK
locations.setting: A media and business campus on Salford Quays with BBC and ITV studios, offices and waterside plazas, including the purpose built Coronation Street set, used for broadcast and corporate productions.

locations.name: Middle Temple
locations.setting: Elizabethan Inn of Court hall with a 1570s double hammer-beam roof, panelled rooms and riverside gardens in the City of London, hired for period and legal-drama filming.
locations.known_for: The Da Vinci Code, Sherlock Holmes, Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason, Pirates of the Caribbean

locations.name: Mitchell Library
locations.setting: Edwardian domed public reference library in Glasgow, one of Europe's largest, with a grand entrance hall, reading rooms and function spaces.
locations.suitability: Glasgow Life states that on occasion staff will be on the premises to film and take photos.
locations.logistics: On-street metered parking (8am-6pm Monday to Friday); NCP car park on India Street about 2 minutes' walk away.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Andeggs~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

locations.name: Museum of Liverpool
locations.setting: Angular white waterfront museum on Liverpool's Pier Head, part of National Museums Liverpool's group of seven sites made available for commercial filming.

locations.name: Museum of the Gorge, Ironbridge
locations.setting: Former riverside warehouse at Ironbridge, part of the Ironbridge Gorge World Heritage Site of 18th century ironworking remains along the River Severn.

locations.name: Music Hall Aberdeen
locations.setting: Granite fronted assembly rooms of 1822 on Union Street, with a Doric portico, a galleried main auditorium and smaller panelled rooms after a full refurbishment.
locations.suitability: Aberdeen Performing Arts hires out its venues, including the Music Hall auditorium and side rooms.

locations.name: National Justice Museum
locations.setting: Former courthouse and prison in Nottingham's Lace Market, with Georgian courtrooms, Victorian cells and a medieval undercroft, now a museum of law and punishment.

locations.name: National Maritime Museum Cornwall
locations.setting: Museum on Falmouth harbour with a timber clad main hall hung with small boats, a lookout tower and an underwater gallery with windows below the waterline.
locations.suitability: The museum publishes a venue hire page covering its main hall, tower and waterside galleries.

locations.name: National Mining Museum Scotland
locations.setting: Preserved Lady Victoria Colliery with winding engine house, headframe, pithead baths, workshops and a surrounding Victorian mining village.
locations.suitability: The museum offers venue hire of its industrial buildings and grounds.

locations.name: National Railway Museum
locations.setting: National collection of historic locomotives and rolling stock in York, housed in former railway engine sheds with large open halls and turntables.
locations.facilities: Great Hall (up to 1,000 guests) displays locomotives including Mallard, Flying Scotsman and a Bullet Train; Station Hall (up to 450 guests) features Royal Carriages; two conference rooms with breakout areas accommodate up to 100 delegates. MIA Accredited Venue.
locations.logistics: Address: Leeman Road, York YO26 4XJ.

locations.name: National Slate Museum
locations.setting: A former slate quarry workshop at Llanberis in Snowdonia, with working machinery, a giant waterwheel and quarrymen's cottages preserved on site.

locations.name: National Space Centre
locations.setting: A space science museum in Leicester with a distinctive rocket tower, planetarium and exhibition halls, available for venue hire including production use.

locations.name: National Waterfront Museum
locations.setting: Industrial history museum in Swansea Marina combining a restored 1901 dockside warehouse with a slate and glass extension, open galleries and quayside outside.
locations.suitability: Amgueddfa Cymru offers venue hire and handles filming enquiries at the site.

locations.name: No.1 Royal Crescent
locations.setting: End-of-terrace Georgian townhouse on Bath's Royal Crescent, restored and furnished as a museum showing how it looked in the 1700s.
locations.facilities: Grand Georgian townhouse with interior rooms furnished in period style, including the Kitchen, Servants' Hall, Withdrawing Room, Dining Room, Lady's Bedroom, Housekeeper's Room and Gentleman's Bedroom.
locations.suitability: Interior rooms and the exterior can both be filmed; green room spaces and facilities are available; the museum can be hired in its entirety so filming is not interrupted by visitors. For filming along the wider Royal Crescent, the site directs enquiries to the Bath Film Office.

locations.name: Nonsuch Mansion
locations.setting: Regency Gothic mansion in Sutton with panelled reception rooms, a service wing with Victorian kitchen and laundry, stable yard and walled garden in public parkland.

locations.name: North Light Film Studios
locations.setting: Converted 19th-century woollen mill near Huddersfield with four sound stages totalling over 19,000 sq ft, plus surrounding mill buildings used as extra sets.
locations.known_for: Happy Valley, Jericho, Jamaica Inn, Where the Heart Is
locations.facilities: Four stages, over 19,000 sq ft total, converted mill buildings for additional sets
locations.logistics: Brookes Mill, Armitage Bridge, Huddersfield HD4 7NR, in a converted 19th-century woollen mill surrounded by the Peak District National Park and Yorkshire Dales countryside.

locations.name: North Yorkshire Moors Railway
locations.setting: Heritage steam railway running 24 miles through the North York Moors, with period stations at Pickering, Goathland and Grosmont used for productions set from the 1930s onward.
locations.known_for: Downton Abbey, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, Heartbeat, Dad's Army (2016)

locations.name: Northern Quarter
locations.setting: Grid of red-brick streets and back alleys in central Manchester whose look has doubled for other cities on screen, from 1940s Brooklyn to 1980s Manhattan.
locations.known_for: Captain America, The Crown, It's a Sin, Boiling Point, Morbius

locations.name: Old Billingsgate
locations.setting: The former Victorian fish market hall on the Thames in the City of London, a column free riverside space hired for productions and functions.
locations.facilities: Three hire spaces: the Grand Hall (47,000 sq ft / 4,300 sqm, sit-down dinner 1,800 / reception 2,500 / conference 1,200), the Gallery (10,000 sq ft / 1,000 sqm, sit-down dinner 250 / reception 500 / conference 300) and the Vault (21,000 sq ft / 2,000 sqm, sit-down dinner 500 / reception 900 / conference 270), each with in-house lighting, sound and production infrastructure.
locations.suitability: Described by the venue as suitable as a filming location; the terrace is presented as a backdrop for brand activations, photoshoots and filming.
locations.logistics: Address 1 Old Billingsgate Walk, London EC3R 6DX; Monument Station about a 4-minute walk away.

locations.name: Old Royal Naval College
locations.setting: Baroque waterfront complex of colonnaded courts and a domed Painted Hall at Greenwich, hired as a stand-in for period Paris, Victorian London and other settings.
locations.known_for: Bridgerton, The Crown, Les Misérables, Thor
locations.suitability: Site accommodates documentary and commercial filming, personal and commercial photography, wedding photography, and news and media; featured in more than 300 productions including Bridgerton, The Crown, Les Miserables and Thor. Location fees charged go towards preserving the site.

locations.name: Old Wardour Castle
locations.setting: Ruined hexagonal 14th-century castle beside a lake in Wiltshire, its courtyard and roofless halls used for medieval action filming.

locations.name: Olympia London
locations.setting: Victorian exhibition halls in west London with a barrel vaulted glass roof, cast iron structure and column free floors, plus newer conference spaces.

locations.name: Orford Ness
locations.setting: Shingle spit on the Suffolk coast used for decades as a secret military testing site, with derelict laboratories, pagoda-shaped test buildings and a lighthouse.

locations.name: Painshill
locations.setting: Eighteenth century landscape garden at Cobham with a serpentine lake, Gothic temple, ruined abbey, crystal grotto, vineyard and long open lawns.
locations.known_for: Dorian Gray, Suffragette, Black Mirror, Bridgerton

locations.name: Papplewick Pumping Station
locations.setting: Victorian waterworks of 1884 with two working beam engines, ornamental ironwork columns, stained glass, a boiler house with six Lancashire boilers and a cooling pond.
locations.suitability: The trust hires the engine house and grounds out for events and filming.

locations.name: Park Hill
locations.setting: Grade II* listed 1960s brutalist housing estate overlooking Sheffield city centre, its long deck-access blocks partly restored and partly awaiting refurbishment.

locations.name: Penshurst Place
locations.setting: Medieval manor house near Tonbridge with a 1341 barons hall under a chestnut roof, state rooms, a walled Tudor garden and estate farmland.
locations.known_for: The Other Boleyn Girl, The Princess Bride, Merlin, The Hollow Crown

locations.name: People's History Museum
locations.setting: The national museum of democracy in Manchester, housed in a former Edwardian hydraulic pumping station beside the River Irwell, with galleries and an events space.

locations.name: Perth Racecourse
locations.setting: A Scottish jump racing course set in Scone Palace Park near Perth, with grandstands and parkland offered for film and television location filming.
locations.suitability: Film and TV location filming advertised as a dedicated service alongside weddings and corporate hire

locations.name: Peterhead Prison Museum
locations.setting: Former Scottish state prison at Peterhead, closed in 2013, with its original cell blocks, exercise yard and perimeter wall open as a museum.
locations.facilities: Spaces include A Hall, the Segregation Block, the Booking In Office, the hospital wing, laundry and a woodwork area; over 125 years of prison history as backdrop.
locations.suitability: Used for crime dramas, documentaries and period productions; TV, film and photography productions are accommodated with flexible hire options and on-site support.

locations.name: Pinewood Studios
locations.setting: Major studio complex west of London whose facilities include large sound stages, the vast 007 Stage, backlots and an underwater filming tank.
locations.known_for: No Time to Die, Star Wars: The Force Awakens
locations.facilities: 30 stages including the 007 Stage (59,092 sq ft, 5,490 m2, 12 m high, with a 91 x 22 m interior tank 2 m deep), an underwater stage with a 20 x 10 x 6 m tank of 1.2 million litres kept at 30 C, three backlots (Paddock Lot, North Lot) with a 32,000 sq ft water pad, workshops of 1,000 to 12,000 sq ft, production offices, hair and makeup rooms, six mixing theatres and 20 cutting rooms.
locations.suitability: Stages are hired individually or in combination; an Indie Film Hub keeps two stages for independent film, over 150 on-lot businesses supply equipment hire, motion capture and 3D scanning, and Diving Services UK manages the underwater stage. Canteen, bar, cinema and 24/7 security on the lot.
locations.logistics: Pinewood Road, Iver Heath: 10 miles from Heathrow, via M4 junction 5 or A40 junction 1; about 45 minutes from Baker Street by Underground to Uxbridge then 10 minutes by taxi, with a free shuttle bus to Uxbridge, Slough, Gerrards Cross and West Ruislip stations; on-site parking.

locations.name: Pontcysyllte Aqueduct
locations.setting: Cast iron canal trough of 1805 carried thirty eight metres above the Dee on nineteen stone piers, with a towpath crossing and a wooded valley below.
locations.suitability: The World Heritage Site partnership publishes visitor and access information for the aqueduct and canal corridor.

locations.name: Portland Port
locations.setting: Former Royal Navy base on Portland Harbour with deep water quays, breakwaters and forts, warehouses, dry dock, cranes and open hardstanding behind a secure gate.
locations.suitability: The port publishes a film and television page and offers quays, buildings and land to productions under controlled access.

locations.name: Portmeirion
locations.setting: Italianate village on the Gwynedd coast built by Clough Williams-Ellis between 1925 and 1975, with pastel-coloured buildings, a piazza and subtropical gardens.

locations.name: Portsmouth Historic Dockyard
locations.setting: Working Royal Navy dockyard and heritage site with historic warships, dry docks and Georgian storehouses along Portsmouth Harbour.

locations.name: Powderham Castle
locations.setting: Fortified manor of 1391 remodelled in Georgian and Victorian phases, with a rococo staircase hall, music room, chapel, stables and a deer park on the Exe estuary.
locations.suitability: The castle hires out its rooms, courtyard and grounds and takes location enquiries.

locations.name: Prime Studios
locations.setting: Film and TV production hub in Leeds with several sound stages, warehouse space, production offices and an on-site cinema, also home to a film school.
locations.known_for: Bank of Dave, The ABC Murders, Girlfriends, The Duke
locations.facilities: Studio 01: 2,394 sq ft (222.22 m2), 17 ft 4 in (5.30 m) high, drive-in access 15 ft 3 in (4.66 m), with an infinity cove. Studio 03: 1,100 sq ft with a 428 sq ft infinity wall, 12 ft 8 in (3.90 m) high, changing and dressing rooms with en-suite shower, Sony 4K and Dolby Atmos enabled cinema. Also office space on site and the Archive coffee house, bar and event space.
locations.logistics: 94-96 Kirkstall Road, Leeds LS3 1HD.

locations.name: Production Park
locations.setting: Studio complex in Wakefield with Yorkshire's first LED virtual production volume (over 3,000 panels), plus rehearsal studios, crew accommodation and dining space.
locations.facilities: Modular LED volume of 3,000+ panels, on-site crew and artist accommodation, multiple studios, production offices, dining and green rooms

locations.name: Pyramids Studios
locations.setting: A large studio campus on a former industrial site between Edinburgh and Glasgow, with two very large sound stages and extensive support office space.
locations.facilities: 2 stages totalling 105,000 sq ft (individual stages 45,000-60,500 sq ft), 22-32 ft clear height; 380,200 sq ft facility on a 93-acre campus; 80,000 sq ft of production office and support space plus 195,000 sq ft of additional leasable office space; 1,214 parking spaces; cafeteria and fitness centre; 120,000 sq ft expansion approved.
locations.logistics: Easter Inch Steadings, Bathgate EH48 2EH, between Edinburgh and Glasgow (own site).

locations.name: Racecourse Ground
locations.setting: Football stadium in Wrexham, north Wales, one of the oldest international football grounds still in use, with stands close to the pitch on all four sides.

locations.name: Rhondda Heritage Park
locations.setting: A former colliery in the Rhondda valley, South Wales, preserved with pithead buildings and winding gear as a mining heritage museum.

locations.name: Ribblehead Viaduct
locations.setting: 24-arch stone railway viaduct carrying the Settle to Carlisle line across open moorland in the Yorkshire Dales.

locations.name: Richmond Park
locations.setting: Former royal hunting park of 2,500 acres in south west London with ancient oaks, deer herds, ponds, walled plantations and long open grassland.
locations.known_for: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows, Into the Woods, Heat and Dust

locations.name: Rievaulx Abbey
locations.setting: Extensive ruined Cistercian abbey in a wooded North Yorkshire valley, its arches and undercroft used for fantasy, period drama and documentary filming.
locations.known_for: Transformers: The Last Knight, Gentleman Jack

locations.name: Riverside Museum
locations.setting: A Zaha Hadid designed transport museum where the Kelvin meets the Clyde in Glasgow, with a zigzag roofline, a recreated street and a tall ship moored outside.
locations.suitability: Photography, filming and sketching permitted under Glasgow Life's museum guidelines, with venue hire available

locations.name: Rivoli Ballroom
locations.setting: 1950s dance hall in Brockley with red velvet walls, chandeliers, booth seating and a sprung maple floor, one of the last intact ballrooms in London.
locations.known_for: Good Times, Lana Del Rey: Burning Desire

locations.name: Rosewood London
locations.setting: Hotel in the Edwardian Pearl Assurance building on High Holborn with a carriage archway, courtyard, Pavonazzo marble staircase and panelled function rooms.

locations.name: Roundhouse
locations.setting: Circular former railway engine shed in Camden turned performance venue, its exposed iron pillars and brickwork hired out for industrial-look filming.
locations.facilities: High-standard AV package, in-house technical team, Circle balcony seating 503

locations.name: Royal Albert Hall
locations.setting: Circular Victorian concert hall with a domed glass and iron roof, tiered galleries and a large stage, available for filming and photography by arrangement.
locations.known_for: The Man Who Knew Too Much, The King's Speech

locations.name: Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh
locations.setting: Seventy acre botanic garden a mile north of the centre, with Victorian palm houses, a modern glasshouse range, rock garden, arboretum and Georgian Inverleith House.
locations.suitability: The garden publishes a filming, photography and garden hire page for commercial shoots.

locations.name: Royal Gunpowder Mills
locations.setting: Former explosives works at Waltham Abbey with 21 listed buildings, canals, tramways, blast mounds and 175 acres of woodland closed to the public.

locations.name: Royal Highland Centre
locations.setting: A large showground and exhibition centre at Ingliston near Edinburgh Airport, with halls, arenas and outdoor space hired for events and productions.

locations.name: Royal Holloway, University of London
locations.setting: Victorian university campus at Egham centred on the ornate French Renaissance-style Founder's Building, with quadrangles, a chapel and a picture gallery.
locations.suitability: Filming location services are offered alongside event spaces, catering and accommodation (own site).

locations.name: Royal Hospital Chelsea
locations.setting: Wren designed home for army veterans with a Great Hall, chapel, panelled Long Wards, Figure Court and 66 acres of grounds running down to the Thames.

locations.name: Royal Pavilion
locations.setting: Regency seaside palace in Brighton with Indian domes outside and Chinese style interiors, a banqueting room, music room and great kitchen.
locations.suitability: General filming and photography permitted inside the Royal Pavilion, five venues offered to film makers

locations.name: Royal William Yard
locations.setting: Georgian naval victualling yard in Plymouth built of limestone and granite, with a brewhouse, bakery, cooperage, slate roofs, a gatehouse arch and its own harbour.
locations.suitability: The estate takes filming and event enquiries for its buildings, courtyards and quays.

locations.name: Ryedale Folk Museum
locations.setting: Open-air museum of relocated rural buildings at Hutton-le-Hole in the North York Moors, spanning Iron Age to 1950s interiors, hired out for filming.
locations.known_for: Death Comes to Pemberley, Hacker the Dog

locations.name: Salts Mill
locations.setting: Former Victorian textile mill in the Saltaire World Heritage village near Bradford, a vast stone and iron structure now used as galleries, shops and offices.

photo.author: The original uploader was Markj 87 at English Wikipedia.

locations.name: Sands Films Studio
locations.setting: A small riverside soundstage in a former Rotherhithe granary, combined with the long-running Sands Films costume and production house.
locations.facilities: One soundproofed stage with 50-seat theatre capacity, DMX LED lighting control, multi-camera HD recording (up to 5 remotely controlled cameras), Blackmagic Hyper Deck and MultiCAM recording, dressing rooms and live-streaming capability. No stage dimensions published.
locations.suitability: Own site describes it as suited to small and medium productions, interviews and web content recording; limited disabled access, no licensed bar.
locations.logistics: 82 St Marychurch Street, Rotherhithe, London SE16 4HZ (own site).

locations.name: Sea Containers London
locations.setting: Hotel in a 1970s office block on the South Bank with a copper clad lobby, riverside rooms, screening room and a roof terrace over the Thames.

locations.name: SEC Centre
locations.setting: Exhibition and conference centre on the Clyde in Glasgow, alongside the SSE Hydro concert arena, with large column-free halls used for events and filming.
locations.facilities: Five interconnected exhibition and event halls with a combined area of over 22,000 sq m.

locations.name: Segedunum Roman Fort
locations.setting: The excavated remains of a Roman fort at Wallsend marking the eastern end of Hadrian's Wall, with a reconstructed bathhouse, viewing tower and museum.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Severn Valley Railway
locations.setting: 16-mile heritage steam railway between Kidderminster and Bridgnorth with five preserved Victorian stations, engine sheds and rolling stock used for period rail scenes.
locations.known_for: 28 Days Later, Enola Holmes, The Chronicles of Narnia, Goodnight Mister Tom

locations.name: Shepperton Studios
locations.setting: A historic Thames-side studio complex with 31 stages across two backlots, a 17th-century manor house and river and woodland grounds for filming.
locations.known_for: Oliver!, Alien, Gandhi, Captain America: The First Avenger
locations.facilities: 31 stages plus 2 large backlots; workshops from 600 to 14,000 sq ft, some with mezzanines; production offices, hair and makeup rooms (1-6 positions), wardrobe and dressing rooms with en-suite bathrooms; 9 mixing theatres and 20 cutting rooms; Littleton House (17th-century) and the River Ash and woodland grounds available as additional filming locations.
locations.suitability: Pinewood Group states the lot supports large-scale stage and backlot productions alongside on-site post-production.
locations.logistics: The studios run a free shuttle bus between Shepperton Studios, Shepperton station and Staines station, Monday to Friday excluding bank holidays, for staff, tenants, crew and visitors. Nearest mainline stations are Staines, Ashford or Shepperton; trains from London Waterloo call at Feltham and Staines, from where a taxi takes around 15 minutes, 10 minutes from Ashford and around 5 minutes from Shepperton. Nearest Underground stations are Hatton Cross and Heathrow; taxis from Heathrow Airport take 20 to 25 minutes. The site has 12 acres of backlot.

locations.name: Shepton Mallet Prison
locations.setting: Former English prison dating to 1610, closed in 2013, with cell wings, exercise yards and a gatehouse now hired as an events and filming venue.

locations.name: Shinfield Studios
locations.setting: A large new-build studio campus south of Reading, now operated as Shadowbox Studios Shinfield, with 18 stages up to 41,000 sq ft and a hard-standing backlot.
locations.price_note: Up to 25% UK tax credit available for qualifying production expenditure (own site).
locations.facilities: 18 soundproofed, air-conditioned stages from 17,250 to 41,000 sq ft; largest stages 3 and 4 at 41,000 sq ft with 50 ft working height, smallest stages 15 and 16 at 17,250 sq ft with 36 ft height; 430,000 sq ft of stage space and 270,000 sq ft of support space; 125,000+ sq ft of office space across 4 buildings; 38 workshops (A-J), 2,500 to 12,050 sq ft; 9-acre hard-standing backlot.
locations.logistics: Address: South Avenue, Shinfield, Reading RG2 9LH (own site).

locations.name: Shrewsbury Prison
locations.setting: A closed Victorian prison on The Dana in Shrewsbury, with wings, cells and exercise yards intact from its use until 2013.
locations.suitability: Production and film location hire listed as a dedicated service alongside tours and ghost events

locations.name: Silverstone Circuit
locations.setting: A motor racing circuit on a former airfield in Northamptonshire, with grandstands, pit garages and a test track hired for motoring productions.

locations.name: Sky Studios Elstree
locations.setting: A newly built studio campus in Elstree and Borehamwood with twelve large-format sound stages and on-site production offices and workshops.
locations.facilities: 12 sound stages ranging from 10,000 to 40,000 sq ft with a minimum 40 ft height clearance; workshops on ground and mezzanine floors plus two larger construction, SFX, props and costume workshop buildings across the road; production office space, parking and on-site catering.
locations.logistics: Located in Elstree and Borehamwood, Hertfordshire, described by the operator as an easy commute from central London.

locations.name: Slieve Donard Resort and Spa
locations.setting: Red brick railway hotel of 1897 on the beach at Newcastle, with a ballroom, panelled lounges, long corridors and the Mourne Mountains directly behind.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes a meetings and events page listing its ballroom and function rooms.

locations.name: Snape Maltings
locations.setting: Former Victorian malting complex on the River Alde, its brick maltings and kilns converted into a concert hall, galleries and shops.

locations.name: Somerset House
locations.setting: Neoclassical courtyard building on the Strand with a fountain court and river terrace, hired for events and productions in central London.
locations.facilities: Multiple spaces for hire: the Edmond J. Safra Fountain Court (3,000 capacity), Embankment Galleries (800), River Terrace (500), West Wing (500), Portico Rooms/Seamen's Hall/Lightwells & Deadhouse (200 each), Navy Board Rooms (100) and Screening Room (70).

locations.name: SouthGate Bath
locations.setting: Open air shopping quarter of 2010 next to Bath Spa station, built in Bath stone with modern shopfronts, colonnades, a public square and a multi storey car park.
locations.suitability: Listed in the Bath Film Office location database, which handles filming requests in the city.

locations.name: Southwold Pier
locations.setting: Traditional seaside pier rebuilt in the 2000s on its Edwardian footings, with a pavilion, amusement arcade and end-of-pier walkway over the North Sea.

locations.name: Space Studios Manchester
locations.setting: Purpose-built film and TV production complex in Beswick, Manchester, with 760,000 sq ft of space including a 30,000 sq ft main stage, offices, workshops and unit base parking.
locations.facilities: Six dry-hire stages: Stage 1 11,194 sq ft (30 ft), Stage 2 10,669 sq ft (30 ft), Stage 3 10,096 sq ft (21.9 ft), Stage 4 10,150 sq ft (21.9 ft), Stage 5 8,991 sq ft (21.9 ft), Stage 6 29,892 sq ft (40 ft). 760,000 sq ft of production space in total, 158,000 sq ft of unit base parking, plus production offices, workshops, prop stores and dressing rooms.
locations.suitability: Stages are let dry hire and were purpose-built for film, high-end TV and commercial filming. Support space is also dry hire and can be used as offices, workshops, costume, supporting-artist holding or prop storage.
locations.logistics: 10 minutes from Manchester city centre, 2 hours to London by train, with an international airport nearby serving over 200 destinations. Dedicated external space for builds, unit base, parking and logistics.

locations.name: SS Great Britain
locations.setting: Preserved Victorian iron-hulled steamship in her original dry dock in Bristol, with restored decks, engine room and dockside museum buildings.

locations.name: SS Nomadic
locations.setting: Restored 1911 tender ship in Belfast's Hamilton Dock, the last remaining vessel of the White Star Line, moored beside Titanic Belfast as a museum ship.

locations.name: St Davids Bishop's Palace
locations.setting: Ruined 14th-century bishop's palace beside St Davids Cathedral in Pembrokeshire, with a great hall, arcaded parapets and undercrofts, available for filming and exhibitions.

locations.name: St Fagans National Museum of History
locations.setting: Open air museum in a hundred acre park west of Cardiff with more than forty re-erected Welsh buildings, from medieval church and farmhouses to a row of ironworkers cottages and a working mill.
locations.suitability: Amgueddfa Cymru offers venue hire and handles filming enquiries at the site.

locations.name: St George's Bristol
locations.setting: A deconsecrated Georgian church on Brandon Hill in Bristol converted into a concert hall, its columned interior hired for recordings, filming and events.

locations.name: St George's Market
locations.setting: Late Victorian covered market hall in Belfast, a red brick and steel structure with market stalls, used for markets, events and filming when not trading.

locations.name: St John's Gardens, Manchester
locations.setting: Small public garden square off Quay Street in central Manchester, laid out in 1932 on the site of a former church and graveyard, used for quieter scenes near the city centre.
locations.known_for: Domino Day, Cobra, Fresh Meat, Age Before Beauty

locations.name: St Mary's Guildhall
locations.setting: Fourteenth century guildhall next to Coventry's ruined cathedral, with a great hall under an angel roof, medieval tapestry, undercroft kitchen and stone court.
locations.suitability: The guildhall is hired out for events and takes filming enquiries through the city council.

locations.name: St Pancras Renaissance London Hotel
locations.setting: Gilbert Scott's Gothic revival Midland Grand at St Pancras station, with the Grand Staircase, vaulted corridors, ballroom and a red brick clock tower facade.
locations.known_for: Batman Begins, The Secret Garden, Spice Girls: Wannabe

locations.name: St Paul's Cathedral
locations.setting: Working Anglican cathedral in the City of London with Wren's dome, geometric staircase and west steps, hired for feature and TV filming through its press office.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter, Sherlock Holmes, Mary Poppins Returns, Mission: Impossible - Fallout, Paddington 2, Wonka, The Diplomat

locations.name: Standedge Tunnel
locations.setting: Britain's longest, deepest and highest canal tunnel, cut through the Pennines at Marsden on the Huddersfield Narrow Canal, with a visitor centre and boat trips into the tunnel, open for filming under Canal and River Trust permit.

locations.name: Studio Ulster
locations.setting: A dedicated virtual production facility at Belfast Harbour Studios, with in-camera VFX stages, an LED motion-capture stage and a CoSTAR screen lab.
locations.facilities: VP Stage 1: 12,750 sq ft, 55 ft to steel, NantStudios Dynamic Volume with nine configurable LED walls and five motorised ceiling pods. VP Stage 2: 4,600 sq ft, 55 ft to steel, curved LED wall (ROE 2.2 pixel pitch) and LED ceiling. VP Stage 3 / CoSTAR Screen Lab: 2,240 sq ft, 13 ft height, LED ceiling and floor. Motion Capture Stage: 2,240 sq ft, 55 ft to steel, overhead truss rigging for up to six performers. Screening room with Dolby-certified 7.1 sound and 4.6K laser projection.
locations.logistics: Located at Belfast Harbour Studios, Belfast (own site).

locations.name: Sutton Scarsdale Hall
locations.setting: Roofless shell of a Georgian country mansion on a Derbyshire hillside, its bare facades and empty window openings used as a ruined-grandeur filming backdrop.
locations.known_for: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice

locations.name: Swansea Arena
locations.setting: Arena of 2021 on the Swansea waterfront seating around three and a half thousand, with a wrapped LED facade, flat floor mode and a raised public plaza outside.
locations.suitability: The arena takes hire enquiries for events through its own site.

locations.name: SWG3
locations.setting: A converted warehouse and former whisky bond in Glasgow's Yorkhill, now a multi room venue used for music, events and film and television production.

locations.name: Syon Park
locations.setting: Ducal house in west London with Robert Adam state rooms, a great conservatory, stable block and 200 acres of parkland and water meadow beside the Thames.
locations.known_for: Gosford Park, Killing Eve, Belgravia, Bridgerton

locations.name: Tanfield Railway
locations.setting: Preserved colliery line on a 1725 waggonway route, with the Causey Arch, Marley Hill engine shed of 1854, wooden platforms and industrial tank engines.
locations.suitability: The railway publishes a television and film venue hire page for stations, sheds and trains.

locations.name: Tapton Masonic Hall
locations.setting: Grade II listed former family home in Sheffield turned Masonic hall, with a stairway, library, reception rooms, bar and a period dance floor room for hire.

locations.name: The Bluecoat
locations.setting: Britain's oldest surviving purpose-built arts centre, a Grade I listed early Georgian charity school building in central Liverpool with galleries, a courtyard and function rooms.

locations.name: The Bottle Yard Studios
locations.setting: Council-run studio complex on the site of a former sherry bottling plant in south Bristol, with eleven sound stages across two sites and a rooftop solar array.
locations.known_for: Poldark, Wolf Hall, Broadchurch series 3, The Pale Horse, Rivals, Hellboy
locations.facilities: 11 BAFTA albert-accredited stages over two sites. Studios 1-8 at the original TBY1 site range up to 22,000 sq ft and include a 5,000 sq ft green screen studio. TBY2 premium soundstages: Studio 9 20,000 sq ft, Studio 10 16,500 sq ft, Studio 11 7,000 sq ft, fully soundproofed with clear-span build space. Production Village with 17 artist dressing and green rooms, furnished make-up and wardrobe facilities and a supporting artist holding room; production offices; site-wide 3GB internet with free guest wifi and structured cabling in all offices.
locations.suitability: All 11 stages are BAFTA albert-accredited and available for long and short term hire.
locations.logistics: 100 parking spaces on a first-come-first-served basis, with special arrangements for technical vehicles needing access to build spaces; a 5 mph site speed limit applies. 24/7 Mitie security, full perimeter fence with CCTV, internal CCTV and PAC access control.

locations.name: The Burrell Collection
locations.setting: Museum of 1983 set in Pollok Country Park, rebuilt in 2022, with glazed galleries facing woodland, sandstone walls and reconstructed medieval doorways inside.
locations.suitability: Glasgow Life offers the building for venue hire.

locations.name: The Charterhouse
locations.setting: Former Carthusian monastery and Tudor mansion turned almshouse near Smithfield, its Great Hall, cloister, chapel and square hired for period filming around resident life.

locations.name: The Custard Factory
locations.setting: Former Bird's custard works in Digbeth turned into studios and shops, with brick factory blocks, iron walkways, loading bays, painted yards and canal frontage.
locations.suitability: The estate hires out yards, units and courtyards for events and shoots.

locations.name: The Depot
locations.setting: Purpose-built studio at Liverpool Innovation Park with two 20,000 sq ft stages, production offices, workshops and a 1.7-acre unit base with parking for 200 vehicles.
locations.known_for: Hollyoaks, The Batman, Fantastic Beasts, Peaky Blinders, House of Guinness
locations.facilities: Two purpose-built stages, Depot 01 and Depot 02, each 20,000 sq ft, 195 ft (60 m) long by 96 ft (30 m) wide and 39 ft (12 m) high, with 400 amps of power in three power clusters including SP&N, acoustic ratings of 48 dB (ceiling) and 42 dB (walls), two 5 x 4 m roller shutters and six acoustically treated doors each. Over 300,000 sq ft of production space in total including offices, boardrooms and workshops. Production offices at the adjacent Liverpool Innovation Park range up to 25,000 sq ft with broadband up to 1 GB/s, a cafe and a gym.
locations.logistics: Close to Liverpool city centre with access to road, rail and international airports. On-site unit base spanning 1.7 acres, fully fenced with 24/7 monitored CCTV, and parking for up to 200 vehicles.

locations.name: The Glasshouse International Centre for Music
locations.setting: Foster designed concert building of 2004 on the Gateshead quayside, with a curved glass and steel shell, two halls, a rehearsal drum and a long river facing concourse.
locations.suitability: The building publishes a conference and events hire section covering halls and concourse.

locations.name: The Grand Brighton
locations.setting: Victorian seafront hotel of 1864 with a white stucco facade, central atrium staircase, ballroom and a former library with marble pillars.

locations.name: The Grand Hotel Birmingham
locations.setting: Restored 1879 hotel on Colmore Row with a French Renaissance facade, the gilded Grand Ballroom, marble lobby and a first floor suite of period reception rooms.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes a meetings and events section covering the ballroom and private rooms.

locations.name: The Grange, Northington
locations.setting: Greek Revival country house shell near Northington in Hampshire, its giant portico and roofless interior used as a grand filming backdrop.

locations.name: The Guildhall
locations.setting: Neo Gothic civic hall of 1890 beside the city walls, with a clock tower, stained glass windows across the main hall, council chamber and stone stairways.
locations.suitability: The council lets rooms in the building and handles filming requests for its civic venues.

locations.name: The Historic Dockyard Chatham
locations.setting: 80-acre former Royal Navy dockyard on the Medway with Georgian ropewalks, covered slips, dry docks and historic ships used as period maritime backdrops.
locations.suitability: Both interior and exterior locations are offered, including No. 3 Slip, the Tarred Yarn Store, the Ropery exterior, Anchor Wharf, and cobbled Victorian streets, suited to period productions.

locations.name: The Landmark London
locations.setting: Former Great Central Hotel at Marylebone station with a glass roofed eight storey atrium, palm filled winter garden, ballroom and Victorian brick exterior.

locations.name: The Langham, London
locations.setting: Victorian grand hotel opposite Broadcasting House with a colonnaded Palm Court, ballroom, marble lobby and a long facade on Portland Place.
locations.known_for: Wonderland, Garfield: A Tail of Two Kitties, Burnt

locations.name: The MAC
locations.setting: Arts centre of 2012 in the Cathedral Quarter with two theatres, three galleries, a tall brick and basalt atrium and open stairways over several levels.
locations.suitability: The building's theatres, galleries and public spaces are available for hire.

locations.name: The Ned
locations.setting: Hotel and club in the former Midland Bank headquarters by Lutyens in the City, with a banking hall of green marble columns, vaults, offices and a roof pool.

locations.name: The Northern Studios
locations.setting: Teesside University production facility in Hartlepool with a sound stage, green screen, virtual production volume, edit suites and workshop space.
locations.suitability: The studios take bookings from productions for stage, virtual production and post facilities.

locations.name: The O2 Belfast
locations.setting: An indoor arena in the Odyssey complex on Belfast's Queen's Quay, home to ice hockey and concerts, with a bowl and function spaces for hire.

locations.name: The Old Truman Brewery
locations.setting: Former East End brewery complex on Brick Lane with converted vat rooms, yards and warehouse floors hired as event and shoot space.

locations.name: The Piece Hall
locations.setting: Grade I listed 18th century cloth hall in Halifax, a colonnaded stone quadrangle of former merchants' rooms around a large open square, now shops, bars and an events space.

locations.name: The Royal Crescent Hotel and Spa
locations.setting: Hotel occupying two houses at the centre of Bath's Royal Crescent, with Georgian drawing rooms, a rear garden, a coach house and a spa in the former stable block.
locations.suitability: The hotel publishes a meetings and events page, and the Royal Crescent is listed in the Bath Film Office location database.

locations.name: The Savoy
locations.setting: Riverside hotel on the Strand with an art deco entrance court, the American Bar, a mirrored ballroom, Thames facing suites and Edwardian dining rooms.

photo.author: Photo by CVB, edited and cropped by Cart

locations.name: The Sharp Project
locations.setting: A converted industrial estate in north Manchester built as television and digital production studios, with offices, a yard and outdoor space for crews and vehicles.
locations.facilities: 200,000 sq ft refurbished warehouse campus. Stage One is a 3,700 sq ft production space with room for up to 110 people in theatre-style seating, wifi, a green room and 3-phase power. The Campus, the central communal space, seats up to 200 and has a licensed bar, wifi and 3-phase power. Meeting rooms (boardroom up to 20, theatre up to 20), in-house catering team and on-site tenants.

locations.name: The Signet Library
locations.setting: Neoclassical law library beside St Giles with a colonnaded upper hall, painted cupola, galleries of leather bound books and a lower library used for events.
locations.suitability: The library is hired out for events and photography as well as private functions.

locations.name: The Tank Museum
locations.setting: Military vehicle museum on the Bovington army camp with several hundred tanks and armoured vehicles, indoor halls and outdoor arena space.

locations.name: Thermae Bath Spa
locations.setting: Spa built around Bath's hot springs, joining the Georgian Cross Bath and Hot Bath to a glass and stone New Royal Bath with a rooftop pool over the city.
locations.suitability: Listed in the Bath Film Office location database; the spa also hires its historic baths for private use.

locations.name: Thetford Forest
locations.setting: England's largest lowland pine forest, spanning the Norfolk-Suffolk border, with rides and clearings bookable for filming through Forestry England's national team.

locations.name: Thinktank, Birmingham Science Museum
locations.setting: A science museum at Millennium Point in Birmingham with galleries of steam engines, vehicles and interactive exhibits across four floors, available for venue hire.

locations.name: Three Mills Studios
locations.setting: An East London production campus on an old mill island, with around a dozen stages, rehearsal rooms and 130-plus production offices near the 2012 Olympic Park.
locations.facilities: 75,000 sq ft of stage space across stages 4-15, plus rehearsal spaces (stages 1-2, rehearsal rooms 1-5, stage 10 A/B/C); 130+ offices and ancillary spaces; unit base and parking; screening room and on-site cafe.
locations.logistics: Address: Three Mill Lane, London E3 3DU (own site).

locations.name: Tilbury Fort
locations.setting: 17th-century artillery fort guarding the Thames Estuary near Tilbury Docks, its moated ramparts and parade ground used for war and period filming.
locations.known_for: Wonder Woman, Tulip Fever, SS-GB, Taboo

locations.name: Titanic Belfast
locations.setting: A six floor angular aluminium clad museum on the Belfast slipway where the Titanic was built, with galleries and function spaces hired for events.
locations.logistics: Easy access to public transport and car parking; walking distance from Belfast city centre and around 5-10 minutes by car from George Best Belfast City Airport.

locations.name: Tobacco Dock
locations.setting: A Grade I listed early nineteenth century dock warehouse in Wapping, with exposed brick vaults and cast iron columns hired as an events space.
locations.facilities: 13 event spaces including the Great Gallery, Little Gallery, Dock Gallery, Quayside areas, Vaults and meeting suites, in a Grade I listed building dating from 1812. The venue reports around 2,000,000 visitors and 1,500 events a year across the site.
locations.logistics: Between Wapping and Shadwell; Shadwell station about 5 minutes' walk, Wapping station about 6 minutes' walk; served by London Overground, DLR and bus routes 100 and D3.

locations.name: Tollcross International Swimming Centre
locations.setting: Competition swimming venue with a ten lane fifty metre pool, diving and training pools, spectator seating and modern changing halls behind a red sandstone frontage.
locations.suitability: Glasgow Life lists the centre for venue hire.

locations.name: Tollymore Forest Park
locations.setting: Six hundred hectare forest park at the foot of the Mournes with mixed conifer and broadleaf woodland, the Shimna river, stone bridges, follies and gate arches.
locations.suitability: The forest is managed by the Forest Service, which handles filming permissions on its estate.

locations.name: Tower Bridge
locations.setting: Bascule and suspension bridge over the Thames with twin Victorian Gothic towers and a glass-floored high-level walkway overlooking the city.
locations.known_for: The Mummy Returns, Spider-Man: Far From Home
locations.facilities: Interior filming spaces include the High-Level Walkways (level 5), the North and South Towers and the Engine Rooms; a Film Liaison team, on-site security and on-site catering are available.
locations.suitability: Filming and photography applications (inside the attraction, on the bridge pavements, on Tower Bridge Road, or in the airspace around the bridge) are made through the FilmApp portal and need at least 5 working days to process. Drones are strictly prohibited within a 50m perimeter for the general public; commercial drone requests are considered case by case with safety protocols. Post-production additions implying the Bridge endorses a brand are not supported. Photography of the Bridge from public space is allowed without permission under Freedom of Panorama.

locations.name: Trades Hall of Glasgow
locations.setting: Robert Adam designed 18th century guild hall in central Glasgow, with a domed saloon and panelled function rooms still used by the city's trade incorporations.

locations.name: Tretower Court and Castle
locations.setting: Fortified 15th-century manor house beside a Norman round tower in the Brecon Beacons, with a restored great hall and period garden, available for filming.

locations.name: Trinity Buoy Wharf
locations.setting: Former lighthouse testing wharf at the mouth of the River Lea, with a lightship, converted shipping-container studios and dockside sheds.

locations.name: Troubadour Meridian Water Studios
locations.setting: A modern north London studio built beside the Meridian Water rail interchange, with three large-format sound stages, production hubs and workshops.
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 20,914 sq ft (1,943 sq m), 166.6 x 125.3 ft, 65.6 ft (20 m) apex height. Stage 2: 11,216 sq ft (1,042 sq m), 141.4 x 79 ft, 57.7 ft (17.6 m) apex height. Stage 3: 8,213 sq ft (763 sq m), 116.1 x 70.5 ft, 48.8 ft (14.9 m) apex height. All stages have sealed concrete floors, acoustic black drapes, high-load ceilings, ground-floor rigging and dock doors. Production hubs with open-plan offices, meeting rooms, green rooms and cafe; two multi-purpose workshops; furnished production blocks with hair/makeup and wardrobe space.
locations.logistics: Off the North Circular in Enfield, near Meridian Water and Tottenham Hale stations; 12 miles to London City Airport, 25 to Heathrow (own site).

locations.name: Troxy
locations.setting: A former 1930s cinema in Limehouse converted into an events venue, its art deco auditorium and foyers hired for filming, television and live shows.
locations.facilities: State-of-the-art AV facilities; the art deco building opened in 1933 and underwent a GBP 1.5 million refurbishment.
locations.logistics: About 15 minutes from London Waterloo station, in east London.

locations.name: Twickenham Studios
locations.setting: A century-old riverside studio in south-west London combining three sound stages with post-production and, since 2025, a virtual production volume.
locations.known_for: Enola Holmes 3, Trigger Point (series 2), Masters of the Universe, His Dark Materials
locations.facilities: Stage 1: 7,552 sq ft (701 sq m), 118 x 64 x 34 ft. Stage 2: 2,000 sq ft (186 sq m), 50 x 40 x 23 ft. Stage 3: 5,551 sq ft (515 sq m), 93 x 60 x 24 ft, dry-hire space reduced by a virtual production screen. Three stages totalling 15,100 sq ft. Production offices, green rooms and star apartments, dressing rooms with private star entrance, art department, costume store and prop storage, hair and makeup, on-site parking.
locations.logistics: Address: The Barons, London TW1 2AW (own site).

locations.name: Two Temple Place
locations.setting: Neo-Gothic mansion built for William Waldorf Astor beside the Thames, with a galleried great hall and carved wood interiors offered for filming.
locations.suitability: Offers 'Filming & Photoshoots' as part of its venue hire service; pricing, capacities and floorplans are provided by the venue hire team on request.

locations.name: Ulster Folk Museum
locations.setting: Open-air museum at Cultra near Belfast with relocated cottages, shops, a meeting house and cobbled streets recreating rural and small-town Ulster life, hired out for filming.

locations.name: Ulster Museum
locations.setting: National museum at the edge of the Botanic Gardens, joining an Edwardian classical block to a brutalist concrete extension of 1972 with cantilevered galleries and a top lit atrium.
locations.suitability: National Museums NI publishes a venue hire page and handles filming enquiries.

locations.name: Ulster Transport Museum
locations.setting: A National Museums NI transport museum at Cultra on Belfast Lough, with halls of trains, cars and aircraft beside the adjoining Ulster Folk Museum's historic buildings.

locations.name: Union Chapel
locations.setting: A working Victorian Gothic chapel in Islington that doubles as a music venue, its galleried octagonal interior hired for filming and concerts.

locations.name: University College, Oxford
locations.setting: Oxford's oldest college, fronting the High Street with a 17th-century quadrangle and chapel, available for filming during university vacations with the Domestic Bursar's permission.

locations.name: University of Leeds
locations.setting: Redbrick campus in central Leeds with Gothic, Art Deco and modern buildings around the Parkinson Building, available for external filming through the university press office.

locations.name: University of Salford
locations.setting: A university campus beside MediaCityUK on Salford Quays, with lecture theatres, media production studios and modern teaching buildings.

locations.name: Usher Hall
locations.setting: Category A-listed Edwardian concert hall in Edinburgh seating up to 2,200, council-owned and hired out for conferences, concerts and film shoots.

locations.name: Utilita Arena Birmingham
locations.setting: Indoor arena in central Birmingham seating several thousand, used for concerts, sport and other large events at the NEC Group's city centre site.

locations.name: V&A Dundee
locations.setting: Waterfront design museum on the Dundee riverside with a stacked-stone exterior by architect Kengo Kuma, opened in 2018 beside the historic ship RRS Discovery.

locations.name: Verdant Works
locations.setting: A restored nineteenth century jute mill in Dundee with original machinery and mill buildings, run as a museum of the city's textile industry.

locations.name: Versa Leeds Studios
locations.setting: Multi-stage production facility on Whitehall Road, Leeds, opened 2020, with four stages up to 27,000 sq ft, production offices, workshops and on-site parking.
locations.known_for: Bodies, Boat Story, Platform 7, Marvel's Secret Invasion
locations.facilities: Over 140,000 sq ft of production space with four sound stages: Stage 1 1,487 sq m (16,004 sq ft), 8.496 m (27.87 ft) high; Stage 2 1,167 sq m (12,558 sq ft), 8.258 m (27.09 ft); Stage 3 972 sq m (10,461.5 sq ft), 8.141 m (26.70 ft); Stage 4 2,523 sq m (27,162 sq ft), 8.276 m (27.15 ft). Backlot, workshops, production office space and car parking on site.
locations.logistics: In Leeds city centre, with an on-site backlot and car park.

locations.name: Victoria Baths
locations.setting: Disused Edwardian public baths in Manchester with three original pools, a Turkish suite and stained glass, hired as a filming location since its closure in 1993.

locations.name: Victoria Leeds
locations.setting: Restored Victorian shopping arcade in Leeds combining the 1990 Victoria Quarter and 2016 Victoria Gate, with Britain's largest stained-glass ceiling and mosaic floors.

locations.name: W5
locations.setting: An interactive science discovery centre inside the Odyssey complex on Belfast's Queen's Quay, with exhibition floors and workshop spaces.

locations.name: Wales Millennium Centre
locations.setting: Steel and slate clad performing arts centre on Cardiff Bay, with a main theatre, studio spaces and a bronze-lettered curved facade.

locations.name: Wardpark Film and Television Studios
locations.setting: Scotland's fully integrated film studio complex at Cumbernauld, with five sound stages and on-site accommodation for cast and crew.
locations.facilities: A Stage 13,000 sq ft x 40 ft; B Stage 12,000 sq ft x 21 ft; C Stage 11,500 sq ft x 26 ft; D Stage 11,500 sq ft x 26 ft; E Stage 5,000 sq ft x 18 ft. 300 parking spaces, on-site accommodation, 24/7 security.
locations.logistics: Cumbernauld, North Lanarkshire, 2 minutes to Cumbernauld Airport and on the M80 (own site).

locations.name: Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden
locations.setting: A former aerodrome converted into one of Europe's largest film studios, with lettered and numbered stages, a large water tank and an extensive backlot.
locations.known_for: Harry Potter film series, GoldenEye, Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace, The Dark Knight
locations.facilities: 350,000 sq ft of sound stages across lettered stages (A to V) and numbered stages (1 to 11); Europe's largest interior water tank; a backlot of more than 55 acres; dedicated mill and multi-function workshop buildings; executive, production and art department offices; on-site set lighting, rigging and De Lane Lea sound post-production.
locations.logistics: Address: Warner Drive, Leavesden, Hertfordshire, WD25 7LP.

locations.name: Watercress Line
locations.setting: Preserved standard gauge railway between Alresford and Alton with restored country stations, a locomotive shed, steam engines and ten miles of track.

locations.name: Waverley Abbey
locations.setting: Ruined 12th-century Cistercian abbey beside the River Wey in Surrey, its stone arches and open meadow setting used as a fantasy and period backdrop.
locations.known_for: Into the Woods, The Huntsman: Winter's War, The Mummy, The Witcher

locations.name: Weald and Downland Living Museum
locations.setting: 40-acre open-air museum near Chichester with 50 rescued and rebuilt historic buildings from the 13th to 19th centuries and a reconstructed Saxon hall, used for period film and TV interiors and exteriors.
locations.known_for: The Repair Shop, Good Omens, The Hollow Crown: Henry VI Part II

locations.name: Wembley Stadium
locations.setting: National stadium seating 90,000 under a steel arch, with pitch, players tunnel, dressing rooms, wide concourses and hospitality suites available outside the event calendar.

locations.name: Wentworth Woodhouse
locations.setting: Country house near Rotherham with one of the longest facades in Europe, a marble saloon, state rooms, service corridors, stables and parkland.
locations.suitability: Film and TV hire, rooms can stand in for a Georgian manor or a Victorian street

locations.name: West London Film Studios
locations.setting: A two-site studio complex in Hayes with ten stages in total, including the UK's only permanent standing hospital set.
locations.known_for: Ted Lasso, Killing Eve, The Father, Venom: The Last Dance, Good Omens, Bohemian Rhapsody, The Imitation Game
locations.facilities: 10 stages across two sites, all with drive-in access. Springfield Road: Stage 1 6,240 sq ft, Stage 2 5,300 sq ft, Stage 3 7,100 sq ft, Stage 5 7,100 sq ft, Stage 6 9,400 sq ft (all 24 ft high), Stages 4A 1,291 sq ft, 4B 1,300 sq ft and 4C 1,700 sq ft (20 ft high). Parkside: Stages 7 and 9 13,605 sq ft each, Stages 8 and 10 11,302 sq ft each, all 40 ft high. Over 70 office rooms, a meeting/conference room seating up to 60, canteen seating up to 100, laundry room, post room, scissor lift on request and site-wide wifi.
locations.logistics: Springfield Road, Hayes UB4 0RG (own site).

locations.name: Westonbirt, The National Arboretum
locations.setting: A Forestry England arboretum in Gloucestershire with thousands of labelled trees, formal avenues and a treetop walkway.

locations.name: Wharram Percy Deserted Medieval Village
locations.setting: Earthwork remains of a deserted medieval village in a secluded Yorkshire Wolds valley, with a ruined church, used as a rural period-filming location.

locations.name: Whitby Abbey
locations.setting: Ruined Benedictine abbey on Whitby's East Cliff above the North Sea, its Gothic skeleton and headstone-lined churchyard used for gothic and period drama.

locations.name: Wilton's Music Hall
locations.setting: Surviving Victorian music hall in Wapping with a barley-twist column auditorium and worn brick backstage areas, hired for filming and photography.
locations.facilities: Victorian rooms and spaces including the main stairway, the Cocktail Bar and the main Hall, plus the auditorium, Mahogany Bar and The Study. On-site production offices, dressing rooms and wardrobe facilities can be hired, with technical staff able to advise on power and setup; additional crew is available for an extra charge.

locations.name: Winchester Cathedral
locations.setting: Norman and Gothic cathedral with the longest medieval nave in Europe, a crypt that floods in winter, cloister ruins and a walled close.

locations.name: Wingfield Manor
locations.setting: Ruined 15th-century fortified manor house in Derbyshire, once used to hold Mary, Queen of Scots, its great hall and undercroft used for period filming.

locations.name: Winter Gardens Blackpool
locations.setting: A Victorian entertainment complex in Blackpool covering almost five acres, with the domed Spanish Hall, an opera house and function rooms hired for events.
locations.facilities: 4.9 acres of connected space across multiple linked venues including the Opera House and Spanish Hall, with on-site cafes, bars and restaurants.

locations.name: Wolf Studios Wales
locations.setting: A producer-built Cardiff studio complex of seven sound-treated stages and a serviced backlot, run by the production company Bad Wolf.
locations.known_for: Doctor Who, His Dark Materials, A Discovery of Witches, Industry
locations.facilities: 7 stages totalling 137,000 sq ft: Stage 1 21,661 sq ft (32-41 ft); Stage 2 14,531 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 3 14,531 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 4 27,000 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 5 20,000 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 6 24,497 sq ft, 57.5 ft (tallest stage); Stage 7 15,000 sq ft (32-41 ft). All stages A-rated for sound with scene docks 13 x 16.4 ft. 69,000 sq ft serviced backlot; 13 edit suites; 2 costume workshops; flexible offices; props storage and fabrication.
locations.logistics: 2 miles from Cardiff Central Station, 30 minutes from Cardiff Airport, under 2 hours by train from London Paddington (own site).

locations.name: Wolfson College, Oxford
locations.setting: 1970s Oxford college on the banks of the Cherwell with modernist buildings and riverside gardens, available for filming with the events office's permission.

locations.name: Wollaton Hall
locations.setting: Elizabethan prodigy house of 1588 on a hill in Nottingham, with a stone screen facade, hall under a clerestory prospect room, cellars and a five hundred acre deer park.
locations.suitability: The hall publishes a hire page covering rooms, courtyard and park, including filming.

locations.name: Woodhorn Museum
locations.setting: A former colliery near Ashington in Northumberland with preserved pithead buildings, a winding engine and headstocks, run as a mining heritage museum.
locations.suitability: Part of the North East Museums group, which states it welcomes film, television and photography companies to hire its venues

locations.name: Wookey Hole
locations.setting: A show cave complex in the Mendip Hills near Wells, with limestone chambers, an underground river and an attached Victorian paper mill.

locations.name: Woolwich Works
locations.setting: Arts venue in five restored Royal Arsenal munitions buildings in south east London, with brick halls, exposed roof trusses, rehearsal rooms and open yards.

locations.name: Wrest Park
locations.setting: Country house near Silsoe built in French chateau style, set within formal gardens with canals, pavilions and woodland walks.

locations.name: Wrotham Park
locations.setting: Palladian house of 1754 north of Barnet with a portico front, marble hall, panelled rooms and 2,500 acres of park, kept for private hire and filming.
locations.logistics: About 12 miles from central London, inside the M25
